# Attribution

Every indicator here is a port of a Pine Script study written by someone else.
This file records which upstream work each port came from and the licence it
inherits. Each `.js` file repeats the same three facts in its own header, and
that header is authoritative for that file.

Nothing here is an original strategy. The work in this repository is the
translation onto the openalgo-charts descriptor contract: the calculation, the
plots, the inputs and the hooks. The ideas, formulas and parameter choices
belong to the authors below.

## Upstream projects

| Upstream | Author | Licence | Ports here |
|---|---|---|---:|
| [mihakralj/pinescript](https://github.com/mihakralj/pinescript) | mihakralj | MIT | 408 |
| [everget/tradingview-pinescript-indicators](https://github.com/everget/tradingview-pinescript-indicators) | Alex Orekhov (everget) | GPL-3.0 | 57 |
| [ArunKBhaskar/PineScript](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript) | Arun K Bhaskar | MPL-2.0 | 24 |
| [sukesan7/meridian-indicators](https://github.com/sukesan7/meridian-indicators) | sukesan7 | MPL-2.0 | 7 |
| [CedInvest/sm-radar-pine](https://github.com/CedInvest/sm-radar-pine) | CedInvest | MPL-2.0 | 1 |

**Total: 497 indicators.**

## Why the repository is not single-licensed

A port is a derivative work, so it carries the licence of what it was
ported from. GPL-3.0 and MPL-2.0 are copyleft and neither permits
relicensing to MIT, so those ports are kept under their own terms in their
own directories rather than relabelled. See LICENSE.

      const ssC1 = 1 - ssC2 - ssC3

| Ehlers Adaptive Laguerre Filter (ALAGUERRE)',
    category: 'Filters',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      { key: 'source', type: 'source', label: 'Source', default: 'close' },
      { key: 'length', type: 'number', label: 'Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 200, step: 1,
        tooltip: 'Lookback for the highest/lowest normalisation of the tracking error.' },
      { key: 'medianLength', type: 'number', label: 'Median Length', default: 5, min: 1, max: 50, step: 1,
        tooltip: 'Lookback for the median smoothing of the adaptive alpha.' },
    ],

    plots: [{ key: 'alaguerre', type: 'line', title: 'ALaguerre', style: { color: '#ff9800', lineWidth: 2 } }],

    calc(bars, settings) {
      // A cleared number field arrives as '', and Number('') is 0.
      const length = Math.min(200, Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.length) // 20)))
      const medianLength = Math.min(50, Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.medianLength) // 5)))
      const src = sourceValues(bars, settings.source ?? 'close')

      const out = new Array(bars.length).fill(NaN)

      // Pine holds every one of these in a var, so they are loop state here.
      let l0 = 0
      let l1 = 0
      let l2 = 0
      let l3 = 0
      let lastResult = 0
      let initialized = false
      const diffBuf = []
      const coeffBuf = []

      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        // Pine's nz(src, src[1]): fall back to the previous bar's source.
        let ssrc = src[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(ssrc)) ssrc = i > 0 ? src[i - 1] : NaN
        if (!Number.isFinite(ssrc)) continue

        if (!initialized) {
          l0 = ssrc
          l1 = ssrc
          l2 = ssrc
          l3 = ssrc
          lastResult = ssrc
          initialized = true
          // The seed entries stay in both buffers and take part in later windows.
          diffBuf.push(0)
          coeffBuf.push(0.5)
        } else {
          // Tracking error of the filter against the source.
          const diff = Math.abs(ssrc - lastResult)
          diffBuf.push(diff)
          if (diffBuf.length > length) diffBuf.shift()

          let hh = -Infinity
          let ll = Infinity
          for (let k = 0; k < diffBuf.length; k++) {
            if (diffBuf[k] > hh) hh = diffBuf[k]
            if (diffBuf[k] < ll) ll = diffBuf[k]
          }

          // A flat error range carries no information, so alpha holds at 0.5.
          const coeff = hh - ll > 1e-15 ? (diff - ll) / (hh - ll) : 0.5
          coeffBuf.push(coeff)
          if (coeffBuf.length > medianLength) coeffBuf.shift()

          const sorted = coeffBuf.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b)
          const sz = sorted.length
          const alpha =
            sz % 2 === 1
              ? sorted[Math.floor(sz / 2)]
              : (sorted[sz / 2 - 1] + sorted[sz / 2]) / 2

          const pL0 = l0
          const pL1 = l1
          const pL2 = l2
          const gamma = 1 - alpha
          l0 = alpha * ssrc + gamma * pL0
          l1 = -gamma * l0 + pL0 + gamma * pL1
          l2 = -gamma * l1 + pL1 + gamma * pL2
          // l3 on the right is still the previous bar | `oa-alaguerre` | `oa-alaguerre.js` | [source](https://github.com/mihakralj/pinescript/blob/c4e91b962be09733d8fc76caa5191e9e586c5cee/indicators/filters/alaguerre.pine) |

      const highs = bars.map((b) => b.high)
      const lows = bars.map((b) => b.low)

    calc(bars, settings) {
      // A cleared number field arrives as '', and Number('') is 0.
      const length = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.length) // 14))
      const src = sourceValues(bars, settings.source ?? 'close')

      // Fibonacci weights built iteratively, exact integers, no Binet round-off.
      // Pine pushes F(1)..F(length) then reverses, so index 0 (the newest bar)
      // carries F(length).
      const weights = new Array(length)
      let prev = 0

      let weightSum = 0

        const next = prev + curr

        curr = next

      const dir = new Array(bars.length).fill(NaN)
      if (!(weightSum > 0)) return { fwma: nulls(ma), dir: nulls(dir) }

        for (let j = 0; j < length; j++) {

        ],
        tooltip: 'Displacement: a strong, sudden move with long candles and small wicks. Retracement: price pulls back to a Fibonacci level of that move.',
      },
      { key: 'showLong', type: 'boolean', label: 'Long Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },
      { key: 'showShort', type: 'boolean', label: 'Short Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },

      {
        key: 'minBars',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Minimum Bars',
        default: 3,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
        tooltip: 'A run is only marked once it reaches this many displacement candles.',
      },
      {
        key: 'devPercent',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Minimal Deviation (%)',
        default: 60,
        min: 1,
        max: 1000,
        step: 10,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
        tooltip: 'Smallest displacement, as a percentage of the average high-low range of the last 14 bars.',
      },
      {
        key: 'closeFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Close Above/Below Prev Close',
        default: true,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
      },
      {
        key: 'hlFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Close Above/Below Prev High/Low',
        default: false,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
      },
      {
        key: 'fibValue',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Fibonacci Value',
        default: 0.5,
        min: -5,
        max: 5,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
        tooltip: '0 is the top of a bullish and the bottom of a bearish run, 1 the opposite end, 0.5 the midpoint.',
      },

      {
        key: 'atrFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply ATR Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Keeps only candles whose range clears the ATR times the multiplier.',
      },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      {
        key: 'atrMult',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'ATR Multiplier',
        default: 1,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Higher values filter out longer or more volatile candles.',
      },

      {
        key: 'timeFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Time Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Keeps retracement signals inside a window of the exchange trading day.',
      },
      { key: 'hourFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (Hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (Minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (Hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (Minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'dateFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Date Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Keeps retracement signals on one calendar date only.',
      },
      { key: 'day', type: 'number', label: 'Day', default: 30, min: 1, max: 31, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'month', type: 'number', label: 'Month', default: 3, min: 1, max: 12, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'year', type: 'number', label: 'Year', default: 2025, min: 0, max: 2999, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'showPerfTable', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Performance Table' },
      {
        key: 'tablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'bottom-right',
        group: 'Performance Table',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
      },
      {
        key: 'tableSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Size',
        default: 'normal',
        group: 'Performance Table',
        options: [
          { label: 'Auto', value: 'auto' },
          { label: 'Tiny', value: 'tiny' },
          { label: 'Small', value: 'small' },
          { label: 'Normal', value: 'normal' },
          { label: 'Large', value: 'large' },
          { label: 'Huge', value: 'huge' },
        ],
      },
    ],

    // Both Fibonacci lines are plotted with display.none in the source: they
    // carry the level the retracement test and the dotted line read, and are
    // not meant to be drawn.
    plots: [
      { key: 'bearFib', type: 'step', title: 'Bearish Fib Line', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1, visible: false } },
      { key: 'bullFib', type: 'step', title: 'Bullish Fib Line', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 1, visible: false } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      const minBars = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numOr(settings.minBars, 3)))
      const devPercent = Math.max(1, numOr(settings.devPercent, 60))
      const closeFilter = settings.closeFilter !== false
      const hlFilter = settings.hlFilter === true
      const fibValue = numOr(settings.fibValue, 0.5)

      const useAtr = settings.atrFilter === true
      const atrLength = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numOr(settings.atrLength, 14)))
      const atrMult = Math.max(1, numOr(settings.atrMult, 1))

      const useTime = settings.timeFilter === true
      const hourFrom = intOr(settings.hourFrom, 9, 0, 23)
      const minuteFrom = intOr(settings.minuteFrom, 15, 0, 59)
      const hourTo = intOr(settings.hourTo, 10, 0, 23)
      const minuteTo = intOr(settings.minuteTo, 15, 0, 59)

      const useDate = settings.dateFilter === true
      const dayWanted = intOr(settings.day, 30, 1, 31)
      const monthWanted = intOr(settings.month, 3, 1, 12)
      const yearWanted = intOr(settings.year, 2025, 0, 2999)

      const method = methodOf(settings)
      const showLong = showLongOf(settings)
      const showShort = showShortOf(settings)

      const zoneRaw = ctx?.timezone ?? settings.timezone ?? DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
      const zone =
        typeof zoneRaw === 'string' && zoneRaw !== '' && isValidTimezone(zoneRaw) ? zoneRaw : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      const high = new Array(n)
      const low = new Array(n)
      const close = new Array(n)
      const open = new Array(n)
      const hl = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        high[i] = bars[i].high
        low[i] = bars[i].low
        close[i] = bars[i].close
        open[i] = bars[i].open
        hl[i] = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
      }

      // Pine: nz(input / 100 * ta.sma(high - low, 14)). The nz() makes the
      // threshold 0 for the first 13 bars, so every early bar clears it.
      const avgRange = sma(hl, 14)
      const atrValues = atr(high, low, close, atrLength)

      // Exchange wall clock, never the browser's zone.
      const timeOk = new Array(n).fill(true)
      const dateOk = new Array(n).fill(true)
      if (useTime // useDate) {
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
          if (useTime) {
            const hour = parts.hour
            const minute = parts.minute
            timeOk[i] =
              (hour > hourFrom // (hour === hourFrom && minute >= minuteFrom)) &&
              (hour < hourTo // (hour === hourTo && minute < minuteTo))
          }
          if (useDate) {
            dateOk[i] = parts.year === yearWanted && parts.month === monthWanted && parts.day === dayWanted
          }
        }
      }

      const bullFibCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearFibCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullCntCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const bearCntCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const bullMaxCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const bearMaxCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const bullRetCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const bearRetCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const bullRangePctCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearRangePctCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullLineFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearLineFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const cumPchgCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const volPchgCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const curVolCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const prevVolCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      // var-carried state, exactly as the source declares it.
      let bullCnt = 0
      let bearCnt = 0
      let bullRunHi = NaN
      let bullRunLo = NaN
      let bearRunHi = NaN
      let bearRunLo = NaN
      let bullFib = NaN
      let bearFib = NaN
      let bullActive = false
      let bearActive = false
      let bullDone = false
      let bearDone = false
      let bullStart = -1
      let bearStart = -1
      let cumPchg = NaN
      let currCumVol = NaN
      let prevCumVol = NaN

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // bullCnt / bearCnt still hold the previous bar's values here. On bar 0
        // Pine reads them as na, and every comparison with na is false.
        const prevBullCnt = i > 0 ? bullCnt : NaN
        const prevBearCnt = i > 0 ? bearCnt : NaN
        const prevClose = i > 0 ? close[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevHigh = i > 0 ? high[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevLow = i > 0 ? low[i - 1] : NaN

        const threshold = fin(avgRange[i]) ? (devPercent / 100) * avgRange[i] : 0
        const priceChg = hl[i]
        const atrOk = !useAtr // (fin(atrValues[i]) && priceChg > atrValues[i] * atrMult)

        const bullish =
          fin(priceChg) &&
          priceChg >= threshold &&
          close[i] > open[i] &&
          (!closeFilter // (fin(prevClose) && close[i] > prevClose)) &&
          (!hlFilter // (fin(prevHigh) && close[i] > prevHigh)) &&
          atrOk
        const bearish =
          fin(priceChg) &&
          priceChg >= threshold &&
          close[i] < open[i] &&
          (!closeFilter // (fin(prevClose) && close[i] < prevClose)) &&
          (!hlFilter // (fin(prevLow) && close[i] < prevLow)) &&
          atrOk

        // The source keeps one array of highs and one of lows per side and
        // clears them when the other side starts, so a running extreme reset at
        // the first bar of a run is the same thing.
        if (bullish) {
          bullCnt += 1
          bearCnt = 0
          if (bullCnt === 1) {
            bullRunHi = high[i]
            bullRunLo = low[i]
          } else {
            bullRunHi = Math.max(bullRunHi, high[i])
            bullRunLo = Math.min(bullRunLo, low[i])
          }
        } else if (bearish) {
          bearCnt += 1
          bullCnt = 0
          if (bearCnt === 1) {
            bearRunHi = high[i]
            bearRunLo = low[i]
          } else {
            bearRunHi = Math.max(bearRunHi, high[i])
            bearRunLo = Math.min(bearRunLo, low[i])
          }
        } else {
          bullCnt = 0
          bearCnt = 0
        }

        bullCntCol[i] = bullCnt
        bearCntCol[i] = bearCnt

        let bullRangePct = NaN
        let bearRangePct = NaN
        if (bullCnt >= minBars) {
          const range = bullRunHi - bullRunLo
          if (fin(range) && fin(bullRunLo) && bullRunLo !== 0) bullRangePct = (range / bullRunLo) * 100
          bullFib = bullRunHi - range * fibValue
        }
        if (bearCnt >= minBars) {
          const range = bearRunHi - bearRunLo
          if (fin(range) && fin(bearRunLo) && bearRunLo !== 0) bearRangePct = (range / bearRunLo) * 100
          bearFib = bearRunLo + range * fibValue
        }
        bullFibCol[i] = bullFib
        bearFibCol[i] = bearFib
        bullRangePctCol[i] = bullRangePct
        bearRangePctCol[i] = bearRangePct

        const bullMax = fin(prevBullCnt) && prevBullCnt >= minBars && bullCnt === 0
        const bearMax = fin(prevBearCnt) && prevBearCnt >= minBars && bearCnt === 0
        bullMaxCol[i] = bullMax ? 1 : 0
        bearMaxCol[i] = bearMax ? 1 : 0

        // A run becomes active on the bar it first reaches the minimum length.
        if (bullCnt >= minBars && fin(prevBullCnt) && prevBullCnt < minBars) {
          bullActive = true
          bearActive = false
          bullDone = false
          bearDone = false
          bullStart = i - bullCnt + 1
        }
        if (bearCnt >= minBars && fin(prevBearCnt) && prevBearCnt < minBars) {
          bearActive = true
          bullActive = false
          bearDone = false
          bullDone = false
          bearStart = i - bearCnt + 1
        }

        const prevBearFib = i > 0 ? bearFibCol[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevBullFib = i > 0 ? bullFibCol[i - 1] : NaN
        // ta.crossover(high, bearFib), plus the source's extra high[1] < bearFib.
        const bearCross =
          i > 0 && fin(bearFib) && fin(prevBearFib) && fin(prevHigh) && high[i] > bearFib && prevHigh <= prevBearFib
        const bullCross =
          i > 0 && fin(bullFib) && fin(prevBullFib) && fin(prevLow) && low[i] < bullFib && prevLow >= prevBullFib

        const bearRet = bearActive && !bearDone && bearCross && prevHigh < bearFib && timeOk[i] && dateOk[i]
        const bullRet = bullActive && !bullDone && bullCross && prevLow > bullFib && timeOk[i] && dateOk[i]
        bearRetCol[i] = bearRet ? 1 : 0
        bullRetCol[i] = bullRet ? 1 : 0

        // Only the marked retracement closes a run and draws its line, which is
        // why a run can re-signal while the Displacement method is selected.
        if (bearRet && method === 'Retracement' && showShort) {
          bearDone = true
          if (bearStart >= 0 && bearStart < n) bearLineFrom[i] = bars[bearStart].time
        }
        if (bullRet && method === 'Retracement' && showLong) {
          bullDone = true
          if (bullStart >= 0 && bullStart < n) bullLineFrom[i] = bars[bullStart].time
        }

        // Performance: cumulative percentage change and cumulative volume,
        // both reset on the first bar of each exchange day.
        const isNewDay = i > 0 && isNewZonedDay(bars[i - 1].time, bars[i].time, zone)
        const dayPchg =
          i > 0 && fin(prevClose) && prevClose !== 0 ? ((close[i] - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100 : 0
        cumPchg = isNewDay ? dayPchg : !fin(cumPchg) ? dayPchg : cumPchg + dayPchg

        const volume = fin(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : NaN
        if (isNewDay) {
          prevCumVol = currCumVol
          currCumVol = volume
        } else {
          currCumVol = !fin(currCumVol) ? volume : currCumVol + volume
        }
        const prevSafe = fin(prevCumVol) ? prevCumVol : currCumVol
        cumPchgCol[i] = cumPchg
        curVolCol[i] = fin(currCumVol) ? currCumVol : NaN
        prevVolCol[i] = fin(prevSafe) ? prevSafe : NaN
        volPchgCol[i] =
          fin(currCumVol) && fin(prevSafe) && prevSafe !== 0 ? ((currCumVol - prevSafe) / prevSafe) * 100 : NaN
      }

      return {
        bearFib: nulls(bearFibCol),
        bullFib: nulls(bullFibCol),
        bullCnt: bullCntCol,
        bearCnt: bearCntCol,
        bullMax: bullMaxCol,
        bearMax: bearMaxCol,
        bullRet: bullRetCol,
        bearRet: bearRetCol,
        bullRangePct: bullRangePctCol,
        bearRangePct: bearRangePctCol,
        bullLineFrom: bullLineFrom,
        bearLineFrom: bearLineFrom,
        cumPchg: cumPchgCol,
        volPchg: volPchgCol,
        curVol: curVolCol,
        prevVol: prevVolCol,
      }
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const method = methodOf(settings)
      const showLong = showLongOf(settings)
      const showShort = showShortOf(settings)
      const pad = markerPad(bars)

      const labels = []
      const shapes = []
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        // The run-length label sits on the last bar of the run, which is the
        // bar before the one that ended it.
        if (showShort && values.bearMax[i] === 1) {
          const count = values.bearCnt[i - 1]
          if (fin(count) && fin(bars[i - 1].low)) {
            labels.push({
              time: bars[i - 1].time,
              position: 'atPrice',
              price: bars[i - 1].low - pad,
              shape: 'labelUp',
              size: 'small',
              color: NEG_LIGHT,
              text: String(Math.round(count)),
            })
          }
        }
        if (showLong && values.bullMax[i] === 1) {
          const count = values.bullCnt[i - 1]
          if (fin(count) && fin(bars[i - 1].high)) {
            labels.push({
              time: bars[i - 1].time,
              position: 'atPrice',
              price: bars[i - 1].high + pad,
              shape: 'labelDown',
              size: 'small',
              color: POS_LIGHT,
              text: String(Math.round(count)),
            })
          }
        }

        if (method !== 'Retracement') continue
        if (showShort && values.bearRet[i] === 1 && fin(bars[i].high)) {
          shapes.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
          })
        }
        if (showLong && values.bullRet[i] === 1 && fin(bars[i].low)) {
          shapes.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_LIGHT,
          })
        }
      }
      // The source caps itself at 500 labels.
      return labels.slice(-500).concat(shapes)
    },

    draws({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const bearFrom = values.bearLineFrom[i]
        const bearPrice = values.bearFib[i]
        if (fin(bearFrom) && fin(bearPrice)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bearFrom, price: bearPrice },
            to: { time: bars[i].time, price: bearPrice },
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
            lineWidth: 1,
            lineStyle: 'dotted',
          })
        }
        const bullFrom = values.bullLineFrom[i]
        const bullPrice = values.bullFib[i]
        if (fin(bullFrom) && fin(bullPrice)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bullFrom, price: bullPrice },
            to: { time: bars[i].time, price: bullPrice },
            color: POS_LIGHT,
            lineWidth: 1,
            lineStyle: 'dotted',
          })
        }
      }
      // The source caps itself at 500 lines.
      return out.slice(-500)
    },

    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const method = methodOf(settings)
      const showLong = showLongOf(settings)
      const showShort = showShortOf(settings)
      return bars.map((bar, i) => {
        if (method !== 'Retracement') return null
        if (showShort && values.bearRet[i] === 1) return NEG_LIGHT
        if (showLong && values.bullRet[i] === 1) return POS_LIGHT
        return null
      })
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.showPerfTable === false // bars.length === 0) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const pchg = values.cumPchg[i]
      const volPchg = values.volPchg[i]
      const curVol = values.curVol[i]
      const prevVol = values.prevVol[i]

      const pchgColor = fin(pchg) && pchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const volColor = fin(volPchg) && volPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const prevColor = fin(prevVol) && fin(curVol) && prevVol < curVol ? NEG : POS

      const label = (text) => ({ text, align: 'left', bgColor: NEU_DARK, textColor: NEU })
      const value = (text, color) => ({ text, align: 'right', bgColor: NEU_DARK, textColor: color })
      const pct = (v) => (fin(v) ? `${fmt2(v)} %` : '-')
      const lakhs = (v) => (fin(v) ? `${fmt2(v / 100000)} L` : '-')

      const position = TABLE_POSITIONS.has(settings.tablePosition) ? settings.tablePosition : 'bottom-right'
      const fontSize = FONT_SIZES[settings.tableSize] ?? FONT_SIZES.normal

      return {
        rows: [
          [label('%Chg'), value(pct(pchg), pchgColor)],
          [label('Vol %Chg'), value(pct(volPchg), volColor)],
          [label('Vol'), value(lakhs(curVol), volColor)],
          [label('PD Vol'), value(lakhs(prevVol), prevColor)],
        ],
        options: {
          position,
          fontSize,
          cellWidth: [90, 90],
          cellHeight: 20,
          borderColor: '#5a6b8c | `oa-ict-displacement-candles-scanner` | `oa-ict-displacement-candles-scanner.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/ICT) |
| ICT Displacement Candles Indicator',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'scanMethod',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Scanning Method',
        default: 'Displacement',
        options: [
          { label: 'Displacement', value: 'Displacement' },
          { label: 'Retracement', value: 'Retracement' },
        ],
        group: 'Scanner',
        tooltip:
          'Displacement: strong, sudden price move (up or down) with long candles and minimal wicks. Retracement: price pulls back to a Fibonacci level of the displacement, a potential entry for trend continuation.',
      },
      { key: 'showLong', type: 'boolean', label: 'Long Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },
      { key: 'showShort', type: 'boolean', label: 'Short Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },

      {
        key: 'minBars',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Minimum Bars',
        default: 3,
        min: 1,
        max: 500,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
        tooltip: 'Shows if bars exceed the set value.',
      },
      {
        key: 'devPercent',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Minimal Deviation (%)',
        default: 60,
        min: 1,
        max: 1000,
        step: 10,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
        tooltip: 'Minimal size of a displacement candle, as a percentage of the average high-low range of the last 14 bars.',
      },
      {
        key: 'closeFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Close Above/Below Prev Close',
        default: true,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
      },
      {
        key: 'hlFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Close Above/Below Prev High/Low',
        default: false,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
      },
      {
        key: 'fibVal',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Fibonacci Value',
        default: 0.5,
        min: 0,
        max: 1,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Displacement Candles',
        tooltip:
          '0: top of a bullish and bottom of a bearish displacement. 1: bottom of a bullish and top of a bearish displacement. 0.5: the midpoint.',
      },

      {
        key: 'atrFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply ATR Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Filters out longer or more volatile displacement candles.',
      },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      {
        key: 'atrMulti',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'ATR Multiplier',
        default: 1,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Higher values filter longer or more volatile candles.',
      },

      {
        key: 'timeFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Time Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Filter retracement signals to a window of the trading day.',
      },
      { key: 'hour1', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minute1', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hour2', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minute2', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'dateFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Date Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Filter retracement signals to one specified date.',
      },
      { key: 'day', type: 'number', label: 'Day', default: 30, min: 1, max: 31, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'month', type: 'number', label: 'Month', default: 3, min: 1, max: 12, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'year', type: 'number', label: 'Year', default: 2025, min: 0, max: 9999, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'showTable', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Performance Table' },
      {
        key: 'tablePos',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'bottom-right',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
        group: 'Performance Table',
      },
      {
        key: 'tableSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Size',
        default: 'normal',
        options: [
          { label: 'Auto', value: 'auto' },
          { label: 'Tiny', value: 'tiny' },
          { label: 'Small', value: 'small' },
          { label: 'Normal', value: 'normal' },
          { label: 'Large', value: 'large' },
          { label: 'Huge', value: 'huge' },
        ],
        group: 'Performance Table',
        tooltip: 'The table layer has no automatic sizing, so Auto renders at the Normal size.',
      },
    ],

    // Both Pine plots carry display.none: the Fibonacci levels drive the
    // retracement test rather than being drawn, so they start hidden here too.
    plots: [
      {
        key: 'bearFib',
        type: 'step',
        title: 'Bearish Fib Line',
        style: { color: NEG_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
      {
        key: 'bullFib',
        type: 'step',
        title: 'Bullish Fib Line',
        style: { color: POS_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      // A cleared field arrives as '', and Number('') is 0.
      const minBars = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.minBars) // 3))
      const devPercent = Math.max(1, Number(settings.devPercent) // 60)
      // 0 is a meaningful Fibonacci value here, so only a cleared or unreadable
      // field falls back to the default.
      const fibRaw = settings.fibVal === '' // settings.fibVal == null ? NaN : Number(settings.fibVal)
      const fibVal = Number.isFinite(fibRaw) ? fibRaw : 0.5
      const closeFilter = settings.closeFilter !== false
      const hlFilter = settings.hlFilter === true
      const useAtrFilter = settings.atrFilter === true
      const atrLength = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.atrLength) // 14))
      const atrMulti = Math.max(1, Number(settings.atrMulti) // 1)
      const useTimeFilter = settings.timeFilter === true
      const hour1 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(settings.hour1) // 0))
      const minute1 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(settings.minute1) // 0))
      const hour2 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(settings.hour2) // 0))
      const minute2 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(settings.minute2) // 0))
      const useDateFilter = settings.dateFilter === true
      const wantDay = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.day) // 1))
      const wantMonth = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.month) // 1))
      const wantYear = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(settings.year) // 0))
      const method = settings.scanMethod === 'Retracement' ? 'Retracement' : 'Displacement'
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const zone = zoneOf(ctx)

      const high = new Array(n)
      const low = new Array(n)
      const close = new Array(n)
      const range = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
        high[i] = bars[i].high
        low[i] = bars[i].low
        close[i] = bars[i].close
        range[i] = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
      }

      // The deviation threshold is a series: Pine wraps it in nz(), so during
      // the 14-bar SMA warmup it is 0 and every candle clears it.
      const avgRange = sma(range, 14)
      const atrLine = useAtrFilter ? atr(high, low, close, atrLength) : null

      const bearFib = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullFib = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearSig = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullSig = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearLabel = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullLabel = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const cumPchg = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const cumVolPchg = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const currVol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const prevVol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      // Run state carried across bars, exactly as the Pine var declarations do.
      let bullCnt = 0
      let bearCnt = 0
      let prevBullCnt = 0
      let prevBearCnt = 0
      let bullHighs = []
      let bullLows = []
      let bearHighs = []
      let bearLows = []
      let curBullFib = NaN
      let curBearFib = NaN
      let prevBullFib = NaN
      let prevBearFib = NaN

      let bullActive = false
      let bearActive = false
      let bullDone = false
      let bearDone = false
      let bullStart = NaN
      let bearStart = NaN

      let cumPchgState = NaN
      let currCumVol = NaN
      let prevCumVol = NaN

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
        const h = high[i]
        const l = low[i]
        const c = close[i]
        const o = bars[i].open
        const prevClose = i > 0 ? close[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevHigh = i > 0 ? high[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevLow = i > 0 ? low[i - 1] : NaN

        // ---- Performance figures -------------------------------------------
        // Pine's ta.change(time('D')) is na on the first bar, which compares
        // false, so the first bar never counts as a new day.
        const isNewDay = i > 0 ? isNewZonedDay(bars[i - 1].time, bars[i].time, zone) : false

        const dayPchg =
          Number.isFinite(prevClose) && prevClose !== 0 && Number.isFinite(c)
            ? ((c - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100
            : 0
        cumPchgState = isNewDay // !Number.isFinite(cumPchgState) ? dayPchg : cumPchgState + dayPchg

        // Volume is absent on index series, so it counts as zero rather than
        // poisoning the running total.
        const vol = Number.isFinite(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : 0
        if (isNewDay) {
          prevCumVol = currCumVol
          currCumVol = vol
        } else {
          currCumVol = Number.isFinite(currCumVol) ? currCumVol + vol : vol
        }
        const prevVolSafe = Number.isFinite(prevCumVol) ? prevCumVol : currCumVol
        const volPchg =
          Number.isFinite(prevVolSafe) && prevVolSafe !== 0
            ? ((currCumVol - prevVolSafe) / prevVolSafe) * 100
            : 0

        cumPchg[i] = cumPchgState
        cumVolPchg[i] = volPchg
        currVol[i] = Number.isFinite(currCumVol) ? currCumVol : 0
        prevVol[i] = Number.isFinite(prevVolSafe) ? prevVolSafe : 0

        // ---- Filters --------------------------------------------------------
        // Pine compares against na as false, so a warmup ATR blocks the filter.
        const atrOk =
          !useAtrFilter //
          (atrLine !== null && Number.isFinite(atrLine[i]) && Number.isFinite(range[i]) && range[i] > atrLine[i] * atrMulti)

        let timeOk = true
        let dateOk = true
        if (useTimeFilter // useDateFilter) {
          const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
          if (useTimeFilter) {
            timeOk =
              (parts.hour > hour1 // (parts.hour === hour1 && parts.minute >= minute1)) &&
              (parts.hour < hour2 // (parts.hour === hour2 && parts.minute < minute2))
          }
          if (useDateFilter) {
            dateOk = parts.year === wantYear && parts.month === wantMonth && parts.day === wantDay
          }
        }

        // ---- Displacement runs ---------------------------------------------
        const threshold = Number.isFinite(avgRange[i]) ? (devPercent / 100) * avgRange[i] : 0
        const bigEnough = Number.isFinite(range[i]) && range[i] >= threshold

        const bullish =
          bigEnough &&
          Number.isFinite(c) &&
          Number.isFinite(o) &&
          c > o &&
          (!closeFilter // (Number.isFinite(prevClose) && c > prevClose)) &&
          (!hlFilter // (Number.isFinite(prevHigh) && c > prevHigh)) &&
          atrOk
        const bearish =
          bigEnough &&
          Number.isFinite(c) &&
          Number.isFinite(o) &&
          c < o &&
          (!closeFilter // (Number.isFinite(prevClose) && c < prevClose)) &&
          (!hlFilter // (Number.isFinite(prevLow) && c < prevLow)) &&
          atrOk

        prevBullCnt = bullCnt
        prevBearCnt = bearCnt

        if (bullish) {
          bullCnt += 1
          bearCnt = 0
          bullHighs.push(h)
          bullLows.push(l)
          if (bullCnt === 1) {
            bearHighs = []
            bearLows = []
          }
        } else if (bearish) {
          bearCnt += 1
          bullCnt = 0
          bearHighs.push(h)
          bearLows.push(l)
          if (bearCnt === 1) {
            bullHighs = []
            bullLows = []
          }
        } else {
          bullCnt = 0
          bearCnt = 0
          bullHighs = []
          bullLows = []
          bearHighs = []
          bearLows = []
        }

        prevBullFib = curBullFib
        prevBearFib = curBearFib

        if (bullCnt >= minBars && bullHighs.length > 0) {
          const hi = Math.max(...bullHighs)
          const lo = Math.min(...bullLows)
          if (Number.isFinite(hi) && Number.isFinite(lo)) curBullFib = hi - (hi - lo) * fibVal
        }
        if (bearCnt >= minBars && bearHighs.length > 0) {
          const hi = Math.max(...bearHighs)
          const lo = Math.min(...bearLows)
          if (Number.isFinite(hi) && Number.isFinite(lo)) curBearFib = lo + (hi - lo) * fibVal
        }

        bullFib[i] = curBullFib
        bearFib[i] = curBearFib

        // A run that just ended is labelled on the bar before this one, which is
        // the last bar of the run.
        if (i > 0 && prevBearCnt >= minBars && bearCnt === 0 && showShort) bearLabel[i - 1] = prevBearCnt
        if (i > 0 && prevBullCnt >= minBars && bullCnt === 0 && showLong) bullLabel[i - 1] = prevBullCnt

        // ---- Retracement tracking -------------------------------------------
        if (i > 0 && bullCnt >= minBars && prevBullCnt < minBars) {
          bullActive = true
          bearActive = false
          bullDone = false
          bearDone = false
          bullStart = i - bullCnt + 1
        }
        if (i > 0 && bearCnt >= minBars && prevBearCnt < minBars) {
          bearActive = true
          bullActive = false
          bearDone = false
          bullDone = false
          bearStart = i - bearCnt + 1
        }

        // ta.crossover(high, bearFib) compares against the previous bar's fib,
        // and every operand has to be a real number or Pine reads the test as
        // false while JavaScript would read null as zero.
        const bearCross =
          i > 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(h) &&
          Number.isFinite(curBearFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevHigh) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevBearFib) &&
          h > curBearFib &&
          prevHigh <= prevBearFib
        const bullCross =
          i > 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(l) &&
          Number.isFinite(curBullFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLow) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevBullFib) &&
          l < curBullFib &&
          prevLow >= prevBullFib

        const bearRet =
          bearActive && !bearDone && bearCross && Number.isFinite(prevHigh) && prevHigh < curBearFib && timeOk && dateOk
        const bullRet =
          bullActive && !bullDone && bullCross && Number.isFinite(prevLow) && prevLow > curBullFib && timeOk && dateOk

        if (bearRet && method === 'Retracement' && showShort) {
          bearDone = true
          bearSig[i] = curBearFib
          if (Number.isFinite(bearStart)) bearFrom[i] = bearStart
        }
        if (bullRet && method === 'Retracement' && showLong) {
          bullDone = true
          bullSig[i] = curBullFib
          if (Number.isFinite(bullStart)) bullFrom[i] = bullStart
        }
      }

      return {
        bearFib: nulls(bearFib),
        bullFib: nulls(bullFib),
        bearSig: nulls(bearSig),
        bullSig: nulls(bullSig),
        bearFrom: nulls(bearFrom),
        bullFrom: nulls(bullFrom),
        bearLabel: nulls(bearLabel),
        bullLabel: nulls(bullLabel),
        cumPchg: nulls(cumPchg),
        cumVolPchg: nulls(cumVolPchg),
        currVol: nulls(currVol),
        prevVol: nulls(prevVol),
      }
    },

    markers({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []

      // aboveBar and belowBar anchor to this indicator's own plot, so the marks
      // are priced off the candle with a gap scaled to the instrument.
      let sumRange = 0
      let counted = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          sumRange += r
          counted += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = counted > 0 ? sumRange / counted : 0
      const lastClose = Number.isFinite(bars[n - 1].close) ? bars[n - 1].close : 0
      const pad = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, Math.abs(lastClose) * 0.0005)

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
        const bearCount = values.bearLabel[i]
        if (Number.isFinite(bearCount) && Number.isFinite(bars[i].low)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'labelUp',
            size: 'small',
            color: NEG_LIGHT_COLOR,
            text: String(bearCount),
          })
        }
        const bullCount = values.bullLabel[i]
        if (Number.isFinite(bullCount) && Number.isFinite(bars[i].high)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'labelDown',
            size: 'small',
            color: POS_LIGHT_COLOR,
            text: String(bullCount),
          })
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(values.bearSig[i]) && Number.isFinite(bars[i].high)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_LIGHT_COLOR,
          })
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(values.bullSig[i]) && Number.isFinite(bars[i].low)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_LIGHT_COLOR,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    draws({ bars, values }) {
      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i += 1) {
        const bearPrice = values.bearSig[i]
        const bearAt = values.bearFrom[i]
        if (Number.isFinite(bearPrice) && Number.isFinite(bearAt) && bars[bearAt]) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bars[bearAt].time, price: bearPrice },
            to: { time: bars[i].time, price: bearPrice },
            color: NEG_LIGHT_COLOR,
            lineStyle: 'dotted',
            lineWidth: 1,
          })
        }
        const bullPrice = values.bullSig[i]
        const bullAt = values.bullFrom[i]
        if (Number.isFinite(bullPrice) && Number.isFinite(bullAt) && bars[bullAt]) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bars[bullAt].time, price: bullPrice },
            to: { time: bars[i].time, price: bullPrice },
            color: POS_LIGHT_COLOR,
            lineStyle: 'dotted',
            lineWidth: 1,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    barColors({ bars, values }) {
      return bars.map((bar, i) => {
        if (Number.isFinite(values.bearSig[i])) return NEG_LIGHT_COLOR
        if (Number.isFinite(values.bullSig[i])) return POS_LIGHT_COLOR
        return null
      })
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.showTable === false // bars.length === 0) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const pchg = Number(values.cumPchg[i])
      const volPchg = Number(values.cumVolPchg[i])
      const cur = Number(values.currVol[i])
      const prior = Number(values.prevVol[i])

      const pchgCol = pchg > 0 ? POS_COLOR : NEG_COLOR
      const volCol = volPchg > 0 ? POS_COLOR : NEG_COLOR
      const priorCol = prior < cur ? NEG_COLOR : POS_COLOR

      const label = (text) => ({ text, bgColor: NEU_DARK_COLOR, textColor: HEAD_TEXT_COLOR, align: 'left' })
      const value = (text, textColor) => ({ text, bgColor: NEU_DARK_COLOR, textColor, align: 'right' })

      const size = TABLE_FONT_SIZE[settings.tableSize] ?? TABLE_FONT_SIZE.normal
      const positions = [
        'top-left', 'top-center', 'top-right',
        'middle-left', 'middle-center', 'middle-right',
        'bottom-left', 'bottom-center', 'bottom-right',
      ]
      const position = positions.includes(settings.tablePos) ? settings.tablePos : 'bottom-right'

      return {
        rows: [
          [label('%Chg'), value(fmt(pchg) + ' %', pchgCol)],
          [label('Vol %Chg'), value(fmt(volPchg) + ' %', volCol)],
          [label('Vol'), value(fmt(cur / 100000) + ' L', volCol)],
          [label('PD Vol'), value(fmt(prior / 100000) + ' L', priorCol)],
        ],
        options: {
          position,
          fontSize: size,
          cellWidth: [Math.round(size * 7), Math.round(size * 8)],
          cellHeight: Math.round(size * 2),
          borderColor: '#5a6b8c | `oa-ict-displacement-candles` | `oa-ict-displacement-candles.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/ICT) |
| ICT Equal Highs and Lows',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      { key: 'left', type: 'number', label: 'Left', default: 60, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Equal High Low' },
      { key: 'right', type: 'number', label: 'Right', default: 30, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Equal High Low' },
      {
        key: 'eqPercent',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Equal HL %',
        default: 0.05,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.01,
        group: 'Equal High Low',
        tooltip: 'Lower values mean highs and lows are closer.',
      },
      {
        key: 'srcMode',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Source',
        default: 'High/Low',
        group: 'Equal High Low',
        options: [
          { label: 'High/Low', value: 'High/Low' },
          { label: 'Open/Close', value: 'Open/Close' },
        ],
      },
    ],

    // The source plots no series: everything it shows is a box or a shape.
    // These two carry the confirmed pivots so the legend has something to
    // name, and are hidden by default like the source's own output.
    plots: [
      { key: 'ph', type: 'line', title: 'Pivot High', style: { color: BEAR, visible: false } },
      { key: 'pl', type: 'line', title: 'Pivot Low', style: { color: BULL, visible: false } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const left = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numOr(settings.left, 60)))
      const right = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numOr(settings.right, 30)))
      const eqPercent = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.eqPercent, 0.05))
      const useOpenClose = settings.srcMode === 'Open/Close'

      const srcHigh = new Array(n)
      const srcLow = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        srcHigh[i] = useOpenClose ? Math.max(b.open, b.close) : b.high
        srcLow[i] = useOpenClose ? Math.min(b.open, b.close) : b.low
      }

      const phRaw = pivotHigh(srcHigh, left, right)
      const plRaw = pivotLow(srcLow, left, right)

      const phCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const plCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      // One column per box corner, written on the bar that confirms the pair.
      const eqHighFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqHighTo = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqHighTop = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqHighBottom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowTo = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowTop = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowBottom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      // The tag prices, read from the raw high and low as the source does.
      const eqHighMark = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowMark = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      // The source keeps the last two pivot prices and the bar indexes that
      // confirmed them. Index 0 is the newest, and both start na.
      let phPrice0 = NaN
      let phPrice1 = NaN
      let phBar0 = NaN
      let phBar1 = NaN
      let plPrice0 = NaN
      let plPrice1 = NaN
      let plBar0 = NaN
      let plBar1 = NaN

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // barstate.isconfirmed. Every loaded bar but the last is closed, and
        // the chart tells us whether the last one is.
        const confirmed = i < n - 1 ? true : ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false

        const isPh = Number.isFinite(phRaw[i])
        const isPl = Number.isFinite(plRaw[i])

        if (isPh) {
          phPrice1 = phPrice0
          phPrice0 = phRaw[i]
          phBar1 = phBar0
          phBar0 = i
          phCol[i] = phRaw[i]
        }
        if (isPl) {
          plPrice1 = plPrice0
          plPrice0 = plRaw[i]
          plBar1 = plBar0
          plBar0 = i
          plCol[i] = plRaw[i]
        }

        // pchg() runs on every bar in the source, so it holds its last computed
        // value between pivots and is na until two pivots of that side exist.
        const phPchg =
          Number.isFinite(phPrice0) && Number.isFinite(phPrice1) && phPrice1 !== 0
            ? Math.abs(((phPrice0 - phPrice1) / phPrice1) * 100)
            : NaN
        const plPchg =
          Number.isFinite(plPrice0) && Number.isFinite(plPrice1) && plPrice1 !== 0
            ? Math.abs(((plPrice0 - plPrice1) / plPrice1) * 100)
            : NaN

        // Every comparison against na is false in Pine, so guard before testing.
        const phCondition = isPh && Number.isFinite(phPchg) && phPchg < eqPercent && confirmed
        const plCondition = isPl && Number.isFinite(plPchg) && plPchg < eqPercent && confirmed

            eqHighFrom[i] = bars[from].time
            eqHighTo[i] = bars[to].time

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const left = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numOr(settings.left, 60)))
      const right = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numOr(settings.right, 30)))
      const eqPercent = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.eqPercent, 0.05))
      const useOpenClose = settings.srcMode === 'Open/Close'
      const sweep = settings.method === 'Equals Sweep'
      const direction = settings.direction ?? 'Both'
      const showBull = settings.showBull !== false
      const showBear = settings.showBear !== false

      // 103.80000000000001, which the table would print in full. Trim the tail
      // while keeping far more significant digits than any price needs.
      const snap = (v) => {
        if (!Number.isFinite(v) // tick <= 0) return v
        return Number(roundToTick(v, tick).toPrecision(12))
      }

      // Pine: bull = not(direction == "Bearish"), bear = not(direction == "Bullish").
      const bullAllowed = direction !== 'Bearish'
      const bearAllowed = direction !== 'Bullish'

      const srcHigh = new Array(n)
      const srcLow = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        srcHigh[i] = useOpenClose ? Math.max(b.open, b.close) : b.high
        srcLow[i] = useOpenClose ? Math.min(b.open, b.close) : b.low

      const plRaw = pivotLow(srcLow, left, right)

      const plCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      const eqHighFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqHighTo = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqHighTop = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqHighBottom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowFrom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowTo = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowTop = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowBottom = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      // The tag prices, read from the raw high and low as the source does.
      const eqHighMark = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const eqLowMark = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const signal = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const signalPrice = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      // The source keeps the last two pivot prices and the bar indexes that
      // confirmed them. Index 0 is the newest.
      let phPrice0 = NaN
      let phPrice1 = NaN
      let phBar0 = NaN
      let phBar1 = NaN
      let plPrice0 = NaN
      let plPrice1 = NaN
      let plBar0 = NaN
      let plBar1 = NaN
      // ph_price_0 and pl_price_0 as series, for the sweep crossovers.

      let prevPlLevel = NaN

        if (isPh) {
          phPrice1 = phPrice0
          phPrice0 = phRaw[i]
          phBar1 = phBar0
          phBar0 = i
          phCol[i] = phRaw[i]
        }
        if (isPl) {
          plPrice1 = plPrice0
          plPrice0 = plRaw[i]
          plBar1 = plBar0
          plBar0 = i
          plCol[i] = plRaw[i]
        }

        // pchg() runs on every bar in the source, so it holds the last computed
        // value between pivots and is na until two pivots of that side exist.
        const phPchg =
          Number.isFinite(phPrice0) && Number.isFinite(phPrice1) && phPrice1 !== 0
            ? Math.abs(((phPrice0 - phPrice1) / phPrice1) * 100)
            : NaN
        const plPchg =
          Number.isFinite(plPrice0) && Number.isFinite(plPrice1) && plPrice1 !== 0
            ? Math.abs(((plPrice0 - plPrice1) / plPrice1) * 100)
            : NaN

        // Every comparison against na is false in Pine, so guard before testing.
        const phCondition = isPh && Number.isFinite(phPchg) && phPchg < eqPercent && confirmed
        const plCondition = isPl && Number.isFinite(plPchg) && plPchg < eqPercent && confirmed

        // A box runs from the earlier pivot bar to the later one. The stored
        // bar indexes are the confirming bars, so the source subtracts `right`
        // from each to reach the pivot itself.
        if (phCondition) {
          const from = phBar1 - right
          const to = phBar0 - right
          if (from >= 0 && to >= 0 && from < n && to < n) {
            eqHighFrom[i] = bars[from].time
            eqHighTo[i] = bars[to].time
            eqHighTop[i] = phPrice1
            eqHighBottom[i] = phPrice0
            eqHighMark[i] = bars[to].high
          }
        }
        if (plCondition) {
          const from = plBar1 - right
          const to = plBar0 - right
          if (from >= 0 && to >= 0 && from < n && to < n) {
            eqLowFrom[i] = bars[from].time
            eqLowTo[i] = bars[to].time
            eqLowTop[i] = plPrice1
            eqLowBottom[i] = plPrice0
            eqLowMark[i] = bars[to].low
          }
        }

        // Screening method. The sweep variant waits for the raw high to cross
        // above the newest equal high, or the raw low to cross below the newest
        // equal low, rather than reporting the pair as it forms.
        let bullishCond = phCondition
        let bearishCond = plCondition
        if (sweep) {
          const h = bars[i].high
          const l = bars[i].low
          const hPrev = i > 0 ? bars[i - 1].high : NaN
          const lPrev = i > 0 ? bars[i - 1].low : NaN
          const crossOver =
            Number.isFinite(h) &&
            Number.isFinite(hPrev) &&
            Number.isFinite(phPrice0) &&
            Number.isFinite(prevPhLevel) &&
            h > phPrice0 &&

          const crossUnder =

            Number.isFinite(lPrev) &&

          bearishCond = Number.isFinite(plPchg) && plPchg < eqPercent && crossUnder && confirmed

        eqHighFrom: nulls(eqHighFrom),
        eqHighTo: nulls(eqHighTo),
        eqHighTop: nulls(eqHighTop),
        eqHighBottom: nulls(eqHighBottom),
        eqLowFrom: nulls(eqLowFrom),
        eqLowTo: nulls(eqLowTo),
        eqLowTop: nulls(eqLowTop),
        eqLowBottom: nulls(eqLowBottom),
        eqHighMark: nulls(eqHighMark),
        eqLowMark: nulls(eqLowMark),
        signal: nulls(signal),
        signalPrice: nulls(signalPrice),
      }
    },

    draws({ bars, values }) {

      const boxes = []

      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        if (values.eqHighFrom[i] != null) {
          boxes.push({
            index: i,
            kind: 'box',
            from: { time: values.eqHighFrom[i], price: values.eqHighTop[i] },
            to: { time: values.eqHighTo[i], price: values.eqHighBottom[i] },
            color: withAlpha(BEAR, OPACITY),
            fillColor: BEAR,
            opacity: OPACITY,

        }
        if (values.eqLowFrom[i] != null) {
          boxes.push({

            from: { time: values.eqLowFrom[i], price: values.eqLowTop[i] },

            color: withAlpha(BULL, OPACITY),
            fillColor: BULL,
            opacity: OPACITY,

        }

      // Pine keeps only the newest max_boxes_count boxes, which defaults to 50.
      const kept = boxes.length > MAX_BOXES ? boxes.slice(boxes.length - MAX_BOXES) : boxes
      return kept.map(({ index, ...box }) => box)
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return []
      const right = Math.max(1, Math.floor(numOr(settings.right, 30)))
      const out = []

      // The source draws its shape at location.absolute with offset=-right, so
      // the tag sits on the pivot bar itself at that bar's raw high or low.
      // 'atPrice' is the only position that anchors to the candle rather than
      // to this indicator's own plot line. The style set here has no xcross, so
      // a diamond stands in for it.
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const at = i - right
        if (at < 0) continue
        if (values.eqHighMark[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[at].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: values.eqHighMark[i],
            shape: 'diamond',
            size: 'small',
            color: withAlpha(BEAR, OPACITY),
          })
        }
        if (values.eqLowMark[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[at].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: values.eqLowMark[i],
            shape: 'diamond',
            size: 'small',
            color: withAlpha(BULL, OPACITY),
          })

      return out
    },

    inputs: [
      { key: 'phl1Show', type: 'boolean', label: 'Pivot High Low 1', default: true, group: QUICK },
      { key: 'phl2Show', type: 'boolean', label: 'Pivot High Low 2', default: true, group: QUICK },
      { key: 'phl3Show', type: 'boolean', label: 'Pivot High Low 3', default: true, group: QUICK },
      { key: 'phlEqShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Equal Pivot High Low', default: true, group: QUICK },

          { label: 'Open/Close', value: 'Open/Close' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Open/Close reads the candle body instead of the wick, so a long shadow does not set the swing.',
      },

      ...groupInputs(GROUP_DEFAULTS[0], G1),
      ...groupInputs(GROUP_DEFAULTS[1], G2),
      ...groupInputs(GROUP_DEFAULTS[2], G3),

      { key: 'eqLeft', type: 'number', label: 'Left', default: 60, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: GEQ },
      { key: 'eqRight', type: 'number', label: 'Right', default: 30, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: GEQ },
      {

        type: 'number',
        label: 'Equal HL %',

      },

      },
    ],

    // Nothing in the source is a value per bar, so both plots are the chart
    // timeframe swing pivots the Equal High Low pass is built from, carried as

    plots: [
