            ? shortHigh - (shortHigh - shortLow) * fibValue
            : NaN
        const bull =
          Number.isFinite(longHigh) && Number.isFinite(longLow)
            ? longLow + (longHigh - longLow) * fibValue
            : NaN

        // Retracement. ta.crossover and ta.crossunder need both bars finite, or
        // the signal fires straight through the warmup gap.
        const prevHigh = i > 0 ? bars[i - 1].high : NaN
        const prevLow = i > 0 ? bars[i - 1].low : NaN
        const crossOver =
          Number.isFinite(h) &&
          Number.isFinite(bear) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevHigh) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevBearFib) &&
          h > bear &&
          prevHigh <= prevBearFib
        const crossUnder =
          Number.isFinite(l) &&
          Number.isFinite(bull) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLow) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevBullFib) &&
          l < bull &&
          prevLow >= prevBullFib

        const shortCont2 = crossOver && timePass && datePass && confirmed
        const longCont2 = crossUnder && timePass && datePass && confirmed

        // Two-step state machine: arm on the displacement candle, fire on the
        // retracement, then reset on the bar after the signal.
        shortState = shortState === 2 ? 0 : shortState
        if (shortCont1 && shortState === 0) shortState = 1
        if (!shortCont1 && shortCont2 && shortState === 1) shortState = 2

        longState = longState === 2 ? 0 : longState
        if (longCont1 && longState === 0) longState = 1
        if (!longCont1 && longCont2 && longState === 1) longState = 2

        if (Number.isFinite(bear)) bearFib[i] = bear
        if (Number.isFinite(bull)) bullFib[i] = bull
        if (shortCont1) shortCont1Col[i] = 1
        if (longCont1) longCont1Col[i] = 1
        if (shortState === 2) {
          shortSignal[i] = 1
          if (shortAnchor >= 0) shortAnchorTime[i] = bars[shortAnchor].time
        }
        if (longState === 2) {
          longSignal[i] = 1
          if (longAnchor >= 0) longAnchorTime[i] = bars[longAnchor].time
        }

        prevBearFib = bear
        prevBullFib = bull
      }

      return {
        bearFib: nulls(bearFib),
        bullFib: nulls(bullFib),
        shortSignal: nulls(shortSignal),
        longSignal: nulls(longSignal),
        shortCont1: nulls(shortCont1Col),
        longCont1: nulls(longCont1Col),
        shortAnchorTime: nulls(shortAnchorTime),
        longAnchorTime: nulls(longAnchorTime),
      }
    },

    // plotshape(location.abovebar / location.belowbar). aboveBar and belowBar
    // would anchor to this indicator's own hidden line, so the triangles sit at
    // an explicit price with padding scaled to the instrument instead.
    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return []
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      if (!showShort && !showLong) return []

      let rangeSum = 0
      let rangeCount = 0
      for (let i = Math.max(0, bars.length - 200); i < bars.length; i++) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          rangeSum += r
          rangeCount += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = rangeCount > 0 ? rangeSum / rangeCount : 0
      const lastClose = Number(bars[bars.length - 1].close)
      const pad = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, Math.abs(Number.isFinite(lastClose) ? lastClose : 0) * 0.0005)

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const bar = bars[i]
        if (showShort && values.shortSignal[i] != null && Number.isFinite(bar.high)) {
          out.push({
            time: bar.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bar.high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_LIGHT_COLOR,
          })
        }
        if (showLong && values.longSignal[i] != null && Number.isFinite(bar.low)) {
          out.push({
            time: bar.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bar.low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_LIGHT_COLOR,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // barcolor(): the displacement candle itself is repainted.
    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      return bars.map((_, i) => {
        if (showShort && values.shortCont1[i] != null) return NEG_LIGHT_COLOR
        if (showLong && values.longCont1[i] != null) return POS_LIGHT_COLOR
        return null
      })
    },

    // line.new(x1 = displacement bar, y1 = fib level, x2 = signal bar, y2 = same).
    // Anchored to bar times so the level stays welded to its candle when history
    // is paged in.
    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {

      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const styles = ['solid', 'dashed', 'dotted']

        if (showLong && values.longSignal[i] != null) {

            out.push({
              kind: 'line | `oa-ict-liquidity-void-fill` | `oa-ict-liquidity-void-fill.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/ICT) |
| ICT Liquidity Void Multi-timeframe',

    calc(bars, settings) {

      if (n === 0) return { atrHtf: column }

      const atrLength = coerce(settings.atrLength, 14, 1, true)
      const atrSeries = atr(htf.high, htf.low, htf.close, atrLength)

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const k = htf.bucketOfBar[i]
        if (k >= 0 && Number.isFinite(atrSeries[k])) column[i] = atrSeries[k]

    draws({ bars, settings }) {

      const atrSeries = atr(htf.high, htf.low, htf.close, atrLength)
      const atrMultiplier = coerce(settings.atrMultiplier, 4, 1, false)
      const percentage = coerce(settings.percentage, 2.5, 0, false)
      const showLast = coerce(settings.showLast, 2, 0, true)
      const filterMode = settings.filterMode === 'Percentage' ? 'Percentage' : 'ATR'
      const lineMode = settings.lineMode === 'OTE 0.79%' // settings.lineMode === '50%'
        ? settings.lineMode
        : 'High/Low'
      const hideCrossed = settings.hideCrossed === true

      // and na comparisons are false in Pine. In JavaScript they are not, so
      // the anchor has to be checked explicitly or a void fires on bar one.
      const passesFilter = (anchor, other, atrValue) => {

        if (filterMode === 'ATR') {
          if (!Number.isFinite(atrValue)) return false
          return Math.abs(anchor - other) > atrValue * atrMultiplier
        }
        if (anchor === 0) return false
        return Math.abs(((anchor - other) / anchor) * 100) > percentage
      }

      // The source tests 'OTE 0.79%' twice, so its third branch is unreachable
      // and only the first two forms plus the midpoint are ever produced.
      const priceSourceOf = (anchor, other) => {
        if (lineMode === 'High/Low') return anchor
        if (lineMode === 'OTE 0.79%') return other + (anchor - other) * 0.79
        return (anchor + other) / 2
      }

      const newSide = (color, up) => ({

      if (settings.showBullish !== false) sides.push(newSide(BULL_COLOR, false))
      if (sides.length === 0) return []

      for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {

        const highHtf = htf.high[k]
        const lowHtf = htf.low[k]
        const closeHtf = htf.close[k]
        const timeHtf = htf.time[k]

        // barstate.isconfirmed on the higher timeframe: the last bucket is
        // still forming, so it updates and cleans but creates nothing.

        const broke = (price) => Number.isFinite(price)
          && Number.isFinite(highHtf)
          && Number.isFinite(lowHtf)
          && highHtf >= price
          && lowHtf <= price

        for (const side of sides) {
          const trending = Number.isFinite(closeHtf) && Number.isFinite(openHtf)
            && (side.up ? closeHtf > openHtf : closeHtf < openHtf)

          if (confirmed && trending) {

              && Number.isFinite(linePrice)) {
              const line = { x1: side.anchorTime, y1: linePrice, x2: timeHtf, alive: true }
              const box = { left: side.anchorTime, top: other, bottom: side.anchorPrice, right: timeHtf, alive: true }

              if (side.allLines.length > showLast) {

          { label: 'Percentage', value: 'Percentage' },
        ],
        group: 'Void Height Filter',
        tooltip:
          'Filters remove narrow liquidity voids. ATR filtering adjusts automatically when the timeframe changes, a percentage filter stays constant across timeframes. For no filtering choose Percentage and set it to 0.',
      },
      {
        key: 'atrLength',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'ATR Period',
        default: 14,
        min: 1,
        max: 5000,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Void Height Filter',
        tooltip: 'Applicable only if Filter Using is ATR.',
      },
      {
        key: 'atrMulti',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'ATR Multiplier',
        default: 4,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Void Height Filter',
        tooltip: 'Higher the number, filters higher void height.',
      },
      {
        key: 'percentage',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Percentage Above',
        default: 2.5,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Void Height Filter',
        tooltip: 'Filters liquidity void above the given percentage.',
      },
      {
        key: 'direction',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Direction',
        default: 'Both',
        options: [
          { label: 'Both', value: 'Both' },
          { label: 'Bullish', value: 'Bullish' },
          { label: 'Bearish', value: 'Bearish' },
        ],
        group: 'Signals',
      },
      { key: 'onlyBullish', type: 'boolean', label: 'Only Bullish', default: true, group: 'Signals' },
      { key: 'onlyBearish', type: 'boolean', label: 'Only Bearish', default: true, group: 'Signals' },
    ],

    // The source plots nothing: it draws lines and boxes, and fills a screener
    // table. The two carried void levels are exposed as hidden plots so the
    // descriptor has a series and the legend can report what a signal fired on.
    plots: [
      {
        key: 'bearLevel',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Bearish Void Level',
        style: { color: BEAR_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
      {
        key: 'bullLevel',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Bullish Void Level',
        style: { color: BULL_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      const showLast = intInput(settings.showLast, 2, 0, 500)
      const lineMode = settings.lineSource // 'High/Low'
      const showBear = settings.showBear !== false
      const showBull = settings.showBull !== false
      const hideCrossed = settings.hideCrossed === true
      const filterUsing = settings.filterUsing // 'ATR'
      const atrLength = intInput(settings.atrLength, 14, 1, 5000)
      const atrMulti = numInput(settings.atrMulti, 4, 1, 100)
      const percentage = numInput(settings.percentage, 2.5, 0, 100)
      const direction = settings.direction // 'Both'
      const onlyBullish = settings.onlyBullish !== false
      const onlyBearish = settings.onlyBearish !== false

      const high = new Array(n)
      const low = new Array(n)
      const close = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        high[i] = bars[i].high
        low[i] = bars[i].low
        close[i] = bars[i].close
      }
      // Pine calls ta.atr inside the conditional block, which in v5 only
      // advances that series on the bars where the branch is taken. That is a
      // Pine wart rather than the intent, so this is the ordinary continuous
      // Wilder average over every bar.
      const atrValues = atr(high, low, close, atrLength)

      const bearLevel = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullLevel = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const signal = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lvLine = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lvLineRight = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lvTop = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lvBot = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lvBoxRight = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lvAnchor = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lvDir = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      // Both filter tests read na as false in Pine, so an unfinished ATR warmup
      // or a missing previous extreme must not let a void through here either.
      const passesFilter = (prev, other, atrValue) => {
        if (!Number.isFinite(prev) // !Number.isFinite(other)) return false
        if (filterUsing === 'ATR') {
          if (!Number.isFinite(atrValue)) return false
          return Math.abs(prev - other) > atrValue * atrMulti
        }
        if (prev === 0) return false
        const pct = Math.abs(((prev - other) / prev) * 100)
        return Number.isFinite(pct) && pct > percentage
      }

      // The third branch of the Pine ternary repeats the second condition and
      // is unreachable, so the real choices are the far edge, the 0.79
      // retracement, or the midpoint.
      const priceSource = (prev, other) => {
        if (lineMode === 'High/Low') return prev
        if (lineMode === 'OTE 0.79%') return other + (prev - other) * 0.79
        return (prev + other) / 2
      }

      const voids = []
      const makeStream = (dir) => ({
        dir,
        prev: NaN,
        prevTime: NaN,
        level: NaN,
        allLines: [],
        allBoxes: [],
        keepLines: new Set(),
        keepBoxes: new Set(),
      })
      const bearStream = makeStream(-1)
      const bullStream = makeStream(1)

      const stepStream = (stream, i, show, isActive, other, nextPrev) => {
        const time = bars[i].time
        const hi = high[i]
        const lo = low[i]

        if (show && isActive) {
          const prev = stream.prev
          const filtered = passesFilter(prev, other, atrValues[i])
          const level = priceSource(prev, other)
          // The gap itself: a bearish void needs this high at or below the
          // previous low, a bullish void this low at or above the previous high.
          const gapped =
            Number.isFinite(prev) &&
            Number.isFinite(other) &&
            (stream.dir < 0 ? other <= prev : other >= prev)

          if (gapped && filtered) {
            const item = {
              dir: stream.dir,
              index: i,
              anchor: stream.prevTime,
              linePrice: level,
              top: other,
              bottom: prev,
              lineRight: time,
              boxRight: time,
              lineAlive: true,
              boxAlive: true,
            }
            voids.push(item)
            stream.allLines.push(item)
            stream.allBoxes.push(item)
            // Only the last `showLast` of each side survive; the rest are
            // dropped off the front of the arrays and deleted.
            if (stream.allLines.length > showLast) {
              const removed = stream.allLines.shift()
              stream.keepLines.delete(removed)
              removed.lineAlive = false
            }
            if (stream.allBoxes.length > showLast) {
              const removed = stream.allBoxes.shift()
              stream.keepBoxes.delete(removed)
              removed.boxAlive = false
            }
            stream.level = level
          }

          stream.prev = nextPrev
          stream.prevTime = time
        }

        // Each drawing keeps stretching right until price trades through it,
        // and is then frozen at that bar.
        for (const item of stream.allLines) {
          if (stream.keepLines.has(item)) continue
          item.lineRight = time
          if (hi >= item.linePrice && lo <= item.linePrice) stream.keepLines.add(item)
        }
        for (const item of stream.allBoxes) {
          if (stream.keepBoxes.has(item)) continue
          item.boxRight = time
          if (hi >= item.top && lo <= item.top) stream.keepBoxes.add(item)
        }

        // Hide Crossed removes a frozen drawing once price reaches it again:
        // the level itself for a line, the far edge for a box.
        if (hideCrossed) {
          for (const item of [...stream.keepLines]) {
            if (hi >= item.linePrice && lo <= item.linePrice) {
              item.lineAlive = false
              stream.keepLines.delete(item)
              const at = stream.allLines.indexOf(item)
              if (at >= 0) stream.allLines.splice(at, 1)
            }
          }
          for (const item of [...stream.keepBoxes]) {
            if (hi >= item.bottom && lo <= item.bottom) {
              item.boxAlive = false
              stream.keepBoxes.delete(item)
              const at = stream.allBoxes.indexOf(item)
              if (at >= 0) stream.allBoxes.splice(at, 1)
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // barstate.isconfirmed: every historical bar is closed, and the forming
      // bar counts only once the host says it has closed.
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const confirmed = i < n - 1 // lastConfirmed
        const bullishCandle = Number.isFinite(close[i]) && close[i] > bars[i].open
        const bearishCandle = Number.isFinite(close[i]) && close[i] < bars[i].open

        stepStream(bearStream, i, showBear && confirmed, bullishCandle, high[i], low[i])
        stepStream(bullStream, i, showBull && confirmed, bearishCandle, low[i], high[i])

        bearLevel[i] = bearStream.level
        bullLevel[i] = bullStream.level

        // ta.crossunder(low, bull level) and ta.crossover(high, bear level).
        // Every leg has to be finite, or the cross fires straight through the
        // bars where the level did not exist yet.
        let bearishCross = false
        let bullishCross = false
        if (i > 0 && confirmed) {
          const bullNow = bullLevel[i]
          const bullPrev = bullLevel[i - 1]
          if (
            Number.isFinite(bullNow) &&
            Number.isFinite(bullPrev) &&
            Number.isFinite(low[i]) &&
            Number.isFinite(low[i - 1])
          ) {
            bearishCross = low[i] < bullNow && low[i - 1] >= bullPrev
          }
          const bearNow = bearLevel[i]
          const bearPrev = bearLevel[i - 1]
          if (
            Number.isFinite(bearNow) &&
            Number.isFinite(bearPrev) &&
            Number.isFinite(high[i]) &&
            Number.isFinite(high[i - 1])
          ) {
            bullishCross = high[i] > bearNow && high[i - 1] <= bearPrev
          }
        }

        const allowBear = direction !== 'Bullish'
        const allowBull = direction !== 'Bearish'
        if (confirmed) {
          if (onlyBullish && bearishCross && allowBear) signal[i] = -1
          else if (onlyBearish && bullishCross && allowBull) signal[i] = 1
        }
      }

      for (const item of voids) {
        const i = item.index
        lvDir[i] = item.dir
        lvAnchor[i] = item.anchor
        if (item.lineAlive) {
          lvLine[i] = item.linePrice
          lvLineRight[i] = item.lineRight
        }
        if (item.boxAlive) {
          lvTop[i] = item.top
          lvBot[i] = item.bottom
          lvBoxRight[i] = item.boxRight
        }
      }

      return {
        bearLevel: nulls(bearLevel),
        bullLevel: nulls(bullLevel),
        signal: nulls(signal),
        lvLine: nulls(lvLine),
        lvLineRight: nulls(lvLineRight),
        lvTop: nulls(lvTop),
        lvBot: nulls(lvBot),
        lvBoxRight: nulls(lvBoxRight),
        lvAnchor: nulls(lvAnchor),
        lvDir: nulls(lvDir),
      }
    },

    draws({ bars, values }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return []
      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const dir = values.lvDir[i]
        const anchor = values.lvAnchor[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(dir) // !Number.isFinite(anchor)) continue
        const colour = dir < 0 ? BEAR_COLOR : BULL_COLOR

        const top = values.lvTop[i]
        const bottom = values.lvBot[i]
        const boxRight = values.lvBoxRight[i]
        if (Number.isFinite(top) && Number.isFinite(bottom) && Number.isFinite(boxRight)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'box',
            from: { time: anchor, price: top },
            to: { time: boxRight, price: bottom },
            color: colour,
            fillColor: colour,
            opacity: BOX_OPACITY,
          })
        }

        const price = values.lvLine[i]
        const lineRight = values.lvLineRight[i]
        if (Number.isFinite(price) && Number.isFinite(lineRight)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: anchor, price },
            to: { time: lineRight, price },
            color: colour,
            lineWidth: LINE_WIDTH,
            lineStyle: 'solid',
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    markers({ bars, values }) {
      const out = []
      if (bars.length === 0) return out

      // atPrice adds no padding of its own, so it is scaled to the instrument
      // rather than fixed in points.
      let rangeSum = 0
      let rangeCount = 0
      for (let i = Math.max(0, bars.length - 50); i < bars.length; i++) {
        const span = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(span)) {
          rangeSum += span
          rangeCount += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = rangeCount > 0 ? rangeSum / rangeCount : 0
      const lastClose = bars[bars.length - 1].close
      const pad = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, Math.abs(Number.isFinite(lastClose) ? lastClose : 0) * 0.0005)

      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const value = values.signal[i]
        if (value === 1) {
          // Price has crossed back up through a bearish void, so the label
          // carries that void's colour, exactly as the source table does.
          const price = bars[i].high + pad
          if (!Number.isFinite(price)) continue
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price,
            shape: 'labelDown',
            size: 'small',
            color: BEAR_COLOR,
            text: 'H',
          })
        } else if (value === -1) {
          const price = bars[i].low - pad
          if (!Number.isFinite(price)) continue
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price,
            shape: 'labelUp',
            size: 'small',
            color: BULL_COLOR,
            text: 'L | `oa-ict-liquidity-void-screener` | `oa-ict-liquidity-void-screener.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/ICT) |
| ICT Market Structure Shift (MSS) Screener',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'scrMethod',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Screening Method',
        default: 'Market Structure Shift',
        group: 'Screener',
        options: [
          { label: 'Market Structure Shift', value: 'Market Structure Shift' },
          { label: 'Retracement to OTE / OB', value: 'Retracement to OTE / OB' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Which event fills the table: the structure shift itself, or the retracement back into the shifted range.',
      },
      {
        key: 'scrDirection',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Direction',
        default: 'Both',
        group: 'Screener',
        options: [
          { label: 'Both', value: 'Both' },
          { label: 'Bullish', value: 'Bullish' },
          { label: 'Bearish', value: 'Bearish' },
        ],
      },
      { key: 'scrShowBull', type: 'boolean', label: 'Only Bullish', default: true, group: 'Screener' },
      { key: 'scrShowBear', type: 'boolean', label: 'Only Bearish', default: true, group: 'Screener' },
      { key: 'tblRows', type: 'number', label: 'Display Rows', default: 16, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Screener' },
      {
        key: 'tblPosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Table Position',
        default: 'bottom-left',
        group: 'Screener',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
      },
      {
        key: 'tblSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Table Size',
        default: 'small',
        group: 'Screener',
        options: [
          { label: 'Auto', value: 'auto' },
          { label: 'Tiny', value: 'tiny' },
          { label: 'Small', value: 'small' },
          { label: 'Normal', value: 'normal' },
          { label: 'Large', value: 'large' },
          { label: 'Huge', value: 'huge' },
        ],
      },

      { key: 'bearShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bearish', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bearShiftShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bearish Shift', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bearRetShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bearish Retracement', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bullShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bullish', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bullShiftShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bullish Shift', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bullRetShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bullish Retracement', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      {
        key: 'zzPeriod',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Zig Zag Length',
        default: 4,
        min: 2,
        max: 500,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Zig Zag',
        tooltip: 'A bar is a swing point when it is the highest or lowest of this many bars.',
      },
      {
        key: 'zzSource',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Source',
        default: 'High/Low',
        group: 'Zig Zag',
        options: [
          { label: 'High/Low', value: 'High/Low' },
          { label: 'Open/Close', value: 'Open/Close' },
        ],
      },
      { key: 'zzShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show Zig Zag', default: false, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      {
        key: 'boxTransp',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Box Transparency',
        default: 75,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Zig Zag',
        tooltip: 'Transparency of the swing range box, 0 solid to 100 invisible.',
      },

      {
        key: 'filterChoice',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Filter Using',
        default: 'Percentage',
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        options: [
          { label: 'Multiplier', value: 'Multiplier' },
          { label: 'Percentage', value: 'Percentage' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Filters remove narrow swing displacements. Multiplier adapts to the timeframe; Percentage stays constant across all of them. Set Percentage to 0 for no filtering.',
      },
      {
        key: 'filterMultiplier',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Multiplier',
        default: 2,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'The new swing displacement must be this many times the previous one.',
      },
      {
        key: 'filterPercentage',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Percentage Above',
        default: 0.7,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Filters liquidity displacement above the given percentage.',
      },
    ],

    // Everything this study draws is geometry (boxes, levels, the zig zag) or a
    // marker, none of which is one value per bar. The zig zag pivot column is
    // the one honest per-bar series and it carries the polyline, so it is the
    // declared plot, hidden by default because on its own it is a row of dots.
    plots: [
      { key: 'zzPivot', type: 'line', title: 'Zig Zag Pivot', style: { color: ZZ_LINE_COLOR, lineWidth: 2, visible: false } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      const period = Math.max(2, Math.floor(numOr(settings.zzPeriod, 4)))
      const useBody = settings.zzSource === 'Open/Close'
      const byMultiplier = settings.filterChoice === 'Multiplier'
      const multiplier = Math.max(1, numOr(settings.filterMultiplier, 2))
      const percentage = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.filterPercentage, 0.7))
      const byRetracement = settings.scrMethod === 'Retracement to OTE / OB'
      const direction = settings.scrDirection === 'Bullish' // settings.scrDirection === 'Bearish'
        ? settings.scrDirection
        : 'Both'
      const showBullOnly = settings.scrShowBull !== false
      const showBearOnly = settings.scrShowBear !== false

      // syminfo.mintick: the chart knows it, so never ask the user for it.
      const tick = Number(ctx?.tickSize) // 0
      const snap = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) && tick > 0 ? roundToTick(v, tick) : v)

      // barstate.isconfirmed. Every bar but the last is closed; the last is only
      // closed when the host says so, and a host that says nothing is history.
      const lastIndex = Number.isFinite(ctx?.barState?.lastIndex) ? ctx.barState.lastIndex : n - 1
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false

      const zzPivot = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const zz1Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const zz2Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const zz3Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bi1Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bi2Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bi3Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearSignal = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullSignal = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearRetSignal = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullRetSignal = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearRetLevel = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullRetLevel = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearRetAnchor = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullRetAnchor = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const screenSignal = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const screenPrice = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      const columns = {
        zzPivot: nulls(zzPivot),
        zz1: zz1Col,
        zz2: zz2Col,
        zz3: zz3Col,
        bi1: bi1Col,
        bi2: bi2Col,
        bi3: bi3Col,
        bearSignal,
        bullSignal,
        bearRetSignal,
        bullRetSignal,
        bearRetLevel,
        bullRetLevel,
        bearRetAnchor,
        bullRetAnchor,
        screenSignal,
        screenPrice,
      }
      if (n === 0) return columns

      // _high / _low: the swing source, body extremes or the wick extremes.
      const hiSrc = new Array(n)
      const loSrc = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        hiSrc[i] = useBody ? Math.max(b.open, b.close) : b.high
        loSrc[i] = useBody ? Math.min(b.open, b.close) : b.low
      }
      // ta.highestbars(...) == 0 means this bar is the extreme of the window.
      // Both helpers are NaN for the first period - 1 bars, exactly as Pine is.
      const hiBars = highestBars(hiSrc, period)
      const loBars = lowestBars(loSrc, period)

      // The Pine zigzag array holds five pivots as ten slots, newest first:
      // [price0, index0, price1, index1, ...]. It is kept here as an ordered
      // list of pivots instead, oldest first, because the drawing needs the
      // whole chain and the ten slot window is derived from it.
      const pivots = []
      const pineSize = () => Math.min(pivots.length, 5) * 2
      const pineSlot = (j) => {
        const p = pivots[pivots.length - 1 - Math.floor(j / 2)]
        if (!p) return NaN
        return j % 2 === 0 ? p.price : p.index
      }

      // filter(): both bearish_filter and bullish_filter are the same call in
      // the source, so one result serves both.
      const swingFilter = (s3, s2, s1) => {
        if (!Number.isFinite(s1) // !Number.isFinite(s2) // !Number.isFinite(s3)) return false
        if (byMultiplier) return Math.abs(s1 - s2) > Math.abs(s3 - s2) * multiplier
        if (s3 === 0) return false
        return Math.abs(((s3 - s1) / s3) * 100) > percentage
      }

      let dir = 0
      let prevDir = null
      let prevClose = NaN
      let prevZz2 = NaN
      let prevHigh = NaN
      let prevLow = NaN
      let bearPrice = NaN
      let bearAnchor = NaN
      let bullPrice = NaN
      let bullAnchor = NaN
      let bearState = 0
      let bullState = 0

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const bar = bars[i]
        const close = bar.close

        const ph = hiBars[i] === 0 ? hiSrc[i] : NaN
        const pl = loBars[i] === 0 ? loSrc[i] : NaN
        const hasPh = Number.isFinite(ph)
        const hasPl = Number.isFinite(pl)

        // dir := pl and na(ph) ? -1 : ph and na(pl) ? 1 : dir
        // Pine casts the float to bool, where na is false. A price of exactly
        // zero would also read false there; no traded instrument produces one.
        if (hasPl && !hasPh) dir = -1
        else if (hasPh && !hasPl) dir = 1

        // ta.change(dir) is na on the first bar, which Pine reads as false.
        const dirChanged = prevDir !== null && dir !== prevDir

        if (hasPh // hasPl) {
          const value = dir === 1 ? ph : pl
          if (Number.isFinite(value)) {
            if (dirChanged // pivots.length === 0) {
              // add_to_zigzag: a new leg begins.
              pivots.push({ price: value, index: i })
            } else {
              // update_zigzag: the newest pivot extends in the current direction.
              const last = pivots[pivots.length - 1]
              if ((dir === 1 && value > last.price) // (dir === -1 && value < last.price)) {
                last.price = value
                last.index = i
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // The source reads the swings from the END of the array, so zz_1 is the
        // newest settled swing, zz_2 the one before it and zz_3 older still.
        const size = pineSize()
        const zz1 = size > 7 ? pineSlot(size - 8) : NaN
        const bi1 = size > 6 ? pineSlot(size - 7) : NaN
        const zz2 = size > 5 ? pineSlot(size - 6) : NaN
        const bi2 = size > 4 ? pineSlot(size - 5) : NaN
        const zz3 = size > 3 ? pineSlot(size - 4) : NaN
        const bi3 = size > 2 ? pineSlot(size - 3) : NaN

        const filterOk = swingFilter(zz3, zz2, zz1)
        const confirmed = i < lastIndex ? true : lastConfirmed
        const swingsReady = Number.isFinite(zz1) && Number.isFinite(zz2) && Number.isFinite(zz3)

        // ta.crossunder / ta.crossover against the middle swing. Every operand
        // is checked first: in JavaScript a comparison with null is not false.
        const crossReady = swingsReady && Number.isFinite(prevZz2) && Number.isFinite(prevClose)
        const crossUnder2 = crossReady && close < zz2 && prevClose >= prevZz2
        const crossOver2 = crossReady && close > zz2 && prevClose <= prevZz2

        const bearCond = swingsReady &&
          zz1 > zz2 && zz1 > zz3 &&
          zz2 < zz1 && zz2 < zz3 &&
          zz3 < zz1 && zz3 > zz2 &&
          close < zz1 && close < zz2 && close < zz3 &&
          crossUnder2 && filterOk && confirmed

        const bullCond = swingsReady &&
          zz1 < zz2 && zz1 < zz3 &&
          zz2 > zz1 && zz2 > zz3 &&
          zz3 > zz1 && zz3 < zz2 &&
          close > zz1 && close > zz2 && close > zz3 &&
          crossOver2 && filterOk && confirmed

        // One third of the way back into the broken range.
        const bearLevel = zz1 - (zz1 - zz2) / 3
        const bullLevel = zz1 + (zz2 - zz1) / 3

        // var series: the level and its anchor persist until the next shift.
        const heldBearPrice = bearPrice
        const heldBullPrice = bullPrice
        if (bearCond) {
          bearPrice = bearLevel
          bearAnchor = bi1
        }
        if (bullCond) {
          bullPrice = bullLevel
          bullAnchor = bi1
        }

        // ta.crossover(high, level) and ta.crossunder(low, level), against the
        // raw bar extremes rather than the zig zag source.
        const bearRetCond = confirmed &&
          Number.isFinite(bearPrice) && Number.isFinite(heldBearPrice) && Number.isFinite(prevHigh) &&
          bar.high > bearPrice && prevHigh <= heldBearPrice
        const bullRetCond = confirmed &&
          Number.isFinite(bullPrice) && Number.isFinite(heldBullPrice) && Number.isFinite(prevLow) &&
          bar.low < bullPrice && prevLow >= heldBullPrice

        // Shift, then retracement, then reset: state 2 lasts exactly one bar.
        let bearNext = bearState === 2 ? 0 : bearState
        if (bearCond && bearNext === 0) bearNext = 1
        if (bearRetCond && bearNext === 1) bearNext = 2
        const bearTrigger = bearNext === 2
        bearState = bearNext

        let bullNext = bullState === 2 ? 0 : bullState
        if (bullCond && bullNext === 0) bullNext = 1
        if (bullRetCond && bullNext === 1) bullNext = 2
        const bullTrigger = bullNext === 2
        bullState = bullNext

        // The screener, run on this symbol. The source pairs i_scr_show_bull
        // with the bearish branch and i_scr_show_bear with the bullish one;
        // that crossover is upstream behaviour and is reproduced, not tidied.
        const bearMethod = byRetracement ? bearTrigger && bearRetCond : bearCond
        const bullMethod = byRetracement ? bullTrigger && bullRetCond : bullCond
        const allowBull = direction !== 'Bearish'
        const allowBear = direction !== 'Bullish'
        if (confirmed) {
          let signal = NaN
          if (showBullOnly && bearMethod && allowBear) signal = -1
          else if (showBearOnly && bullMethod && allowBull) signal = 1
          if (Number.isFinite(signal)) {
            screenSignal[i] = signal
            screenPrice[i] = snap(close)
          }
        }

        zz1Col[i] = zz1
        zz2Col[i] = zz2
        zz3Col[i] = zz3
        bi1Col[i] = bi1
        bi2Col[i] = bi2
        bi3Col[i] = bi3
        if (bearCond) bearSignal[i] = 1
        if (bullCond) bullSignal[i] = 1
        if (bearTrigger) bearRetSignal[i] = 1
        if (bullTrigger) bullRetSignal[i] = 1
        bearRetLevel[i] = bearPrice
        bullRetLevel[i] = bullPrice
        bearRetAnchor[i] = bearAnchor
        bullRetAnchor[i] = bullAnchor

        prevDir = dir
        prevClose = close
        prevZz2 = zz2
        prevHigh = bar.high
        prevLow = bar.low
      }

      // A pivot keeps moving while its leg is live, so the chain is only final
      // once the whole pass is done.
      for (const p of pivots) {
        if (p.index >= 0 && p.index < n) zzPivot[p.index] = p.price
      }
      columns.zzPivot = nulls(zzPivot)

      return columns
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []

      const bearShow = settings.bearShow !== false
      const bullShow = settings.bullShow !== false
      const bearShift = settings.bearShiftShow !== false
      const bullShift = settings.bullShiftShow !== false
      const bearRet = settings.bearRetShow !== false
      const bullRet = settings.bullRetShow !== false

      // location.abovebar / location.belowbar are relative to the candle, so
      // the marker is anchored atPrice with a gap scaled to the instrument.
      let rangeSum = 0
      let rangeCount = 0
      for (const b of bars) {
        const r = b.high - b.low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          rangeSum += r
          rangeCount += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = rangeCount > 0 ? rangeSum / rangeCount : 0
      const lastClose = Number.isFinite(bars[n - 1].close) ? bars[n - 1].close : 0
      const gap = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, Math.abs(lastClose) * 0.0005)

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(b.high) // !Number.isFinite(b.low)) continue
        if (bearShow && bearShift && values.bearSignal[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.high + gap,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
        if (bullShow && bullShift && values.bullSignal[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.low - gap,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
        // plotchar() with a rotation arrow becomes a short text marker: the
        // glyph was decoration, the position and the colour carry the meaning.
        // Marker text always renders above its anchor, so the one that belongs
        // under the candle is dropped a further gap to clear the low.
        if (bearShow && bearRet && values.bearRetSignal[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.high + gap,
            shape: 'text',
            size: 'tiny',
            text: 'Ret',
            color: BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
        if (bullShow && bullRet && values.bullRetSignal[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.low - gap * 2,
            shape: 'text',
            size: 'tiny',
            text: 'Ret',
            color: BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const out = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const bearShow = settings.bearShow !== false
      const bullShow = settings.bullShow !== false
      const bearShift = settings.bearShiftShow !== false
      const bullShift = settings.bullShiftShow !== false
      const bearRet = settings.bearRetShow !== false
      const bullRet = settings.bullRetShow !== false

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // Two barcolor() calls in the source, shift first and retracement
        // second, so the retracement colour wins where both land on one bar.
        let colour = null
        if (bearShow && bearShift && values.bearSignal[i] === 1) colour = BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR
        else if (bullShow && bullShift && values.bullSignal[i] === 1) colour = BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR
        if (bearShow && bearRet && values.bearRetSignal[i] === 1) colour = BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR
        else if (bullShow && bullRet && values.bullRetSignal[i] === 1) colour = BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR
        out[i] = colour
      }
      return out
    },

    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []

      const bearShow = settings.bearShow !== false
      const bullShow = settings.bullShow !== false
      const bearShift = settings.bearShiftShow !== false
      const bullShift = settings.bullShiftShow !== false
      const bearRet = settings.bearRetShow !== false
      const bullRet = settings.bullRetShow !== false
      const transparency = clamp(numOr(settings.boxTransp, 75), 0, 100)
      const boxOpacity = (100 - transparency) / 100

      // bar_index anchors become bar times: paging older history in shifts every
      // index, and a box welded to an index would slide off its swings.
      const timeAt = (idx) => {
        if (!Number.isFinite(idx)) return NaN
        const k = Math.round(idx)
        if (k < 0 // k >= n) return NaN
        return bars[k].time
      }
      const anchored = (t, p) => Number.isFinite(t) && Number.isFinite(p)

      const out = []

      // line.new between consecutive zig zag pivots. Both Pine colour defaults
      // are the same, so the whole chain is one polyline rather than a segment
      // per leg.
      if (settings.zzShow === true) {
        const points = []
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const p = values.zzPivot[i]
          if (p != null && Number.isFinite(p)) points.push({ time: bars[i].time, price: p })
        }
        const kept = points.length > MAX_ZZ_POINTS ? points.slice(points.length - MAX_ZZ_POINTS) : points
        if (kept.length >= 2) {
          out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points: kept, color: ZZ_LINE_COLOR, lineWidth: 2 })
        }
      }

      // The swing range box and the broken level, newest first up to the cap.
      let events = 0
      for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0 && events < MAX_EVENTS; i--) {
        const isBear = bearShow && values.bearSignal[i] === 1
        const isBull = bullShow && values.bullSignal[i] === 1
        if (!isBear && !isBull) continue
        events += 1

        const colour = isBear ? NEG_COLOR : POS_COLOR
        const t3 = timeAt(values.bi3[i])
        const t1 = timeAt(values.bi1[i])
        const zz3 = values.zz3[i]
        const zz1 = values.zz1[i]
        if (anchored(t3, zz3) && anchored(t1, zz1)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'box',
            from: { time: t3, price: zz3 },
            to: { time: t1, price: zz1 },
            // border_color=#00000000 in the source: the box is a shade, not an outline.
            color: withAlpha(colour, 0),
            fillColor: colour,
            opacity: boxOpacity,
          })
        }

        const showLevel = isBear ? bearShift : bullShift
        const t2 = timeAt(values.bi2[i])
        const zz2 = values.zz2[i]
        if (showLevel && anchored(t2, zz2)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: t2, price: zz2 },
            to: { time: bars[i].time, price: zz2 },
            color: colour,
            lineWidth: 1,
            lineStyle: 'dashed',
          })
        }
      }

      // The retracement level, drawn back to the swing it was measured from.
      let retracements = 0
      for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0 && retracements < MAX_EVENTS; i--) {
        const isBear = bearShow && bearRet && values.bearRetSignal[i] === 1
        const isBull = bullShow && bullRet && values.bullRetSignal[i] === 1
        if (!isBear && !isBull) continue
        retracements += 1

        const price = isBear ? values.bearRetLevel[i] : values.bullRetLevel[i]
        const anchor = timeAt(isBear ? values.bearRetAnchor[i] : values.bullRetAnchor[i])
        if (!anchored(anchor, price)) continue
        out.push({
          kind: 'line',
          from: { time: anchor, price },
          to: { time: bars[i].time, price },
          color: isBear ? NEG_COLOR : POS_COLOR,
          lineWidth: 1,
          lineStyle: 'dotted',
        })
      }

      return out
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return null

      const rows = Math.max(0, Math.floor(numOr(settings.tblRows, 16)))
      const method = settings.scrMethod === 'Retracement to OTE / OB'
        ? 'Retracement to OTE / OB'
        : 'Market Structure Shift'
      const zone = typeof settings.timezone === 'string' && isValidTimezone(settings.timezone)
        ? settings.timezone
        : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      // timeframe.isintraday, read from the bars because the table hook is
      // handed no context: anything under a day apart is an intraday series.
      let intraday = false
      for (let i = Math.max(1, n - 10); i < n; i++) {
        const step = bars[i].time - bars[i - 1].time
        if (step > 0 && step < 86400) {
          intraday = true
          break
        }
      }
      const stamp = (t) => {
        const p = utcSecondsToZonedParts(t, zone)
        const date = `${pad2(p.day)}-${pad2(p.month)}-${p.year}`
        return intraday ? `${pad2(p.hour)}:${pad2(p.minute)}  ${date}` : date
      }

      const head = (text) => ({
        text,
        textColor: NEUTRAL_COLOR,
        bgColor: withAlpha(NEUTRAL_COLOR, 0.1),
        align: 'center',
      })
      const cell = (text, colour) => ({
        text,
        textColor: colour,
        bgColor: withAlpha(colour, 0.1),
        align: 'left',
      })

      // The source builds its matrix newest first and trims the tail, so the
      // newest signals are the ones that survive.
      const body = []
      for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0 && body.length < rows; i--) {
        const signal = values.screenSignal[i]
        if (signal !== 1 && signal !== -1) continue
        const colour = signal === 1 ? POS_COLOR : NEG_COLOR
        body.push([
          cell(stamp(bars[i].time), colour),
          cell(priceText(values.screenPrice[i]), colour),
          cell(signal === 1 ? 'Bullish' : 'Bearish', colour),
        ])
      }

      return {
        rows: [
          [head(method), head(''), head('')],
          [head('Time'), head('Price'), head('Signal')],
          ...body,
        ],
        options: {
          position: String(settings.tblPosition ?? 'bottom-left | `oa-ict-market-structure-shift-mss-screener` | `oa-ict-market-structure-shift-mss-screener.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/ICT) |
| ICT Market Structure Shift (MSS)',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      { key: 'bearShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bearish', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bearShiftShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bearish Shift', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bearRetShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bearish Retracement', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bullShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bullish', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bullShiftShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bullish Shift', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'bullRetShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Bullish Retracement', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'zzPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'Zig Zag Length', default: 4, min: 2, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      {
        key: 'zzSource',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Source',
        default: 'High/Low',
        options: [
          { label: 'High/Low', value: 'High/Low' },
          { label: 'Open/Close', value: 'Open/Close' },
        ],
        group: 'Zig Zag',
      },
      { key: 'zzShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show Zig Zag', default: false, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      {
        key: 'boxTransparency',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Box Transparency',
        default: 75,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 1,
        tooltip: 'Matches the Pine transp argument on the swing range box: 0 is solid, 100 is invisible.',
        group: 'Zig Zag',
      },
      {
        key: 'filterChoice',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Filter Using',
        default: 'Percentage',
        options: [
          { label: 'Multiplier', value: 'Multiplier' },
          { label: 'Percentage', value: 'Percentage' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Filters out narrow swing displacements. Multiplier rescales with the timeframe, percentage stays constant across all of them. Set Percentage to 0 for no filtering.',
        group: 'Additional Filters',
      },
      {
        key: 'multiplier',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Multiplier',
        default: 2,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        tooltip: 'A shift only counts when the new swing displacement is this many times the previous one.',
        group: 'Additional Filters',
      },
      {
        key: 'percentage',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Percentage Above',
        default: 0.7,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        tooltip: 'A shift only counts when the swing displacement exceeds this percentage of the older swing price.',
        group: 'Additional Filters',
      },
    ],

    // Nothing here is a value per bar that wants a line. Every column exists so
    // markers, draws and barColors can read it: those hooks are handed values
    // and never store.
    plots: [
      { key: 'zzPivot', type: 'line', title: 'Zig Zag', style: { visible: false } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const period = Math.max(2, Math.floor(Number(settings.zzPeriod) // 4))
      const useOpenClose = settings.zzSource === 'Open/Close'
      const filterChoice = settings.filterChoice === 'Multiplier' ? 'Multiplier' : 'Percentage'
      const multiplier = Math.max(1, Number(settings.multiplier) // 2)
      // A deliberate 0 disables the percentage filter, so a plain `// 0.7` would
      // silently override it. Only a cleared or unreadable field falls back.
      const rawPct = Number(settings.percentage)
      const percentage =
        settings.percentage === '' // settings.percentage == null // !Number.isFinite(rawPct)
          ? 0.7
          : Math.max(0, rawPct)

      const zzPivot = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const zz1Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const zz2Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const zz3Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bi1Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bi2Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bi3Col = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearShiftCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullShiftCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearRetCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullRetCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearRetPriceCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bearRetBiCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullRetPriceCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bullRetBiCol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      const result = () => ({
        zzPivot: nulls(zzPivot),
        zz1: nulls(zz1Col),
        zz2: nulls(zz2Col),
        zz3: nulls(zz3Col),
        bi1: nulls(bi1Col),
        bi2: nulls(bi2Col),
        bi3: nulls(bi3Col),
        bearShift: nulls(bearShiftCol),
        bullShift: nulls(bullShiftCol),
        bearRet: nulls(bearRetCol),
        bullRet: nulls(bullRetCol),
        bearRetPrice: nulls(bearRetPriceCol),
        bearRetBi: nulls(bearRetBiCol),
        bullRetPrice: nulls(bullRetPriceCol),
        bullRetBi: nulls(bullRetBiCol),
      })
      if (n === 0) return result()

      // barstate.isconfirmed is true on every closed bar and false only on a
      // still-forming last bar. With no context the history is all there is.
      const lastConfirmed = !(ctx && ctx.barState && ctx.barState.isConfirmed === false)
      const confirmedAt = (i) => (i < n - 1 ? true : lastConfirmed)

      const hi = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lo = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        if (useOpenClose) {
          if (Number.isFinite(b.open) && Number.isFinite(b.close)) {
            hi[i] = Math.max(b.open, b.close)
            lo[i] = Math.min(b.open, b.close)
          }
        } else {
          if (Number.isFinite(b.high)) hi[i] = b.high
          if (Number.isFinite(b.low)) lo[i] = b.low
        }
      }

      // ta.highestbars(_high, period) == 0 means this bar holds the window's
      // high. Pine has no value until the window is full, so the first
      // period - 1 bars produce no pivot at all.
      const isWindowHigh = (i) => {
        if (i < period - 1) return false
        const v = hi[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return false
        for (let k = 1; k < period; k++) {
          if (Number.isFinite(hi[i - k]) && hi[i - k] > v) return false
        }
        return true
      }
      const isWindowLow = (i) => {
        if (i < period - 1) return false
        const v = lo[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return false
        for (let k = 1; k < period; k++) {
          if (Number.isFinite(lo[i - k]) && lo[i - k] < v) return false
        }
        return true
      }

      // The Pine array is [value0, barIndex0, value1, barIndex1, ...] with the
      // newest pivot at the front, capped at ten entries. The cap is what makes
      // the swing lookups below shift while the history is still short, so the
      // array is reproduced literally rather than replaced by a tidier list.
      const MAX_ARRAY_SIZE = 10
      const zigzag = []
      const pivots = []

      const addToZigzag = (value, barIndex) => {
        zigzag.unshift(barIndex)
        zigzag.unshift(value)
        if (zigzag.length > MAX_ARRAY_SIZE) {
          zigzag.pop()
          zigzag.pop()
        }
        pivots.push({ value, bar: barIndex })
      }
      const updateZigzag = (value, barIndex, dir) => {
        if (zigzag.length === 0) {
          addToZigzag(value, barIndex)
          return
        }
        const head = zigzag[0]
        if ((dir === 1 && value > head) // (dir === -1 && value < head)) {
          zigzag[0] = value
          zigzag[1] = barIndex
          if (pivots.length > 0) pivots[pivots.length - 1] = { value, bar: barIndex }
        }
      }

      let prevDir = 0
      let prevZz2 = NaN
      let prevHigh = NaN
      let prevLow = NaN
      let prevClose = NaN
      let bearRetPrice = NaN
      let bearRetBi = NaN
      let bullRetPrice = NaN
      let bullRetBi = NaN
      let prevBearRetPrice = NaN
      let prevBullRetPrice = NaN
      let bearStatePrev = 0
      let bullStatePrev = 0

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const ph = isWindowHigh(i) ? hi[i] : NaN
        const pl = isWindowLow(i) ? lo[i] : NaN

        // var dir := pl and na(ph) ? -1 : ph and na(pl) ? 1 : dir
        let dir
        if (truthy(pl) && !Number.isFinite(ph)) dir = -1
        else if (truthy(ph) && !Number.isFinite(pl)) dir = 1
        else dir = prevDir

        // ta.change(dir) is na on the first bar, which reads as false.
        const dirChanged = i > 0 && dir !== prevDir

        if (truthy(ph) // truthy(pl)) {
          const value = dir === 1 ? ph : pl
          if (Number.isFinite(value)) {
            if (dirChanged) addToZigzag(value, i)
            else updateZigzag(value, i, dir)
          }
        }

        // The three most recent completed swings, read off the capped array by
        // the source's own offsets. While the array is short these land on
        // different pivots than they do once it is full; that is the source's
        // behaviour and it is reproduced, not corrected.
        const size = zigzag.length
        const zz1 = size > 7 ? zigzag[size - 8] : NaN
        const bi1 = size > 6 ? zigzag[size - 7] : NaN
        const zz2 = size > 5 ? zigzag[size - 6] : NaN
        const bi2 = size > 4 ? zigzag[size - 5] : NaN
        const zz3 = size > 3 ? zigzag[size - 4] : NaN
        const bi3 = size > 2 ? zigzag[size - 3] : NaN

        zz1Col[i] = zz1
        zz2Col[i] = zz2
        zz3Col[i] = zz3
        bi1Col[i] = bi1
        bi2Col[i] = bi2
        bi3Col[i] = bi3

        const swingsReady = Number.isFinite(zz1) && Number.isFinite(zz2) && Number.isFinite(zz3)

        let passFilter = false
        if (swingsReady) {
          if (filterChoice === 'Multiplier') {
            passFilter = Math.abs(zz1 - zz2) > Math.abs(zz3 - zz2) * multiplier
          } else if (zz3 !== 0) {
            passFilter = Math.abs(((zz3 - zz1) / zz3) * 100) > percentage
          }
        }

        const close = bars[i].close
        const high = bars[i].high
        const low = bars[i].low
        const confirmed = confirmedAt(i)

        // Every comparison is guarded: in JavaScript `5 > null` is true, so an
        // unguarded test would fire straight through the warmup.
        const crossReady =
          swingsReady && Number.isFinite(close) && Number.isFinite(prevClose) && Number.isFinite(prevZz2)
        const crossUnderZz2 = crossReady && close < zz2 && prevClose >= prevZz2
        const crossOverZz2 = crossReady && close > zz2 && prevClose <= prevZz2

        const bearishCondition =
          swingsReady &&
          Number.isFinite(close) &&
          zz1 > zz2 &&
          zz1 > zz3 &&
          zz2 < zz3 &&
          close < zz1 &&
          close < zz2 &&
          close < zz3 &&
          crossUnderZz2 &&
          passFilter &&
          confirmed

        const bullishCondition =
          swingsReady &&
          Number.isFinite(close) &&
          zz1 < zz2 &&
          zz1 < zz3 &&
          zz2 > zz3 &&
          close > zz1 &&
          close > zz2 &&
          close > zz3 &&
          crossOverZz2 &&
          passFilter &&
          confirmed

        if (bearishCondition) bearShiftCol[i] = 1
        if (bullishCondition) bullShiftCol[i] = 1

        // A third of the way back into the broken swing range.
        const bearRetLevel = swingsReady ? zz1 - (zz1 - zz2) / 3 : NaN
        const bullRetLevel = swingsReady ? zz1 + (zz2 - zz1) / 3 : NaN

        // Pine latches the retracement price before testing the cross, so the
        // shift bar itself can complete the sequence.
        if (bearishCondition) {
          bearRetPrice = bearRetLevel
          bearRetBi = bi1
        }
        if (bullishCondition) {
          bullRetPrice = bullRetLevel
          bullRetBi = bi1
        }

        const bearRetCondition =
          Number.isFinite(high) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevHigh) &&
          Number.isFinite(bearRetPrice) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevBearRetPrice) &&
          high > bearRetPrice &&
          prevHigh <= prevBearRetPrice &&
          confirmed

        const bullRetCondition =
          Number.isFinite(low) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLow) &&
          Number.isFinite(bullRetPrice) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevBullRetPrice) &&
          low < bullRetPrice &&
          prevLow >= prevBullRetPrice &&
          confirmed

        // A three-step latch: 0 waiting, 1 shift seen, 2 retracement taken. The
        // 2 lives for exactly one bar and then resets.
        let bearState = bearStatePrev === 2 ? 0 : bearStatePrev
        if (bearishCondition && bearState === 0) bearState = 1
        if (bearRetCondition && bearState === 1) bearState = 2

        let bullState = bullStatePrev === 2 ? 0 : bullStatePrev
        if (bullishCondition && bullState === 0) bullState = 1
        if (bullRetCondition && bullState === 1) bullState = 2

        if (bearState === 2) {
          bearRetCol[i] = 1
          bearRetPriceCol[i] = bearRetPrice
          bearRetBiCol[i] = bearRetBi
        }
        if (bullState === 2) {
          bullRetCol[i] = 1
          bullRetPriceCol[i] = bullRetPrice
          bullRetBiCol[i] = bullRetBi
        }

        prevDir = dir
        prevZz2 = zz2
        prevHigh = high
        prevLow = low
        prevClose = close
        prevBearRetPrice = bearRetPrice
        prevBullRetPrice = bullRetPrice
        bearStatePrev = bearState
        bullStatePrev = bullState
      }

      for (const p of pivots) {
        if (p.bar >= 0 && p.bar < n) zzPivot[p.bar] = p.value
      }

      return result()
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const bearShow = settings.bearShow !== false
      const bullShow = settings.bullShow !== false
      const bearShiftShow = settings.bearShiftShow !== false
      const bullShiftShow = settings.bullShiftShow !== false
      const bearRetShow = settings.bearRetShow !== false
      const bullRetShow = settings.bullRetShow !== false

      // atPrice adds no padding, so the gap is computed from the instrument
      // rather than fixed in points, which would suit one symbol and no other.
      let rangeSum = 0
      let rangeCount = 0
      let lastClose = 0
      for (const b of bars) {
        if (Number.isFinite(b.high) && Number.isFinite(b.low)) {
          rangeSum += b.high - b.low
          rangeCount += 1
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(b.close)) lastClose = b.close
      }
      const meanRange = rangeCount > 0 ? rangeSum / rangeCount : 0
      const pad = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, Math.abs(lastClose) * 0.0005)

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(b.high) // !Number.isFinite(b.low)) continue

        if (bearShow && bearShiftShow && values.bearShift[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
        if (bullShow && bullShiftShow && values.bullShift[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
        // The source marks a retracement with a curved-arrow glyph; a plain
        // letter carries the same meaning without a pictogram.
        if (bearShow && bearRetShow && values.bearRet[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.high + pad * 2,
            shape: 'text',
            size: 'tiny',
            text: 'R',
            color: BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
        if (bullShow && bullRetShow && values.bullRet[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: b.time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: b.low - pad * 2,
            shape: 'text',
            size: 'tiny',
            text: 'R',
            color: BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const bearShow = settings.bearShow !== false
      const bullShow = settings.bullShow !== false
      const bearShiftShow = settings.bearShiftShow !== false
      const bullShiftShow = settings.bullShiftShow !== false
      const bearRetShow = settings.bearRetShow !== false
      const bullRetShow = settings.bullRetShow !== false

      // The source paints twice: shift candles first, retracement candles after,
      // so a bar that is both takes the retracement colour.
      return bars.map((_, i) => {
        if (bearShow && bearRetShow && values.bearRet[i] != null) return BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR
        if (bullShow && bullRetShow && values.bullRet[i] != null) return BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR
        if (bearShow && bearShiftShow && values.bearShift[i] != null) return BEAR_SIGNAL_COLOR
        if (bullShow && bullShiftShow && values.bullShift[i] != null) return BULL_SIGNAL_COLOR
        return null
      })
    },

    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const bearShow = settings.bearShow !== false
      const bullShow = settings.bullShow !== false
      const bearShiftShow = settings.bearShiftShow !== false
      const bullShiftShow = settings.bullShiftShow !== false
      const bearRetShow = settings.bearRetShow !== false
      const bullRetShow = settings.bullRetShow !== false
      const zzShow = settings.zzShow === true

      const rawTransp = Number(settings.boxTransparency)
      const transparency = Number.isFinite(rawTransp) ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, rawTransp)) : 75
      const boxOpacity = (100 - transparency) / 100

      // A bar index only means something while it points into the loaded bars.
      const timeAt = (raw) => {
        const idx = Math.round(Number(raw))
        if (!Number.isFinite(idx) // idx < 0 // idx >= n) return null
        return bars[idx].time
      }

      const out = []
      // Walk backwards so the cap keeps the most recent structures.
      for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0 && out.length < MAX_DRAWINGS; i--) {
        const isBear = values.bearShift[i] != null
        const isBull = values.bullShift[i] != null
        if (!isBear && !isBull) continue
        if (isBear && !bearShow) continue
        if (isBull && !bullShow) continue

        const zz1 = values.zz1[i]
        const zz2 = values.zz2[i]
        const zz3 = values.zz3[i]
        const t3 = timeAt(values.bi3[i])
        const t1 = timeAt(values.bi1[i])
        const t2 = timeAt(values.bi2[i])
        const colour = isBear ? NEG_COLOR : POS_COLOR

        if (t3 != null && t1 != null && zz3 != null && zz1 != null) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'box',
            from: { time: t3, price: zz3 },
            to: { time: t1, price: zz1 },
            // The source draws the border fully transparent.
            color: withAlpha(colour, 0),
            fillColor: colour,
            opacity: boxOpacity,
          })
        }

        const shiftShow = isBear ? bearShiftShow : bullShiftShow
        if (shiftShow && t2 != null && zz2 != null) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: t2, price: zz2 },
            to: { time: bars[i].time, price: zz2 },
            color: colour,
            lineWidth: 1,
            lineStyle: 'dashed',
          })
        }
      }

      // Retracement levels, drawn from the swing they were measured off to the
      // bar that took them.
      for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0 && out.length < MAX_DRAWINGS * 2; i--) {
        if (bearShow && bearRetShow && values.bearRet[i] != null) {
          const price = values.bearRetPrice[i]
          const t = timeAt(values.bearRetBi[i])
          if (t != null && price != null) {
            out.push({
              kind: 'line',
              from: { time: t, price },
              to: { time: bars[i].time, price },
              color: NEG_COLOR,
              lineWidth: 1,
              lineStyle: 'dotted',
            })
          }
        }
        if (bullShow && bullRetShow && values.bullRet[i] != null) {
          const price = values.bullRetPrice[i]
          const t = timeAt(values.bullRetBi[i])
          if (t != null && price != null) {
            out.push({
              kind: 'line',
              from: { time: t, price },
              to: { time: bars[i].time, price },
              color: POS_COLOR,
              lineWidth: 1,
              lineStyle: 'dotted',
            })
          }
        }
      }

      if (zzShow) {
        const points = []
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const v = values.zzPivot[i]
          if (v != null) points.push({ time: bars[i].time, price: v })
        }
        // The source rebuilds one segment at a time; the finished shape is the
        // polyline through every pivot it has kept.
        const tail = points.length > MAX_DRAWINGS ? points.slice(points.length - MAX_DRAWINGS) : points
        if (tail.length > 1) {
          out.push({ kind: 'polyline | `oa-ict-market-structure-shift-mss` | `oa-ict-market-structure-shift-mss.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/ICT) |
| ICT Mitigation Block Scanner',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'method',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Screening Method',
        default: 'Mitigation Block',
        group: 'Signals',
        options: [
          { label: 'Mitigation Block', value: 'Mitigation Block' },
          { label: 'Retracement', value: 'Retracement' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Mitigation Block marks the shift bar itself. Retracement waits for price to come back to the level that shift left behind.',
      },
      { key: 'showLong', type: 'boolean', label: 'Long Signals', default: true, group: 'Signals' },
      { key: 'showShort', type: 'boolean', label: 'Short Signals', default: true, group: 'Signals' },

      { key: 'zzDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Zig Zag', default: true, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      { key: 'zzPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'Zig Zag Length', default: 3, min: 2, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Zig Zag' },
      {
        key: 'zzSource',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Source',
        default: 'High/Low',
        group: 'Zig Zag',
        options: [
          { label: 'High/Low', value: 'High/Low' },
          { label: 'Open/Close', value: 'Open/Close' },
          { label: 'Close', value: 'Close' },
        ],
      },
      {
        key: 'zzBoxTransp',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Box Transparency',
        default: 85,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Zig Zag',
        tooltip: 'Transparency of the structure box, as in the source: 0 is solid and 100 is invisible.',
      },

      {
        key: 'pchgFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply % Change Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Source behaviour: the script requires the day change to be both above +N and below -N at once, which nothing satisfies, so switching this on suppresses every signal. Ported as written rather than corrected.',
      },
      { key: 'pchgAboveBelow', type: 'number', label: '% Change Above/Below +/-', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'volFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volAbove', type: 'number', label: 'Volume Above', default: 500000, min: 0, max: 1000000000000, step: 1000, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'volPchgFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume % Change Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volPchgAbove', type: 'number', label: 'Volume % Change Above', default: 0, min: 0, max: 100000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'atrFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply ATR Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrMulti', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'bodyFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body % Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyPercent', type: 'number', label: 'Body % Above', default: 60, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'bodySizeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body Size Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'Body Size Multiplier (x)', default: 2, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'volumeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume SMA Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'Volume SMA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'relVolFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Relative Volume Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolLength', type: 'number', label: 'Relative Volume Length', default: 90, min: 2, max: 2000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolMulti', type: 'number', label: 'Rel Vol SMA Multiplier', default: 5, min: 0, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'timeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Time Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'dateFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Date Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'day', type: 'number', label: 'Day', default: 25, min: 1, max: 31, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'month', type: 'number', label: 'Month', default: 10, min: 1, max: 12, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'year', type: 'number', label: 'Year', default: 2024, min: 0, max: 9999, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'showDataTable', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Table', default: true, group: 'Data Table' },
      {
        key: 'tablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'bottom-right',
        group: 'Data Table',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
      },
      { key: 'tableFontSize', type: 'number', label: 'Size', default: 12, min: 8, max: 20, step: 1, group: 'Data Table' },
    ],

    /* Nothing here is a value per bar: the zig zag, the boxes and the levels are
     * geometry (draws), the signals are markers and bar colours, and the
     * readings are a table. A descriptor still needs one plot, so this carries
     * the hidden placeholder the built-in seasonality study uses for the same
     * reason. Every column below it is read by a hook, never drawn as a line. */
    plots: [{ key: 'none', type: 'line', title: '', style: { visible: false } }],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      const zzPeriod = int(settings.zzPeriod, 3, 2, 500)
      const zzSource =
        settings.zzSource === 'Open/Close' // settings.zzSource === 'Close' ? settings.zzSource : 'High/Low'

      const pchgFilter = settings.pchgFilter === true
      const pchgAboveBelow = flt(settings.pchgAboveBelow, 2, 0, 1000)
      const volFilter = settings.volFilter === true
      const volAbove = flt(settings.volAbove, 500000, 0, 1000000000000)
      const volPchgFilter = settings.volPchgFilter === true
      const volPchgAbove = flt(settings.volPchgAbove, 0, 0, 100000)
      const atrFilter = settings.atrFilter === true
      const atrLength = int(settings.atrLength, 14, 1, 1000)
      const atrMulti = flt(settings.atrMulti, 1, 1, 100)
      const bodyFilter = settings.bodyFilter === true
      /* Pine divides this input by 100 where it is declared. */
      const bodyPercent = flt(settings.bodyPercent, 60, 0, 100) / 100
      const bodySizeFilter = settings.bodySizeFilter === true
      const bodySizeMultiplier = int(settings.bodySizeMultiplier, 2, 0, 100)
      const volumeFilter = settings.volumeFilter === true
      const volSmaLength = int(settings.volSmaLength, 20, 1, 1000)
      const relVolFilter = settings.relVolFilter === true
      const relVolLength = int(settings.relVolLength, 90, 2, 2000)
      const relVolMulti = flt(settings.relVolMulti, 5, 0, 100)
      const timeFilter = settings.timeFilter === true
      const hourFrom = int(settings.hourFrom, 9, 0, 23)
      const minuteFrom = int(settings.minuteFrom, 15, 0, 59)
      const hourTo = int(settings.hourTo, 10, 0, 23)
      const minuteTo = int(settings.minuteTo, 15, 0, 59)
      const dateFilter = settings.dateFilter === true
      const dayOf = int(settings.day, 25, 1, 31)
      const monthOf = int(settings.month, 10, 1, 12)
