      const yearOf = int(settings.year, 2024, 0, 9999)

      const zone = zoneOf(settings, ctx)
      const col = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      /* ---- zig zag source -------------------------------------------------
       * The 'Open/Close' branch takes math.max(open, close) for the low as well
       * as for the high. That is what the source does, so it is what this does. */
      const zHigh = col()
      const zLow = col()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        if (zzSource === 'Open/Close') {
          const m = Math.max(b.open, b.close)
          zHigh[i] = m
          zLow[i] = m
        } else if (zzSource === 'Close') {
          zHigh[i] = b.close
          zLow[i] = b.close
        } else {
          zHigh[i] = b.high
          zLow[i] = b.low
        }
      }
      /* highestBars and lowestBars carry Pine's convention: 0 means this bar is
       * the extreme of the window, and NaN for the first zzPeriod - 1 bars. */
      const hb = highestBars(zHigh, zzPeriod)
      const lb = lowestBars(zLow, zzPeriod)

      /* ---- series the filters read ----------------------------------------- */
      const highs = new Array(n)
      const lows = new Array(n)
      const closes = new Array(n)
      const vols = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        highs[i] = bars[i].high
        lows[i] = bars[i].low
        closes[i] = bars[i].close
        /* An index series carries no volume. Pine would read na there and every
         * volume test would be false; NaN does exactly the same here. */
        vols[i] = Number.isFinite(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : NaN
      }
      const atrArr = atr(highs, lows, closes, atrLength)
      const volSma = sma(vols, volSmaLength)

      /* relative_volume = volume / average_volume[1], then its own SMA. */
      const avgVol = sma(vols, relVolLength)
      const relVol = col()
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        const a = avgVol[i - 1]
        if (!Number.isFinite(a) // a === 0 // !Number.isFinite(vols[i])) continue
        relVol[i] = vols[i] / a
      }
      const relVolSma = sma(relVol, relVolLength)

      /* ---- daily cumulative change and volume -------------------------------
       * ta.change(time('D')) is na on the first bar, so the first bar is never a
       * new day. Bar times are UTC seconds, so the boundary is resolved in the
       * chart's zone and not in the browser's. */
      const newDay = new Array(n).fill(false)
      if (n > 0) {
        let prevDayIdx = zonedDayIndex(bars[0].time, zone)
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
          const d = zonedDayIndex(bars[i].time, zone)
          newDay[i] = d !== prevDayIdx
          prevDayIdx = d
        }
      }

      const cumPchg = col()
      let cum = NaN
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const prevClose = i > 0 ? closes[i - 1] : NaN
        const daily =
          !Number.isFinite(prevClose) // prevClose === 0 ? 0 : ((closes[i] - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100
        cum = newDay[i] ? daily : !Number.isFinite(cum) ? daily : cum + daily
        cumPchg[i] = cum
      }

      /* The source seeds current_cum_vol with na and adds to it, so it stays na
       * for the whole first day. NaN reproduces that, and the volume filters
       * read false through that stretch just as Pine does. */
      const dayVol = col()
      const prevDayVol = col()
      let curVol = NaN
      let priorVol = NaN
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (newDay[i]) {
          priorVol = curVol
          curVol = vols[i]
        } else {
          curVol = curVol + vols[i]
        }
        dayVol[i] = curVol
        prevDayVol[i] = priorVol
      }

      const cumVolPchg = col()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        /* nz(prev_cum_vol, current_cum_vol) */
        const base = Number.isFinite(prevDayVol[i]) ? prevDayVol[i] : dayVol[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(base) // base === 0 // !Number.isFinite(dayVol[i])) continue
        cumVolPchg[i] = ((dayVol[i] - base) / base) * 100
      }

      const parts = timeFilter // dateFilter ? bars.map((b) => utcSecondsToZonedParts(b.time, zone)) : null

      /* ---- output columns --------------------------------------------------- */
      const none = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const shortShift = col()
      const longShift = col()
      const shortRet = col()
      const longRet = col()
      const boxLeft = col()
      const boxRight = col()
      const boxTop = col()
      const boxBottom = col()
      const mbLineBar = col()
      const mbLevel = col()
      const retShortBar = col()
      const retShortLevel = col()
      const retLongBar = col()
      const retLongLevel = col()
      const zzValue = col()
      const zzDir = col()

      /* ---- zig zag state -----------------------------------------------------
       * Pine keeps one float array holding value, bar index, value, bar index,
       * newest first, capped at 18 entries (nine pivots). The full list is kept
       * here so the whole zig zag can still be drawn, and the capped view is
       * emulated for the pivot reads, which index from the END of that array. */
      const pv = []
      let dir = 0

      /* Retracement state, all Pine `var`s. */
      let shortBreakPrice = NaN
      let shortBreakBar = NaN
      let prevShortBreakPrice = NaN
      let longBreakPrice = NaN
      let longBreakBar = NaN
      let prevLongBreakPrice = NaN
      let shortState = 0
      let longState = 0
      let prevZz2 = NaN

      /* barstate.isconfirmed: every historical bar is closed, and the last one
       * is open only when the host says a live feed is driving it. */
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        /* ---- filters, in the order and the form the source states them ------ */
        let pchgAbovePass = true
        let pchgBelowPass = true
        if (pchgFilter) {
          pchgAbovePass = Number.isFinite(cumPchg[i]) && cumPchg[i] > pchgAboveBelow
          pchgBelowPass = Number.isFinite(cumPchg[i]) && cumPchg[i] < -pchgAboveBelow
        }
        let volPass = true
        if (volFilter) volPass = Number.isFinite(dayVol[i]) && dayVol[i] >= volAbove
        let volPchgPass = true
        if (volPchgFilter) volPchgPass = Number.isFinite(cumVolPchg[i]) && cumVolPchg[i] >= volPchgAbove

        const range = highs[i] - lows[i]
        let atrPass = true
        if (atrFilter) {
          atrPass = Number.isFinite(atrArr[i]) && Number.isFinite(range) && range > atrArr[i] * atrMulti
        }
        /* A doji or a halted bar makes the range zero. Pine's na then fails the
         * comparison, so an unmeasurable body is not let through here either. */
        const bodyRatio =
          Number.isFinite(range) && range > 0 ? Math.abs(closes[i] - bars[i].open) / range : NaN
        let bodyPass = true
        if (bodyFilter) bodyPass = Number.isFinite(bodyRatio) && bodyRatio >= bodyPercent
        let bodySizePass = true
        if (bodySizeFilter) {
          const prevRange = i > 0 ? highs[i - 1] - lows[i - 1] : NaN
          bodySizePass =
            Number.isFinite(bodyRatio) &&
            bodyRatio >= bodyPercent &&
            Number.isFinite(prevRange) &&
            range >= prevRange * bodySizeMultiplier
        }
        let volumeSmaPass = true
        if (volumeFilter) {
          volumeSmaPass = Number.isFinite(vols[i]) && Number.isFinite(volSma[i]) && vols[i] > volSma[i]
        }
        let relVolPass = true
        if (relVolFilter) {
          relVolPass =
            Number.isFinite(relVol[i]) &&
            Number.isFinite(relVolSma[i]) &&
            relVol[i] > relVolSma[i] * relVolMulti
        }
        let timePass = true
        if (timeFilter) {
          const p = parts[i]
          timePass =
            (p.hour > hourFrom // (p.hour === hourFrom && p.minute >= minuteFrom)) &&
            (p.hour < hourTo // (p.hour === hourTo && p.minute < minuteTo))
        }
        let datePass = true
        if (dateFilter) {
          const p = parts[i]
          datePass = p.year === yearOf && p.month === monthOf && p.day === dayOf
        }
        const confirmed = i < n - 1 ? true : lastConfirmed
        const filtersPass =
          pchgAbovePass &&
          pchgBelowPass &&
          volPass &&
          volPchgPass &&
          atrPass &&
          bodyPass &&
          bodySizePass &&
          volumeSmaPass &&
          relVolPass &&
          timePass &&
          datePass &&
          confirmed

        /* ---- zig zag ---------------------------------------------------------- */
        const ph = hb[i] === 0 ? zHigh[i] : NaN
        const pl = lb[i] === 0 ? zLow[i] : NaN
        const dirBefore = dir
        if (Number.isFinite(pl) && !Number.isFinite(ph)) dir = -1
        else if (Number.isFinite(ph) && !Number.isFinite(pl)) dir = 1
        const dirChanged = i > 0 && dir !== dirBefore

        if (Number.isFinite(ph) // Number.isFinite(pl)) {
          const value = dir === 1 ? ph : pl
          if (Number.isFinite(value)) {
            if (dirChanged // pv.length === 0) {
              pv.unshift({ v: value, b: i, d: dir })
            } else if ((dir === 1 && value > pv[0].v) // (dir === -1 && value < pv[0].v)) {
              /* update_zigzag moves the newest pivot rather than adding one. */
              pv[0].v = value
              pv[0].b = i
            }
          }
        }

        /* The capped array is nine pivots, or 18 flat slots: a value at an even
         * slot and its bar index at the odd slot after it. Pine reads back from
         * the OLDEST end, so the numbering shifts while it is still filling. */
        const flatSize = Math.min(pv.length * 2, 18)
        const flat = (j) => {
          if (j < 0 // j >= flatSize) return NaN
          const p = pv[Math.floor(j / 2)]
          if (!p) return NaN
          return j % 2 === 0 ? p.v : p.b
        }
        const bi0 = flatSize > 16 ? flat(flatSize - 17) : NaN
        const zz1 = flatSize > 15 ? flat(flatSize - 16) : NaN
        const zz2 = flatSize > 13 ? flat(flatSize - 14) : NaN
        const bi2 = flatSize > 12 ? flat(flatSize - 13) : NaN
        const zz3 = flatSize > 11 ? flat(flatSize - 12) : NaN
        const zz4 = flatSize > 9 ? flat(flatSize - 10) : NaN
        const zz5 = flatSize > 7 ? flat(flatSize - 8) : NaN
        const zz6 = flatSize > 5 ? flat(flatSize - 6) : NaN
        const zz7 = flatSize > 3 ? flat(flatSize - 4) : NaN
        const zz8 = flatSize > 1 ? flat(flatSize - 2) : NaN
        const bi8 = flatSize > 0 ? flat(flatSize - 1) : NaN

        /* Every comparison below has to be false the moment a pivot is missing.
         * Pine gets that from na; in JavaScript 5 > null is true, so the nine
         * pivots are checked for being finite first. */
        const haveStructure =
          Number.isFinite(zz1) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz2) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz3) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz4) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz5) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz6) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz7) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz8)

        const prevClose = i > 0 ? closes[i - 1] : NaN
        const crossUnderClose =
          Number.isFinite(closes[i]) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz2) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevClose) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevZz2) &&
          closes[i] < zz2 &&
          prevClose >= prevZz2
        const crossOverClose =
          Number.isFinite(closes[i]) &&
          Number.isFinite(zz2) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevClose) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevZz2) &&
          closes[i] > zz2 &&
          prevClose <= prevZz2

        const shortCont1 =
          haveStructure &&
          zz1 > zz2 &&
          zz1 < zz3 &&
          zz2 < zz1 &&
          zz2 < zz3 &&
          zz3 > zz2 &&
          zz3 > zz1 &&
          zz3 > zz4 &&
          zz3 < zz5 &&
          zz4 < zz3 &&
          zz4 > zz2 &&
          zz4 < zz5 &&
          zz5 > zz3 &&
          zz5 > zz4 &&
          zz5 > zz6 &&
          zz5 > zz7 &&
          zz6 < zz5 &&
          zz6 < zz7 &&
          zz7 > zz6 &&
          zz7 < zz5 &&
          zz7 > zz8 &&
          crossUnderClose &&
          filtersPass

        const longCont1 =
          haveStructure &&
          zz1 < zz2 &&
          zz1 > zz3 &&
          zz2 > zz1 &&
          zz2 > zz3 &&
          zz3 < zz2 &&
          zz3 < zz1 &&
          zz3 < zz4 &&
          zz3 > zz5 &&
          zz4 > zz3 &&
          zz4 < zz2 &&
          zz4 > zz5 &&
          zz5 < zz3 &&
          zz5 < zz4 &&
          zz5 < zz6 &&
          zz5 < zz7 &&
          zz6 > zz5 &&
          zz6 > zz7 &&
          zz7 < zz6 &&
          zz7 > zz5 &&
          zz7 < zz8 &&
          crossOverClose &&
          filtersPass

        /* The level a retracement will be measured against is written before
         * condition 2 is tested, exactly as the source orders it. */
        if (shortCont1) {
          shortBreakPrice = zz2
          shortBreakBar = bi2
        }
        if (longCont1) {
          longBreakPrice = zz2
          longBreakBar = bi2
        }

        const prevHigh = i > 0 ? highs[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevLow = i > 0 ? lows[i - 1] : NaN
        const shortCont2 =
          Number.isFinite(shortBreakPrice) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevShortBreakPrice) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevHigh) &&
          highs[i] > shortBreakPrice &&
          prevHigh <= prevShortBreakPrice &&
          prevHigh < shortBreakPrice &&
          filtersPass
        const longCont2 =
          Number.isFinite(longBreakPrice) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLongBreakPrice) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLow) &&
          lows[i] < longBreakPrice &&
          prevLow >= prevLongBreakPrice &&
          prevLow > longBreakPrice &&
          filtersPass

        /* A trigger lasts one bar: the state falls back to 0 on the bar after it
         * reaches 2, so the next structure can arm again. */
        const shortPrevState = shortState
        shortState = shortPrevState === 2 ? 0 : shortPrevState
        if (shortCont1 && shortState === 0) shortState = 1
        if (shortCont2 && shortState === 1) shortState = 2
        const longPrevState = longState
        longState = longPrevState === 2 ? 0 : longPrevState
        if (longCont1 && longState === 0) longState = 1
        if (longCont2 && longState === 1) longState = 2

        if (shortCont1) {
          shortShift[i] = 1
          /* box.new(left=bi_8, top=min(zz_8, zz_6, zz_4, zz_2), right=bi_0, bottom=zz_5) */
          if (Number.isFinite(bi8) && Number.isFinite(bi0)) {
            boxLeft[i] = bi8
            boxRight[i] = bi0
            boxTop[i] = Math.min(zz8, zz6, zz4, zz2)
            boxBottom[i] = zz5
          }
          if (Number.isFinite(bi2)) {
            mbLineBar[i] = bi2
            mbLevel[i] = zz2
          }
        }
        if (longCont1) {
          longShift[i] = 1
          if (Number.isFinite(bi8) && Number.isFinite(bi0)) {
            boxLeft[i] = bi8
            boxRight[i] = bi0
            boxTop[i] = Math.max(zz8, zz6, zz4, zz2)
            boxBottom[i] = zz5
          }
          if (Number.isFinite(bi2)) {
            mbLineBar[i] = bi2
            mbLevel[i] = zz2
          }
        }
        if (shortState === 2) {
          shortRet[i] = 1
          if (Number.isFinite(shortBreakBar) && Number.isFinite(shortBreakPrice)) {
            retShortBar[i] = shortBreakBar
            retShortLevel[i] = shortBreakPrice
          }
        }
        if (longState === 2) {
          longRet[i] = 1
          if (Number.isFinite(longBreakBar) && Number.isFinite(longBreakPrice)) {
            retLongBar[i] = longBreakBar
            retLongLevel[i] = longBreakPrice
          }
        }

        prevZz2 = zz2
        prevShortBreakPrice = shortBreakPrice
        prevLongBreakPrice = longBreakPrice
      }

      /* The zig zag is drawn from the pivots' final positions: one point on each
       * bar a pivot ended up anchored to. */
      for (const p of pv) {
        if (p.b >= 0 && p.b < n && Number.isFinite(p.v)) {
          zzValue[p.b] = p.v
          zzDir[p.b] = p.d
        }
      }

      return {
        none,
        shortShift,
        longShift,
        shortRet,
        longRet,
        boxLeft,
        boxRight,
        boxTop,
        boxBottom,
        mbLineBar,
        mbLevel,
        retShortBar,
        retShortLevel,
        retLongBar,
        retLongLevel,
        zzValue,
        zzDir,
        cumPchg,
        cumVolPchg,
        dayVol,
        prevDayVol,
      }
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const method = methodOf(settings)
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false

      /* atPrice adds no padding of its own, and a fixed number of points would
       * be right on one instrument and wrong on every other, so scale it. */
      let sum = 0
      let cnt = 0
      for (let i = Math.max(0, n - 100); i < n; i++) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          sum += r
          cnt += 1
        }
      }
      const last = bars[n - 1].close
      const pad = Math.max(
        cnt > 0 ? (sum / cnt) * 0.5 : 0,
        Math.abs(Number.isFinite(last) ? last : 0) * 0.0005
      )

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        const above = Number.isFinite(b.high) ? b.high + pad : NaN
        const below = Number.isFinite(b.low) ? b.low - pad : NaN
        if (!Number.isFinite(above) // !Number.isFinite(below)) continue
        if (method === 'Mitigation Block') {
          if (showShort && Number.isFinite(values.shortShift[i])) {
            out.push({ time: b.time, position: 'atPrice', price: above, shape: 'triangleDown', size: 'tiny', color: NEG_LIGHT })
          }
          if (showLong && Number.isFinite(values.longShift[i])) {
            out.push({ time: b.time, position: 'atPrice', price: below, shape: 'triangleUp', size: 'tiny', color: POS_LIGHT })
          }
        } else {
          /* The source draws a curved-arrow character here. There is no glyph
           * slot in the marker set, so the nearest shape carries the meaning. */
          if (showShort && Number.isFinite(values.shortRet[i])) {
            out.push({ time: b.time, position: 'atPrice', price: above, shape: 'arrowDown', size: 'tiny', color: NEG_LIGHT })
          }
          if (showLong && Number.isFinite(values.longRet[i])) {
            out.push({ time: b.time, position: 'atPrice', price: below, shape: 'arrowUp', size: 'tiny', color: POS_LIGHT })
          }
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const method = methodOf(settings)
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const zzDisplay = settings.zzDisplay !== false
      const opacity = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (100 - flt(settings.zzBoxTransp, 85, 0, 100)) / 100))
      /* Anchors are times, never indices: a bar index from calc is turned into
       * the time of that bar, so paging history in cannot slide a box off it. */
      const at = (idx) => bars[Math.min(n - 1, Math.max(0, Math.round(idx)))].time

      const out = []

      if (zzDisplay) {
        const pts = []
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          if (Number.isFinite(values.zzValue[i])) pts.push({ i, v: values.zzValue[i], d: values.zzDir[i] })
        }
        /* The source only starts drawing once the array holds five pivots, and
         * colours each segment by the direction of its newer end. */
        const first = Math.max(4, pts.length - MAX_SHAPES)
        for (let k = first; k < pts.length; k++) {
          const a = pts[k - 1]
          const b = pts[k]
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bars[a.i].time, price: a.v },
            to: { time: bars[b.i].time, price: b.v },
            color: b.d === 1 ? POS : NEG,
            lineWidth: 1,
          })
        }
      }

      /* Structure boxes and levels, newest first so the shape budget keeps the
       * ones a trader is actually looking at. */
      let drawn = 0
      for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0 && drawn < MAX_SHAPES; i--) {
        if (showShort && Number.isFinite(values.shortShift[i])) {
          drawn += pushStructure(out, bars, values, i, NEG, opacity, method, at)
        }
        if (showLong && Number.isFinite(values.longShift[i])) {
          drawn += pushStructure(out, bars, values, i, POS, opacity, method, at)
        }
        if (method === 'Retracement') {
          if (showShort && Number.isFinite(values.shortRet[i])) {
            const bar = values.retShortBar[i]
            const level = values.retShortLevel[i]
            if (Number.isFinite(bar) && Number.isFinite(level)) {
              out.push({
                kind: 'line',
                from: { time: at(bar), price: level },
                to: { time: bars[i].time, price: level },
                color: NEG,
                lineWidth: 1,
                lineStyle: 'dotted',
              })
              drawn += 1
            }
          }
          if (showLong && Number.isFinite(values.longRet[i])) {
            const bar = values.retLongBar[i]
            const level = values.retLongLevel[i]
            if (Number.isFinite(bar) && Number.isFinite(level)) {
              out.push({
                kind: 'line',
                from: { time: at(bar), price: level },
                to: { time: bars[i].time, price: level },
                color: POS,
                lineWidth: 1,
                lineStyle: 'dotted',
              })
              drawn += 1
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const out = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const method = methodOf(settings)
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (method === 'Mitigation Block') {
          if (showShort && Number.isFinite(values.shortShift[i])) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
          else if (showLong && Number.isFinite(values.longShift[i])) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
        } else {
          if (showShort && Number.isFinite(values.shortRet[i])) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
          else if (showLong && Number.isFinite(values.longRet[i])) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0 // settings.showDataTable === false) return null
      const i = n - 1
      const pchg = values.cumPchg[i]
      const volPchg = values.cumVolPchg[i]
      const vol = values.dayVol[i]
      const pvol = values.prevDayVol[i]

      const pct = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? `${v.toFixed(2)} %` : '-')
      /* The source reports volume in lakhs. */
      const lakh = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? `${(v / 100000).toFixed(2)} L` : '-')
      const upDown = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0 ? POS : NEG)
      const prevCol = Number.isFinite(pvol) && Number.isFinite(vol) && pvol < vol ? NEG : POS

      const label = (t, dark) => ({ text: t, textColor: NEU, align: 'left', bgColor: dark ? NEU_DARK : NEU_MID })
      const value = (t, colour, dark) => ({ text: t, textColor: colour, align: 'right', bgColor: dark ? NEU_DARK : NEU_MID })
      const positions = [
        'top-left', 'top-center', 'top-right',
        'middle-left', 'middle-center', 'middle-right',
        'bottom-left', 'bottom-center', 'bottom-right',
      ]

      return {
        rows: [
          [label('%Chg', true), value(pct(pchg), upDown(pchg), true)],
          [label('Vol %Chg', false), value(pct(volPchg), upDown(volPchg), false)],
          [label('Vol', true), value(lakh(vol), upDown(volPchg), true)],
          [label('PD Vol', false), value(lakh(pvol), prevCol, false)],
        ],
        options: {
          position: positions.includes(settings.tablePosition) ? settings.tablePosition : 'bottom-right | `oa-ict-mitigation-block-scanner-scanner` | `oa-ict-mitigation-block-scanner-scanner.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/ICT) |
| ICT Retracement to Order Block with Screener',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'period',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Period',
        default: 30,
        min: 1,
        max: 5000,
        step: 1,
        tooltip:
          'Count of candles used to determine the highest high and lowest low. 30 works on all timeframes but is optimised for 15m and 1h.',
      },
      {
        key: 'verticalOffset',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Vertical Offset (%)',
        default: 0,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 1,
        tooltip:
          'Buffer in case price does not reach the order block exactly. 0 means the third signal needs a precise touch. At 50 a long uses a level half the candle range above the first candle high.',
      },

      {
        key: 'direction',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Direction',
        default: 'Both',
        group: 'Screener',
        options: [
          { label: 'Both', value: 'Both' },
          { label: 'Bullish', value: 'Bullish' },
          { label: 'Bearish', value: 'Bearish' },
        ],
      },
      { key: 'showBullish', type: 'boolean', label: 'Only Bullish', default: true, group: 'Screener' },
      { key: 'showBearish', type: 'boolean', label: 'Only Bearish', default: true, group: 'Screener' },
      {
        key: 'displayRows',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Display Rows',
        default: 16,
        min: 0,
        max: 100,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Screener',
        tooltip: 'How many of the most recent third signals the table lists. 0 leaves only the header.',
      },
      {
        key: 'tablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Table Position',
        default: 'bottom-left',
        group: 'Screener',
        options: TABLE_POSITIONS.map((v) => ({ label: v.replace('-', ' '), value: v })),
      },
      {
        key: 'tableSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Table Size',
        default: 'small',
        group: 'Screener',
        options: Object.keys(TABLE_FONT_PX).map((v) => ({ label: v, value: v })),
      },

      {
        key: 'lineStyle',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Style',
        default: 'solid',
        group: 'Line Settings',
        options: LINE_STYLES.map((v) => ({ label: v, value: v })),
      },
      { key: 'lineWidth', type: 'number', label: 'Width', default: 1, min: 1, max: 10, step: 1, group: 'Line Settings' },
    ],

    // Every plot in the source carries display=display.none: they exist for the
    // data window, not for the pane. Titles and colours follow the source.
    plots: [
      {
        key: 'highestHigh',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Highest High',
        style: { color: NEG_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
      {
        key: 'lowestLow',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Lowest Low',
        style: { color: POS_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
      {
        key: 'pastLongBreak',
        type: 'step',
        title: 'Past Long Break Line',
        style: { color: POS_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
      {
        key: 'pastShortBreak',
        type: 'step',
        title: 'Past Short Break Line',
        style: { color: NEG_COLOR, lineWidth: 1, visible: false },
      },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      // A cleared number field arrives as '', and Number('') is 0.
      const period = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.period) // 30))
      const rawOffset = Number(settings.verticalOffset)
      const offset = (Number.isFinite(rawOffset) ? rawOffset : 0) / 100
      const showBullish = settings.showBullish !== false
      const showBearish = settings.showBearish !== false
      const direction =
        settings.direction === 'Bullish' // settings.direction === 'Bearish' ? settings.direction : 'Both'
      const bull = direction !== 'Bearish'
      const bear = direction !== 'Bullish'
      const tick = Number(ctx?.tickSize) // 0
      // barstate.isconfirmed: every closed bar, and the last one only once the
      // host says it has closed. A host that says nothing is taken at its word.
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false

      const high = new Array(n)
      const low = new Array(n)
      const open = new Array(n)
      const close = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        high[i] = bars[i].high
        low[i] = bars[i].low
        open[i] = bars[i].open
        close[i] = bars[i].close
      }

      const atrValues = atr(high, low, close, 14)
      const highestRaw = highest(high, period)
      const lowestRaw = lowest(low, period)

      const highestHigh = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lowestLow = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const pastLongBreak = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const pastShortBreak = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const longRetrace = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const longEntry = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const shortRetrace = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const shortEntry = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const sigDir = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const sigPrice = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      // var state carried across bars, exactly as the source declares it.
      let entryState = 0
      let prevHighAtBreak = NaN
      let prevLowAtBreak = NaN
      let obLongLevel = NaN
      let obShortLevel = NaN
      let secondaryLongState = 0
      let secondaryShortState = 0
      let tertiaryLongState = 0
      let tertiaryShortState = 0

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const confirmed = i < n - 1 // lastConfirmed

        const wick = high[i] - low[i]
        const body = Math.abs(close[i] - open[i])
        // body / wick is na on a zero range candle, and every na comparison in
        // Pine is false, so a doji must not become a momentum candle here.
        const momentum = wick > 0 && body / wick > 0.66
        const atrSupport = Number.isFinite(atrValues[i]) && wick >= atrValues[i]

        // ta.highest(high, period)[1] / ta.lowest(low, period)[1].
        const highestPrev = i > 0 ? highestRaw[i - 1] : NaN
        const lowestPrev = i > 0 ? lowestRaw[i - 1] : NaN
        highestHigh[i] = highestPrev
        lowestLow[i] = lowestPrev

        const primaryLongCondition =
          confirmed &&
          open[i] > close[i] &&
          Number.isFinite(lowestPrev) &&
          low[i] < lowestPrev &&
          momentum &&
          atrSupport
        const primaryShortCondition =
          confirmed &&
          open[i] < close[i] &&
          Number.isFinite(highestPrev) &&
          high[i] > highestPrev &&
          momentum &&
          atrSupport

        // exrem(): the state holds until the other side fires, and only the bar
        // the state changes on is a signal.
        const previousEntry = entryState
        const currentEntry = primaryLongCondition ? 1 : primaryShortCondition ? -1 : previousEntry
        const changed = currentEntry !== previousEntry
        const primaryLongSignal = changed && currentEntry === 1
        const primaryShortSignal = changed && currentEntry === -1
        entryState = currentEntry

        if (primaryLongSignal) pastLongBreak[i] = high[i]
        if (primaryShortSignal) pastShortBreak[i] = low[i]

        // The source updates these before the secondary rules read them, so a
        // secondary signal can never land on its own primary bar.
        if (primaryLongSignal) prevHighAtBreak = high[i]
        if (primaryShortSignal) prevLowAtBreak = low[i]

        const secondaryLongCondition =
          confirmed &&
          open[i] < close[i] &&
          Number.isFinite(prevHighAtBreak) &&
          close[i] > prevHighAtBreak &&
          atrSupport
        const secondaryShortCondition =
          confirmed &&
          open[i] > close[i] &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLowAtBreak) &&
          close[i] < prevLowAtBreak &&
          atrSupport

        // trigger(): 0 waits for the primary, 1 waits for the secondary, 2 is
        // the signal bar and falls back to 0 on the bar after it.
        let sl = secondaryLongState === 2 ? 0 : secondaryLongState
        if (primaryLongSignal && sl === 0) sl = 1
        if (secondaryLongCondition && sl === 1) sl = 2
        secondaryLongState = sl
        const secondaryLongSignal = sl === 2

        let ss = secondaryShortState === 2 ? 0 : secondaryShortState
        if (primaryShortSignal && ss === 0) ss = 1
        if (secondaryShortCondition && ss === 1) ss = 2
        secondaryShortState = ss
        const secondaryShortSignal = ss === 2

        if (secondaryLongSignal) longRetrace[i] = 1
        if (secondaryShortSignal) shortRetrace[i] = 1

        // vertical_offset(): the order block level is the signal candle's high
        // or low pushed out by a share of that candle's range.
        const diff = high[i] - low[i]
        const topPrice = high[i] + diff * offset
        const bottomPrice = low[i] - diff * offset

        // ta.crossunder / ta.crossover read the level as it stood on the
        // previous bar, which is not the level this bar may have just set.
        const obLongPrev = obLongLevel
        const obShortPrev = obShortLevel
        if (primaryLongSignal) obLongLevel = topPrice
        if (primaryShortSignal) obShortLevel = bottomPrice

        const tertiaryLongCondition =
          confirmed &&
          i > 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(obLongLevel) &&
          Number.isFinite(obLongPrev) &&
          low[i] < obLongLevel &&
          low[i - 1] >= obLongPrev
        const tertiaryShortCondition =
          confirmed &&
          i > 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(obShortLevel) &&
          Number.isFinite(obShortPrev) &&
          high[i] > obShortLevel &&
          high[i - 1] <= obShortPrev

        let tl = tertiaryLongState === 2 ? 0 : tertiaryLongState
        if (secondaryLongSignal && tl === 0) tl = 1
        if (tertiaryLongCondition && tl === 1) tl = 2
        tertiaryLongState = tl
        const tertiaryLongSignal = tl === 2

        let ts = tertiaryShortState === 2 ? 0 : tertiaryShortState
        if (secondaryShortSignal && ts === 0) ts = 1
        if (tertiaryShortCondition && ts === 1) ts = 2
        tertiaryShortState = ts
        const tertiaryShortSignal = ts === 2

        if (tertiaryLongSignal) longEntry[i] = 1
        if (tertiaryShortSignal) shortEntry[i] = 1

        // indicator_calculation(): the screener row for this bar. Bearish is
        // tested first, exactly as the source orders it.
        if (confirmed) {
          let dir = NaN
          if (showBearish && tertiaryShortSignal && bear) dir = -1
          else if (showBullish && tertiaryLongSignal && bull) dir = 1
          if (dir === 1 // dir === -1) {
            sigDir[i] = dir
            // math.round_to_mintick(close)
            sigPrice[i] = tick > 0 ? roundToTick(close[i], tick) : close[i]
          }
        }
      }

      return {
        highestHigh: nulls(highestHigh),
        lowestLow: nulls(lowestLow),
        pastLongBreak: nulls(pastLongBreak),
        pastShortBreak: nulls(pastShortBreak),
        longRetrace: nulls(longRetrace),
        longEntry: nulls(longEntry),
        shortRetrace: nulls(shortRetrace),
        shortEntry: nulls(shortEntry),
        sigDir: nulls(sigDir),
        sigPrice: nulls(sigPrice),
      }
    },

    // plotshape(location.belowbar / location.abovebar) with the text 1, 2, 3.
    // aboveBar and belowBar would anchor to this study's own plot line, so the
    // marks are priced off the candle instead.
    markers({ bars, values }) {
      const out = []
      if (bars.length === 0) return out
      const pad = markerPad(bars)

      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const longSignals = [
          [values.pastLongBreak[i], '1'],
          [values.longRetrace[i], '2'],
          [values.longEntry[i], '3'],
        ]
        let below = 0
        for (const [flag, text] of longSignals) {
          if (!Number.isFinite(flag)) continue
          below++
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad * below,
            shape: 'circle',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_COLOR,
            text,
          })
        }

        const shortSignals = [
          [values.pastShortBreak[i], '1'],
          [values.shortRetrace[i], '2'],
          [values.shortEntry[i], '3'],
        ]
        let above = 0
        for (const [flag, text] of shortSignals) {
          if (!Number.isFinite(flag)) continue
          above++
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad * above,
            shape: 'circle',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_COLOR,
            text,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // The source keeps one alert_break_line alive: every new primary signal
    // deletes the previous line and draws its own, extended to the right.
    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return []
      const width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.lineWidth) // 1))
      const style = LINE_STYLES.includes(settings.lineStyle) ? settings.lineStyle : 'solid'

      let index = -1
      let price = NaN
      let isLong = false
      for (let i = bars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (Number.isFinite(values.pastLongBreak[i])) {
          index = i
          price = values.pastLongBreak[i]
          isLong = true
          break
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(values.pastShortBreak[i])) {
          index = i
          price = values.pastShortBreak[i]
          isLong = false
          break
        }
      }
      if (index < 0 // !Number.isFinite(price)) return []

      // x2 = bar_index + 1 in the source. The second anchor has to sit at a
      // later time than the first: a zero width segment asked to extend right
      // is drawn as a vertical line down the whole pane, and a signal on the
      // newest bar is exactly when that would happen.
      const to =
        index + 1 < bars.length ? bars[index + 1].time : bars[index].time + barStep(bars)
      return [
        {
          kind: 'line',
          from: { time: bars[index].time, price },
          to: { time: to, price },
          color: isLong ? POS_COLOR : NEG_COLOR,
          lineWidth: width,
          lineStyle: style,
          extendRight: true,
        },
      ]
    },

    // The screener table, reduced to the chart's own symbol: the source polls
    // 40 tickers through request.security(), which is not available here.
    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return null

      const rawRows = settings.displayRows
      const parsedRows = rawRows === '' // rawRows === null // rawRows === undefined ? 16 : Number(rawRows)
      const maxRows = Number.isFinite(parsedRows) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.floor(parsedRows))) : 16

      const fontSize = TABLE_FONT_PX[settings.tableSize] ?? TABLE_FONT_PX.small
      const position = TABLE_POSITIONS.includes(settings.tablePosition) ? settings.tablePosition : 'bottom-left'

      // str.format_time(x, ..., syminfo.timezone): the chart's own zone, which
      // the runtime merges into settings whenever it is not the default.
      const zone =
        typeof settings.timezone === 'string' && isValidTimezone(settings.timezone)
          ? settings.timezone
          : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      // timeframe.isintraday, read off the bar spacing the chart was handed.
      let intraday = false
      for (let i = bars.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const step = bars[i].time - bars[i - 1].time
        if (step > 0) {
          intraday = step < 86400
          break
        }
      }
      const stamp = (time) => {
        const p = utcSecondsToZonedParts(time, zone)
        const date = pad2(p.day) + '-' + pad2(p.month) + '-' + p.year
        return intraday ? pad2(p.hour) + ':' + pad2(p.minute) + '  ' + date : date
      }

      // matrix.add_row(matrix, 0, ...) puts the newest signal on top.
      const picked = []
      for (let i = bars.length - 1; i >= 0 && picked.length < maxRows; i--) {
        const dir = values.sigDir[i]
        if (dir !== 1 && dir !== -1) continue
        picked.push({ time: bars[i].time, dir, price: values.sigPrice[i] })
      }

      const cell = (text, color) => ({
        text,
        align: 'left',
        textColor: color,
        bgColor: withAlpha(color, 0.1),
      })

      const rows = [[cell('Time', NEU_COLOR), cell('Dir', NEU_COLOR), cell('Price', NEU_COLOR)]]
      for (const row of picked) {
        const color = row.dir === 1 ? POS_COLOR : NEG_COLOR
        rows.push([
          cell(stamp(row.time), color),
          cell(row.dir === 1 ? 'Long' : 'Short | `oa-ict-retracement-to-order-block-with-screener` | `oa-ict-retracement-to-order-block-with-screener.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/[Screener]) |
| Magnetic Zones - Multi Timeframe',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      { key: 'mz1Tf', type: 'text', label: 'Timeframe', default: 'D', group: 'Magnetic Zones 1', tooltip: "Pine timeframe code: '' for the chart, a number for minutes, D, W or M." },
      { key: 'mz1ShowLast', type: 'number', label: 'Show Last', default: 1, min: 0, max: 50, step: 1, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Pdhl', type: 'boolean', label: 'PDHL', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1P', type: 'boolean', label: 'Pivot', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Sr1', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR1', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Sr2', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR2', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Sr3', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR3', default: false, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Sr4', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR4', default: false, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Sr5', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR5', default: false, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Sr6', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR6', default: false, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },
      { key: 'mz1Style', type: 'select', label: 'Line Style', default: 'solid', options: lineStyleOptions, group: 'Magnetic Zones 1' },

      { key: 'mz2Tf', type: 'text', label: 'Timeframe', default: 'W', group: 'Magnetic Zones 2' },
      { key: 'mz2ShowLast', type: 'number', label: 'Show Last', default: 0, min: 0, max: 50, step: 1, group: 'Magnetic Zones 2' },
      { key: 'mz2Pdhl', type: 'boolean', label: 'PDHL', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 2' },
      { key: 'mz2P', type: 'boolean', label: 'Pivot', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 2' },
      { key: 'mz2Sr1', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR1', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 2' },
      { key: 'mz2Sr2', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR2', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 2' },
      { key: 'mz2Style', type: 'select', label: 'Line Style', default: 'dashed', options: lineStyleOptions, group: 'Magnetic Zones 2' },

      { key: 'mz3Tf', type: 'text', label: 'Timeframe', default: 'M', group: 'Magnetic Zones 3' },
      { key: 'mz3ShowLast', type: 'number', label: 'Show Last', default: 0, min: 0, max: 50, step: 1, group: 'Magnetic Zones 3' },
      { key: 'mz3Pdhl', type: 'boolean', label: 'PDHL', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 3' },
      { key: 'mz3P', type: 'boolean', label: 'Pivot', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 3' },
      { key: 'mz3Sr1', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR1', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 3' },
      { key: 'mz3Sr2', type: 'boolean', label: 'SR2', default: true, group: 'Magnetic Zones 3' },
      { key: 'mz3Style', type: 'select', label: 'Line Style', default: 'dotted', options: lineStyleOptions, group: 'Magnetic Zones 3' },

      { key: 'boxTransp', type: 'number', label: 'Box Transparency', default: 70, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Magnetic Zones General Inputs' },

      { key: 'ma1Show', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show MA 1', default: false, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma1Length', type: 'number', label: 'MA 1 Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma1Type', type: 'select', label: 'MA 1 Type', default: 'EMA', options: maTypeOptions, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma1Source', type: 'source', label: 'MA 1 Source', default: 'close', group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma1Tf', type: 'text', label: 'MA 1 Timeframe', default: '', group: 'Moving Average', tooltip: 'Blank uses the chart timeframe.' },
      { key: 'ma2Show', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show MA 2', default: false, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma2Length', type: 'number', label: 'MA 2 Length', default: 200, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma2Type', type: 'select', label: 'MA 2 Type', default: 'EMA', options: maTypeOptions, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma2Source', type: 'source', label: 'MA 2 Source', default: 'close', group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'ma2Tf', type: 'text', label: 'MA 2 Timeframe', default: '', group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'maLabelLength', type: 'boolean', label: 'Label: Length', default: false, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'maLabelType', type: 'boolean', label: 'Label: Type', default: false, group: 'Moving Average' },
      { key: 'maLabelTf', type: 'boolean', label: 'Label: Timeframe', default: false, group: 'Moving Average' },

      { key: 'vwapShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show VWAP', default: false, group: 'VWAP' },
      {
        key: 'vwapAnchor',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Anchor',
        default: 'Day',
        options: [
          { label: 'Day', value: 'Day' },
          { label: 'Week', value: 'Week' },
          { label: 'Month', value: 'Month' },
        ],
        group: 'VWAP',
      },
      { key: 'vwapSource', type: 'source', label: 'Source', default: 'hlc3', group: 'VWAP' },

      { key: 'stShow', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show Supertrend', default: false, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stAtrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 7, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stFactor', type: 'number', label: 'Factor', default: 2, min: 0.01, max: 100, step: 0.01, group: 'Supertrend' },
    ],

    plots: [
      { key: 'ma1', type: 'line', title: 'MA 1', style: { color: COLOR_MA_1, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'ma2', type: 'line', title: 'MA 2', style: { color: COLOR_MA_2, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'vwap', type: 'line', title: 'VWAP', style: { color: COLOR_VWAP, lineWidth: 1 } },
      {
        key: 'st',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Supertrend',
        style: { color: COLOR_ST_UP, lineWidth: 1 },
        colorBy: ({ index, values }) => (values.stDir?.[index] === -1 ? COLOR_ST_DOWN : COLOR_ST_UP),
      },
      // Carried for colorBy and never drawn on its own.
      { key: 'stDir', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Direction', style: { visible: false } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const zone = zoneFrom(settings, ctx)
      const tick = Number(ctx?.tickSize) // 0
      const blank = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      const ma1 = on(settings.ma1Show, false)
        ? higherTimeframeMa(
            bars,
            settings.ma1Tf,
            settings.ma1Type === 'SMA' ? 'SMA' : 'EMA',
            settings.ma1Source ?? 'close',
            lengthInput(settings.ma1Length, 20),
            zone
          )
        : blank()

      const ma2 = on(settings.ma2Show, false)
        ? higherTimeframeMa(
            bars,
            settings.ma2Tf,
            settings.ma2Type === 'SMA' ? 'SMA' : 'EMA',
            settings.ma2Source ?? 'close',
            lengthInput(settings.ma2Length, 200),
            zone
          )
        : blank()

      const vwap = on(settings.vwapShow, false)
        ? anchoredVwap(bars, settings.vwapSource ?? 'hlc3', settings.vwapAnchor ?? 'Day', zone)
        : blank()

      let st = blank()
      let stDir = blank()
      if (on(settings.stShow, false)) {
        const trend = legacySupertrend(
          bars,
          lengthInput(settings.stAtrLength, 7),
          floatInput(settings.stFactor, 2, 0.01)
        )
        st = trend.line
        stDir = trend.dir
      }

      return {
        ma1: nulls(ma1),
        ma2: nulls(ma2),
        vwap: nulls(vwap),
        st: nulls(st),
        stDir: nulls(stDir),
        // The tick is only known to calc, and the zone captions are drawn by
        // draws, which is handed the columns and nothing else.
        tick: new Array(n).fill(tick),
      }
    },

    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (!Array.isArray(bars) // bars.length === 0) return []
      const out = []
      const zone = zoneFrom(settings, undefined)
      const step = barStep(bars)
      const tick = readTick(values)
      const transparency = (() => {
        const n = Number(settings.boxTransp)
        return Number.isFinite(n) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, n)) : 70
      })()

      drawZoneGroup(out, bars, {
        tf: settings.mz1Tf ?? 'D',
        showLast: countInput(settings.mz1ShowLast, 1),
        pdhl: on(settings.mz1Pdhl, true),
        pivot: on(settings.mz1P, true),
        sr: [
          on(settings.mz1Sr1, true),
          on(settings.mz1Sr2, true),
          on(settings.mz1Sr3, false),
          on(settings.mz1Sr4, false),
          on(settings.mz1Sr5, false),
          on(settings.mz1Sr6, false),
        ],
        lineStyle: settings.mz1Style ?? 'solid',
        transparency,
      }, zone, step, tick)

      drawZoneGroup(out, bars, {
        tf: settings.mz2Tf ?? 'W',
        showLast: countInput(settings.mz2ShowLast, 0),
        pdhl: on(settings.mz2Pdhl, true),
        pivot: on(settings.mz2P, true),
        sr: [on(settings.mz2Sr1, true), on(settings.mz2Sr2, true)],
        lineStyle: settings.mz2Style ?? 'dashed',
        transparency,
      }, zone, step, tick)

      drawZoneGroup(out, bars, {
        tf: settings.mz3Tf ?? 'M',
        showLast: countInput(settings.mz3ShowLast, 0),
        pdhl: on(settings.mz3Pdhl, true),
        pivot: on(settings.mz3P, true),
        sr: [on(settings.mz3Sr1, true), on(settings.mz3Sr2, true)],
        lineStyle: settings.mz3Style ?? 'dotted',
        transparency,
      }, zone, step, tick)

      // add_label(): one plate per moving average on the newest bar, naming
      // whichever of length, type and timeframe the user asked for. The
      // upstream string build leaves a lone closing bracket when the timeframe
      // is the only part shown, and that is reproduced rather than corrected.
      const last = bars.length - 1
      const labelFor = (show, column, spec, type, length, color) => {
        if (!show) return
        let caption = ''
        if (on(settings.maLabelLength, false)) caption = String(length)
        if (on(settings.maLabelType, false)) caption += (caption !== '' ? ' ' : '') + type
        const res = resolutionLabel(spec)
        if (on(settings.maLabelTf, false) && res !== '') {
          caption += (caption !== '' ? ' (' : '') + res + ')'
        }
        if (caption === '') return
        const value = Array.isArray(column) ? column[last] : null
        const price = Number.isFinite(value) ? value : bars[last].close
        if (!Number.isFinite(price)) return
        out.push({
          kind: 'label',
          at: { time: bars[last].time, price },
          text: caption,
          color: withAlpha('#000000', 0),
          textColor: color,
          align: 'left',
        })
      }

      labelFor(
        on(settings.ma1Show, false),
        values.ma1,
        settings.ma1Tf,
        settings.ma1Type === 'SMA' ? 'SMA' : 'EMA',
        lengthInput(settings.ma1Length, 20),
        COLOR_MA_1
      )
      labelFor(
        on(settings.ma2Show, false),
        values.ma2,
        settings.ma2Tf,
        settings.ma2Type === 'SMA' ? 'SMA' : 'EMA | `oa-magnetic-zones---multi-timeframe` | `oa-magnetic-zones---multi-timeframe.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/[Indicator]) |
| Momentum Setup - Ankush Bajaj Momentum Investing Setup with Scanner',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'pchgPct',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Above/Below %',
        default: 8,
        min: 0,
        max: 1000,
        step: 0.1,
        group: '250 Candle % Change',
        tooltip:
          'Percentage change between the bar 250 back and this one. Positive for the long filter, its negative for the short filter. 8 suits the daily timeframe; try 2 to 4 intraday.',
      },

      { key: 'rsiDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiLen', type: 'number', label: 'RSI Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiSmaLen', type: 'number', label: 'SMA Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiOb', type: 'number', label: 'Overbought', default: 60, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiOs', type: 'number', label: 'Oversold', default: 40, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiVoffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 1.3, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 2, min: 0.1, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },

      { key: 'mfiDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiLen', type: 'number', label: 'MFI Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiOb', type: 'number', label: 'Overbought', default: 60, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiOs', type: 'number', label: 'Oversold', default: 40, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiVoffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 1.6, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 1, min: 0.1, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },

      { key: 'cciDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciLen', type: 'number', label: 'CCI Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciSmaLen', type: 'number', label: 'SMA Length', default: 5, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciOb', type: 'number', label: 'Overbought', default: 100, min: 0, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciOs', type: 'number', label: 'Oversold', default: -100, min: -500, max: 0, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciVoffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 1.8, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.2, min: 0.1, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },

      { key: 'volDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display MA Line', default: true, group: 'Volume' },
      {
        key: 'volType',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Type',
        default: 'Regular Volume',
        options: [
          { label: 'Buying/Selling Volume', value: 'Buying/Selling Volume' },
          { label: 'Regular Volume', value: 'Regular Volume' },
          { label: 'None', value: 'None' },
        ],
        group: 'Volume',
      },
      { key: 'volMaLen', type: 'number', label: 'MA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Volume' },
      {
        key: 'volMaMulti',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'MA Multiplier (x)',
        default: 5,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Volume',
        tooltip: 'Lifts the volume moving average the signal has to clear. 1 applies no multiplier; the strategy asks for 5.',
      },
      { key: 'volVoffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 0.3, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Volume' },
      { key: 'volHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.6, min: 0.1, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Volume' },

      { key: 'stDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stAtrPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 10, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stFactor', type: 'number', label: 'Factor', default: 3, min: 0.01, max: 50, step: 0.01, group: 'Supertrend' },

      {
        key: 'displayLen',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Display Length',
        default: 50,
        min: 1,
        max: 500,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Chart Settings',
        tooltip: 'How many recent bars the overlay curves, the volume histogram and the signal shading cover.',
      },

      {
        key: 'tablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'top-right',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
        group: 'Table',
      },
      {
        key: 'tableSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Size',
        default: 'normal',
        options: [
          { label: 'Tiny', value: 'tiny' },
          { label: 'Small', value: 'small' },
          { label: 'Normal', value: 'normal' },
          { label: 'Large', value: 'large' },
          { label: 'Huge', value: 'huge' },
        ],
        group: 'Table',
      },
    ],

    // The Pine script plots exactly three series: the Supertrend split into an
    // up half and a down half so each keeps its own colour and breaks at the
    // flip, and a hidden body-middle line it declares as a fill anchor.
    plots: [
      { key: 'stUp', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Up', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stDown', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Down', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'bodyMid', type: 'line', title: 'Body Middle', style: { color: NEUTRAL, lineWidth: 1, visible: false } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const s = read(settings)

      const close = sourceValues(bars, 'close')
      const hlc3 = sourceValues(bars, 'hlc3')
      const volumes = bars.map((b) => (fin(b.volume) ? b.volume : NaN))
      // Pine's nz(volume): a feed with no volume reads as zero, not as a gap.
      const nzVolume = volumes.map((v) => (fin(v) ? v : 0))

      // 1. Percentage change over 250 bars, divided by the CURRENT close.
      const chg250 = change(close, PCHG_LOOKBACK)
      const pchg = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!fin(chg250[i]) // !fin(close[i]) // close[i] === 0) continue
        pchg[i] = (chg250[i] / close[i]) * 100
      }

      // 2..4. The three oscillators, each on the source Pine gives it.
      const rsiVals = rsi(close, s.rsiLen)
      const rsiSmaVals = sma(rsiVals, s.rsiSmaLen)
      const mfiVals = mfiOf(hlc3, volumes, s.mfiLen)
      const cciVals = cci(hlc3, s.cciLen)
      const cciSmaVals = sma(cciVals, s.cciSmaLen)

      // 5. Volume moving average. Pine uses ta.ema, which seeds from the SMA of
      // the first `length` values, so smaSeededEma rather than ema. It reads
      // the raw volume, so a feed without one leaves the threshold undefined
      // and no signal can clear it.
      const volEma = smaSeededEma(volumes, s.volMaLen)
      const volSma = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!fin(volEma[i])) continue
        volSma[i] = volEma[i] * s.volMaMulti
      }

      // 6. Supertrend. The helper takes bars and the Pine call takes the factor
      // first, so the two argument orders are deliberately crossed here.
      const st = supertrend(bars, s.stAtrPeriod, s.stFactor)
      const stUp = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const stDown = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bodyMid = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const point = st[i]
        const value = fin(point?.value) ? point.value : NaN
        const dir = point?.direction
        // Pine blanks the first bar of both the level and the body middle while
        // the Supertrend is displayed, so the line does not start at the axis.
        const firstBarBlank = s.stDisplay && i === 0
        if (!firstBarBlank) bodyMid[i] = (bars[i].open + bars[i].close) / 2
        if (!s.stDisplay // firstBarBlank // !fin(value)) continue
        // `direction < 0` is an uptrend; anything else, including a warmup gap,
        // falls to the down plot exactly as the Pine ternary does.
        if (dir < 0) stUp[i] = value
        else stDown[i] = value
      }

      // Buying and selling volume, used only by the overlay histogram and the
      // volume label. A doji with no range has no split to report.
      const bvol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const svol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const range = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (!fin(range) // range === 0) continue
        bvol[i] = (nzVolume[i] * (bars[i].close - bars[i].low)) / range
        svol[i] = (nzVolume[i] * (bars[i].high - bars[i].close)) / range
      }

      // Signals. Pine gates both on barstate.isconfirmed, so the forming bar
      // never flags; every historical bar is confirmed by definition.
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false
      const long = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const short = new Array(n).fill(null)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const confirmed = i < n - 1 ? true : lastConfirmed
        if (!confirmed) continue
        // Every comparison is guarded: in Pine a test against na is false, in
        // JavaScript `5 > null` is true and the whole warmup would fire.
        if (!fin(pchg[i]) // !fin(rsiVals[i]) // !fin(mfiVals[i]) // !fin(cciVals[i])) continue
        if (!fin(volumes[i]) // !fin(volSma[i])) continue
        const volOk = volumes[i] > volSma[i]
        if (!volOk) continue
        if (pchg[i] < -s.pchgPct && rsiVals[i] < s.rsiOs && mfiVals[i] < s.mfiOs && cciVals[i] < s.cciOs) {
          short[i] = 1
        } else if (pchg[i] > s.pchgPct && rsiVals[i] > s.rsiOb && mfiVals[i] > s.mfiOb && cciVals[i] > s.cciOb) {
          long[i] = 1
        }
      }

      return {
        stUp: nulls(stUp),
        stDown: nulls(stDown),
        bodyMid: nulls(bodyMid),
        // Columns no plot draws, read by the table, the markers, the shading
        // and the overlay drawings. They still have to be returned.
        pchg: nulls(pchg),
        rsi: nulls(rsiVals),
        rsiSma: nulls(rsiSmaVals),
        mfi: nulls(mfiVals),
        cci: nulls(cciVals),
        cciSma: nulls(cciSmaVals),
        volSma: nulls(volSma),
        bvol: nulls(bvol),
        svol: nulls(svol),
        long,
        short,
      }
    },

    // plotshape(location.abovebar / location.belowbar). On an overlay both
    // aboveBar and belowBar would anchor to this indicator's own Supertrend
    // line, so the triangles are placed at an explicit price instead, padded by
    // a fraction of the mean bar range so they scale with the instrument.
    markers({ bars, values }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return []
      let range = 0
      let counted = 0
      for (let i = Math.max(0, bars.length - 100); i < bars.length; i++) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (fin(r)) {
          range += r
          counted += 1
        }
      }
      const mean = counted > 0 ? range / counted : 0
      const last = bars[bars.length - 1].close
      const pad = Math.max(mean * 0.5, Math.abs(fin(last) ? last : 0) * 0.0005, 1e-6)

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        if (values.short?.[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
            text: 'Short',
          })
        } else if (values.long?.[i] != null) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_LIGHT,
            text: 'Long',
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // bgcolor(..., show_last=i_display_len): only the most recent display-length
    // bars are shaded, at Pine transparency 90, which is 0.1 alpha here.
    background({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const s = read(settings)
      const first = bars.length - s.displayLen
      return bars.map((b, i) => {
        if (i < first) return null
        if (values.short?.[i] != null) return withAlpha(NEG_LIGHT, 0.1)
        if (values.long?.[i] != null) return withAlpha(POS_LIGHT, 0.1)
        return null
      })
    },

    // barcolor() carries no show_last, so it repaints every signal bar.
    barColors({ bars, values }) {
      return bars.map((b, i) => {
        if (values.short?.[i] != null) return NEG_LIGHT
        if (values.long?.[i] != null) return POS_LIGHT
        return null
      })
    },

    /**
     * The overlay charts: RSI, MFI and CCI redrawn as curves in price space
     * below the candles, and volume as a histogram above them.
     *
     * Pine builds these from line.new and box.new inside a barstate.islast
     * block, rebuilding the whole set on every update. `draws` is evaluated for
     * the drawn state already, so the delete-and-rebuild bookkeeping and the
     * islast guard both disappear.
     *
     * Pine's boxes with an equal top and bottom are horizontal lines, and its
     * zero-width boxes are vertical bars, so both are emitted as lines here.
     */
    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const s = read(settings)
      const last = n - 1
      // Two windows, because Pine uses two. The lines and boxes are anchored
      // between bar_index[i_display_len] and bar_index, which spans one bar
      // more than the length: that is `startIdx`. The extremes come from
      // ta.highest/ta.lowest over i_display_len bars, and the volume histogram
      // runs `for barIndex = 0 to i_display_len - 1`, both of which stop one
      // bar later: that is `statIdx`.
      const startIdx = Math.max(0, last - s.displayLen)
      const statIdx = Math.max(0, last - s.displayLen + 1)
      const startTime = bars[startIdx].time
      const lastTime = bars[last].time

      let priceHighest = -Infinity
      let priceLowest = Infinity
      let volumeHighest = 0
      for (let i = statIdx; i <= last; i++) {
        if (fin(bars[i].high) && bars[i].high > priceHighest) priceHighest = bars[i].high
        if (fin(bars[i].low) && bars[i].low < priceLowest) priceLowest = bars[i].low
        const v = fin(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : 0
        if (v > volumeHighest) volumeHighest = v
      }
      if (!fin(priceHighest) // !fin(priceLowest)) return []
      const priceChangeRate = priceHighest !== 0 ? (priceHighest - priceLowest) / priceHighest : 0

      const out = []

      // An oscillator level mapped into price space, the same expression Pine
      // repeats for every box, line and label in this section.
      const mapOsc = (voffset, height, level) => {
        if (!fin(level)) return NaN
        return priceLowest * (1 - priceChangeRate * voffset) * (1 + (level / OSC_TOP) * priceChangeRate * height)
      }

      // A curve, split wherever the oscillator is still warming up: a polyline
      // needs every anchor finite, and a warmup gap should break the line.
      const curve = (col, voffset, height, color) => {
        if (!Array.isArray(col)) return
        let run = []
        for (let i = startIdx; i <= last; i++) {
          const price = mapOsc(voffset, height, col[i])
          if (fin(price) && fin(bars[i].time)) run.push({ time: bars[i].time, price })
          else {
            if (run.length > 1) out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points: run, color, lineWidth: 1 })
            run = []
          }
        }
        if (run.length > 1) out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points: run, color, lineWidth: 1 })
      }

      // A reference level: Pine draws it as a box whose top and bottom agree,
      // at transparency 75, which is 0.25 alpha here.
      const level = (voffset, height, value, color) => {
        const price = mapOsc(voffset, height, value)
        if (!fin(price)) return
        out.push({
          kind: 'line',
          from: { time: startTime, price },
          to: { time: lastTime, price },
          color: withAlpha(color, 0.25),
          lineWidth: 1,
        })
      }

      // Pine anchors every label at bar_index + 3. There is no bar three ahead,
      // so the label sits on the last bar and opens to the right instead. Its
      // reading, which Pine hides in a hover tooltip, goes into the text.
      const label = (voffset, height, value, text, color) => {
        const price = mapOsc(voffset, height, value)
        if (!fin(price)) return
        out.push({
          kind: 'label',
          at: { time: lastTime, price },
          text,
          color: '#00000000',
          textColor: color,
          align: 'left',
        })
      }

      const mid = 50 // math.avg(100, 0)

      if (s.mfiDisplay) {
        level(s.mfiVoffset, s.mfiHeight, s.mfiOb, POS)
        level(s.mfiVoffset, s.mfiHeight, mid, NEUTRAL)
        level(s.mfiVoffset, s.mfiHeight, s.mfiOs, NEG)
        curve(values.mfi, s.mfiVoffset, s.mfiHeight, INDICATOR)
        label(s.mfiVoffset, s.mfiHeight, mid, `MFI ${fmt(values.mfi?.[last])}`, INDICATOR)
      }

      if (s.rsiDisplay) {
        level(s.rsiVoffset, s.rsiHeight, s.rsiOb, POS)
        level(s.rsiVoffset, s.rsiHeight, mid, NEUTRAL)
        level(s.rsiVoffset, s.rsiHeight, s.rsiOs, NEG)
        curve(values.rsi, s.rsiVoffset, s.rsiHeight, INDICATOR)
        curve(values.rsiSma, s.rsiVoffset, s.rsiHeight, SIGNAL)
        label(s.rsiVoffset, s.rsiHeight, mid, `RSI ${fmt(values.rsi?.[last])}`, INDICATOR)
      }

      if (s.cciDisplay) {
        // CCI's middle line is the zero level, which Pine writes out as the
        // bare offset with no height term. Level 0 is the same expression.
        level(s.cciVoffset, s.cciHeight, s.cciOb, POS)
        level(s.cciVoffset, s.cciHeight, 0, NEUTRAL)
        level(s.cciVoffset, s.cciHeight, s.cciOs, NEG)
        curve(values.cci, s.cciVoffset, s.cciHeight, INDICATOR)
        curve(values.cciSma, s.cciVoffset, s.cciHeight, SIGNAL)
        label(s.cciVoffset, s.cciHeight, 0, `CCI ${fmt(values.cci?.[last])}`, INDICATOR)
      }

      // Volume sits above the candles rather than below them.
      const volBase = priceHighest * (1 + priceChangeRate * s.volVoffset)
      const mapVol = (v) => {
        if (!fin(v) // volumeHighest <= 0 // !fin(volBase)) return NaN
        return volBase * (1 + (v / volumeHighest) * priceChangeRate * s.volHeight)
      }

      if (s.volType !== 'None') {
        const b = values.bvol?.[last]
        const sell = values.svol?.[last]
        const total = fin(b) && fin(sell) ? b + sell : NaN
        const buyPct = fin(total) && total !== 0 ? fmt((b / total) * 100) : '-'
        const sellPct = fin(total) && total !== 0 ? fmt((sell / total) * 100) : '-'
        const lastVol = fin(bars[last].volume) ? bars[last].volume : 0
        const avgVol = values.volSma?.[last]
        if (fin(volBase)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'label',
            at: { time: lastTime, price: volBase },
            text:
              `VOL  Buy ${buyPct}%  Sell ${sellPct}%\n` +
              `Last ${compactVolume(lastVol)}  Avg ${fin(avgVol) ? compactVolume(avgVol) : '-'}`,
            color: '#00000000',
            textColor: NEUTRAL,
            align: 'left',
          })
        }
      }

      // Pine guards the whole histogram on the last bar carrying volume at all.
      const lastVolume = fin(bars[last].volume) ? bars[last].volume : 0
      if (s.volType !== 'None' && lastVolume !== 0) {
        const buySell = s.volType === 'Buying/Selling Volume'
        for (let i = statIdx; i <= last; i++) {
          const v = fin(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : 0
          const top = mapVol(v)
          if (!fin(top) // !fin(volBase)) continue
          const bullCandle = bars[i].close > bars[i].open
          const color = buySell ? POS : bullCandle ? POS : NEG
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bars[i].time, price: volBase },
            to: { time: bars[i].time, price: top },
            color,
            lineWidth: 2,
          })
          if (buySell) {
            const sellTop = mapVol(values.svol?.[i])
            if (fin(sellTop)) {
              out.push({
                kind: 'line',
                from: { time: bars[i].time, price: volBase },
                to: { time: bars[i].time, price: sellTop },
                color: NEG,
                lineWidth: 2,
              })
            }
          }
        }

        // The volume moving average, drawn through the histogram. Pine divides
        // the bar's own height by volumeMARate, which is volume / vol_sma.
        if (s.volDisplay) {
          let run = []
          for (let i = startIdx; i <= last; i++) {
            const v = fin(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : 0
            const maVal = values.volSma?.[i]
            const rate = fin(maVal) && maVal !== 0 ? v / maVal : NaN
            let price = NaN
            if (fin(rate) && rate !== 0 && volumeHighest > 0 && fin(volBase)) {
              price = volBase * (1 + ((v / volumeHighest) * priceChangeRate * s.volHeight) / rate)
            }
            if (fin(price)) run.push({ time: bars[i].time, price })
            else {
              if (run.length > 1) out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points: run, color: NEUTRAL, lineWidth: 1 })
              run = []
            }
          }
          if (run.length > 1) out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points: run, color: NEUTRAL, lineWidth: 1 })
        }
      }

      return out
    },

    // The 2x5 readout Pine builds with table.new on the last bar. Cell colours
    // follow the same three-way verdict, at transparency 90 for the background.
    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return null
      const s = read(settings)
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const at = (k) => {
        const v = values[k]?.[i]
        return fin(v) ? v : NaN
      }

      const pchg = at('pchg')
      const rsiVal = at('rsi')
      const mfiVal = at('mfi')
      const cciVal = at('cci')
      const volSma = at('volSma')
      const vol = fin(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : NaN

      const verdict = (v, ob, os) => {
        if (!fin(v)) return NEUTRAL
        if (v > ob) return POS
        if (v < os) return NEG
        return NEUTRAL
      }
      const colPchg = verdict(pchg, s.pchgPct, -s.pchgPct)
      const colRsi = verdict(rsiVal, s.rsiOb, s.rsiOs)
      const colMfi = verdict(mfiVal, s.mfiOb, s.mfiOs)
      const colCci = verdict(cciVal, s.cciOb, s.cciOs)
      const colVol = fin(vol) && fin(volSma) && vol > volSma ? POS : NEUTRAL

      const cell = (text, color, align) => ({
        text,
        textColor: color,
        bgColor: withAlpha(color, 0.1),
        align: align ?? 'left',
      })

      return {
        rows: [
          [cell('%Chg', colPchg), cell(fmt(pchg), colPchg)],
          [cell('RSI', colRsi), cell(fmt(rsiVal), colRsi)],
          [cell('MFI', colMfi), cell(fmt(mfiVal), colMfi)],
          [cell('CCI', colCci), cell(fmt(cciVal), colCci)],
          [cell('Vol', colVol), cell(`${fin(vol) ? fmt(vol / 100000) : '- | `oa-momentum-setup---ankush-bajaj-momentum-investing-setup-with-` | `oa-momentum-setup---ankush-bajaj-momentum-investing-setup-with-.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Momentum) |
| Momentum Setup - Ankush Bajaj Momentum Investing Setup',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'pchgThreshold',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Above/Below %',
        default: 8,
        min: 0,
        max: 500,
        step: 0.1,
        group: '250 Candle % Change',
        tooltip:
          'Percentage change between the bar 250 bars back and the current bar. Positive for a bullish trend and the same number negated for a bearish one. 8 suits the daily timeframe, 2 to 4 an intraday one.',
      },

      { key: 'rsiDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiLen', type: 'number', label: 'RSI Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiSmaLen', type: 'number', label: 'SMA Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiOb', type: 'number', label: 'Overbought', default: 60, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      { key: 'rsiOs', type: 'number', label: 'Oversold', default: 40, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },
      {
        key: 'rsiVOffset',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Vertical Offset',
        default: 1.3,
        min: -10,
        max: 10,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)',
        tooltip: 'How far below the lowest price of the display window the RSI panel is drawn.',
      },
      { key: 'rsiHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 2, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Relative Strength Index (RSI)' },

      { key: 'mfiDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiLen', type: 'number', label: 'MFI Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiOb', type: 'number', label: 'Overbought', default: 60, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
