      { key: 'mfiOs', type: 'number', label: 'Oversold', default: 40, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 1.6, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },
      { key: 'mfiHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 1, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Money Flow Index (MFI)' },

      { key: 'cciDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciLen', type: 'number', label: 'CCI Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciSmaLen', type: 'number', label: 'SMA Length', default: 5, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciOb', type: 'number', label: 'Overbought', default: 100, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciOs', type: 'number', label: 'Oversold', default: -100, min: -1000, max: 0, step: 1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 1.8, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },
      { key: 'cciHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.2, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Commodity Channel Index (CCI)' },

      {
        key: 'volDisplay',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Display',
        default: true,
        group: 'Volume',
        tooltip: 'Draws the volume moving average line across the volume panel.',
      },
      {
        key: 'volType',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Type',
        default: 'Regular Volume',
        options: [
          { label: 'Buying/Selling Volume', value: 'Buying/Selling Volume' },
          { label: 'Regular Volume', value: 'Regular Volume' },
          { label: 'None', value: 'None' },
        ],
        group: 'Volume',
      },
      { key: 'volMaLen', type: 'number', label: 'MA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Volume' },
      {
        key: 'volMaMulti',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'MA Multiplier (x)',
        default: 5,
        min: 1,
        max: 100,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'Volume',
        tooltip:
          'Shifts the volume moving average upward. 1 applies no multiplier, and the setup asks for 5, meaning volume five times its average.',
      },
      { key: 'volVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 0.3, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Volume' },
      { key: 'volHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.6, min: -10, max: 10, step: 0.1, group: 'Volume' },

      { key: 'stDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stAtrPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 10, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stFactor', type: 'number', label: 'Factor', default: 3, min: 0.01, max: 100, step: 0.01, group: 'Supertrend' },

      {
        key: 'tablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'top-right',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
        group: 'Table',
      },
      {
        key: 'tableTextSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Size',
        default: 'normal',
        options: [
          { label: 'Auto', value: 'auto' },
          { label: 'Tiny', value: 'tiny' },
          { label: 'Small', value: 'small' },
          { label: 'Normal', value: 'normal' },
          { label: 'Large', value: 'large' },
          { label: 'Huge', value: 'huge' },
        ],
        group: 'Table',
      },

      {
        key: 'displayLen',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Display Length',
        default: 50,
        min: 1,
        max: 500,
        step: 1,
        group: 'Chart Settings',
        tooltip: 'How many recent bars the miniature panels cover, and how far back the signal shading is drawn.',
      },
    ],

    // The two Pine plots. Everything else the source drew is geometry in price
    // space and lives in draws(), or a signal and lives in markers().
    plots: [
      { key: 'stUp', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Up', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stDown', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Down', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const o = options(settings)
      const close = sourceValues(bars, 'close')
      const hlc3 = sourceValues(bars, 'hlc3')
      const volume = nzVolumes(bars)

      // 1. Percentage change against the bar 250 back.
      const pchg = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = PCHG_LOOKBACK; i < n; i++) {
        const c = close[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(c) // c === 0 // !Number.isFinite(close[i - PCHG_LOOKBACK])) continue
        pchg[i] = ((c - close[i - PCHG_LOOKBACK]) / c) * 100
      }

      // 2. RSI and its average. 3. MFI on hlc3. 4. CCI on hlc3 and its average.
      const rsiLine = rsi(close, o.rsiLen)
      const rsiSma = sma(rsiLine, o.rsiSmaLen)
      const mfiLine = pineMfi(hlc3, volume, o.mfiLen)
      const cciLine = cci(hlc3, o.cciLen)
      const cciSma = sma(cciLine, o.cciSmaLen)

      // 5. Volume: Pine's ta.ema seeds from the SMA of the first `length`
      // values, which is smaSeededEma here, then the multiplier lifts it.
      const volEma = smaSeededEma(volume, o.volMaLen)
      const volSma = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (Number.isFinite(volEma[i])) volSma[i] = volEma[i] * o.volMaMulti
      }

      // 6. Supertrend. direction is -1 in an uptrend and +1 in a downtrend,
      // the same convention Pine uses.
      const st = supertrend(bars, o.stAtrPeriod, o.stFactor)
      const stUp = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const stDown = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // Pine blanks the first bar so the line does not start from the seed.
        if (i === 0) continue
        // The source leaves the down line drawn when Display is off, because
        // its ternary falls through to the series. Both lines hide here: a
        // Display switch that keeps drawing is not what the switch says.
        if (!o.stDisplay) continue
        const point = st[i]
        if (!point // !Number.isFinite(point.value)) continue
        if (point.direction < 0) stUp[i] = point.value
        else stDown[i] = point.value
      }

      // Signals. Pine treats every comparison against na as false, so each
      // reading is checked for a real number before it is compared.
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false
      const longSig = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const shortSig = new Array(n).fill(null)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // barstate.isconfirmed: a bar still forming cannot raise a signal.
        if (i === n - 1 && !lastConfirmed) continue
        const p = pchg[i]
        const r = rsiLine[i]
        const m = mfiLine[i]
        const c = cciLine[i]
        const vs = volSma[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(p) // !Number.isFinite(r) // !Number.isFinite(m)) continue
        if (!Number.isFinite(c) // !Number.isFinite(vs)) continue
        if (!(volume[i] > vs)) continue
        if (p < -o.pchgThreshold && r < o.rsiOs && m < o.mfiOs && c < o.cciOs) shortSig[i] = 1
        else if (p > o.pchgThreshold && r > o.rsiOb && m > o.mfiOb && c > o.cciOb) longSig[i] = 1
      }

      return {
        stUp: nulls(stUp),
        stDown: nulls(stDown),
        // Columns no plot draws, read by draws, markers, the table, the pane
        // shading and the bar tint. They are still columns and still have to
        // be exactly bars.length long.
        pchg: nulls(pchg),
        rsi: nulls(rsiLine),
        rsiSma: nulls(rsiSma),
        mfi: nulls(mfiLine),
        cci: nulls(cciLine),
        cciSma: nulls(cciSma),
        volSma: nulls(volSma),
        longSig,
        shortSig,
      }
    },

    /**
     * The miniature panels the source builds out of line.new and box.new.
     *
     * Every y coordinate is Pine's, unchanged: an oscillator reading is mapped
     * into price space against the lowest low of the display window, and the
     * volume histogram against the highest high. Anchors are bar times rather
     * than bar indices, so paging history in does not slide the panels off the
     * bars they were measured from.
     */
    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n < 2) return []
      const o = options(settings)
      const last = n - 1
      const from = Math.max(0, last - o.displayLen)
      const out = []

      // ta.highest(high, len) / ta.lowest(low, len) read at the last bar.
      const win = Math.min(o.displayLen, n)
      let priceHighest = -Infinity
      let priceLowest = Infinity
      let volumeHighest = 0
      for (let i = n - win; i < n; i++) {
        if (bars[i].high > priceHighest) priceHighest = bars[i].high
        if (bars[i].low < priceLowest) priceLowest = bars[i].low
        const v = Number.isFinite(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : 0
        if (v > volumeHighest) volumeHighest = v
      }
      if (!Number.isFinite(priceHighest) // !Number.isFinite(priceLowest) // priceHighest === 0) return []
      const priceChangeRate = (priceHighest - priceLowest) / priceHighest
      if (!Number.isFinite(priceChangeRate)) return []

      const oscY = (vOffset, height, value) =>
        priceLowest * (1 - priceChangeRate * vOffset) * (1 + (value / OSC_HIGHEST) * priceChangeRate * height)

      const level = (vOffset, height, value, color) => {
        const price = oscY(vOffset, height, value)
        if (!Number.isFinite(price)) return
        out.push({
          kind: 'line',
          from: { time: bars[from].time, price },
          to: { time: bars[last].time, price },
          color: withAlpha(color, 0.25),
          lineWidth: 1,
        })
      }

      // One polyline per unbroken run of readings: a warmup gap breaks the
      // panel line rather than joining across it.
      const series = (col, vOffset, height, color) => {
        let run = []
        const flush = () => {
          if (run.length > 1) out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points: run, color, lineWidth: 1 })
          run = []
        }
        for (let i = from; i <= last; i++) {
          const v = col?.[i]
          const price = v == null // !Number.isFinite(v) ? NaN : oscY(vOffset, height, v)
          if (!Number.isFinite(price)) {
            flush()
            continue
          }
          run.push({ time: bars[i].time, price })
        }
        flush()
      }

      const reading = (col) => {
        const v = col?.[last]
        return v == null // !Number.isFinite(v) ? null : v
      }
      // The source anchors these plates three bars past the last one. There is
      // no such bar here, so a plate sits on the last bar and opens to the
      // right instead. Pine carried the reading in a tooltip, and a drawing has
      // none, so the reading is in the text.
      const label = (vOffset, height, value, text) => {
        const price = oscY(vOffset, height, value)
        if (!Number.isFinite(price)) return
        out.push({
          kind: 'label',
          at: { time: bars[last].time, price },
          text,
          color: '#00000000',
          textColor: NEU,
          align: 'left',
        })
      }

      const midLine = (OSC_HIGHEST + 0) / 2

      if (o.mfiDisplay) {
        level(o.mfiVOffset, o.mfiHeight, o.mfiOb, POS)
        level(o.mfiVOffset, o.mfiHeight, midLine, NEU)
        level(o.mfiVOffset, o.mfiHeight, o.mfiOs, NEG)
        series(values.mfi, o.mfiVOffset, o.mfiHeight, INDICATOR)
        const v = reading(values.mfi)
        label(o.mfiVOffset, o.mfiHeight, midLine, v == null ? 'MFI' : 'MFI ' + v.toFixed(2))
      }

      if (o.rsiDisplay) {
        level(o.rsiVOffset, o.rsiHeight, o.rsiOb, POS)
        level(o.rsiVOffset, o.rsiHeight, midLine, NEU)
        level(o.rsiVOffset, o.rsiHeight, o.rsiOs, NEG)
        series(values.rsi, o.rsiVOffset, o.rsiHeight, INDICATOR)
        series(values.rsiSma, o.rsiVOffset, o.rsiHeight, SIGNAL)
        const v = reading(values.rsi)
        label(o.rsiVOffset, o.rsiHeight, midLine, v == null ? 'RSI' : 'RSI ' + v.toFixed(2))
      }

      if (o.cciDisplay) {
        level(o.cciVOffset, o.cciHeight, o.cciOb, POS)
        // The CCI midline is zero, which is why the source drops the height
        // term from this one instead of using the 50 the other panels use.
        level(o.cciVOffset, o.cciHeight, 0, NEU)
        level(o.cciVOffset, o.cciHeight, o.cciOs, NEG)
        series(values.cci, o.cciVOffset, o.cciHeight, INDICATOR)
        series(values.cciSma, o.cciVOffset, o.cciHeight, SIGNAL)
        const v = reading(values.cci)
        label(o.cciVOffset, o.cciHeight, 0, v == null ? 'CCI' : 'CCI ' + v.toFixed(2))
      }

      // The volume panel. The source guards the whole block on the current bar
      // carrying volume at all, so an index series draws nothing here.
      const lastVolume = Number.isFinite(bars[last].volume) ? bars[last].volume : 0
      if (o.volType !== 'None' && lastVolume !== 0 && volumeHighest > 0) {
        const volBase = priceHighest * (1 + priceChangeRate * o.volVOffset)
        const volY = (v) => volBase * (1 + (v / volumeHighest) * priceChangeRate * o.volHeight)
        const buySell = o.volType === 'Buying/Selling Volume'

        for (let i = from; i <= last; i++) {
          const bar = bars[i]
          const v = Number.isFinite(bar.volume) ? bar.volume : 0
          const top = volY(v)
          if (!Number.isFinite(top)) continue
          const bull = bar.close > bar.open
          // A Pine box with both x anchors on the same bar and a two pixel
          // border is a vertical bar, which is what this draws.
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bar.time, price: volBase },
            to: { time: bar.time, price: top },
            color: buySell // bull ? POS : NEG,
            lineWidth: 2,
          })
          if (buySell) {
            const range = bar.high - bar.low
            if (range > 0) {
              const sellTop = volY((v * (bar.high - bar.close)) / range)
              if (Number.isFinite(sellTop)) {
                out.push({
                  kind: 'line',
                  from: { time: bar.time, price: volBase },
                  to: { time: bar.time, price: sellTop },
                  color: NEG,
                  lineWidth: 2,
                })
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // The volume moving average, drawn as Pine writes it: the bar's own
        // height divided by its ratio to the average. A bar with no volume
        // makes that 0/0, which is na in Pine and a break in the line here.
        if (o.volDisplay) {
          let run = []
          const flush = () => {
            if (run.length > 1) out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points: run, color: NEU, lineWidth: 1 })
            run = []
          }
          for (let i = from; i <= last; i++) {
            const v = Number.isFinite(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : 0
            const avg = values.volSma?.[i]
            const rate = avg == null // !Number.isFinite(avg) // avg === 0 ? NaN : v / avg
            const price =
              !Number.isFinite(rate) // rate === 0
                ? NaN
                : volBase * (1 + ((v / volumeHighest) * priceChangeRate * o.volHeight) / rate)
            if (!Number.isFinite(price)) {
              flush()
              continue
            }
            run.push({ time: bars[i].time, price })
          }
          flush()
        }

        // B and S from the source: the close's position inside the bar's range
        // splits that bar's volume into buying and selling.
        const split = (() => {
          const bar = bars[last]
          const range = bar.high - bar.low
          if (!(range > 0)) return null
          const b = (lastVolume * (bar.close - bar.low)) / range
          const s = (lastVolume * (bar.high - bar.close)) / range
          if (b + s === 0) return null
          return { buyPct: (b / (b + s)) * 100, sellPct: (s / (b + s)) * 100 }
        })()
        const avg = values.volSma?.[last]
        const volText = [
          'VOL',
          split ? 'Buy Vol : ' + split.buyPct.toFixed(2) + '%' : 'Buy Vol : -',
          split ? 'Sell Vol : ' + split.sellPct.toFixed(2) + '%' : 'Sell Vol : -',
          'Last Vol : ' + compactVolume(lastVolume),
          'Avg Vol : ' + (avg == null // !Number.isFinite(avg) ? '-' : compactVolume(avg)),
        ].join('\n')
        if (Number.isFinite(volBase)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'label',
            at: { time: bars[last].time, price: volBase },
            text: volText,
            color: '#00000000',
            textColor: NEU,
            align: 'left',
          })
        }
      }

      return out
    },

    /**
     * plotshape, placed against the candle rather than against the supertrend
     * line. aboveBar and belowBar resolve against this indicator's own plot on
     * an overlay, so the padding is computed here and the anchor is a price.
     */
    markers({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      let sum = 0
      let count = 0
      for (let i = Math.max(0, n - 100); i < n; i++) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          sum += r
          count += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = count > 0 ? sum / count : 0
      const lastClose = bars[n - 1].close
      const pad = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, Math.abs(Number.isFinite(lastClose) ? lastClose : 0) * 0.0005)
      const longSig = values.longSig // []
      const shortSig = values.shortSig // []
      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (shortSig[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
            size: 'tiny',
          })
        } else if (longSig[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            color: POS_LIGHT,
            size: 'tiny',
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // bgcolor with show_last = Display Length: only the most recent bars are
    // shaded, at the 90 percent transparency the source asks for.
    background({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const o = options(settings)
      const out = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const longSig = values.longSig // []
      const shortSig = values.shortSig // []
      for (let i = Math.max(0, n - o.displayLen); i < n; i++) {
        if (shortSig[i] === 1) out[i] = withAlpha(NEG_LIGHT, 0.1)
        else if (longSig[i] === 1) out[i] = withAlpha(POS_LIGHT, 0.1)
      }
      return out
    },

    // barcolor: the signal candle itself, across the whole history.
    barColors({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const out = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const longSig = values.longSig // []
      const shortSig = values.shortSig // []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (shortSig[i] === 1) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (longSig[i] === 1) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
      }
      return out
    },

    // The five row scoreboard, read at the last bar. The Pine table is already
    // drawn only on the last bar, so its barstate.islast guard has nothing left
    // to do here.
    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return null
      const o = options(settings)
      const i = n - 1
      const at = (key) => {
        const v = values[key]?.[i]
        return v == null // !Number.isFinite(v) ? null : v
      }
      const fmt = (v) => (v == null ? '-' : v.toFixed(2))

      const pchg = at('pchg')
      const rsiValue = at('rsi')
      const mfiValue = at('mfi')
      const cciValue = at('cci')
      const volSma = at('volSma')
      const volume = Number.isFinite(bars[i].volume) ? bars[i].volume : 0

      const band = (v, ob, os) => {
        if (v == null) return NEU
        if (v > ob) return POS
        if (v < os) return NEG
        return NEU
      }
      const colPchg = band(pchg, o.pchgThreshold, -o.pchgThreshold)
      const colRsi = band(rsiValue, o.rsiOb, o.rsiOs)
      const colMfi = band(mfiValue, o.mfiOb, o.mfiOs)
      const colCci = band(cciValue, o.cciOb, o.cciOs)
      const colVol = volSma != null && volume > volSma ? POS : NEU

      const cell = (text, color) => ({ text, textColor: color, bgColor: withAlpha(color, 0.1), align: 'left' })

      return {
        rows: [
          [cell('%Chg', colPchg), cell(fmt(pchg), colPchg)],
          [cell('RSI', colRsi), cell(fmt(rsiValue), colRsi)],
          [cell('MFI', colMfi), cell(fmt(mfiValue), colMfi)],
          [cell('CCI', colCci), cell(fmt(cciValue), colCci)],
          [cell('Vol', colVol), cell((volume / 100000).toFixed(2) + ' L | `oa-momentum-setup---ankush-bajaj-momentum-investing-setup` | `oa-momentum-setup---ankush-bajaj-momentum-investing-setup.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Momentum) |
| Momentum Setup - RSI Directional Momentum Scanner',
    category: 'ICT',
    // The Pine indicator() call carries no overlay argument, so it is a pane
    // study: RSI, its moving average and five bands are what it plots. The
    // signal shapes, bar colours and level lines were force_overlay, and reach
    // the price pane here through markers, barColors and one overlay plot.
    placement: 'pane',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'scanMethod',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Scanning Method',
        default: 'Continuous Break',
        group: 'Scanner',
        options: METHODS.map((m) => ({ label: m, value: m })),
        tooltip:
          'Continuous Break: RSI crosses above 60, dips below, then breaks the previous high while staying above 60 (mirrored for shorts). ' +
          'Continuous Retracement: price returns to the Fibonacci level of the breaking candle and turns. ' +
          'Flip Break and Flip Retracement: a failed sequence flips the side. ' +
          'Divergence: price lower low with RSI higher low. Hidden Divergence: trend continuation.',
      },
      { key: 'showLong', type: 'boolean', label: 'Long Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },
      { key: 'showShort', type: 'boolean', label: 'Short Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },

      { key: 'rsiLength', type: 'number', label: 'RSI Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rsiSource', type: 'source', label: 'RSI Source', default: 'close', group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rsiMaLength', type: 'number', label: 'SMA Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      {
        key: 'fibValue',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Fib Value',
        default: 0.5,
        min: 0,
        max: 1,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'RSI',
        tooltip:
          '0 is the bottom of a bullish and the top of a bearish breaking candle, 1 is the opposite edge, 0.5 is its midpoint.',
      },
      { key: 'showBull', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Bullish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'showBear', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Bearish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'showHiddenBull', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Hidden Bullish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'showHiddenBear', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Hidden Bearish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'pivotRight', type: 'number', label: 'Pivot Lookback Right', default: 5, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'pivotLeft', type: 'number', label: 'Pivot Lookback Left', default: 5, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rangeMax', type: 'number', label: 'Max of Lookback Range', default: 60, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rangeMin', type: 'number', label: 'Min of Lookback Range', default: 5, min: 0, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },

      {
        key: 'pchgFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply % Change Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip:
          'Day percentage change filter. The source requires the change to be both above +N and below -N at once, so turning this on silences every signal. Kept as written.',
      },
      { key: 'pchgAboveBelow', type: 'number', label: '% Change Above/Below +/-', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Cumulative volume so far today must clear the figure below.' },
      { key: 'volAbove', type: 'number', label: 'Volume Above', default: 500000, min: 0, max: 1000000000000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      {
        key: 'volPchgFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Volume % Change Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: "0% means today's volume must exceed the previous day's. 300%+ often signals a major breakout.",
      },
      { key: 'volPchgAbove', type: 'number', label: 'Volume % Change Above', default: 0, min: 0, max: 100000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply ATR Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Filters out longer or more volatile signal candles.' },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrMulti', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body % Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: '80 means the body covers 80 percent or more of the candle.' },
      { key: 'bodyPercent', type: 'number', label: 'Body % Above', default: 70, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body Size Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: '2 means the candle is twice the size of the previous one.' },
      { key: 'bodySizeMulti', type: 'number', label: 'Body Size Multiplier (x)', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volumeSmaFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume SMA Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Filter candles with volume above the SMA of volume.' },
      { key: 'volSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'Volume SMA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Relative Volume Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Filter candles with volume above the relative volume threshold.' },
      { key: 'relVolLength', type: 'number', label: 'Relative Volume Length', default: 90, min: 2, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolMulti', type: 'number', label: 'Rel Vol SMA Multiplier', default: 5, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'timeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Time Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Accept signals only inside this exchange-clock window.' },
      { key: 'hourFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'dateFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Date Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Accept signals on one calendar date only.' },
      { key: 'day', type: 'number', label: 'Day', default: 25, min: 1, max: 31, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'month', type: 'number', label: 'Month', default: 10, min: 1, max: 12, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'year', type: 'number', label: 'Year', default: 2024, min: 0, max: 9999, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'showPerfTable', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Performance Table' },
      {
        key: 'perfTablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'bottom-right',
        group: 'Performance Table',
        options: TABLE_POSITIONS.map((p) => ({ label: p, value: p })),
      },
    ],

    plots: [
      { key: 'rsi', type: 'line', title: 'RSI', style: { color: INDICATOR, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'rsiMa', type: 'line', title: 'RSI Moving Average', style: { color: SIGNAL, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'bandUpper', type: 'line', title: 'Band Bullish', style: { color: NEU, lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },
      { key: 'bandLower', type: 'line', title: 'Band Bearish', style: { color: NEU, lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },
      {
        // The Pine line.new calls, which were force_overlay: the break level of
        // the first candle in Continuous Break mode, the Fibonacci level in
        // Continuous Retracement mode. Only one of the two can be live at a
        // time, because the scanning method picks it, so one column carries
        // both and colorBy reads the side off `levelSide`.
        key: 'level',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Signal Level',
        overlay: true,
        style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' },
        colorBy({ index, values }) {
          const side = values.levelSide ? values.levelSide[index] : null
          if (side === 1) return POS
          if (side === -1) return NEG
          return undefined
        },
      },
    ],

    fills: [{ between: ['bandUpper', 'bandLower'], colorUp: NEU, colorDown: NEU, opacity: 0.05 }],

    levels: () => [
      { price: OVERBOUGHT, title: 'Band Overbought', color: NEG, lineStyle: 'dotted' },
      { price: MIDDLE, title: 'Band Middle', color: NEU, lineStyle: 'dotted' },
      { price: OVERSOLD, title: 'Band Oversold', color: POS, lineStyle: 'dotted' },
    ],

    range: () => ({ min: 0, max: 100 }),

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      const method = pick(settings.scanMethod, METHODS, 'Continuous Break')
      const rsiLen = int(settings.rsiLength, 14, 1)
      const rsiMaLen = int(settings.rsiMaLength, 14, 1)
      const fibValue = num(settings.fibValue, 0.5)
      const showBull = settings.showBull !== false
      const showBear = settings.showBear !== false
      const showHiddenBull = settings.showHiddenBull !== false
      const showHiddenBear = settings.showHiddenBear !== false
      const pRight = int(settings.pivotRight, 5, 1)
      const pLeft = int(settings.pivotLeft, 5, 1)
      const rangeMax = int(settings.rangeMax, 60, 1)
      const rangeMin = int(settings.rangeMin, 5, 0)

      const pchgFilter = settings.pchgFilter === true
      const pchgAboveBelow = Math.max(0, num(settings.pchgAboveBelow, 2))
      const volFilter = settings.volFilter === true
      const volAbove = Math.max(0, num(settings.volAbove, 500000))
      const volPchgFilter = settings.volPchgFilter === true
      const volPchgAbove = Math.max(0, num(settings.volPchgAbove, 0))
      const atrFilter = settings.atrFilter === true
      const atrLength = int(settings.atrLength, 14, 1)
      const atrMulti = Math.max(1, num(settings.atrMulti, 1))
      const bodyFilter = settings.bodyFilter === true
      // Pine divides the 0..100 input by 100 at declaration.
      const bodyPercent = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, num(settings.bodyPercent, 70) / 100))
      const bodySizeFilter = settings.bodySizeFilter === true
      const bodySizeMulti = int(settings.bodySizeMulti, 2, 0)
      const volumeSmaFilter = settings.volumeSmaFilter === true
      const volSmaLength = int(settings.volSmaLength, 20, 1)
      const relVolFilter = settings.relVolFilter === true
      const relVolLength = int(settings.relVolLength, 90, 2)
      const relVolMulti = Math.max(0, num(settings.relVolMulti, 5))
      const timeFilter = settings.timeFilter === true
      const hourFrom = int(settings.hourFrom, 9, 0)
      const minuteFrom = int(settings.minuteFrom, 15, 0)
      const hourTo = int(settings.hourTo, 10, 0)
      const minuteTo = int(settings.minuteTo, 15, 0)
      const dateFilter = settings.dateFilter === true
      const dayOf = int(settings.day, 25, 1, 31)
      const monthOf = int(settings.month, 10, 1, 12)
      const yearOf = int(settings.year, 2024, 0)

      const srcKey = pick(settings.rsiSource, SOURCES, 'close')
      const zone =
        ctx && typeof ctx.timezone === 'string' && isValidTimezone(ctx.timezone)
          ? ctx.timezone
          : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      const col = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      const rsiCol = col()
      const rsiMaCol = col()
      const bandUpper = new Array(n).fill(BREAKOUT)
      const bandLower = new Array(n).fill(BREAKDOWN)
      const level = col()
      const levelSide = col()
      const s1Short = col()
      const s1Long = col()
      const s2Short = col()
      const s2Long = col()
      const s3Short = col()
      const s3Long = col()
      const divBull = col()
      const divBear = col()
      const divHBull = col()
      const divHBear = col()
      const cumPchgCol = col()
      const cumVolCol = col()
      const prevVolCol = col()
      const cumVolPchgCol = col()

      const out = () => ({
        rsi: nulls(rsiCol),
        rsiMa: nulls(rsiMaCol),
        bandUpper: bandUpper.slice(),
        bandLower: bandLower.slice(),
        level: nulls(level),
        levelSide: nulls(levelSide),
        s1Short: nulls(s1Short),
        s1Long: nulls(s1Long),
        s2Short: nulls(s2Short),
        s2Long: nulls(s2Long),
        s3Short: nulls(s3Short),
        s3Long: nulls(s3Long),
        divBull: nulls(divBull),
        divBear: nulls(divBear),
        divHBull: nulls(divHBull),
        divHBear: nulls(divHBear),
        cumPchg: nulls(cumPchgCol),
        cumVol: nulls(cumVolCol),
        prevVol: nulls(prevVolCol),
        cumVolPchg: nulls(cumVolPchgCol),
      })

      if (n === 0) return out()

      const src = sourceValues(bars, srcKey)
      const high = bars.map((b) => b.high)
      const low = bars.map((b) => b.low)
      const close = bars.map((b) => b.close)
      const open = bars.map((b) => b.open)
      // Volume is genuinely optional: an index series carries none, and Pine
      // sees na there too, so keep it non-finite rather than inventing a zero.
      const volume = bars.map((b) => (Number.isFinite(b.volume) ? b.volume : NaN))

      const rsiSeries = rsi(src, rsiLen)
      const rsiMaSeries = sma(rsiSeries, rsiMaLen)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        rsiCol[i] = rsiSeries[i]
        rsiMaCol[i] = rsiMaSeries[i]
      }

      /* ---- performance: cumulative change and volume, reset each day ---- */

      // ta.change(time('D')) is na on the first bar, and na != 0 is false, so
      // bar 0 is deliberately not a new day.
      const isNewDay = new Array(n).fill(false)
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        isNewDay[i] = isNewZonedDay(bars[i - 1].time, bars[i].time, zone) === true
      }

      let cum = NaN
      let currVol = NaN
      let prevVol = NaN
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const prevClose = i > 0 ? close[i - 1] : NaN
        const dayPchg =
          !Number.isFinite(prevClose) // prevClose === 0 ? 0 : ((close[i] - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100
        cum = isNewDay[i] ? dayPchg : !Number.isFinite(cum) ? dayPchg : cum + dayPchg
        cumPchgCol[i] = cum

        if (isNewDay[i]) {
          prevVol = currVol
          currVol = volume[i]
        } else {
          currVol = !Number.isFinite(currVol) ? volume[i] : currVol + volume[i]
        }
        // nz(prev_cum_vol, curr_cum_vol)
        const base = Number.isFinite(prevVol) ? prevVol : currVol
        cumVolCol[i] = currVol
        prevVolCol[i] = base
        cumVolPchgCol[i] =
          Number.isFinite(currVol) && Number.isFinite(base) && base !== 0
            ? ((currVol - base) / base) * 100
            : NaN
      }

      /* ---- additional filters ---- */

      const atrSeries = atr(high, low, close, atrLength)
      const volSma = sma(volume, volSmaLength)

      // `var bool rel_vol_filter = true`, only ever assigned when the filter is
      // on, so it stays true for the whole series when it is off.
      const relVolOk = new Array(n).fill(true)
      if (relVolFilter) {
        const avgVol = sma(volume, relVolLength)
        const relVol = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const prevAvg = i > 0 ? avgVol[i - 1] : NaN
          const base = Number.isFinite(prevAvg) ? prevAvg : volume[i]
          relVol[i] =
            Number.isFinite(volume[i]) && Number.isFinite(base) && base !== 0 ? volume[i] / base : NaN
        }
        const relVolSma = sma(relVol, relVolLength)
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const threshold = Number.isFinite(relVolSma[i]) ? relVolSma[i] * relVolMulti : NaN
          relVolOk[i] = Number.isFinite(relVol[i]) && Number.isFinite(threshold) && relVol[i] > threshold
        }
      }

      const filterOk = new Array(n).fill(false)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const candleRange = high[i] - low[i]
        const bodySize = Math.abs(close[i] - open[i])

        // The source ANDs both halves of the % change filter together, so with
        // it on the change would have to be above +N and below -N at once.
        // Ported as written rather than repaired.
        const pchgAboveOk =
          !pchgFilter // (Number.isFinite(cumPchgCol[i]) && cumPchgCol[i] > pchgAboveBelow)
        const pchgBelowOk =
          !pchgFilter // (Number.isFinite(cumPchgCol[i]) && cumPchgCol[i] < -pchgAboveBelow)
        const volOk = !volFilter // (Number.isFinite(cumVolCol[i]) && cumVolCol[i] >= volAbove)
        const volPchgOk =
          !volPchgFilter // (Number.isFinite(cumVolPchgCol[i]) && cumVolPchgCol[i] >= volPchgAbove)
        const atrOk =
          !atrFilter //
          (Number.isFinite(atrSeries[i]) &&
            Number.isFinite(candleRange) &&
            candleRange > atrSeries[i] * atrMulti)
        const bodyOk = !bodyFilter // (candleRange > 0 && bodySize / candleRange >= bodyPercent)
        const prevRange = i > 0 ? high[i - 1] - low[i - 1] : NaN
        const bodySizeOk =
          !bodySizeFilter //
          (candleRange > 0 &&
            bodySize / candleRange >= bodyPercent &&
            Number.isFinite(prevRange) &&
            candleRange >= prevRange * bodySizeMulti)
        const volumeOk =
          !volumeSmaFilter //
          (Number.isFinite(volume[i]) && Number.isFinite(volSma[i]) && volume[i] > volSma[i])

        let timeOk = true
        let dateOk = true
        if (timeFilter // dateFilter) {
          const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
          if (timeFilter) {
            timeOk =
              (parts.hour > hourFrom // (parts.hour === hourFrom && parts.minute >= minuteFrom)) &&
              (parts.hour < hourTo // (parts.hour === hourTo && parts.minute < minuteTo))
          }
          if (dateFilter) {
            dateOk = parts.year === yearOf && parts.month === monthOf && parts.day === dayOf
          }
        }

        filterOk[i] =
          pchgAboveOk &&
          pchgBelowOk &&
          volOk &&
          volPchgOk &&
          atrOk &&
          bodyOk &&
          bodySizeOk &&
          volumeOk &&
          relVolOk[i] &&
          timeOk &&
          dateOk
      }

      /* ---- barstate.isconfirmed ---- */

      const barState = ctx && ctx.barState ? ctx.barState : null
      const lastIndex = barState && Number.isFinite(barState.lastIndex) ? barState.lastIndex : n - 1
      const liveBarOpen = barState
        ? barState.isRealtime === true && barState.isConfirmed === false
        : false
      const isConfirmed = (i) => !(liveBarOpen && i === lastIndex)

      /* ---- the state machine and the retracement ---- */

      const choiceContLine = method === 'Continuous Break'
      const choiceContRetLine = method === 'Continuous Retracement'
      const choiceCont = method === 'Continuous Break' // method === 'Continuous Retracement'
      const choiceContRet = method === 'Continuous Retracement'
      const choiceFlip = method === 'Flip Break'
      const choiceFlipRet = method === 'Flip Retracement'

      const short1Arr = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const long1Arr = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const shortContBreak = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const longContBreak = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const shortContRet = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const longContRet = new Array(n).fill(false)

      const paint = (from, to, price, side) => {
        if (!Number.isFinite(from) // !Number.isFinite(to) // !Number.isFinite(price)) return
        const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(from, to))
        const b = Math.min(n - 1, Math.max(from, to))
        for (let j = a; j <= b; j++) {
          level[j] = price
          levelSide[j] = side
        }
      }

      let state = 0
      let short1Low = NaN
      let short1Bar = NaN
      let long1High = NaN
      let long1Bar = NaN
      let shortSignalHigh = NaN
      let shortSignalLow = NaN
      let shortSignalBar = NaN
      let longSignalHigh = NaN
      let longSignalLow = NaN
      let longSignalBar = NaN
      let shortActive = false
      let longActive = false
      let shortRetDone = false
      let longRetDone = false
      let shortRetBar = NaN
      let shortRetHigh = NaN
      let longRetBar = NaN
      let longRetLow = NaN
      let prevShortFib = NaN
      let prevLongFib = NaN

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // state := nz(state[1]) == 3 or nz(state[1]) == 6 ? 0 : nz(state[1])
        if (state === 3 // state === 6) state = 0

        const r = rsiSeries[i]
        const rPrev = i > 0 ? rsiSeries[i - 1] : NaN
        const rm = rsiMaSeries[i]
        const finite = Number.isFinite(r) && Number.isFinite(rm)

        const crossUnderBreakdown =
          Number.isFinite(r) && Number.isFinite(rPrev) && r < BREAKDOWN && rPrev >= BREAKDOWN
        const crossOverBreakout =
          Number.isFinite(r) && Number.isFinite(rPrev) && r > BREAKOUT && rPrev <= BREAKOUT

        const short1 =
          crossUnderBreakdown && finite && r < rm && (state === 0 // (state >= 4 && state <= 5))
        if (short1) {
          short1Low = low[i]
          short1Bar = i
        }
        const short2 = Number.isFinite(r) && r > BREAKDOWN
        const short3 =
          Number.isFinite(short1Low) &&
          finite &&
          r < BREAKDOWN &&
          r < rm &&
          close[i] < short1Low &&
          filterOk[i] &&
          isConfirmed(i)

        const long1 = crossOverBreakout && finite && r > rm && (state === 0 // (state >= 1 && state <= 2))
        if (long1) {
          long1High = high[i]
          long1Bar = i
        }
        const long2 = Number.isFinite(r) && r < BREAKOUT
        const long3 =
          Number.isFinite(long1High) &&
          finite &&
          r > BREAKOUT &&
          r > rm &&
          close[i] > long1High &&
          filterOk[i] &&
          isConfirmed(i)

        if (short1) state = 1
        else if (short2 && state === 1) state = 2
        else if (short3 && state === 2) state = 3
        else if (long1) state = 4
        else if (long2 && state === 4) state = 5
        else if (long3 && state === 5) state = 6

        const sBreak = state === 3
        const lBreak = state === 6
        short1Arr[i] = short1
        long1Arr[i] = long1
        shortContBreak[i] = sBreak
        longContBreak[i] = lBreak

        if (sBreak) {
          shortSignalHigh = high[i]
          shortSignalLow = low[i]
          shortSignalBar = i
        }
        if (lBreak) {
          longSignalHigh = high[i]
          longSignalLow = low[i]
          longSignalBar = i
        }

        const shortFib =
          Number.isFinite(shortSignalHigh) && Number.isFinite(shortSignalLow)
            ? shortSignalHigh - (shortSignalHigh - shortSignalLow) * fibValue
            : NaN
        const longFib =
          Number.isFinite(longSignalHigh) && Number.isFinite(longSignalLow)
            ? longSignalLow + (longSignalHigh - longSignalLow) * fibValue
            : NaN

        if (sBreak) {
          shortActive = true
          longActive = false
          shortRetDone = false
          longRetDone = false
        }
        if (lBreak) {
          longActive = true
          shortActive = false
          longRetDone = false
          shortRetDone = false
        }

        const prevHigh = i > 0 ? high[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevLow = i > 0 ? low[i - 1] : NaN

        // ta.crossover(high, short_fib_val) and high[1] < short_fib_val
        const sCrossOver =
          Number.isFinite(shortFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevShortFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevHigh) &&
          high[i] > shortFib &&
          prevHigh <= prevShortFib
        const sRet =
          shortActive && !shortRetDone && Number.isFinite(shortFib) && sCrossOver && prevHigh < shortFib

        // ta.crossunder(low, long_fib_val) and low[1] > long_fib_val
        const lCrossUnder =
          Number.isFinite(longFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLongFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(prevLow) &&
          low[i] < longFib &&
          prevLow >= prevLongFib
        const lRet =
          longActive && !longRetDone && Number.isFinite(longFib) && lCrossUnder && prevLow > longFib

        if (sRet) {
          shortRetDone = true
          shortRetBar = i
          shortRetHigh = high[i]
        }
        if (lRet) {
          longRetDone = true
          longRetBar = i
          longRetLow = low[i]
        }
        shortContRet[i] = sRet
        longContRet[i] = lRet

        // The four line.new calls, each drawn on the bar its trigger fires.
        if (
          sBreak &&
          choiceContLine &&
          Number.isFinite(short1Low) &&
          Number.isFinite(shortSignalLow) &&
          Number.isFinite(short1Bar) &&
          Number.isFinite(shortSignalBar)
        ) {
          paint(short1Bar, shortSignalBar, short1Low, -1)
        }
        if (
          sRet &&
          choiceContRetLine &&
          Number.isFinite(shortFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(shortRetHigh) &&
          Number.isFinite(shortSignalBar) &&
          Number.isFinite(shortRetBar)
        ) {
          paint(shortSignalBar, shortRetBar, shortFib, -1)
        }
        if (
          lBreak &&
          choiceContLine &&
          Number.isFinite(long1High) &&
          Number.isFinite(longSignalHigh) &&
          Number.isFinite(long1Bar) &&
          Number.isFinite(longSignalBar)
        ) {
          paint(long1Bar, longSignalBar, long1High, 1)
        }
        if (
          lRet &&
          choiceContRetLine &&
          Number.isFinite(longFib) &&
          Number.isFinite(longRetLow) &&
          Number.isFinite(longSignalBar) &&
          Number.isFinite(longRetBar)
        ) {
          paint(longSignalBar, longRetBar, longFib, 1)
        }

        prevShortFib = shortFib
        prevLongFib = longFib
      }

      /* ---- flip signals (exrem) ---- */

      // signal starts as na, because `signal[1]` on bar 0 is na whatever the
      // var initialiser says, and `entry = signal != signal[1]` is false while
      // either side is na. That is what suppresses the very first flip.
      const exrem = (cond1, cond2) => {
        const up = new Array(n).fill(false)
        const down = new Array(n).fill(false)
        let signal = NaN
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const prev = signal
          const cur = cond1[i] ? 1 : cond2[i] ? -1 : prev
          const entry = Number.isFinite(cur) && Number.isFinite(prev) && cur !== prev
          up[i] = entry && cur === 1
          down[i] = entry && cur === -1
          signal = cur
        }
        return [up, down]
      }

      const flipBreak = exrem(longContBreak, shortContBreak)
      const longFlipBreak = flipBreak[0]
      const shortFlipBreak = flipBreak[1]
      const flipRet = exrem(longContRet, shortContRet)
      const longFlipRet = flipRet[0]
      const shortFlipRet = flipRet[1]

      /* ---- divergences ---- */

      const plRaw = pivotLow(rsiSeries, pLeft, pRight)
      const phRaw = pivotHigh(rsiSeries, pLeft, pRight)
      const plFound = plRaw.map((v) => Number.isFinite(v))
      const phFound = phRaw.map((v) => Number.isFinite(v))

      const rsiLBR = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const lowLBR = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const highLBR = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const pivotBar = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const j = i - pRight
        if (j < 0) continue
        rsiLBR[i] = rsiSeries[j]
        lowLBR[i] = low[j]
        highLBR[i] = high[j]
        pivotBar[i] = j
      }

      // _inRange(cond) works on plFound[1] / phFound[1], the flags shifted one
      // bar, so barssince runs on the shifted series.
      const plShift = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const phShift = new Array(n).fill(false)
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        plShift[i] = plFound[i - 1]
        phShift[i] = phFound[i - 1]
      }
      const plSince = barsSince(plShift)
      const phSince = barsSince(phShift)

      const prevPlRsi = valueWhen(plFound, rsiLBR, 1)
      const prevPlLow = valueWhen(plFound, lowLBR, 1)
      const prevPlBar = valueWhen(plFound, pivotBar, 1)
      const prevPhRsi = valueWhen(phFound, rsiLBR, 1)
      const prevPhHigh = valueWhen(phFound, highLBR, 1)
      const prevPhBar = valueWhen(phFound, pivotBar, 1)

      const isDivergence = method === 'Divergence'
      const isHidden = method === 'Hidden Divergence'

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const rl = rsiLBR[i]
        const inRangePl = Number.isFinite(plSince[i]) && rangeMin <= plSince[i] && plSince[i] <= rangeMax
        const inRangePh = Number.isFinite(phSince[i]) && rangeMin <= phSince[i] && phSince[i] <= rangeMax

        const rsiHL = Number.isFinite(rl) && Number.isFinite(prevPlRsi[i]) && rl > prevPlRsi[i] && inRangePl
        const priceLL =
          Number.isFinite(lowLBR[i]) && Number.isFinite(prevPlLow[i]) && lowLBR[i] < prevPlLow[i]
        const bull = isDivergence && showBull && priceLL && rsiHL && plFound[i]

        const rsiLH = Number.isFinite(rl) && Number.isFinite(prevPhRsi[i]) && rl < prevPhRsi[i] && inRangePh
        const priceHH =
          Number.isFinite(highLBR[i]) && Number.isFinite(prevPhHigh[i]) && highLBR[i] > prevPhHigh[i]
        const bear = isDivergence && showBear && priceHH && rsiLH && phFound[i]

        const rsiLL = Number.isFinite(rl) && Number.isFinite(prevPlRsi[i]) && rl < prevPlRsi[i] && inRangePl
        const priceHL =
          Number.isFinite(lowLBR[i]) && Number.isFinite(prevPlLow[i]) && lowLBR[i] > prevPlLow[i]
        const hiddenBull = isHidden && showHiddenBull && priceHL && rsiLL && plFound[i]

        const rsiHH = Number.isFinite(rl) && Number.isFinite(prevPhRsi[i]) && rl > prevPhRsi[i] && inRangePh
        const priceLH =
          Number.isFinite(highLBR[i]) && Number.isFinite(prevPhHigh[i]) && highLBR[i] < prevPhHigh[i]
        const hiddenBear = isHidden && showHiddenBear && priceLH && rsiHH && phFound[i]

        // The value is the previous pivot's bar index: draws() needs both ends
        // of the connector and a column can only carry numbers.
        if (bull && Number.isFinite(prevPlBar[i])) divBull[i] = prevPlBar[i]
        if (bear && Number.isFinite(prevPhBar[i])) divBear[i] = prevPhBar[i]
        if (hiddenBull && Number.isFinite(prevPlBar[i])) divHBull[i] = prevPlBar[i]
        if (hiddenBear && Number.isFinite(prevPhBar[i])) divHBear[i] = prevPhBar[i]
      }

      /* ---- signal columns, already gated by the scanning method ---- */

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (choiceCont && short1Arr[i]) s1Short[i] = 1
        if (choiceCont && long1Arr[i]) s1Long[i] = 1
        if ((choiceCont && shortContBreak[i]) // (choiceFlip && shortFlipBreak[i])) s2Short[i] = 1
        if ((choiceCont && longContBreak[i]) // (choiceFlip && longFlipBreak[i])) s2Long[i] = 1
        if ((choiceContRet && shortContRet[i]) // (choiceFlipRet && shortFlipRet[i])) s3Short[i] = 1
        if ((choiceContRet && longContRet[i]) // (choiceFlipRet && longFlipRet[i])) s3Long[i] = 1
      }

      return out()
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      if (!showLong && !showShort) return []
      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const time = bars[i].time
        if (showShort) {
          if (values.s1Short[i]) {
            out.push({ time, position: 'aboveBar', shape: 'circle', color: NEG_LIGHT, size: 'small' })
          }
          if (values.s2Short[i]) {
            out.push({
              time,
              position: 'aboveBar',
              shape: 'triangleDown',
              color: NEG_LIGHT,
              text: '2',
              size: 'small',
            })
          }
          if (values.s3Short[i]) {
            out.push({
              time,
              position: 'aboveBar',
              shape: 'triangleDown',
              color: NEG_LIGHT,
              text: '3',
              size: 'small',
            })
          }
        }
        if (showLong) {
          if (values.s1Long[i]) {
            out.push({ time, position: 'belowBar', shape: 'circle', color: POS_LIGHT, size: 'small' })
          }
          if (values.s2Long[i]) {
            out.push({
              time,
              position: 'belowBar',
              shape: 'triangleUp',
              color: POS_LIGHT,
              text: '2',
              size: 'small',
            })
          }
          if (values.s3Long[i]) {
            out.push({
              time,
              position: 'belowBar',
              shape: 'triangleUp',
              color: POS_LIGHT,
              text: '3',
              size: 'small',
            })
          }
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const method = pick(settings.scanMethod, METHODS, 'Continuous Break')
      if (method !== 'Divergence' && method !== 'Hidden Divergence') return []
      const pRight = int(settings.pivotRight, 5, 1)
      const rsiCol = values.rsi
      const specs = [
        { key: 'divBull', color: POS, lineWidth: 2 },
        { key: 'divBear', color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 },
        { key: 'divHBull', color: POS, lineWidth: 1 },
        { key: 'divHBear', color: NEG, lineWidth: 1 },
      ]
      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const to = i - pRight
        if (to < 0) continue
        for (const spec of specs) {
          const from = values[spec.key][i]
          if (!Number.isFinite(from) // from < 0 // from >= bars.length) continue
          const y1 = rsiCol[from]
          const y2 = rsiCol[to]
          if (!Number.isFinite(y1) // !Number.isFinite(y2)) continue
          out.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: bars[from].time, price: y1 },
            to: { time: bars[to].time, price: y2 },
            color: spec.color,
            lineWidth: spec.lineWidth,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    background({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      // color.new(c, 90) is ten percent opaque.
      const negBg = NEG_LIGHT + '1A'
      const posBg = POS_LIGHT + '1A'
      const out = new Array(bars.length).fill(null)
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        // bgcolor is called for the 2nd and then the 3rd signal, and the later
        // call wins on a bar where both fire.
        let c = null
        if (showShort && values.s2Short[i]) c = negBg
        else if (showLong && values.s2Long[i]) c = posBg
        if (showShort && values.s3Short[i]) c = negBg
        else if (showLong && values.s3Long[i]) c = posBg
        out[i] = c
      }
      return out
    },

    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const out = new Array(bars.length).fill(null)
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        // Five barcolor calls in source order, 1st then 2nd then 3rd, and the
        // last non-na one wins.
        let c = null
        if (showShort && values.s1Short[i]) c = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (showLong && values.s1Long[i]) c = POS_LIGHT
        if (showShort && values.s2Short[i]) c = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (showLong && values.s2Long[i]) c = POS_LIGHT
        if (showShort && values.s3Short[i]) c = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (showLong && values.s3Long[i]) c = POS_LIGHT
        out[i] = c
      }
      return out
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.showPerfTable === false) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      if (i < 0) return null

      const pchg = values.cumPchg[i]
      const volPchg = values.cumVolPchg[i]
      const currVol = values.cumVol[i]
      const prevVol = values.prevVol[i]

      const pchgColor = Number.isFinite(pchg) && pchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const volPchgColor = Number.isFinite(volPchg) && volPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const prevVolColor =
        Number.isFinite(prevVol) && Number.isFinite(currVol) && prevVol < currVol ? NEG : POS

      const head = (text) => ({ text, bgColor: NEU_DARK, textColor: NEU, align: 'left' })
      const cell = (text, textColor) => ({ text, bgColor: NEU_DARK, textColor, align: 'right' })
      const lakhs = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? fmt2(v / 100000) + ' L' : 'n/a')

      return {
        rows: [
          [head('%Chg'), cell(fmt2(pchg) + ' %', pchgColor)],
          [head('Vol %Chg'), cell(fmt2(volPchg) + ' %', volPchgColor)],
          [head('Vol'), cell(lakhs(currVol), volPchgColor)],
          [head('PD Vol'), cell(lakhs(prevVol), prevVolColor)],
        ],
        options: { position: pick(settings.perfTablePosition, TABLE_POSITIONS, 'bottom-right | `oa-momentum-setup---rsi-directional-momentum-scanner` | `oa-momentum-setup---rsi-directional-momentum-scanner.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Momentum) |
| Momentum Setup - RSI Directional Momentum Indicator',
    category: 'ICT',
    // The Pine indicator() call carries no overlay argument, so overlay is false
    // and the study owns a pane. The columns the source marks force_overlay
    // ride to the price pane on their own plots below.
    placement: 'pane',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'scanMethod',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Scanning Method',
        default: CONT_BREAK,
        group: 'Scanner',
        options: METHODS.map((m) => ({ label: m, value: m })),
        tooltip:
          'Continuous Break: RSI crosses 60 (40), dips back, then breaks the previous high (low) while holding above 60 (below 40). ' +
          'Continuous Retracement: price returns to the Fibonacci level of the breaking candle and turns. ' +
          'Flip Break and Flip Retracement report only the direction changes. ' +
          'Divergence: price makes a lower low while RSI makes a higher low. ' +
          'Hidden Divergence: price makes a higher low while RSI makes a lower low.',
      },
      { key: 'showLong', type: 'boolean', label: 'Long Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },
      { key: 'showShort', type: 'boolean', label: 'Short Signals', default: true, group: 'Scanner' },

      { key: 'rsiLength', type: 'number', label: 'RSI Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rsiSource', type: 'source', label: 'RSI Source', default: 'close', group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rsiMaLength', type: 'number', label: 'SMA Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      {
        key: 'fibValue',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Fib Value',
        default: 0.5,
        min: 0,
        max: 1,
        step: 0.1,
        group: 'RSI',
        tooltip: '0 is the bottom of a bullish and the top of a bearish breaking candle, 1 the other end, 0.5 its midpoint.',
      },
      { key: 'showBull', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Bullish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'showBear', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Bearish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'showHiddenBull', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Hidden Bullish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'showHiddenBear', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Hidden Bearish Divergence', default: true, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'pivotRight', type: 'number', label: 'Pivot Lookback Right', default: 5, min: 1, max: 200, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'pivotLeft', type: 'number', label: 'Pivot Lookback Left', default: 5, min: 1, max: 200, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rangeMax', type: 'number', label: 'Max of Lookback Range', default: 60, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },
      { key: 'rangeMin', type: 'number', label: 'Min of Lookback Range', default: 5, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'RSI' },

      {
        key: 'pchgFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply % Change Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Percentage change of the day. The source asks for the day to be both above +N and below -N, so switching this on blocks every signal.',
      },
      { key: 'pchgAboveBelow', type: 'number', label: '% Change Above/Below +/-', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'volFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Volume Filter (Day Total)',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Cumulative volume of the running day must clear the level below.',
      },
      { key: 'volAbove', type: 'number', label: 'Volume Above', default: 500000, min: 0, max: 1000000000, step: 1000, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'volPchgFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Volume % Change Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: '0% means the running day volume must exceed the previous day total. 300%+ often marks a major breakout.',
      },
      { key: 'volPchgAbove', type: 'number', label: 'Volume % Change Above', default: 0, min: 0, max: 100000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'atrFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply ATR Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Filters out longer or more volatile signal candles.',
      },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrMulti', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'bodyFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Body % Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: '80 means the body covers 80%+ of the candle.',
      },
      { key: 'bodyPercent', type: 'number', label: 'Body % Above', default: 70, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'bodySizeFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Body Size Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: '2 means the candle is twice the size of the previous one.',
      },
      { key: 'bodySizeMulti', type: 'number', label: 'Body Size Multiplier (x)', default: 2, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'volumeFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Volume Filter (vs SMA)',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Filter candles with volume above the SMA of volume.',
      },
      { key: 'volSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'Volume SMA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'relVolFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Relative Volume Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Filter candles with relative volume above its own average times the multiplier.',
      },
      { key: 'relVolLength', type: 'number', label: 'Relative Volume Length', default: 90, min: 2, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolMulti', type: 'number', label: 'Rel Vol SMA Multiplier', default: 5, min: 0, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'timeFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Time Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Keep signals inside a window of the exchange trading day.',
      },
      { key: 'hourFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (Hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (Minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (Hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (Minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      {
        key: 'dateFilter',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Apply Date Filter',
        default: false,
        group: 'Additional Filters',
        tooltip: 'Keep signals on one calendar date only.',
      },
      { key: 'filterDay', type: 'number', label: 'Day', default: 25, min: 1, max: 31, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'filterMonth', type: 'number', label: 'Month', default: 10, min: 1, max: 12, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'filterYear', type: 'number', label: 'Year', default: 2024, min: 0, max: 2999, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'showTable', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Performance Table' },
      {
        key: 'tablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'bottom-right',
        group: 'Performance Table',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
      },
      {
        key: 'tableSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Size',
        default: 'normal',
        group: 'Performance Table',
        options: [
          { label: 'Auto', value: 'auto' },
          { label: 'Tiny', value: 'tiny' },
          { label: 'Small', value: 'small' },
          { label: 'Normal', value: 'normal' },
          { label: 'Large', value: 'large' },
          { label: 'Huge', value: 'huge' },
        ],
      },
    ],

    plots: [
      { key: 'rsi', type: 'line', title: 'RSI', style: { color: INDICATOR, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'rsiMa', type: 'line', title: 'RSI Moving Average', style: { color: SIGNAL, lineWidth: 1 } },

      // hline(60) and hline(40) are the two ends of the source's middle fill, so
      // they are real plots here; 70, 50 and 30 stay plain levels.
      { key: 'bandBull', type: 'line', title: 'Band Bullish', style: { color: withAlpha(NEU, 0.5), lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },
      { key: 'bandBear', type: 'line', title: 'Band Bearish', style: { color: withAlpha(NEU, 0.5), lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },

      // The divergence legs. Both divergence modes plot the same pivot series
      // and differ only in which leg they colour, so one column carries both.
      {
        key: 'divLowRsi',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Line Bull Div',
        style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 },
        colorBy: ({ index, values }) => (values.divLowFlag[index] ? POS : NO_COLOR),
      },
      {
        key: 'divHighRsi',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Line Bear Div',
        style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 },
        colorBy: ({ index, values }) => (values.divHighFlag[index] ? NEG : NO_COLOR),
      },
      {
        key: 'divLowPrice',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Line Bull Div (Price)',
        overlay: true,
        style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 },
        colorBy: ({ index, values }) => (values.divLowFlag[index] ? POS : NO_COLOR),
      },
      {
        key: 'divHighPrice',
        type: 'line',
        title: 'Line Bear Div (Price)',
        overlay: true,
        style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 },
        colorBy: ({ index, values }) => (values.divHighFlag[index] ? NEG : NO_COLOR),
      },

      // The four line.new(force_overlay = true) guides. Each one is horizontal
      // between two bars, which is one value per bar on the price pane.
      { key: 'breakLineShort', type: 'line', title: 'Short Break Level', overlay: true, style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },
      { key: 'breakLineLong', type: 'line', title: 'Long Break Level', overlay: true, style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },
      { key: 'retLineShort', type: 'line', title: 'Short Retracement Level', overlay: true, style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },
      { key: 'retLineLong', type: 'line', title: 'Long Retracement Level', overlay: true, style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 1, lineStyle: 'dotted' } },
    ],

    fills: [{ between: ['bandBull', 'bandBear'], colorUp: NEU, colorDown: NEU, opacity: 0.05 }],

    levels: () => [
      { price: OVERBOUGHT, title: 'Band Overbought', color: withAlpha(NEG, 0.5), lineStyle: 'dotted' },
      { price: MIDDLE, title: 'Band Middle', color: withAlpha(NEU, 0.5), lineStyle: 'dotted' },
      { price: OVERSOLD, title: 'Band Oversold', color: withAlpha(POS, 0.5), lineStyle: 'dotted' },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const col = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const flagCol = () => new Array(n).fill(false)

      const rsiOut = col()
      const rsiMaOut = col()
      const bandBull = col()
      const bandBear = col()
      const divLowRsi = col()
      const divHighRsi = col()
      const divLowPrice = col()
      const divHighPrice = col()
      const breakLineShort = col()
      const breakLineLong = col()
      const retLineShort = col()
      const retLineLong = col()

      const divLowFlag = flagCol()
      const divHighFlag = flagCol()
      const sigShort1 = flagCol()
      const sigLong1 = flagCol()
      const sigShortBreak = flagCol()
      const sigLongBreak = flagCol()
      const sigShortRet = flagCol()
      const sigLongRet = flagCol()
      const sigShortFlipBreak = flagCol()
      const sigLongFlipBreak = flagCol()
      const sigShortFlipRet = flagCol()
      const sigLongFlipRet = flagCol()

      const cumPchgOut = col()
      const cumVolPchgOut = col()
      const cumVolOut = col()
      const prevVolOut = col()

      const result = () => ({
        rsi: nulls(rsiOut),
        rsiMa: nulls(rsiMaOut),
        bandBull: nulls(bandBull),
        bandBear: nulls(bandBear),
        divLowRsi: nulls(divLowRsi),
        divHighRsi: nulls(divHighRsi),
        divLowPrice: nulls(divLowPrice),
        divHighPrice: nulls(divHighPrice),
        breakLineShort: nulls(breakLineShort),
        breakLineLong: nulls(breakLineLong),
        retLineShort: nulls(retLineShort),
        retLineLong: nulls(retLineLong),
        divLowFlag,
        divHighFlag,
        sigShort1,
        sigLong1,
        sigShortBreak,
        sigLongBreak,
        sigShortRet,
        sigLongRet,
        sigShortFlipBreak,
        sigLongFlipBreak,
        sigShortFlipRet,
        sigLongFlipRet,
        cumPchg: nulls(cumPchgOut),
        cumVolPchg: nulls(cumVolPchgOut),
        cumVol: nulls(cumVolOut),
        prevVol: nulls(prevVolOut),
      })

      if (n === 0) return result()

      const rsiLen = intOr(settings.rsiLength, 14, 1)
      const rsiMaLen = intOr(settings.rsiMaLength, 14, 1)
      const fibVal = numOr(settings.fibValue, 0.5)
      const pLeft = intOr(settings.pivotLeft, 5, 1)
      const pRight = intOr(settings.pivotRight, 5, 1)
      const rangeMax = intOr(settings.rangeMax, 60, 1)
      const rangeMin = intOr(settings.rangeMin, 5, 1)
      const method = scanMethodOf(settings)

      const showBull = settings.showBull !== false
      const showBear = settings.showBear !== false
      const showHiddenBull = settings.showHiddenBull !== false
      const showHiddenBear = settings.showHiddenBear !== false

      const pchgFilter = settings.pchgFilter === true
      const pchgAboveBelow = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.pchgAboveBelow, 2))
      const volFilter = settings.volFilter === true
      const volAbove = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.volAbove, 500000))
      const volPchgFilter = settings.volPchgFilter === true
      const volPchgAbove = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.volPchgAbove, 0))
      const atrFilter = settings.atrFilter === true
      const atrLength = intOr(settings.atrLength, 14, 1)
      const atrMulti = Math.max(1, numOr(settings.atrMulti, 1))
      const bodyFilter = settings.bodyFilter === true
      const bodyPct = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, numOr(settings.bodyPercent, 70))) / 100
      const bodySizeFilter = settings.bodySizeFilter === true
      const bodySizeMulti = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.bodySizeMulti, 2))
      const volumeFilter = settings.volumeFilter === true
      const volSmaLength = intOr(settings.volSmaLength, 20, 1)
      const relVolFilter = settings.relVolFilter === true
      const relVolLength = intOr(settings.relVolLength, 90, 2)
      const relVolMulti = Math.max(0, numOr(settings.relVolMulti, 5))
      const timeFilter = settings.timeFilter === true
      const hourFrom = Math.min(23, intOr(settings.hourFrom, 9, 0))
      const minuteFrom = Math.min(59, intOr(settings.minuteFrom, 15, 0))
      const hourTo = Math.min(23, intOr(settings.hourTo, 10, 0))
      const minuteTo = Math.min(59, intOr(settings.minuteTo, 15, 0))
      const dateFilter = settings.dateFilter === true
      const filterDay = intOr(settings.filterDay, 25, 1)
      const filterMonth = intOr(settings.filterMonth, 10, 1)
      const filterYear = intOr(settings.filterYear, 2024, 0)

      const isDivergence = method === DIVERGENCE
      const isHidden = method === HIDDEN_DIVERGENCE
      const isContLine = method === CONT_BREAK
      const isContRetLine = method === CONT_RET

      // Bar times are UTC seconds and the source reads exchange wall clock
      // (hour, minute, dayofmonth, time('D')), so everything calendar goes
      // through the chart's zone and never the browser's.
      const tz = ctx && typeof ctx.timezone === 'string' && ctx.timezone !== '' ? ctx.timezone : null
      const zone = tz && isValidTimezone(tz) ? tz : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      const highs = new Array(n)
      const lows = new Array(n)
      const closes = new Array(n)
      const vols = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        highs[i] = b.high
        lows[i] = b.low
        closes[i] = b.close
        // A computed or index series carries no volume. Leaving it NaN keeps
        // the volume filters false rather than inventing a number.
        vols[i] = fin(b.volume) ? b.volume : NaN
      }

      const src = sourceValues(bars, settings.rsiSource // 'close')
      const rsiArr = rsi(src, rsiLen)
      const rsiMaArr = sma(rsiArr, rsiMaLen)
      const atrArr = atr(highs, lows, closes, atrLength)
      const volSmaArr = sma(vols, volSmaLength)
      const avgVolArr = sma(vols, relVolLength)

      // relative_volume = volume / nz(average_volume[1], volume): during warmup
      // the fallback makes it exactly 1, not na, and that is what feeds its SMA.
      const relVolArr = col()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const denom = i > 0 && fin(avgVolArr[i - 1]) ? avgVolArr[i - 1] : vols[i]
        relVolArr[i] = fin(vols[i]) && fin(denom) && denom > 0 ? vols[i] / denom : NaN
      }
      const relVolSmaArr = sma(relVolArr, relVolLength)

      const pivotLowArr = pivotLow(rsiArr, pLeft, pRight)
      const pivotHighArr = pivotHigh(rsiArr, pLeft, pRight)

      // barstate.isconfirmed is only ever false for the bar still forming.
      const lastConfirmed = !(ctx && ctx.barState && ctx.barState.isConfirmed === false)

      // Per-day cumulative percentage change and volume: the inputs of both the
      // performance table and the first four filters.
      const parts = new Array(n)
      let prevDayKey = null
      let cumPchg = NaN
      let currCumVol = NaN
      let prevCumVol = NaN
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const p = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
        parts[i] = p
        const dayKey = p.year * 10000 + p.month * 100 + p.day
        // ta.change(time('D')) is na on the first bar, so it is not a new day.
        const isNewDay = i > 0 && dayKey !== prevDayKey
        prevDayKey = dayKey

        const prevClose = i > 0 ? closes[i - 1] : NaN
        const dayPchg =
          i > 0 && fin(prevClose) && prevClose !== 0 && fin(closes[i])
            ? ((closes[i] - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100
            : 0
        cumPchg = isNewDay ? dayPchg : !fin(cumPchg) ? dayPchg : cumPchg + dayPchg
        cumPchgOut[i] = cumPchg

        if (isNewDay) {
          prevCumVol = currCumVol
          currCumVol = vols[i]
        } else {
          currCumVol = !fin(currCumVol) ? vols[i] : currCumVol + vols[i]
        }
