        const prevSafe = fin(prevCumVol) ? prevCumVol : currCumVol
        cumVolOut[i] = currCumVol
        prevVolOut[i] = prevSafe
        cumVolPchgOut[i] =
          fin(currCumVol) && fin(prevSafe) && prevSafe !== 0
            ? ((currCumVol - prevSafe) / prevSafe) * 100
            : NaN
      }

      // State carried across bars, exactly as the source's var declarations do.
      let state = 0
      let short1Low = NaN
      let short1Bar = -1
      let long1High = NaN
      let long1Bar = -1
      let shortSignalHigh = NaN
      let shortSignalLow = NaN
      let shortSignalBar = -1
      let longSignalHigh = NaN
      let longSignalLow = NaN
      let longSignalBar = -1
      let shortActive = false
      let longActive = false
      let shortRetDone = false
      let longRetDone = false
      let shortRetBar = -1
      let shortRetHigh = NaN
      let longRetBar = -1
      let longRetLow = NaN
      let prevShortFib = NaN
      let prevLongFib = NaN
      // exrem() keeps `var int signal`, whose history is na on the first bar, so
      // the very first break can never register as a flip.
      let flipBreakPrev = null
      let flipRetPrev = null
      // Most recent confirmed pivot bar, for valuewhen(..., 1) and barssince.
      let lastPlBar = -1
      let lastPhBar = -1

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const bar = bars[i]
        const r = rsiArr[i]
        const rm = rsiMaArr[i]
        const rPrev = i > 0 ? rsiArr[i - 1] : NaN

        rsiOut[i] = r
        rsiMaOut[i] = rm
        bandBull[i] = BREAKOUT
        bandBear[i] = BREAKDOWN

        /* ---- additional filters -------------------------------------- */
        const range = bar.high - bar.low
        const body = Math.abs(bar.close - bar.open)
        const prevRange = i > 0 ? highs[i - 1] - lows[i - 1] : NaN

        // The source asks for the day to be above +N and below -N at the same
        // time, so enabling this filter blocks every signal. Ported as written.
        const pchgAboveOk = !pchgFilter // (fin(cumPchgOut[i]) && cumPchgOut[i] > pchgAboveBelow)
        const pchgBelowOk = !pchgFilter // (fin(cumPchgOut[i]) && cumPchgOut[i] < -pchgAboveBelow)
        const volOk = !volFilter // (fin(cumVolOut[i]) && cumVolOut[i] >= volAbove)
        const volPchgOk = !volPchgFilter // (fin(cumVolPchgOut[i]) && cumVolPchgOut[i] >= volPchgAbove)
        const atrOk = !atrFilter // (fin(atrArr[i]) && range > atrArr[i] * atrMulti)
        const bodyOk = !bodyFilter // (range > 0 && body / range >= bodyPct)
        const bodySizeOk =
          !bodySizeFilter //
          (range > 0 && body / range >= bodyPct && fin(prevRange) && range >= prevRange * bodySizeMulti)
        const volumeOk = !volumeFilter // (fin(vols[i]) && fin(volSmaArr[i]) && vols[i] > volSmaArr[i])
        const relVolOk =
          !relVolFilter //
          (fin(relVolArr[i]) && fin(relVolSmaArr[i]) && relVolArr[i] > relVolSmaArr[i] * relVolMulti)
        const hour = parts[i].hour
        const minute = parts[i].minute
        const timeOk =
          !timeFilter //
          ((hour > hourFrom // (hour === hourFrom && minute >= minuteFrom)) &&
            (hour < hourTo // (hour === hourTo && minute < minuteTo)))
        const dateOk =
          !dateFilter //
          (parts[i].year === filterYear && parts[i].month === filterMonth && parts[i].day === filterDay)
        const filtersOk =
          pchgAboveOk &&
          pchgBelowOk &&
          volOk &&
          volPchgOk &&
          atrOk &&
          bodyOk &&
          bodySizeOk &&
          volumeOk &&
          relVolOk &&
          timeOk &&
          dateOk
        const confirmed = i < n - 1 // lastConfirmed

        /* ---- the state machine --------------------------------------- */
        // state := nz(state[1]) == 3 or nz(state[1]) == 6 ? 0 : nz(state[1])
        if (state === 3 // state === 6) state = 0

        const crossUnderBreakdown = fin(r) && fin(rPrev) && r < BREAKDOWN && rPrev >= BREAKDOWN
        const crossOverBreakout = fin(r) && fin(rPrev) && r > BREAKOUT && rPrev <= BREAKOUT

        const short1 =
          crossUnderBreakdown && fin(rm) && r < rm && (state === 0 // (state >= 4 && state <= 5))
        if (short1) {
          short1Low = bar.low
          short1Bar = i
        }
        const short2 = fin(r) && r > BREAKDOWN
        const short3 =
          fin(short1Low) &&
          fin(r) &&
          r < BREAKDOWN &&
          fin(rm) &&
          r < rm &&
          bar.close < short1Low &&
          filtersOk &&
          confirmed

        const long1 =
          crossOverBreakout && fin(rm) && r > rm && (state === 0 // (state >= 1 && state <= 2))
        if (long1) {
          long1High = bar.high
          long1Bar = i
        }
        const long2 = fin(r) && r < BREAKOUT
        const long3 =
          fin(long1High) &&
          fin(r) &&
          r > BREAKOUT &&
          fin(rm) &&
          r > rm &&
          bar.close > long1High &&
          filtersOk &&
          confirmed

        if (short1) state = 1
        else if (short2 && state === 1) state = 2
        else if (short3 && state === 2) state = 3
        else if (long1) state = 4
        else if (long2 && state === 4) state = 5
        else if (long3 && state === 5) state = 6

        const shortContBreak = state === 3
        const longContBreak = state === 6

        sigShort1[i] = short1
        sigLong1[i] = long1
        sigShortBreak[i] = shortContBreak
        sigLongBreak[i] = longContBreak

        /* ---- continuous retracement ---------------------------------- */
        if (shortContBreak) {
          shortSignalHigh = bar.high
          shortSignalLow = bar.low
          shortSignalBar = i
        }
        if (longContBreak) {
          longSignalHigh = bar.high
          longSignalLow = bar.low
          longSignalBar = i
        }
        const shortFib =
          fin(shortSignalHigh) && fin(shortSignalLow)
            ? shortSignalHigh - (shortSignalHigh - shortSignalLow) * fibVal
            : NaN
        const longFib =
          fin(longSignalHigh) && fin(longSignalLow)
            ? longSignalLow + (longSignalHigh - longSignalLow) * fibVal
            : NaN

        if (shortContBreak) {
          shortActive = true
          longActive = false
          shortRetDone = false
          longRetDone = false
        }
        if (longContBreak) {
          longActive = true
          shortActive = false
          longRetDone = false
          shortRetDone = false
        }

        const prevHigh = i > 0 ? highs[i - 1] : NaN
        const prevLow = i > 0 ? lows[i - 1] : NaN
        // ta.crossover(high, short_fib_val) compares against the PREVIOUS bar's
        // fib level; the source then adds high[1] < the current one.
        const shortContRet =
          shortActive &&
          !shortRetDone &&
          fin(shortFib) &&
          fin(prevShortFib) &&
          fin(prevHigh) &&
          bar.high > shortFib &&
          prevHigh <= prevShortFib &&
          prevHigh < shortFib
        const longContRet =
          longActive &&
          !longRetDone &&
          fin(longFib) &&
          fin(prevLongFib) &&
          fin(prevLow) &&
          bar.low < longFib &&
          prevLow >= prevLongFib &&
          prevLow > longFib

        if (shortContRet) {
          shortRetDone = true
          shortRetBar = i
          shortRetHigh = bar.high
        }
        if (longContRet) {
          longRetDone = true
          longRetBar = i
          longRetLow = bar.low
        }
        sigShortRet[i] = shortContRet
        sigLongRet[i] = longContRet

        /* ---- flip signals (exrem) ------------------------------------ */
        const fbNow = longContBreak ? 1 : shortContBreak ? -1 : flipBreakPrev
        const fbEntry = fbNow !== null && flipBreakPrev !== null && fbNow !== flipBreakPrev
        sigLongFlipBreak[i] = fbEntry && fbNow === 1
        sigShortFlipBreak[i] = fbEntry && fbNow === -1
        flipBreakPrev = fbNow

        const frNow = longContRet ? 1 : shortContRet ? -1 : flipRetPrev
        const frEntry = frNow !== null && flipRetPrev !== null && frNow !== flipRetPrev
        sigLongFlipRet[i] = frEntry && frNow === 1
        sigShortFlipRet[i] = frEntry && frNow === -1
        flipRetPrev = frNow

        /* ---- the drawn guide lines ----------------------------------- */
        if (shortContBreak && isContLine && fin(short1Low) && short1Bar >= 0 && shortSignalBar >= 0) {
          for (let k = short1Bar; k <= shortSignalBar; k++) breakLineShort[k] = short1Low
        }
        if (longContBreak && isContLine && fin(long1High) && long1Bar >= 0 && longSignalBar >= 0) {
          for (let k = long1Bar; k <= longSignalBar; k++) breakLineLong[k] = long1High
        }
        if (
          shortContRet &&
          isContRetLine &&
          fin(shortFib) &&
          fin(shortRetHigh) &&
          shortSignalBar >= 0 &&
          shortRetBar >= 0
        ) {
          for (let k = shortSignalBar; k <= shortRetBar; k++) retLineShort[k] = shortFib
        }
        if (
          longContRet &&
          isContRetLine &&
          fin(longFib) &&
          fin(longRetLow) &&
          longSignalBar >= 0 &&
          longRetBar >= 0
        ) {
          for (let k = longSignalBar; k <= longRetBar; k++) retLineLong[k] = longFib
        }

        prevShortFib = shortFib
        prevLongFib = longFib

        /* ---- divergence ---------------------------------------------- */
        const plFound = fin(pivotLowArr[i])
        const phFound = fin(pivotHighArr[i])
        const lbr = i - pRight
        const rsiLBR = lbr >= 0 ? rsiArr[lbr] : NaN
        const lowLBR = lbr >= 0 ? lows[lbr] : NaN
        const highLBR = lbr >= 0 ? highs[lbr] : NaN

        // _inRange(plFound[1]) is barssince of the shifted flag, which is the
        // gap back to the previous pivot less one bar.
        const plGap = lastPlBar >= 0 ? i - lastPlBar - 1 : NaN
        const phGap = lastPhBar >= 0 ? i - lastPhBar - 1 : NaN
        const plInRange = fin(plGap) && plGap >= rangeMin && plGap <= rangeMax
        const phInRange = fin(phGap) && phGap >= rangeMin && phGap <= rangeMax
        // ta.valuewhen(plFound, x, 1): the value carried at the previous pivot.
        const prevPlIdx = lastPlBar - pRight
        const prevPhIdx = lastPhBar - pRight
        const prevPlRsi = lastPlBar >= 0 && prevPlIdx >= 0 ? rsiArr[prevPlIdx] : NaN
        const prevPlLow = lastPlBar >= 0 && prevPlIdx >= 0 ? lows[prevPlIdx] : NaN
        const prevPhRsi = lastPhBar >= 0 && prevPhIdx >= 0 ? rsiArr[prevPhIdx] : NaN
        const prevPhHigh = lastPhBar >= 0 && prevPhIdx >= 0 ? highs[prevPhIdx] : NaN

        const rsiHL = fin(rsiLBR) && fin(prevPlRsi) && rsiLBR > prevPlRsi && plInRange
        const priceLL = fin(lowLBR) && fin(prevPlLow) && lowLBR < prevPlLow
        const bullDiv = isDivergence && showBull && priceLL && rsiHL && plFound

        const rsiLH = fin(rsiLBR) && fin(prevPhRsi) && rsiLBR < prevPhRsi && phInRange
        const priceHH = fin(highLBR) && fin(prevPhHigh) && highLBR > prevPhHigh
        const bearDiv = isDivergence && showBear && priceHH && rsiLH && phFound

        const rsiLL = fin(rsiLBR) && fin(prevPlRsi) && rsiLBR < prevPlRsi && plInRange
        const priceHL = fin(lowLBR) && fin(prevPlLow) && lowLBR > prevPlLow
        const hiddenBullDiv = isHidden && showHiddenBull && priceHL && rsiLL && plFound

        const rsiHH = fin(rsiLBR) && fin(prevPhRsi) && rsiLBR > prevPhRsi && phInRange
        const priceLH = fin(highLBR) && fin(prevPhHigh) && highLBR < prevPhHigh
        const hiddenBearDiv = isHidden && showHiddenBear && priceLH && rsiHH && phFound

        // offset = -i_rsi_p_right draws the point back on the pivot bar itself.
        if (lbr >= 0 && (isDivergence // isHidden)) {
          if (plFound) {
            divLowRsi[lbr] = rsiLBR
            divLowPrice[lbr] = lowLBR
            divLowFlag[lbr] = bullDiv // hiddenBullDiv
          }
          if (phFound) {
            divHighRsi[lbr] = rsiLBR
            divHighPrice[lbr] = highLBR
            divHighFlag[lbr] = bearDiv // hiddenBearDiv
          }
        }

        if (plFound) lastPlBar = i
        if (phFound) lastPhBar = i
      }

      return result()
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const method = scanMethodOf(settings)
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const isCont = method === CONT_BREAK // method === CONT_RET
      const isContRet = method === CONT_RET
      const isFlip = method === FLIP_BREAK
      const isFlipRet = method === FLIP_RET
      const out = []
      if (!isCont && !isFlip && !isFlipRet) return out

      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const time = bars[i].time
        if (isCont && showShort && values.sigShort1[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'aboveBar', shape: 'circle', color: NEG_LIGHT, size: 'small' })
        }
        if (isCont && showLong && values.sigLong1[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'belowBar', shape: 'circle', color: POS_LIGHT, size: 'small' })
        }
        if (isCont && showShort && values.sigShortBreak[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'aboveBar', shape: 'triangleDown', color: NEG_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '2' })
        }
        if (isCont && showLong && values.sigLongBreak[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'belowBar', shape: 'triangleUp', color: POS_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '2' })
        }
        if (isContRet && showShort && values.sigShortRet[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'aboveBar', shape: 'triangleDown', color: NEG_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '3' })
        }
        if (isContRet && showLong && values.sigLongRet[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'belowBar', shape: 'triangleUp', color: POS_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '3' })
        }
        if (isFlip && showShort && values.sigShortFlipBreak[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'aboveBar', shape: 'triangleDown', color: NEG_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '2' })
        }
        if (isFlip && showLong && values.sigLongFlipBreak[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'belowBar', shape: 'triangleUp', color: POS_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '2' })
        }
        if (isFlipRet && showShort && values.sigShortFlipRet[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'aboveBar', shape: 'triangleDown', color: NEG_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '3' })
        }
        if (isFlipRet && showLong && values.sigLongFlipRet[i]) {
          out.push({ time, position: 'belowBar', shape: 'triangleUp', color: POS_LIGHT, size: 'small', text: '3' })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // bgcolor(), one entry per bar. The source paints a later call over an
    // earlier one, so the retracement and flip shades win where they overlap.
    background({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const method = scanMethodOf(settings)
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const isCont = method === CONT_BREAK // method === CONT_RET
      const isContRet = method === CONT_RET
      const isFlip = method === FLIP_BREAK
      const isFlipRet = method === FLIP_RET
      const shortShade = withAlpha(NEG_LIGHT, 0.1)
      const longShade = withAlpha(POS_LIGHT, 0.1)

      const out = new Array(bars.length).fill(null)
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        if (isFlipRet && showShort && values.sigShortFlipRet[i]) out[i] = shortShade
        else if (isFlipRet && showLong && values.sigLongFlipRet[i]) out[i] = longShade
        else if (isFlip && showShort && values.sigShortFlipBreak[i]) out[i] = shortShade
        else if (isFlip && showLong && values.sigLongFlipBreak[i]) out[i] = longShade
        else if (isContRet && showShort && values.sigShortRet[i]) out[i] = shortShade
        else if (isContRet && showLong && values.sigLongRet[i]) out[i] = longShade
        else if (isCont && showShort && values.sigShortBreak[i]) out[i] = shortShade
        else if (isCont && showLong && values.sigLongBreak[i]) out[i] = longShade
      }
      return out
    },

    // barcolor(), which repaints the price candles themselves.
    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const method = scanMethodOf(settings)
      const showLong = settings.showLong !== false
      const showShort = settings.showShort !== false
      const isCont = method === CONT_BREAK // method === CONT_RET
      const isContRet = method === CONT_RET
      const isFlip = method === FLIP_BREAK
      const isFlipRet = method === FLIP_RET

      const out = new Array(bars.length).fill(null)
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        if (isFlipRet && showShort && values.sigShortFlipRet[i]) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (isFlipRet && showLong && values.sigLongFlipRet[i]) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
        else if (isFlip && showShort && values.sigShortFlipBreak[i]) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (isFlip && showLong && values.sigLongFlipBreak[i]) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
        else if (isContRet && showShort && values.sigShortRet[i]) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (isContRet && showLong && values.sigLongRet[i]) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
        else if (isCont && showShort && values.sigShortBreak[i]) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (isCont && showLong && values.sigLongBreak[i]) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
        else if (isCont && showShort && values.sigShort1[i]) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (isCont && showLong && values.sigLong1[i]) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
      }
      return out
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.showTable === false // bars.length === 0) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const cumPchg = values.cumPchg[i]
      const cumVolPchg = values.cumVolPchg[i]
      const cumVol = values.cumVol[i]
      const prevVol = values.prevVol[i]

      const pchgCol = fin(cumPchg) && cumPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const volPchgCol = fin(cumVolPchg) && cumVolPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const prevVolCol = fin(prevVol) && fin(cumVol) && prevVol < cumVol ? NEG : POS

      const label = (text) => ({ text, bgColor: NEU_DARK, textColor: NEU, align: 'left' })
      const value = (text, textColor) => ({ text, bgColor: NEU_DARK, textColor, align: 'right' })
      const lakh = (v) => (fin(v) ? fmt2(v / 100000) + ' L' : 'n/a')

      return {
        rows: [
          [label('%Chg'), value(fmt2(cumPchg) + ' %', pchgCol)],
          [label('Vol %Chg'), value(fmt2(cumVolPchg) + ' %', volPchgCol)],
          [label('Vol'), value(lakh(cumVol), volPchgCol)],
          [label('PD Vol'), value(lakh(prevVol), prevVolCol)],
        ],
        options: {
          position: TABLE_POSITIONS.includes(settings.tablePosition)
            ? settings.tablePosition
            : 'bottom-right | `oa-momentum-setup---rsi-directional-momentum` | `oa-momentum-setup---rsi-directional-momentum.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Momentum) |
| Momentum Setup: Vijay Thakare Option Buying Scalping Setup Scanner',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'sigMethod',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Signal Method',
        default: 'Continuous Signals',
        options: [
          { label: 'Continuous Signals', value: 'Continuous Signals' },
          { label: 'Flip Signals', value: 'Flip Signals' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Continuous arms on an opposing MACD sign and fires on the full entry condition. Flip reports only the bar where the long and short states change hands.',
        group: 'Signals',
      },

      { key: 'stAtrPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 10, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stFactor', type: 'number', label: 'Factor', default: 3, min: 0.01, max: 100, step: 0.01, group: 'Supertrend' },

      { key: 'maDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Exponential Moving Average' },
      { key: 'maLen1', type: 'number', label: 'Length 1', default: 20, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average' },
      { key: 'maLen2', type: 'number', label: 'Length 2', default: 50, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average' },
      { key: 'maLen3', type: 'number', label: 'Length 3', default: 100, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average' },
      { key: 'maLen4', type: 'number', label: 'Length 4', default: 200, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average' },

      { key: 'vtwapDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'VWAP / TWAP' },
      {
        key: 'vtwapChoice',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Choose',
        default: 'VWAP',
        options: [
          { label: 'VWAP', value: 'VWAP' },
          { label: 'TWAP', value: 'TWAP' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Choose TWAP if volume is not available for the symbol.',
        group: 'VWAP / TWAP',
      },
      {
        key: 'vtwapTimeframe',
        type: 'text',
        label: 'Anchor Timeframe',
        default: '1D',
        tooltip: 'Anchor period in Pine notation: a bare number is minutes, 1D is daily, 1W weekly, 1M monthly, 3M quarterly, 12M yearly.',
        group: 'VWAP / TWAP',
      },

      { key: 'macdDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdFast', type: 'number', label: 'Fast Length', default: 3, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdSlow', type: 'number', label: 'Slow Length', default: 9, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdSignalLen', type: 'number', label: 'Signal Smoothing', default: 15, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 0.5, min: -20, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.7, min: -20, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'MACD' },

      { key: 'stocDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocKLen', type: 'number', label: '%K Length', default: 5, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocKSmooth', type: 'number', label: '%K Smoothing', default: 3, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocDSmooth', type: 'number', label: '%D Smoothing', default: 3, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocOverBought', type: 'number', label: 'Over Bought', default: 60, min: 1, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocOverSold', type: 'number', label: 'Over Sold', default: 40, min: 1, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 1.8, min: -20, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.6, min: -20, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Stochastic' },

      { key: 'volDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Volume Average', default: true, group: 'Volume' },
      {
        key: 'volType',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Type',
        default: 'Regular Volume',
        options: [
          { label: 'Buying/Selling Volume', value: 'Buying/Selling Volume' },
          { label: 'Regular Volume', value: 'Regular Volume' },
          { label: 'None', value: 'None' },
        ],
        group: 'Volume',
      },
      { key: 'volVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 0.5, min: -20, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Volume' },
      { key: 'volHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.6, min: -20, max: 20, step: 0.1, group: 'Volume' },

      { key: 'atrFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply ATR Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'ATR helps filter out longer or more volatile signal candles.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrMulti', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.1, tooltip: 'A higher multiplier filters out a longer or more volatile signal candle.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body % Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'If the input is 80, the body must cover over 80 percent of the candle.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyPercent', type: 'number', label: 'Body % Above', default: 80, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body Size Filter', default: false, tooltip: '2 means the candle is 2 times larger than the previous candle.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'Body Size Multiplier (x)', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volumeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Keep a candle only when its volume is greater than the SMA of volume.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'Volume SMA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Relative Volume Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Keep a candle only when its relative volume is greater than the multiplied average.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolLen', type: 'number', label: 'Relative Volume Length', default: 90, min: 2, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolMulti', type: 'number', label: 'Rel Vol SMA Multiplier', default: 2, min: 0, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'timeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Time Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Keep signals only between the two exchange times below.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'displayLen', type: 'number', label: 'Display Length', default: 50, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1, tooltip: 'How many recent bars the MACD, Stochastic and Volume mini panels cover.', group: 'Chart Settings' },
    ],

    plots: [
      { key: 'ema1', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 1', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'ema2', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 2', style: { color: IND, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'ema3', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 3', style: { color: SIG, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'ema4', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 4', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'vtwap', type: 'line', title: 'VWAP/TWAP', style: { color: NEU, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stUp', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Up', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stDown', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Down', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const s = readSettings(settings)
      const blank = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      const out = {
        ema1: blank(), ema2: blank(), ema3: blank(), ema4: blank(),
        vtwap: blank(), stUp: blank(), stDown: blank(),
        stocK: blank(), stocD: blank(),
        macd: blank(), macdSignal: blank(), macdHist: blank(),
        volMa: blank(), sellVol: blank(),
        longSignal: new Array(n).fill(0), shortSignal: new Array(n).fill(0),
      }
      if (n === 0) return out

      const zoneRaw = ctx && ctx.timezone
      const zone = typeof zoneRaw === 'string' && isValidTimezone(zoneRaw) ? zoneRaw : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      const closeArr = bars.map((b) => Number(b.close))
      const highArr = bars.map((b) => Number(b.high))
      const lowArr = bars.map((b) => Number(b.low))
      const openArr = bars.map((b) => Number(b.open))
      // Index series carry no volume, so nz(volume) is the only safe read.
      const volArr = bars.map((b) => (Number.isFinite(Number(b.volume)) ? Number(b.volume) : 0))
      const hlc3 = sourceValues(bars, 'hlc3')
      const ohlc4 = sourceValues(bars, 'ohlc4')

      /* -- 1. EMA 20, 50, 100, 200 ---------------------------------------- */
      const ema1 = smaSeededEma(closeArr, s.maLen1)
      const ema2 = smaSeededEma(closeArr, s.maLen2)
      const ema3 = smaSeededEma(closeArr, s.maLen3)
      const ema4 = smaSeededEma(closeArr, s.maLen4)

      /* -- 2. VWAP / TWAP, anchored --------------------------------------- */
      const flags = anchorFlags(bars.map((b) => b.time), parseAnchor(s.vtwapTimeframe), zone)
      const vtwapCol = blank()
      let pv = 0
      let vv = 0
      let psum = 0
      let pcount = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (flags[i]) {
          pv = 0
          vv = 0
          psum = 0
          pcount = 0
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(hlc3[i])) {
          pv += hlc3[i] * volArr[i]
          vv += volArr[i]
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(ohlc4[i])) {
          psum += ohlc4[i]
          pcount += 1
        }
        if (s.vtwapChoice === 'TWAP') vtwapCol[i] = pcount > 0 ? psum / pcount : NaN
        else vtwapCol[i] = vv > 0 ? pv / vv : NaN
      }

      /* -- 3. MACD --------------------------------------------------------- */
      const macdFastMa = smaSeededEma(closeArr, s.macdFast)
      const macdSlowMa = smaSeededEma(closeArr, s.macdSlow)
      const macdLine = blank()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (Number.isFinite(macdFastMa[i]) && Number.isFinite(macdSlowMa[i])) {
          macdLine[i] = macdFastMa[i] - macdSlowMa[i]
        }
      }
      const signalLine = pineEma(macdLine, s.macdSignalLen)
      const histLine = blank()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (Number.isFinite(macdLine[i]) && Number.isFinite(signalLine[i])) {
          histLine[i] = macdLine[i] - signalLine[i]
        }
      }

      /* -- 4. Stochastic --------------------------------------------------- */
      const stocK = sma(stoch(closeArr, highArr, lowArr, s.stocKLen), s.stocKSmooth)
      const stocD = sma(stocK, s.stocDSmooth)

      /* -- 5. Volume average and the selling half of the split ------------- */
      const volMa = sma(volArr, s.volSmaLength)
      const sellVol = blank()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const range = highArr[i] - lowArr[i]
        if (Number.isFinite(range) && range > 0) {
          sellVol[i] = (volArr[i] * (highArr[i] - closeArr[i])) / range
        }
      }

      /* -- 6. Supertrend --------------------------------------------------- */
      const st = supertrend(bars, s.stAtrPeriod, s.stFactor)
      const stVal = blank()
      const stDir = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const row = st[i] // {}
        // The source forces the first bar to na.
        stVal[i] = i === 0 ? NaN : Number(row.value)
        stDir[i] = Number(row.direction)
      }

      /* -- Additional filters ---------------------------------------------- */
      const atrCol = atr(highArr, lowArr, closeArr, s.atrLength)
      const volSmaFilterCol = sma(volArr, s.volSmaLength)
      const avgVol = sma(volArr, s.relVolLen)
      const relVol = blank()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const prev = i > 0 ? avgVol[i - 1] : NaN
        if (Number.isFinite(prev) && prev !== 0) relVol[i] = volArr[i] / prev
      }
      const relVolSma = sma(relVol, s.relVolLen)

      // barstate.isconfirmed: every historical bar is confirmed; only a bar
      // still forming under a live feed is not.
      const barState = (ctx && ctx.barState) // {}
      const lastForming = barState.isRealtime === true && barState.isConfirmed === false

      /* -- Entry conditions and the two signal state machines -------------- */
      const longTrigger = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const shortTrigger = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const longFlip = new Array(n).fill(false)
      const shortFlip = new Array(n).fill(false)

      let bearState = 0
      let bullState = 0
      // Pine's `var entry_signal = 0`; a flip is only reported when the state
      // actually differs from the previous bar, so bar 0 never reports one.
      let entrySignal = 0

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const hi = highArr[i]
        const lo = lowArr[i]
        const cl = closeArr[i]
        const op = openArr[i]
        const range = hi - lo
        const body = Math.abs(cl - op)

        let atrPass = true
        if (s.atrFilterOn) atrPass = gt(range, atrCol[i] * s.atrMulti)

        // A zero range makes the source's body ratio 0/0, which is na, so false.
        const bodyRatioPass = Number.isFinite(range) && range > 0 && body / range >= s.bodyPercent
        let bodyPass = true
        if (s.bodyFilterOn) bodyPass = bodyRatioPass

        let bodySizePass = true
        if (s.bodySizeFilterOn) {
          // The source reuses the body percent here rather than its own input.
          const prevRange = i > 0 ? highArr[i - 1] - lowArr[i - 1] : NaN
          bodySizePass = bodyRatioPass
            && Number.isFinite(prevRange)
            && range >= prevRange * s.bodySizeMultiplier
        }

        let volPass = true
        if (s.volumeFilterOn) volPass = gt(volArr[i], volSmaFilterCol[i])

        let relVolPass = true
        if (s.relVolFilterOn) relVolPass = gt(relVol[i], relVolSma[i] * s.relVolMulti)

        let timePass = true
        if (s.timeFilterOn) {
          const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
          const hh = parts.hour
          const mm = parts.minute
          timePass = (hh > s.hourFrom // (hh === s.hourFrom && mm >= s.minuteFrom))
            && (hh < s.hourTo // (hh === s.hourTo && mm < s.minuteTo))
        }

        const confirmed = i < n - 1 // !lastForming
        const filtersPass = atrPass && bodyPass && bodySizePass && volPass && relVolPass && timePass && confirmed

        const shortCont1 = gt(macdLine[i], 0)
        const shortCont2 = lt(cl, stVal[i])
          && lt(cl, vtwapCol[i])
          && lt(stocK[i], s.stocOverBought)
          && lt(stocK[i], stocD[i])
          && lt(macdLine[i], 0)
          && lt(macdLine[i], signalLine[i])
          && lt(macdLine[i], histLine[i])
          && filtersPass

        const longCont1 = lt(macdLine[i], 0)
        const longCont2 = gt(cl, stVal[i])
          && gt(cl, vtwapCol[i])
          && gt(stocK[i], s.stocOverSold)
          && gt(stocK[i], stocD[i])
          && gt(macdLine[i], 0)
          && gt(macdLine[i], signalLine[i])
          && gt(macdLine[i], histLine[i])
          && filtersPass

        // Continuous: arm on the opposing MACD sign, fire on the full entry,
        // then fall straight back to unarmed on the next bar.
        let bear = bearState === 2 ? 0 : bearState
        if (shortCont1 && bear === 0) bear = 1
        if (shortCont2 && bear === 1) bear = 2
        bearState = bear
        shortTrigger[i] = bear === 2

        let bull = bullState === 2 ? 0 : bullState
        if (longCont1 && bull === 0) bull = 1
        if (longCont2 && bull === 1) bull = 2
        bullState = bull
        longTrigger[i] = bull === 2

        // Flip: the exrem idiom, one signal per change of side.
        const prevEntry = entrySignal
        const nextEntry = longCont2 ? 1 : shortCont2 ? -1 : prevEntry
        const changed = i > 0 && nextEntry !== prevEntry
        longFlip[i] = changed && nextEntry === 1
        shortFlip[i] = changed && nextEntry === -1
        entrySignal = nextEntry
      }

      const useFlip = s.sigMethod === 'Flip Signals'
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        out.longSignal[i] = (useFlip ? longFlip[i] : longTrigger[i]) ? 1 : 0
        out.shortSignal[i] = (useFlip ? shortFlip[i] : shortTrigger[i]) ? 1 : 0
      }

      /* -- Plot columns ---------------------------------------------------- */
      const upCol = blank()
      const downCol = blank()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        // plot.style_linebr: the side that is not active is na, which breaks
        // the line rather than joining it across the flip.
        if (stDir[i] < 0) upCol[i] = stVal[i]
        else downCol[i] = stVal[i]
      }

      out.ema1 = nulls(s.maDisplay ? ema1 : blank())
      out.ema2 = nulls(s.maDisplay ? ema2 : blank())
      out.ema3 = nulls(s.maDisplay ? ema3 : blank())
      out.ema4 = nulls(s.maDisplay ? ema4 : blank())
      out.vtwap = nulls(s.vtwapDisplay ? vtwapCol : blank())
      out.stUp = nulls(upCol)
      out.stDown = nulls(downCol)
      out.stocK = nulls(stocK)
      out.stocD = nulls(stocD)
      out.macd = nulls(macdLine)
      out.macdSignal = nulls(signalLine)
      out.macdHist = nulls(histLine)
      out.volMa = nulls(volMa)
      out.sellVol = nulls(sellVol)
      return out
    },

    /* plotshape(style = shape.triangleup / triangledown, location = belowbar / abovebar) */
    markers({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      let sumRange = 0
      let count = 0
      for (const b of bars) {
        const r = Number(b.high) - Number(b.low)
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          sumRange += r
          count += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = count > 0 ? sumRange / count : 0
      const lastClose = Number(bars[n - 1].close)
      // aboveBar and belowBar would pin to this indicator's own line rather
      // than to the candle, so the marker is priced explicitly with a pad
      // scaled to the instrument.
      const pad = Math.max(
        meanRange * 0.5,
        Math.abs(Number.isFinite(lastClose) ? lastClose : 0) * 0.0005,
        1e-8
      )

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (values.shortSignal[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: Number(bars[i].high) + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
            size: 'tiny',
          })
        }
        if (values.longSignal[i] === 1) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: Number(bars[i].low) - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            color: POS_LIGHT,
            size: 'tiny',
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    /* bgcolor(..., show_last = i_display_len) */
    background({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const s = readSettings(settings)
      const out = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const from = Math.max(0, n - s.displayLen)
      for (let i = from; i < n; i++) {
        if (values.shortSignal[i] === 1) out[i] = withAlpha(NEG_LIGHT, 0.1)
        else if (values.longSignal[i] === 1) out[i] = withAlpha(POS_LIGHT, 0.1)
      }
      return out
    },

    /* barcolor() */
    barColors({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const out = new Array(n).fill(null)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (values.shortSignal[i] === 1) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (values.longSignal[i] === 1) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
      }
      return out
    },

    /**
     * The source's "Overlay Charts" section: MACD, Stochastic and Volume
     * redrawn as scaled mini panels across the last `displayLen` bars of the
     * price pane, built there from line.new and box.new.
     *
     * The curves are polylines rather than one line object per bar segment:
     * the geometry is identical, and the source's own 500-object cap existed
     * only because Pine counts drawing objects.
     *
     * A zero-width box with a border is a vertical stroke, so the MACD
     * histogram and the volume bars are drawn as vertical lines.
     */
    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const s = readSettings(settings)
      const len = s.displayLen
      // ta.highest and ta.lowest over `len` bars are na until `len` bars
      // exist, and the panel's left edge is bar_index[len], so it needs one
      // bar more than that.
      if (n < len + 1) return []
      const last = n - 1
      const first = last - len
      // The source's two loops do not cover the same bars. Its curves join
      // bar_index[barIndex] to bar_index[barIndex + 1] for barIndex 0..len-1,
      // so they reach back to bar_index[len], which is `first`. Its per-bar
      // boxes sit on bar_index[barIndex] alone, so they stop at
      // bar_index[len - 1], one bar later. `firstBox` is that bar.
      const firstBox = first + 1

      const finite = (v) => Number.isFinite(v)
      const out = []
      const pushLine = (t1, p1, t2, p2, color, width) => {
        if (!finite(p1) // !finite(p2)) return
        out.push({
          kind: 'line',
          from: { time: t1, price: p1 },
          to: { time: t2, price: p2 },
          color,
          lineWidth: width,
        })
      }
      const pushPolyline = (points, color, width) => {
        if (points.length < 2) return
        out.push({ kind: 'polyline', points, color, lineWidth: width })
      }

      let priceHighest = -Infinity
      let priceLowest = Infinity
      let volumeHighest = 0
      let macdHi = -Infinity
      let macdLo = Infinity
      for (let i = last - len + 1; i <= last; i++) {
        const h = Number(bars[i].high)
        const l = Number(bars[i].low)
        if (finite(h) && h > priceHighest) priceHighest = h
        if (finite(l) && l < priceLowest) priceLowest = l
        const v = Number(bars[i].volume)
        if (finite(v) && v > volumeHighest) volumeHighest = v
        const m = values.macd[i]
        if (finite(m)) {
          if (m > macdHi) macdHi = m
          if (m < macdLo) macdLo = m
        }
      }
      if (!finite(priceHighest) // !finite(priceLowest) // priceHighest === 0) return []

      const priceChangeRate = (priceHighest - priceLowest) / priceHighest
      const oscHighest = 100
      const macdHighest = finite(macdHi) && finite(macdLo) ? macdHi - macdLo : NaN

      const timeAt = (i) => bars[i].time

      /* -- Stochastic panel ------------------------------------------------ */
      const stocBase = priceLowest * (1 - priceChangeRate * s.stocVOffset)
      const stocY = (v) => (finite(v)
        ? stocBase * (1 + (v / oscHighest) * priceChangeRate * s.stocHeight)
        : NaN)

      if (s.stocDisplay) {
        const midLine = (100 + 0) / 2
        pushLine(timeAt(first), stocY(s.stocOverBought), timeAt(last), stocY(s.stocOverBought), withAlpha(NEG, 0.25), 1)
        pushLine(timeAt(first), stocY(midLine), timeAt(last), stocY(midLine), withAlpha(NEU, 0.25), 1)
        pushLine(timeAt(first), stocY(s.stocOverSold), timeAt(last), stocY(s.stocOverSold), withAlpha(POS, 0.25), 1)

        const kPts = []
        const dPts = []
        for (let i = first; i <= last; i++) {
          const yk = stocY(values.stocK[i])
          const yd = stocY(values.stocD[i])
          if (finite(yk)) kPts.push({ time: timeAt(i), price: yk })
          if (finite(yd)) dPts.push({ time: timeAt(i), price: yd })
        }
        pushPolyline(kPts, IND, 1)
        pushPolyline(dPts, SIG, 1)

        const stocLabelY = stocY(midLine)
        if (finite(stocLabelY)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'label',
            at: { time: timeAt(last), price: stocLabelY },
            text: 'STOC',
            color: IND,
            align: 'left',
          })
        }
      }

      /* -- MACD panel ------------------------------------------------------ */
      const macdBase = priceLowest * (1 - priceChangeRate * s.macdVOffset)
      const macdY = (v) => (finite(v) && finite(macdHighest) && macdHighest !== 0
        ? macdBase * (1 + (v / macdHighest) * priceChangeRate * s.macdHeight)
        : NaN)

      if (s.macdDisplay) {
        const mPts = []
        const sPts = []
        for (let i = first; i <= last; i++) {
          const ym = macdY(values.macd[i])
          const ys = macdY(values.macdSignal[i])
          if (finite(ym)) mPts.push({ time: timeAt(i), price: ym })
          if (finite(ys)) sPts.push({ time: timeAt(i), price: ys })
          const h = values.macdHist[i]
          const hPrev = i > 0 ? values.macdHist[i - 1] : NaN
          if (i >= firstBox && finite(h)) {
            const rising = finite(hPrev) && hPrev < h
            const colour = h >= 0 ? (rising ? POS : POS_LIGHT) : (rising ? NEG_LIGHT : NEG)
            pushLine(timeAt(i), macdBase, timeAt(i), macdY(h), colour, 2)
          }
        }
        pushPolyline(mPts, IND, 1)
        pushPolyline(sPts, SIG, 1)

        // The source prices this caption from 50 / oscHighest, not from the
        // MACD range, so it still sits correctly on a flat MACD.
        const macdLabelY = macdBase * (1 + 0.5 * priceChangeRate * s.macdHeight)
        if (finite(macdLabelY)) {
          out.push({
            kind: 'label',
            at: { time: timeAt(last), price: macdLabelY },
            text: 'MACD',
            color: IND,
            align: 'left',
          })
        }
      }

      /* -- Volume panel ---------------------------------------------------- */
      const lastVolume = Number(bars[last].volume)
      const volBase = priceHighest * (1 + priceChangeRate * s.volVOffset)
      const volY = (v) => (finite(v) && volumeHighest > 0
        ? volBase * (1 + (v / volumeHighest) * priceChangeRate * s.volHeight)
        : NaN)

      // The caption is gated only on the volume type; the bars themselves
      // additionally need the last bar to carry volume, as in the source.
      if (s.volType !== 'None' && finite(volBase)) {
        out.push({
          kind: 'label',
          at: { time: timeAt(last), price: volBase },
          text: 'VOL',
          color: NEU,
          align: 'left',
        })
      }

      if (finite(lastVolume) && lastVolume !== 0 && s.volType !== 'None') {
        const buySell = s.volType === 'Buying/Selling Volume | `oa-momentum-setup---vijay-thakare-option-buying-scalping-setup-` | `oa-momentum-setup---vijay-thakare-option-buying-scalping-setup-.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Momentum) |
| Momentum Setup: Vijay Thakare Option Buying Scalping Setup',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      {
        key: 'signalMode',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Screening Method',
        default: CONTINUOUS,
        options: [
          { label: 'Continuous Signals', value: CONTINUOUS },
          { label: 'Flip Signals', value: FLIP },
        ],
        tooltip:
          'Continuous repeats the signal while the setup holds; Flip marks only the bar the side changes on.',
        group: 'Screener',
      },

      { key: 'stAtrPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 10, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stFactor', type: 'number', label: 'Factor', default: 3, min: 0.01, max: 1000, step: 0.01, group: 'Supertrend' },

      { key: 'maDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA)' },
      { key: 'maLen1', type: 'number', label: 'Length 1', default: 20, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA)' },
      { key: 'maLen2', type: 'number', label: 'Length 2', default: 50, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA)' },
      { key: 'maLen3', type: 'number', label: 'Length 3', default: 100, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA)' },
      { key: 'maLen4', type: 'number', label: 'Length 4', default: 200, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Exponential Moving Average (EMA)' },

      { key: 'vtwapDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'VWAP / TWAP' },
      {
        key: 'vtwapChoice',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Choose',
        default: 'VWAP',
        options: [
          { label: 'VWAP', value: 'VWAP' },
          { label: 'TWAP', value: 'TWAP' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Choose TWAP if Volume is not available for the Symbol.',
        group: 'VWAP / TWAP',
      },
      {
        key: 'vtwapTimeframe',
        type: 'text',
        label: 'Timeframe',
        default: '1D',
        tooltip: 'Anchor period: 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, 12M, or a bare number of minutes such as 60.',
        group: 'VWAP / TWAP',
      },

      { key: 'macdDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdFast', type: 'number', label: 'Fast Length', default: 3, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdSlow', type: 'number', label: 'Slow Length', default: 9, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdSignal', type: 'number', label: 'Signal Smoothing', default: 15, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 0.5, min: -100, max: 100, step: 0.1, tooltip: 'Where the drawn MACD panel sits below the price range.', group: 'MACD' },
      { key: 'macdHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.7, min: 0, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'MACD' },

      { key: 'stocDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocKLen', type: 'number', label: '%K Length', default: 5, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocKSmooth', type: 'number', label: '%K Smoothing', default: 3, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocDSmooth', type: 'number', label: '%D Smoothing', default: 3, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocOverBought', type: 'number', label: 'Over Bought', default: 60, min: 1, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocOverSold', type: 'number', label: 'Over Sold', default: 40, min: 1, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 1.8, min: -100, max: 100, step: 0.1, tooltip: 'Where the drawn Stochastic panel sits below the price range.', group: 'Stochastic' },
      { key: 'stocHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.6, min: 0, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Stochastic' },

      { key: 'volDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Volume MA', default: true, group: 'Volume' },
      {
        key: 'volType',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Type',
        default: 'Regular Volume',
        options: [
          { label: 'Buying/Selling Volume', value: BUY_SELL_VOLUME },
          { label: 'Regular Volume', value: 'Regular Volume' },
          { label: 'None', value: 'None' },
        ],
        group: 'Volume',
      },
      { key: 'volVOffset', type: 'number', label: 'Vertical Offset', default: 0.5, min: -100, max: 100, step: 0.1, tooltip: 'Where the drawn volume panel sits above the price range.', group: 'Volume' },
      { key: 'volHeight', type: 'number', label: 'Height', default: 0.6, min: 0, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Volume' },

      { key: 'atrFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply ATR Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'ATR helps filter out longer or more volatile signal candles.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrMulti', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, tooltip: 'A higher multiplier filters out a longer or more volatile signal candle.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body % Filter', default: false, tooltip: "If the input is 80, the body has to cover over 80% of the candle.", group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyPercent', type: 'number', label: 'Body % Above', default: 80, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body Size Filter', default: false, tooltip: '2 means the candle is 2 times larger than the previous candle.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'Body Size Multiplier (x)', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volumeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Keep a candle only when its volume is greater than the SMA of the volume.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'Volume SMA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Relative Volume Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Keep a candle only when its relative volume is greater than its own average.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolLen', type: 'number', label: 'Relative Volume Length', default: 90, min: 2, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolMulti', type: 'number', label: 'Rel Vol SMA Multiplier', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'timeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Time Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Drop signals outside the given exchange-time window.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'displayLen', type: 'number', label: 'Display Length', default: 50, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, tooltip: 'How many recent bars the drawn panels and the signal shading cover.', group: 'Chart Settings' },
    ],

    plots: [
      { key: 'ema1', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 1', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'ema2', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 2', style: { color: INDICATOR, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'ema3', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 3', style: { color: SIGNAL, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'ema4', type: 'line', title: 'EMA 4', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'vwap', type: 'line', title: 'VWAP/TWAP', style: { color: NEU, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stUp', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Up', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stDown', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Down', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const s = read(settings)
      const n = bars.length
      const zone = zoneOf(ctx)

      const blank = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const out = {
        ema1: blank(), ema2: blank(), ema3: blank(), ema4: blank(),
        vwap: blank(), stUp: blank(), stDown: blank(),
        stocK: blank(), stocD: blank(),
        macd: blank(), signal: blank(), hist: blank(), volMa: blank(),
        shortTrigger: blank(), longTrigger: blank(),
        longEntry: blank(), shortEntry: blank(),
      }
      if (n === 0) return out

      const open = bars.map((b) => b.open)
      const high = bars.map((b) => b.high)
      const low = bars.map((b) => b.low)
      const close = bars.map((b) => b.close)
      // Pine's `volume` is na where the feed carries none, and nz(volume) is
      // what the drawn panel uses, so both forms are kept.
      const volume = bars.map((b) => (Number.isFinite(b.volume) ? b.volume : NaN))
      const nzVolume = volume.map((v) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? v : 0))
      const hlc3 = sourceValues(bars, 'hlc3')
      const ohlc4 = sourceValues(bars, 'ohlc4')

      /* 1. EMA 20, 50, 100, 200 */
      const ema1 = smaSeededEma(close, s.maLen1)
      const ema2 = smaSeededEma(close, s.maLen2)
      const ema3 = smaSeededEma(close, s.maLen3)
      const ema4 = smaSeededEma(close, s.maLen4)
      if (s.maDisplay) {
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          out.ema1[i] = ema1[i]
          out.ema2[i] = ema2[i]
          out.ema3[i] = ema3[i]
          out.ema4[i] = ema4[i]
        }
      }

      /* 2. VWAP / TWAP, anchored on the chosen timeframe */
      const anchors = anchorFlags(bars, s.vtwapTimeframe, zone)
      const vwapLine = blank()
      const twapLine = blank()
      let sumPV = 0
      let sumV = 0
      let sumP = 0
      let count = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (i === 0 // anchors[i]) {
          sumPV = 0
          sumV = 0
          sumP = 0
          count = 0
        }
        // A missing volume poisons the running sums exactly as na does in Pine,
        // which is why the source offers TWAP for symbols without volume.
        sumPV += hlc3[i] * volume[i]
        sumV += volume[i]
        vwapLine[i] = sumV > 0 ? sumPV / sumV : NaN
        sumP += ohlc4[i]
        count += 1
        twapLine[i] = count > 0 ? sumP / count : NaN
      }
      const vtwap = s.vtwapChoice === 'VWAP' ? vwapLine : twapLine
      if (s.vtwapDisplay) for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.vwap[i] = vtwap[i]

      /* 3. MACD */
      const macdFast = smaSeededEma(close, s.macdFast)
      const macdSlow = smaSeededEma(close, s.macdSlow)
      const macdLine = blank()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (Number.isFinite(macdFast[i]) && Number.isFinite(macdSlow[i])) {
          macdLine[i] = macdFast[i] - macdSlow[i]
        }
      }
      const signalLine = emaFromFirstFinite(macdLine, s.macdSignal)
      const histLine = blank()
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (Number.isFinite(macdLine[i]) && Number.isFinite(signalLine[i])) {
          histLine[i] = macdLine[i] - signalLine[i]
        }
      }

      /* 4. Stochastic */
      const stocK = sma(stoch(close, high, low, s.stocKLen), s.stocKSmooth)
      const stocD = sma(stocK, s.stocDSmooth)

      /* 5. Volume SMA. The drawn panel uses nz(volume), the filter uses volume. */
      const volSma = sma(volume, s.volSmaLength)
      const volMa = sma(nzVolume, s.volSmaLength)

      /* 6. Supertrend. The helper takes (bars, atrPeriod, factor). */
      const st = supertrend(bars, s.stAtrPeriod, s.stFactor)
      const stValue = blank()
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        // Pine blanks the value on the first bar outright.
        const v = st[i] ? st[i].value : NaN
        if (Number.isFinite(v)) stValue[i] = v
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(stValue[i])) continue
        if (st[i].direction < 0) out.stUp[i] = stValue[i]
        else out.stDown[i] = stValue[i]
      }

      /* Additional filters */
      const atrSeries = atr(high, low, close, s.atrLength)
      const avgVolume = sma(volume, s.relVolLen)
      const relativeVolume = blank()
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        const prevAvg = avgVolume[i - 1]
        if (Number.isFinite(volume[i]) && Number.isFinite(prevAvg) && prevAvg > 0) {
          relativeVolume[i] = volume[i] / prevAvg
        }
      }
      const relVolSma = sma(relativeVolume, s.relVolLen)

      const lastIndex = n - 1
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false

      /* Signals. Every comparison is guarded: in Pine a test against na is
       * false, while in JavaScript `5 > null` is true. */
      let bearState = 0
      let bullState = 0
      let prevFlip = NaN
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const macd = macdLine[i]
        const sig = signalLine[i]
        const hist = histLine[i]
        const k = stocK[i]
        const d = stocD[i]
        const stv = stValue[i]
        const anchorVal = vtwap[i]
        const c = close[i]
        const range = high[i] - low[i]

        const coreFinite =
          Number.isFinite(macd) && Number.isFinite(sig) && Number.isFinite(hist) &&
          Number.isFinite(k) && Number.isFinite(d) && Number.isFinite(stv) &&
          Number.isFinite(anchorVal) && Number.isFinite(c)

        // ATR filter
        let atrOk = true
        if (s.atrFilter) {
          atrOk =
            Number.isFinite(atrSeries[i]) && Number.isFinite(range) &&
            range > atrSeries[i] * s.atrMulti
        }
        // Body percent filter
        const bodyRatio = range > 0 ? Math.abs(c - open[i]) / range : NaN
        let bodyOk = true
        if (s.bodyFilter) bodyOk = Number.isFinite(bodyRatio) && bodyRatio >= s.bodyPercent
        // Body size filter. The source reuses the body percent here even when
        // the body percent filter itself is switched off.
        let bodySizeOk = true
        if (s.bodySizeFilter) {
          const prevRange = i > 0 ? high[i - 1] - low[i - 1] : NaN
          bodySizeOk =
            Number.isFinite(bodyRatio) && bodyRatio >= s.bodyPercent &&
            Number.isFinite(prevRange) && Number.isFinite(range) &&
            range >= prevRange * s.bodySizeMultiplier
        }
        // Volume SMA filter
        let volumeOk = true
        if (s.volumeFilter) {
          volumeOk =
            Number.isFinite(volume[i]) && Number.isFinite(volSma[i]) && volume[i] > volSma[i]
        }
        // Relative volume filter
        let relVolOk = true
        if (s.relVolFilter) {
          relVolOk =
            Number.isFinite(relativeVolume[i]) && Number.isFinite(relVolSma[i]) &&
            relativeVolume[i] > relVolSma[i] * s.relVolMulti
        }
        // Time filter, on exchange wall clock rather than the viewer's browser.
        let timeOk = true
        if (s.timeFilter) {
          const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
          const hour = parts.hour
          const minute = parts.minute
          timeOk =
            (hour > s.hourFrom // (hour === s.hourFrom && minute >= s.minuteFrom)) &&
            (hour < s.hourTo // (hour === s.hourTo && minute < s.minuteTo))
        }

        const confirmed = i < lastIndex // lastConfirmed
        const filtersOk =
          atrOk && bodyOk && bodySizeOk && volumeOk && relVolOk && timeOk && confirmed

        const shortCond1 = coreFinite && macd > 0
        const longCond1 = coreFinite && macd < 0

        const shortCond2 =
          coreFinite && filtersOk &&
          c < stv && c < anchorVal && k < s.stocOverBought && k < d &&
          macd < 0 && macd < sig && macd < hist

        const longCond2 =
          coreFinite && filtersOk &&
          c > stv && c > anchorVal && k > s.stocOverSold && k > d &&
          macd > 0 && macd > sig && macd > hist

        // Continuous: a two-step state machine that re-arms after it fires.
        const bearPrev = bearState
        bearState = bearPrev === 2 ? 0 : bearPrev
        if (shortCond1 && bearState === 0) bearState = 1
        if (shortCond2 && bearState === 1) bearState = 2
        out.shortTrigger[i] = bearState === 2 ? 1 : 0

        const bullPrev = bullState
        bullState = bullPrev === 2 ? 0 : bullPrev
        if (longCond1 && bullState === 0) bullState = 1
        if (longCond2 && bullState === 1) bullState = 2
        out.longTrigger[i] = bullState === 2 ? 1 : 0

        // Flip: Pine's exrem. `entry_signal[1]` is na on the first bar and the
        // variable is never nz'd, so the first change of side compares against
        // na and does not count as an entry. Reproduced rather than corrected.
        const cur = longCond2 ? 1 : shortCond2 ? -1 : prevFlip
        const entry = Number.isFinite(cur) && Number.isFinite(prevFlip) && cur !== prevFlip
        out.longEntry[i] = entry && cur === 1 ? 1 : 0
        out.shortEntry[i] = entry && cur === -1 ? 1 : 0
        prevFlip = cur

        out.stocK[i] = k
        out.stocD[i] = d
        out.macd[i] = macd
        out.signal[i] = sig
        out.hist[i] = hist
        out.volMa[i] = volMa[i]
      }

      const cols = {}
      for (const key of Object.keys(out)) cols[key] = nulls(out[key])
      return cols
    },

    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const s = read(settings)

      // aboveBar and belowBar anchor to this indicator's own line, so the
      // triangles go at an explicit price with a pad scaled to the instrument
      // rather than to a fixed number of points.
      let rangeSum = 0
      let rangeCount = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          rangeSum += r
          rangeCount += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = rangeCount > 0 ? rangeSum / rangeCount : 0
      const lastClose = bars[n - 1].close
      const pad = Math.max(
        meanRange * 0.5,
        Math.abs(Number.isFinite(lastClose) ? lastClose : 0) * 0.0005
      )

      const shortCol = s.signalMode === CONTINUOUS ? values.shortTrigger : values.shortEntry
      const longCol = s.signalMode === CONTINUOUS ? values.longTrigger : values.longEntry

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (shortCol[i] === 1 && Number.isFinite(bars[i].high)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
          })
        }
        if (longCol[i] === 1 && Number.isFinite(bars[i].low)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_LIGHT,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // Pine shades only the last i_display_len bars (show_last).
    background({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const s = read(settings)
      const out = new Array(bars.length).fill(null)
      const shortCol = s.signalMode === CONTINUOUS ? values.shortTrigger : values.shortEntry
      const longCol = s.signalMode === CONTINUOUS ? values.longTrigger : values.longEntry
      const from = Math.max(0, bars.length - s.displayLen)
      for (let i = from; i < bars.length; i++) {
        if (shortCol[i] === 1) out[i] = withAlpha(NEG_LIGHT, 0.1)
        else if (longCol[i] === 1) out[i] = withAlpha(POS_LIGHT, 0.1)
      }
      return out
    },

    // barcolor() carries no show_last, so it repaints every signal bar.
    barColors({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const s = read(settings)
      const out = new Array(bars.length).fill(null)
      const shortCol = s.signalMode === CONTINUOUS ? values.shortTrigger : values.shortEntry
      const longCol = s.signalMode === CONTINUOUS ? values.longTrigger : values.longEntry
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        if (shortCol[i] === 1) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (longCol[i] === 1) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
      }
      return out
    },

    /* The miniature Stochastic, MACD and volume panels the source paints over
     * the price pane on the last bar. Every y is the source's own mapping of a
     * panel value onto the recent price range. */
    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const s = read(settings)
      const last = n - 1
      const lo = Math.max(0, last - s.displayLen)
      const winLo = Math.max(0, last - s.displayLen + 1)

      const high = bars.map((b) => b.high)
      const low = bars.map((b) => b.low)
      const nzVolume = bars.map((b) => (Number.isFinite(b.volume) ? b.volume : 0))

      const priceHighest = winMax(high, winLo, last)
      const priceLowest = winMin(low, winLo, last)
      if (!Number.isFinite(priceHighest) // !Number.isFinite(priceLowest) // priceHighest === 0) {
        return []
      }
      const priceChangeRate = (priceHighest - priceLowest) / priceHighest
      const out = []
      const at = (i, price) => ({ time: bars[i].time, price })
      const caption = (i, price, text) =>
        out.push({ kind: 'label', at: at(i, price), text, color: TRANSPARENT, textColor: FG, align: 'left' })

      /* Stochastic panel. oscHighest is a literal 100 in the source. */
      const stocBase = priceLowest * (1 - priceChangeRate * s.stocVOffset)
      const yStoc = (v) => stocBase * (1 + (v / 100) * priceChangeRate * s.stocHeight)
      if (s.stocDisplay) {
        for (const [level, color] of [
          [s.stocOverBought, withAlpha(NEG, 0.25)],
          [50, withAlpha(NEU, 0.25)],
          [s.stocOverSold, withAlpha(POS, 0.25)],
        ]) {
          const y = yStoc(level)
          if (!Number.isFinite(y)) continue
          out.push({ kind: 'line', from: at(lo, y), to: at(last, y), color, lineWidth: 1 })
        }
        const kPts = []
        const dPts = []
        for (let i = lo; i <= last; i++) {
          const k = values.stocK[i]
          const d = values.stocD[i]
          const yk = Number.isFinite(k) ? yStoc(k) : NaN
          const yd = Number.isFinite(d) ? yStoc(d) : NaN
          kPts.push(Number.isFinite(yk) ? at(i, yk) : null)
          dPts.push(Number.isFinite(yd) ? at(i, yd) : null)
        }
        pushRuns(out, kPts, INDICATOR, 1)
        pushRuns(out, dPts, SIGNAL, 1)
        const yMid = yStoc(50)
        if (Number.isFinite(yMid)) caption(last, yMid, 'STOC')
      }

      /* MACD panel */
      const macdHi = winMax(values.macd, winLo, last)
      const macdLo = winMin(values.macd, winLo, last)
      const macdHighest =
        Number.isFinite(macdHi) && Number.isFinite(macdLo) ? macdHi - macdLo : NaN
      const macdBase = priceLowest * (1 - priceChangeRate * s.macdVOffset)
      const yMacd = (v) => macdBase * (1 + (v / macdHighest) * priceChangeRate * s.macdHeight)
      if (s.macdDisplay) {
        if (Number.isFinite(macdHighest) && macdHighest > 0) {
          const macdPts = []
          const signalPts = []
          for (let i = lo; i <= last; i++) {
            const m = values.macd[i]
            const g = values.signal[i]
            const ym = Number.isFinite(m) ? yMacd(m) : NaN
            const yg = Number.isFinite(g) ? yMacd(g) : NaN
            macdPts.push(Number.isFinite(ym) ? at(i, ym) : null)
            signalPts.push(Number.isFinite(yg) ? at(i, yg) : null)

            // The histogram is a zero-width box in Pine, which is a vertical
            // segment from the panel's zero line to the histogram value.
            const h = values.hist[i]
            if (!Number.isFinite(h)) continue
            const yh = yMacd(h)
            if (!Number.isFinite(yh)) continue
            const prevH = i > 0 ? values.hist[i - 1] : null
            const rising = Number.isFinite(prevH) && prevH < h
            const color = h >= 0 ? (rising ? POS : POS_LIGHT) : rising ? NEG_LIGHT : NEG
            out.push({ kind: 'line', from: at(i, macdBase), to: at(i, yh), color, lineWidth: 2 })
          }
          pushRuns(out, macdPts, INDICATOR, 1)
          pushRuns(out, signalPts, SIGNAL, 1)
        }
        // The caption sits at half height, which the source writes as 50/100
        // rather than against the MACD range.
        const yCap = macdBase * (1 + 0.5 * priceChangeRate * s.macdHeight)
        if (Number.isFinite(yCap)) caption(last, yCap, 'MACD')
      }

      /* Volume panel. The bars are gated on the last bar carrying volume at
       * all, the caption only on the volume type. */
      const volumeHighest = winMax(nzVolume, winLo, last)
      const volBase = priceHighest * (1 + priceChangeRate * s.volVOffset)
      const yVol = (v) => volBase * (1 + (v / volumeHighest) * priceChangeRate * s.volHeight)
      if (s.volType !== 'None' && Number.isFinite(volBase)) {
        if (nzVolume[last] > 0 && Number.isFinite(volumeHighest) && volumeHighest > 0) {
          const maPts = []
          for (let i = lo; i <= last; i++) {
            const v = nzVolume[i]
            const range = high[i] - low[i]
            const yTotal = yVol(v)
            if (Number.isFinite(yTotal)) {
              const bull = bars[i].close > bars[i].open
              const color = s.volType === BUY_SELL_VOLUME ? POS : bull ? POS : NEG
              out.push({ kind: 'line', from: at(i, volBase), to: at(i, yTotal), color, lineWidth: 2 })
              if (s.volType === BUY_SELL_VOLUME && Number.isFinite(range) && range > 0) {
                // Selling volume is drawn over the total, leaving the buying
                // share showing above it.
                const sell = (v * (high[i] - bars[i].close)) / range
                const ySell = yVol(sell)
                if (Number.isFinite(ySell)) {
                  out.push({ kind: 'line', from: at(i, volBase), to: at(i, ySell), color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 })
                }
              }
            }
            const ma = values.volMa[i]
            const yMa = Number.isFinite(ma) ? yVol(ma) : NaN
            maPts.push(Number.isFinite(yMa) ? at(i, yMa) : null)
          }
          if (s.volDisplay) pushRuns(out, maPts, NEU, 1)
        }
        caption(last, volBase, 'VOL | `oa-momentum-setup---vijay-thakare-option-buying-scalping-setup` | `oa-momentum-setup---vijay-thakare-option-buying-scalping-setup.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Momentum) |
| Trend Following Setup - Sideways Market Skipper Scanner',
    category: 'ICT',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs: [
      // Supertrend
      { key: 'stAtrPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 10, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stFactor', type: 'number', label: 'Factor', default: 3, min: 0.01, max: 100, step: 0.01, group: 'Supertrend' },

      // Volatility Range
      { key: 'showRange', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Volatility Range' },
      {

        default: 'Auto ATR',

          { label: 'Type Points', value: 'Type Points' },
        ],
        tooltip:
          'Auto ATR sets the range from the ATR below, so it rescales with the symbol. Type Points uses a fixed number of points instead, for example 60 for NIFTY and 120 for BANKNIFTY.',
      },

        ],
      },
      { key: 'rangeAtrMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1.5, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.5, group: 'Volatility Range' },
      { key: 'rangeAtrSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR SMA Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Volatility Range' },
      { key: 'showAtr', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display ATR and ATR SMA', default: true, group: 'Volatility Range' },

      { key: 'atrFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply ATR Filter', default: true, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Filters out longer or more volatile signal candles.' },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrMulti', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'A higher multiplier filters a longer or more volatile signal candle.' },

      { key: 'bodyFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body % Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'With 80, the body has to cover over 80% of the candle.' },
      { key: 'bodyPercent', type: 'number', label: 'Body % Above', default: 80, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'bodySizeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body Size Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: '2 means the candle is 2 times larger than the previous candle.' },
      { key: 'bodySizeMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'Body Size Multiplier (x)', default: 2, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'volumeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume Filter', default: false, group: 'Additional Filters', tooltip: 'Keeps a candle only when its volume is above the SMA of volume.' },
      { key: 'volSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'Volume SMA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      // Data Table
