        ],
      },
    ],

    plots: [
      { key: 'stUp', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Up', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stDown', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Down', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 } },
      // Only there to anchor the two Supertrend fills, exactly as the source's
      // display=none "Body Middle" plot is.
      { key: 'bodyMid', type: 'line', title: 'Body Middle', style: { color: NEU_MID, lineWidth: 1, visible: false } },
      { key: 'topRange', type: 'step', title: 'Top Range', style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'bottomRange', type: 'step', title: 'Bottom Range', style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1 } },
      // The source's own pane. On the price pane they need a scale of their own,
      // or they flatten against the instrument's range.
      { key: 'atr', type: 'line', title: 'ATR', priceScaleId: 'left', style: { color: INDICATOR, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'atrSma', type: 'line', title: 'ATR SMA', priceScaleId: 'left', style: { color: SIGNAL, lineWidth: 1 } },
    ],

    fills: [
      { between: ['bodyMid', 'stUp'], colorUp: POS, colorDown: POS, opacity: 0.1 },
      { between: ['bodyMid', 'stDown'], colorUp: NEG, colorDown: NEG, opacity: 0.1 },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      const stAtrPeriod = int(settings.stAtrPeriod, 10, 1)
      const stFactor = Math.max(0.01, num(settings.stFactor, 3))

      const showRange = settings.showRange !== false
      const rangeType = settings.rangeType === 'Type Points' ? 'Type Points' : 'Auto ATR'
      const rangePoints = Math.max(0.01, num(settings.rangePoints, 120))
      const rangeAtrLength = int(settings.rangeAtrLength, 14, 1)
      const rangeAtrSmoothing = String(settings.rangeAtrSmoothing // 'RMA')
      const rangeAtrMultiplier = Math.max(1, num(settings.rangeAtrMultiplier, 1.5))
      const rangeAtrSmaLength = int(settings.rangeAtrSmaLength, 14, 1)
      const showAtr = settings.showAtr !== false

      const pchgFilterOn = settings.pchgFilter === true
      const pchgAboveBelow = Math.max(0, num(settings.pchgAboveBelow, 2))
      const volPchgFilterOn = settings.volPchgFilter === true
      const volPchgAbove = Math.max(0, num(settings.volPchgAbove, 0))
      const atrFilterOn = settings.atrFilter !== false
      const atrLength = int(settings.atrLength, 14, 1)
      const atrMulti = Math.max(1, num(settings.atrMulti, 1))
      const bodyFilterOn = settings.bodyFilter === true
      // The source divides the input by 100 at declaration.
      const bodyPercent = clamp(num(settings.bodyPercent, 80), 0, 100) / 100
      const bodySizeFilterOn = settings.bodySizeFilter === true
      const bodySizeMultiplier = Math.max(0, Math.floor(num(settings.bodySizeMultiplier, 2)))
      const volumeFilterOn = settings.volumeFilter === true
      const volSmaLength = int(settings.volSmaLength, 20, 1)
      const relVolFilterOn = settings.relVolFilter === true
      const relVolAvgLen = int(settings.relVolAvgLen, 90, 2)
      const relVolMulti = Math.max(0, num(settings.relVolMulti, 5))
      const timeFilterOn = settings.timeFilter === true
      const hourFrom = clamp(Math.floor(num(settings.hourFrom, 9)), 0, 23)
      const minuteFrom = clamp(Math.floor(num(settings.minuteFrom, 15)), 0, 59)
      const hourTo = clamp(Math.floor(num(settings.hourTo, 10)), 0, 23)
      const minuteTo = clamp(Math.floor(num(settings.minuteTo, 15)), 0, 59)

      const col = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const stUp = col()
      const stDown = col()
      const bodyMid = col()
      const topRange = col()
      const bottomRange = col()
      const atrOut = col()
      const atrSmaOut = col()
      const signalCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const crossCol = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const cumPchgCol = col()
      const cumVolPchgCol = col()
      const cumVolCol = col()
      const prevCumVolCol = col()

      if (n === 0) {
        return {
          stUp, stDown, bodyMid, topRange, bottomRange, atr: atrOut, atrSma: atrSmaOut,
          signal: signalCol, cross: crossCol, cumPchg: cumPchgCol, cumVolPchg: cumVolPchgCol,
          cumVol: cumVolCol, prevCumVol: prevCumVolCol,
        }
      }

      const open = bars.map((b) => b.open)
      const high = bars.map((b) => b.high)
      const low = bars.map((b) => b.low)
      const close = bars.map((b) => b.close)
      // Index series carry no volume at all, so every volume filter has to cope
      // with a missing field rather than divide by it.
      const volume = bars.map((b) => (Number.isFinite(b.volume) ? b.volume : 0))

      const zoneRaw = ctx && typeof ctx.timezone === 'string' ? ctx.timezone : null
      const zone = zoneRaw && isValidTimezone(zoneRaw) ? zoneRaw : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      // ta.supertrend(factor, atrPeriod). direction is -1 up, +1 down here too.
      const st = supertrend(bars, stAtrPeriod, stFactor)

      // The source's ATR is the chosen moving average of ta.tr(true), not
      // ta.atr, so RMA only coincides with Wilder at the default setting.
      const tr = trueRange(high, low, close)
      let atrSeries
      switch (rangeAtrSmoothing) {
        case 'SMA':
          atrSeries = sma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
          break
        // Pine's ta.ema seeds from the SMA of the first `length` values, which
        // `ema` here does not: `smaSeededEma` is the matching one.
        case 'EMA':
          atrSeries = smaSeededEma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
          break
        case 'WMA':
          atrSeries = wma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
          break
        default:
          atrSeries = rma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
      }
      const atrSmaSeries = sma(atrSeries, rangeAtrSmaLength)

      // The candle filter runs its own Wilder ATR at its own length.
      const filterAtr = atr(high, low, close, atrLength)
      const volSma = sma(volume, volSmaLength)

      // relative_volume = volume / average_volume[1]
      const averageVolume = sma(volume, relVolAvgLen)
      const relVol = col()
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        const base = averageVolume[i - 1]
        if (!Number.isFinite(base) // base === 0) continue
        relVol[i] = volume[i] / base
      }
      const relVolSma = sma(relVol, relVolAvgLen)

      const lastIdx = n - 1
      // barstate.isconfirmed: every historical bar is confirmed, the forming one
      // is not. The context is optional, so a host that says nothing means the
      // series is history.
      const lastConfirmed = ctx && ctx.barState ? ctx.barState.isConfirmed !== false : true

      let cumPchg = NaN
      let currentCumVol = NaN
      let prevCumVol = NaN
      let topPrice = NaN
      let bottomPrice = NaN
      // The previous bar's level, which is what `top_price[1]` reads.
      let topRangeState = NaN
      let bottomRangeState = NaN
      let shortState = 0
      let longState = 0
      let prevDayIdx = null

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const confirmed = i < lastIdx ? true : lastConfirmed

        // ta.change(time('D')) != 0, which is false on the very first bar.
        const dayIdx = zonedDayIndex(bars[i].time, zone)
        const isNewDay = prevDayIdx !== null && dayIdx !== prevDayIdx
        prevDayIdx = dayIdx

        // Cumulative percentage change of close, reset each day.
        const prevClose = i > 0 ? close[i - 1] : NaN
        const dailyPct =
          i > 0 && Number.isFinite(prevClose) && prevClose !== 0 && Number.isFinite(close[i])
            ? ((close[i] - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100
            : 0
        cumPchg = isNewDay ? dailyPct : Number.isFinite(cumPchg) ? cumPchg + dailyPct : dailyPct
        cumPchgCol[i] = cumPchg

        // Cumulative volume. The source starts from na, so the first day of a
        // chart genuinely has no previous-day figure to compare against and its
        // volume readings stay unavailable, filters included.
        if (isNewDay) {
          prevCumVol = currentCumVol
          currentCumVol = volume[i]
        } else {
          currentCumVol += volume[i]
        }
        cumVolCol[i] = currentCumVol
        prevCumVolCol[i] = prevCumVol

        const volBase = Number.isFinite(prevCumVol) ? prevCumVol : currentCumVol
        const cumVolPchg =
          Number.isFinite(currentCumVol) && Number.isFinite(volBase) && volBase !== 0
            ? ((currentCumVol - volBase) / volBase) * 100
            : NaN
        cumVolPchgCol[i] = cumVolPchg

        // Additional filters. Every one of them is `true` while switched off,
        // and every comparison is guarded: an unavailable operand makes a Pine
        // comparison false, where in JavaScript it would sail through.
        const pchgAboveOk = !pchgFilterOn // (Number.isFinite(cumPchg) && cumPchg > pchgAboveBelow)
        const pchgBelowOk = !pchgFilterOn // (Number.isFinite(cumPchg) && cumPchg < -pchgAboveBelow)
        const volPchgOk = !volPchgFilterOn // (Number.isFinite(cumVolPchg) && cumVolPchg >= volPchgAbove)

        const barRange = high[i] - low[i]
        const atrOk =
          !atrFilterOn //
          (Number.isFinite(filterAtr[i]) && Number.isFinite(barRange) && barRange > filterAtr[i] * atrMulti)

        // A doji or a halted bar makes this 0/0, which is unavailable in Pine
        // and so fails the filter rather than passing it.
        const bodyRatio = Number.isFinite(barRange) && barRange > 0 ? Math.abs(close[i] - open[i]) / barRange : NaN
        const bodyOk = !bodyFilterOn // (Number.isFinite(bodyRatio) && bodyRatio >= bodyPercent)

        const prevRange = i > 0 ? high[i - 1] - low[i - 1] : NaN
        const bodySizeOk =
          !bodySizeFilterOn //
          (Number.isFinite(bodyRatio) &&
            bodyRatio >= bodyPercent &&
            Number.isFinite(prevRange) &&
            Number.isFinite(barRange) &&
            barRange >= prevRange * bodySizeMultiplier)

        const volumeOk = !volumeFilterOn // (Number.isFinite(volSma[i]) && volume[i] > volSma[i])

        const relVolLimit = Number.isFinite(relVolSma[i]) ? relVolSma[i] * relVolMulti : NaN
        const relVolOk =
          !relVolFilterOn // (Number.isFinite(relVol[i]) && Number.isFinite(relVolLimit) && relVol[i] > relVolLimit)

        let timeOk = true
        if (timeFilterOn) {
          // Pine's `hour` and `minute` are exchange wall clock, never the
          // viewer's, so the chart's zone decides this and not the browser.
          const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
          const hour = parts.hour
          const minute = parts.minute
          timeOk =
            (hour > hourFrom // (hour === hourFrom && minute >= minuteFrom)) &&
            (hour < hourTo // (hour === hourTo && minute < minuteTo))
        }

        // Supertrend, blanked on the first bar exactly as the source does.
        const stValue = i === 0 ? NaN : st[i].value
        const stPrev = i > 0 ? (i - 1 === 0 ? NaN : st[i - 1].value) : NaN
        if (Number.isFinite(stValue)) {
          if (st[i].direction < 0) stUp[i] = stValue
          else stDown[i] = stValue
        }
        if (i > 0) bodyMid[i] = (open[i] + close[i]) / 2

        atrOut[i] = showAtr ? atrSeries[i] : NaN
        atrSmaOut[i] = showAtr ? atrSmaSeries[i] : NaN

        // ta.crossunder / ta.crossover, both operands guarded on both bars.
        const crossable =
          i > 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(stValue) &&
          Number.isFinite(stPrev) &&
          Number.isFinite(close[i]) &&
          Number.isFinite(close[i - 1])
        const shortCont = crossable && close[i] < stValue && close[i - 1] >= stPrev && confirmed
        const longCont = crossable && close[i] > stValue && close[i - 1] <= stPrev && confirmed
        crossCol[i] = shortCont ? -1 : longCont ? 1 : 0

        // Volatility range, carried forward until the next cross replaces it.
        const rangeSource =
          rangeType === 'Type Points'
            ? rangePoints
            : Number.isFinite(atrSeries[i])
              ? atrSeries[i] * rangeAtrMultiplier
              : NaN
        if (shortCont) {
          bottomPrice = close[i] - rangeSource
          topPrice = NaN
        }
        if (longCont) {
          topPrice = close[i] + rangeSource
          bottomPrice = NaN
        }

        // Condition 2: price leaves the box while volatility is expanding.
        const atrRising =
          Number.isFinite(atrSeries[i]) && Number.isFinite(atrSmaSeries[i]) && atrSeries[i] > atrSmaSeries[i]

        const shortBreak =
          Number.isFinite(bottomPrice) &&
          close[i] < bottomPrice &&
          open[i] > close[i] &&
          atrRising &&
          pchgBelowOk &&
          volPchgOk &&
          atrOk &&
          bodyOk &&
          bodySizeOk &&
          volumeOk &&
          relVolOk &&
          timeOk &&
          confirmed

        const longBreak =
          Number.isFinite(topPrice) &&
          close[i] > topPrice &&
          open[i] < close[i] &&
          atrRising &&
          pchgAboveOk &&
          volPchgOk &&
          atrOk &&
          bodyOk &&
          bodySizeOk &&
          volumeOk &&
          relVolOk &&
          timeOk &&
          confirmed

        // Two one-shot state machines: 0 idle, 1 armed by a cross, 2 fired, and
        // 2 falls back to 0 on the next bar so a signal lasts exactly one bar.
        const prevShort = shortState
        shortState = prevShort === 2 ? 0 : prevShort
        if (shortCont && shortState === 0) shortState = 1
        if (shortBreak && shortState === 1) shortState = 2

        const prevLong = longState
        longState = prevLong === 2 ? 0 : prevLong
        if (longCont && longState === 0) longState = 1
        if (longBreak && longState === 1) longState = 2

        signalCol[i] = longState === 2 ? 1 : shortState === 2 ? -1 : 0

        // The range plots carry offset=-1, so this bar's level is written onto
        // the previous bar, and only once it has survived a bar unchanged.
        if (showRange && i > 0) {
          if (Number.isFinite(topPrice) && topPrice === topRangeState) topRange[i - 1] = topPrice
          if (Number.isFinite(bottomPrice) && bottomPrice === bottomRangeState) bottomRange[i - 1] = bottomPrice
        }
        topRangeState = topPrice
        bottomRangeState = bottomPrice
      }

      return {
        stUp: nulls(stUp),
        stDown: nulls(stDown),
        bodyMid: nulls(bodyMid),
        topRange: nulls(topRange),
        bottomRange: nulls(bottomRange),
        atr: nulls(atrOut),
        atrSma: nulls(atrSmaOut),
        signal: signalCol,
        cross: crossCol,
        cumPchg: nulls(cumPchgCol),
        cumVolPchg: nulls(cumVolPchgCol),
        cumVol: nulls(cumVolCol),
        prevCumVol: nulls(prevCumVolCol),
      }
    },

    // plotshape(..., location.belowbar / location.abovebar). On an overlay
    // aboveBar and belowBar anchor to this indicator's own line, so the
    // triangles are placed at an explicit price scaled to the instrument.
    markers({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return []
      const signal = values.signal
      if (!signal) return []

      let sum = 0
      let count = 0
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          sum += r
          count += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = count > 0 ? sum / count : 0
      const lastClose = bars[n - 1].close
      let pad = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, (Number.isFinite(lastClose) ? Math.abs(lastClose) : 0) * 0.0005)
      if (!Number.isFinite(pad) // pad < 0) pad = 0

      const out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const s = signal[i]
        if (s === 1 && Number.isFinite(bars[i].low)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_LIGHT,
          })
        } else if (s === -1 && Number.isFinite(bars[i].high)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // Two barcolor() layers in the source: the Supertrend cross candle, then the
    // signal candle, which is declared last and so wins where both apply.
    barColors({ bars, values }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const out = new Array(n).fill(null)
      const signal = values.signal
      const cross = values.cross
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const s = signal ? signal[i] : 0
        const x = cross ? cross[i] : 0
        if (s === -1) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (s === 1) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
        else if (x === -1) out[i] = NEG_LIGHT
        else if (x === 1) out[i] = POS_LIGHT
      }
      return out
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.showDataTable === false // bars.length === 0) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const read = (key) => {
        const v = values[key] ? values[key][i] : null
        return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null
      }

      const cumPchg = read('cumPchg')
      const cumVolPchg = read('cumVolPchg')
      const cumVol = read('cumVol')
      const prevCumVol = read('prevCumVol')

      const pchgColor = cumPchg !== null && cumPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const volPchgColor = cumVolPchg !== null && cumVolPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const prevVolColor = prevCumVol !== null && cumVol !== null && prevCumVol < cumVol ? NEG : POS

      // The source reports volume in lakhs.
      const lakh = (v) => (v === null ? '-' : `${fmt2(v / 100000)} L`)
      const pct = (v) => (v === null ? '-' : `${fmt2(v)} %`)

      const label = (text, bg) => ({ text, textColor: NEU, bgColor: bg, align: 'left' })
      const value = (text, color, bg) => ({ text, textColor: color, bgColor: bg, align: 'right' })

      const fontSize = FONT_PX[String(settings.tableSize // 'normal')] ?? FONT_PX.normal

      return {
        rows: [
          [label('%Chg', NEU_DARK), value(pct(cumPchg), pchgColor, NEU_DARK)],
          [label('Vol %Chg', NEU_MID), value(pct(cumVolPchg), volPchgColor, NEU_MID)],
          [label('Vol', NEU_DARK), value(lakh(cumVol), volPchgColor, NEU_DARK)],
          [label('PD Vol', NEU_MID), value(lakh(prevCumVol), prevVolColor, NEU_MID)],
        ],
        options: {
          position: String(settings.tablePosition // 'bottom-right | `oa-trend-following-setup---sideways-market-skipper-scanner` | `oa-trend-following-setup---sideways-market-skipper-scanner.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Trend) |
| Trend Following Setup - Sideways Market Skipper',
    category: 'ICT',
    // The Pine script is overlay=false: the ATR pair is its study, and the
    // Supertrend, the range levels and the signals are force_overlay onto the
    // price pane. Each of those plots carries overlay: true below.
    placement: 'pane',

    inputs: [
      { key: 'stAtrPeriod', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 10, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Supertrend' },
      { key: 'stFactor', type: 'number', label: 'Factor', default: 3, min: 0.01, max: 100, step: 0.01, group: 'Supertrend' },

      { key: 'rangeDisplay', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display', default: true, group: 'Volatility Range' },
      {
        key: 'rangeType',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Range Type',
        default: 'Auto ATR',
        options: [
          { label: 'Auto ATR', value: 'Auto ATR' },
          { label: 'Type Points', value: 'Type Points' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Auto ATR sets the range from the ATR value, so it follows the symbol. Type Points sets it in points, for example 60 for NIFTY and 120 for BANKNIFTY.',
        group: 'Volatility Range',
      },
      { key: 'rangePoints', type: 'number', label: 'Type Points', default: 120, min: 0.01, max: 1000000, step: 0.01, tooltip: "Applicable only when 'Range Type' is 'Type Points'.", group: 'Volatility Range' },
      { key: 'rangeAtrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Volatility Range' },
      {
        key: 'rangeAtrSmoothing',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'ATR Smoothing',
        default: 'RMA',
        options: [
          { label: 'RMA', value: 'RMA' },
          { label: 'SMA', value: 'SMA' },
          { label: 'EMA', value: 'EMA' },
          { label: 'WMA', value: 'WMA' },
        ],
        group: 'Volatility Range',
      },
      { key: 'rangeAtrMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1.5, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.5, group: 'Volatility Range' },
      { key: 'rangeAtrSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR SMA Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Volatility Range' },

      { key: 'pchgFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply % Change Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Relative volume is considered only when the cumulative daily percentage change is beyond this figure, positive for longs and negative for shorts.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'pchgAboveBelow', type: 'number', label: '% Change Above/Below +/-', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volPchgFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume % Change Filter', default: false, tooltip: "Zero means today's cumulative volume only has to beat the previous day's. 300% or more often marks a major breakout.", group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volPchgAbove', type: 'number', label: 'Volume % Change Above', default: 0, min: 0, max: 100000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply ATR Filter', default: true, tooltip: 'Filters out longer or more volatile signal candles.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Length', default: 14, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'atrMulti', type: 'number', label: 'ATR Multiplier', default: 1, min: 1, max: 100, step: 0.1, tooltip: 'A higher multiplier filters a longer or more volatile signal candle.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body % Filter', default: false, tooltip: "80 means the body covers over 80% of the candle.", group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodyPercent', type: 'number', label: 'Body % Above', default: 80, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Body Size Filter', default: false, tooltip: '2 means the candle is 2 times larger than the previous candle.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'bodySizeMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'Body Size Multiplier (x)', default: 2, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volumeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Volume Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Filters out a candle whose volume is below the SMA of volume.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'volSmaLength', type: 'number', label: 'Volume SMA Length', default: 20, min: 1, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Relative Volume Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Filters out a candle whose volume is below the relative volume threshold.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolLength', type: 'number', label: 'Relative Volume Length', default: 90, min: 2, max: 5000, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'relVolMultiplier', type: 'number', label: 'Rel Vol SMA Multiplier', default: 5, min: 0, max: 1000, step: 0.1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'timeFilter', type: 'boolean', label: 'Apply Time Filter', default: false, tooltip: 'Keeps signals only between the two times, read in the chart timezone.', group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (hour)', default: 9, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteFrom', type: 'number', label: 'Time From (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'hourTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (hour)', default: 10, min: 0, max: 23, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },
      { key: 'minuteTo', type: 'number', label: 'Time To (minute)', default: 15, min: 0, max: 59, step: 1, group: 'Additional Filters' },

      { key: 'showTable', type: 'boolean', label: 'Display Table', default: true, group: 'Data Table' },
      {
        key: 'tablePosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Position',
        default: 'bottom-right',
        options: [
          { label: 'Top Left', value: 'top-left' },
          { label: 'Top Center', value: 'top-center' },
          { label: 'Top Right', value: 'top-right' },
          { label: 'Middle Left', value: 'middle-left' },
          { label: 'Middle Center', value: 'middle-center' },
          { label: 'Middle Right', value: 'middle-right' },
          { label: 'Bottom Left', value: 'bottom-left' },
          { label: 'Bottom Center', value: 'bottom-center' },
          { label: 'Bottom Right', value: 'bottom-right' },
        ],
        group: 'Data Table',
      },
      {
        key: 'tableTextSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Size',
        default: 'normal',
        options: [
          { label: 'Auto', value: 'auto' },
          { label: 'Tiny', value: 'tiny' },
          { label: 'Small', value: 'small' },
          { label: 'Normal', value: 'normal' },
          { label: 'Large', value: 'large' },
          { label: 'Huge', value: 'huge' },
        ],
        group: 'Data Table',
      },
    ],

    // The first plot owns the markers layer, so it has to be one of the price
    // pane plots for the signal triangles to land on the candles.
    plots: [
      { key: 'stUp', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Up', overlay: true, style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'stDown', type: 'line', title: 'Supertrend Down', overlay: true, style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'topRange', type: 'step', title: 'Top Range', overlay: true, style: { color: POS, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'bottomRange', type: 'step', title: 'Bottom Range', overlay: true, style: { color: NEG, lineWidth: 1 } },
      { key: 'atr', type: 'line', title: 'ATR', style: { color: '#2962FF', lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'atrSma', type: 'line', title: 'ATR SMA', style: { color: '#FF6D00', lineWidth: 2 } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      const stAtrPeriod = intIn(settings.stAtrPeriod, 10, 1, 5000)
      const stFactor = numIn(settings.stFactor, 3, 0.01, 100)

      const rangeDisplay = settings.rangeDisplay !== false
      const rangeType = settings.rangeType === 'Type Points' ? 'Type Points' : 'Auto ATR'
      const rangePoints = numIn(settings.rangePoints, 120, 0.01, 1000000)
      const rangeAtrLength = intIn(settings.rangeAtrLength, 14, 1, 5000)
      const rangeSmoothing = String(settings.rangeAtrSmoothing // 'RMA')
      const rangeMultiplier = numIn(settings.rangeAtrMultiplier, 1.5, 1, 100)
      const rangeSmaLength = intIn(settings.rangeAtrSmaLength, 14, 1, 5000)

      const pchgFilterOn = settings.pchgFilter === true
      const pchgAboveBelow = numIn(settings.pchgAboveBelow, 2, 0, 1000)
      const volPchgFilterOn = settings.volPchgFilter === true
      const volPchgAbove = numIn(settings.volPchgAbove, 0, 0, 100000)
      const atrFilterOn = settings.atrFilter !== false
      const atrLength = intIn(settings.atrLength, 14, 1, 5000)
      const atrMulti = numIn(settings.atrMulti, 1, 1, 100)
      const bodyFilterOn = settings.bodyFilter === true
      const bodyPercent = numIn(settings.bodyPercent, 80, 0, 100) / 100
      const bodySizeFilterOn = settings.bodySizeFilter === true
      const bodySizeMultiplier = intIn(settings.bodySizeMultiplier, 2, 0, 1000)
      const volumeFilterOn = settings.volumeFilter === true
      const volSmaLength = intIn(settings.volSmaLength, 20, 1, 5000)
      const relVolFilterOn = settings.relVolFilter === true
      const relVolLength = intIn(settings.relVolLength, 90, 2, 5000)
      const relVolMultiplier = numIn(settings.relVolMultiplier, 5, 0, 1000)
      const timeFilterOn = settings.timeFilter === true
      const hourFrom = intIn(settings.hourFrom, 9, 0, 23)
      const minuteFrom = intIn(settings.minuteFrom, 15, 0, 59)
      const hourTo = intIn(settings.hourTo, 10, 0, 23)
      const minuteTo = intIn(settings.minuteTo, 15, 0, 59)

      // Bar times are UTC seconds and the Pine hour/minute are exchange wall
      // clock, so they only meet through a zone. Never the browser's own.
      const zone =
        typeof ctx?.timezone === 'string' && isValidTimezone(ctx.timezone)
          ? ctx.timezone
          : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE

      // barstate.isconfirmed: every historical bar is closed, and only the last
      // one can still be forming.
      const lastConfirmed = ctx?.barState?.isConfirmed !== false
      const confirmed = (i) => i < n - 1 // lastConfirmed

      const high = new Array(n)
      const low = new Array(n)
      const close = new Array(n)
      const open = new Array(n)
      const volume = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        high[i] = b.high
        low[i] = b.low
        close[i] = b.close
        open[i] = b.open
        // Index series carry no volume at all, which is Pine's na here too.
        volume[i] = Number.isFinite(b.volume) ? b.volume : NaN
      }

      // 1. Supertrend. The Pine script blanks the first bar's level.
      const st = supertrend(bars, stAtrPeriod, stFactor)
      const stValue = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const stDirection = new Array(n).fill(1)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        stValue[i] = i === 0 ? NaN : st[i].value
        stDirection[i] = st[i].direction
      }

      // 2. The range ATR, smoothed the way the settings ask, and its SMA.
      const tr = trueRange(high, low, close)
      let atrRange
      switch (rangeSmoothing) {
        case 'SMA':
          atrRange = sma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
          break
        // Pine's ta.ema seeds from the SMA of the first `length` values.
        case 'EMA':
          atrRange = smaSeededEma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
          break
        case 'WMA':
          atrRange = wma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
          break
        default:
          atrRange = rma(tr, rangeAtrLength)
      }
      const atrSmaArr = sma(atrRange, rangeSmaLength)

      // Filter series.
      const wilderAtr = atr(high, low, close, atrLength)
      const volSma = sma(volume, volSmaLength)
      const averageVolume = sma(volume, relVolLength)
      const relativeVolume = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        const prevAvg = averageVolume[i - 1]
        if (!Number.isFinite(prevAvg) // prevAvg === 0 // !Number.isFinite(volume[i])) continue
        relativeVolume[i] = volume[i] / prevAvg
      }
      const relVolSma = sma(relativeVolume, relVolLength)

      const stUp = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const stDown = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const topRange = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bottomRange = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const atrOut = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const atrSmaOut = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const longSignal = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const shortSignal = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const crossUp = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const crossDown = new Array(n).fill(0)
      const cumPchgOut = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const cumVolPchgOut = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const curVolOut = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const prevVolOut = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      // var-carried state, exactly as the Pine script carries it.
      let cumPchg = NaN
      let currentCumVol = NaN
      let prevCumVol = NaN
      let topPrice = NaN
      let bottomPrice = NaN
      let shortState = 0
      let longState = 0
      let prevDay = null

      const topRaw = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const bottomRaw = new Array(n).fill(NaN)

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const day = zonedDayIndex(bars[i].time, zone)
        // ta.change(time('D')) is na on the first bar, so it is not a new day.
        const isNewDay = prevDay !== null && day !== prevDay
        prevDay = day

        // Cumulative daily percentage change of the close.
        const prevClose = i > 0 ? close[i - 1] : NaN
        const dailyPct =
          Number.isFinite(prevClose) && prevClose !== 0 && Number.isFinite(close[i])
            ? ((close[i] - prevClose) / prevClose) * 100
            : 0
        cumPchg = isNewDay ? dailyPct : !Number.isFinite(cumPchg) ? dailyPct : cumPchg + dailyPct
        cumPchgOut[i] = cumPchg

        // Cumulative volume. The first partial day carries na in Pine, because
        // the running total starts na and na + volume is still na.
        if (isNewDay) {
          prevCumVol = currentCumVol
          currentCumVol = volume[i]
        } else {
          currentCumVol = currentCumVol + volume[i]
        }
        const volBase = Number.isFinite(prevCumVol) ? prevCumVol : currentCumVol
        const cumVolPchg =
          Number.isFinite(volBase) && volBase !== 0 && Number.isFinite(currentCumVol)
            ? ((currentCumVol - volBase) / volBase) * 100
            : NaN
        cumVolPchgOut[i] = cumVolPchg
        curVolOut[i] = currentCumVol
        prevVolOut[i] = prevCumVol

        // Additional filters. Every comparison against a NaN is false here, the
        // same way every comparison against na is false in Pine.
        const barRange = high[i] - low[i]
        const bodyRatio = barRange > 0 ? Math.abs(close[i] - open[i]) / barRange : NaN
        const prevRange = i > 0 ? high[i - 1] - low[i - 1] : NaN

        const pchgAboveFilter = pchgFilterOn ? cumPchg > pchgAboveBelow : true
        const pchgBelowFilter = pchgFilterOn ? cumPchg < -pchgAboveBelow : true
        const volPchgFilter = volPchgFilterOn ? cumVolPchg >= volPchgAbove : true
        const atrFilter = atrFilterOn ? barRange > wilderAtr[i] * atrMulti : true
        const bodyFilter = bodyFilterOn ? bodyRatio >= bodyPercent : true
        const bodySizeFilter = bodySizeFilterOn
          ? bodyRatio >= bodyPercent && barRange >= prevRange * bodySizeMultiplier
          : true
        const volumeFilter = volumeFilterOn ? volume[i] > volSma[i] : true
        const relVolFilter = relVolFilterOn
          ? relativeVolume[i] > relVolSma[i] * relVolMultiplier
          : true

        let timeFilter = true
        if (timeFilterOn) {
          const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bars[i].time, zone)
          const hour = parts.hour
          const minute = parts.minute
          timeFilter =
            (hour > hourFrom // (hour === hourFrom && minute >= minuteFrom)) &&
            (hour < hourTo // (hour === hourTo && minute < minuteTo))
        }

        // Condition 1: the Supertrend cross.
        const stNow = stValue[i]
        const stPrev = i > 0 ? stValue[i - 1] : NaN
        const crossable =
          i > 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(stNow) &&
          Number.isFinite(stPrev) &&
          Number.isFinite(close[i]) &&
          Number.isFinite(close[i - 1])
        const shortCont = crossable && close[i] < stNow && close[i - 1] >= stPrev && confirmed(i)
        const longCont = crossable && close[i] > stNow && close[i - 1] <= stPrev && confirmed(i)

        // The volatility range opened by that cross.
        const rangeSource = rangeType === 'Type Points' ? rangePoints : atrRange[i] * rangeMultiplier
        if (shortCont) {
          bottomPrice = close[i] - rangeSource
          topPrice = NaN
        }
        if (longCont) {
          topPrice = close[i] + rangeSource
          bottomPrice = NaN
        }
        topRaw[i] = topPrice
        bottomRaw[i] = bottomPrice

        // Condition 2: the break out of that range, with every filter agreeing.
        const risingAtr = atrRange[i] > atrSmaArr[i]
        const shortBreakCond =
          close[i] < bottomPrice &&
          open[i] > close[i] &&
          risingAtr &&
          pchgBelowFilter &&
          volPchgFilter &&
          atrFilter &&
          bodyFilter &&
          bodySizeFilter &&
          volumeFilter &&
          relVolFilter &&
          timeFilter &&
          confirmed(i)
        const longBreakCond =
          close[i] > topPrice &&
          open[i] < close[i] &&
          risingAtr &&
          pchgAboveFilter &&
          volPchgFilter &&
          atrFilter &&
          bodyFilter &&
          bodySizeFilter &&
          volumeFilter &&
          relVolFilter &&
          timeFilter &&
          confirmed(i)

        // Two-step state machines: the cross arms the setup, the break fires it,
        // and a fired state falls back to unarmed on the next bar.
        const bearPrevious = shortState
        shortState = bearPrevious === 2 ? 0 : bearPrevious
        if (shortCont && shortState === 0) shortState = 1
        if (shortBreakCond && shortState === 1) shortState = 2

        const bullPrevious = longState
        longState = bullPrevious === 2 ? 0 : bullPrevious
        if (longCont && longState === 0) longState = 1
        if (longBreakCond && longState === 1) longState = 2

        shortSignal[i] = shortState === 2 ? 1 : 0
        longSignal[i] = longState === 2 ? 1 : 0
        crossDown[i] = shortCont ? 1 : 0
        crossUp[i] = longCont ? 1 : 0

        if (Number.isFinite(stNow)) {
          if (stDirection[i] < 0) stUp[i] = stNow
          else stDown[i] = stNow
        }
        atrOut[i] = atrRange[i]
        atrSmaOut[i] = atrSmaArr[i]
      }

      // The historical range lines. Pine draws them only while the level is
      // unchanged from the previous bar, shifted one bar into the past by
      // offset=-1, so the step starts on the bar that opened the range.
      if (rangeDisplay) {
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
          if (Number.isFinite(topRaw[i]) && topRaw[i] === topRaw[i - 1]) topRange[i - 1] = topRaw[i]
          if (Number.isFinite(bottomRaw[i]) && bottomRaw[i] === bottomRaw[i - 1]) {
            bottomRange[i - 1] = bottomRaw[i]
          }
        }
      }

      return {
        stUp: nulls(stUp),
        stDown: nulls(stDown),
        topRange: nulls(topRange),
        bottomRange: nulls(bottomRange),
        atr: nulls(atrOut),
        atrSma: nulls(atrSmaOut),
        // Columns no plot draws, read by markers, barColors and the table.
        longSignal,
        shortSignal,
        crossUp,
        crossDown,
        cumPchg: nulls(cumPchgOut),
        cumVolPchg: nulls(cumVolPchgOut),
        curVol: nulls(curVolOut),
        prevVol: nulls(prevVolOut),
      }
    },

    markers({ bars, values }) {
      const out = []
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0) return out

      // atPrice adds no padding of its own, so the gap is scaled to the
      // instrument rather than fixed in points.
      let sumRange = 0
      let count = 0
      for (let i = Math.max(0, n - 50); i < n; i++) {
        const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
        if (Number.isFinite(r)) {
          sumRange += r
          count += 1
        }
      }
      const meanRange = count > 0 ? sumRange / count : 0
      const lastClose = bars[n - 1].close
      const pad = Math.max(meanRange * 0.5, Math.abs(Number.isFinite(lastClose) ? lastClose : 0) * 0.0005)

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (values.longSignal[i] === 1 && Number.isFinite(bars[i].low)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].low - pad,
            shape: 'triangleUp',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: POS_LIGHT,
          })
        }
        if (values.shortSignal[i] === 1 && Number.isFinite(bars[i].high)) {
          out.push({
            time: bars[i].time,
            position: 'atPrice',
            price: bars[i].high + pad,
            shape: 'triangleDown',
            size: 'tiny',
            color: NEG_LIGHT,
          })
        }
      }
      return out
    },

    // Two Pine barcolor() calls, the signal one written last so it wins.
    barColors({ bars, values }) {
      return bars.map((b, i) => {
        if (values.shortSignal[i] === 1) return NEG_LIGHT
        if (values.longSignal[i] === 1) return POS_LIGHT
        if (values.crossDown[i] === 1) return NEG_LIGHT
        if (values.crossUp[i] === 1) return POS_LIGHT
        return null
      })
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.showTable === false // bars.length === 0) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const at = (key) => {
        const v = values[key]?.[i]
        return v == null // !Number.isFinite(v) ? null : v
      }
      const pct = (v) => (v === null ? 'n/a' : `${v.toFixed(2)} %`)
      const lakhs = (v) => (v === null ? 'n/a' : `${(v / 100000).toFixed(2)} L`)

      const cumPchg = at('cumPchg')
      const cumVolPchg = at('cumVolPchg')
      const curVol = at('curVol')
      const prevVol = at('prevVol')

      const pchgCol = cumPchg !== null && cumPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const volPchgCol = cumVolPchg !== null && cumVolPchg > 0 ? POS : NEG
      const prevVolCol = prevVol !== null && curVol !== null && prevVol < curVol ? NEG : POS

      const fontSize = TEXT_SIZES[String(settings.tableTextSize ?? 'normal')] ?? TEXT_SIZES.normal
      const label = (text, bg) => ({ text, textColor: NEU, bgColor: bg, align: 'left' })
      const value = (text, colour, bg) => ({ text, textColor: colour, bgColor: bg, align: 'right' })

      return {
        rows: [
          [label('%Chg', NEU_DARK), value(pct(cumPchg), pchgCol, NEU_DARK)],
          [label('Vol %Chg', NEU_MID), value(pct(cumVolPchg), volPchgCol, NEU_MID)],
          [label('Vol', NEU_DARK), value(lakhs(curVol), volPchgCol, NEU_DARK)],
          [label('PD Vol', NEU_MID), value(lakhs(prevVol), prevVolCol, NEU_MID)],
        ],
        options: {
          position: String(settings.tablePosition ?? 'bottom-right | `oa-trend-following-setup---sideways-market-skipper` | `oa-trend-following-setup---sideways-market-skipper.js` | [source](https://github.com/ArunKBhaskar/PineScript/blob/c6821225c466494b01eee08f9dd88bf84d2b24ba/Trend) |

    plots: [
      {
        key: 'barRvolPlot',
        type: 'column',
        title: 'Same-time Bar RVOL',
        style: { color: COLOR_HISTOGRAM_BULL, base: 1, lineWidth: 1 },
        colorBy({ index, values, settings }) {
          const raw = values && values.barRvol ? values.barRvol[index] : NaN
          if (!Number.isFinite(raw)) return withAlpha(COLOR_NEUTRAL, 0.3)
          const quiet = num(settings && settings.quietRvolThreshold, 0.75, 0.1, 1)
          const extreme = num(settings && settings.extremeRvolThreshold, 1.75, 1, 10)
          if (raw >= 1) {
            const strength = fClamp((raw - 1) / Math.max(extreme - 1, 0.01), 0, 1)
            return withAlpha(COLOR_HISTOGRAM_BULL, 0.28 + 0.67 * strength)
          }
          const strength = fClamp((1 - raw) / Math.max(1 - quiet, 0.01), 0, 1)
          return withAlpha(COLOR_HISTOGRAM_BEAR, 0.28 + 0.64 * strength)
        },
      },
      { key: 'cumRvolPlot', type: 'line', title: 'Cumulative RVOL', style: { color: COLOR_PARTICIPATION, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'volRatioPlot', type: 'line', title: 'Realized Volatility Ratio', style: { color: COLOR_VOLATILITY, lineWidth: 2 } },
      { key: 'rangeRatioPlot', type: 'line', title: 'Developing Range Ratio', style: { color: COLOR_SECONDARY, lineWidth: 1 } },
    ],

    levels: () => [{ price: 1, title: 'Normal Baseline', color: withAlpha(COLOR_NEUTRAL, 0.45), dashed: true }],

    calc(bars, settings, _store, ctx) {
      const size = bars.length
      const column = () => new Array(size).fill(NaN)

      const enabled = settings.indicatorEnabled !== false
      const classifyOutside = settings.classifyOutsideRTH === true
      const showBarRvol = settings.showBarRvol !== false
      const showCumRvol = settings.showCumulativeRvol !== false
      const showVolRatio = settings.showRealizedVolRatio !== false
      const showRangeRatio = settings.showRangeRatio === true

      const zoneRaw = typeof settings.sessionTimezone === 'string' ? settings.sessionTimezone.trim() : ''
      const zone = isValidTimezone(zoneRaw) ? zoneRaw : DEFAULT_TZ
      const specRaw = typeof settings.rthSession === 'string' ? settings.rthSession.trim() : ''
      const sessionSpec = specRaw !== '' ? specRaw : DEFAULT_SESSION

      const rthOpenHour = int(settings.rthOpenHour, 9, 0, 23)
      const rthOpenMinute = int(settings.rthOpenMinute, 30, 0, 59)
      const baselineSessions = int(settings.baselineSessions, 40, 5, 60)
      const minimumBaselineSamples = int(settings.minimumBaselineSamples, 10, 3, 40)
      const maximumSupportedMinutes = int(settings.maximumSupportedMinutes, 30, 1, 60)

      const elevatedRvol = num(settings.elevatedRvolThreshold, 1.25, 1, 5)
      const extremeRvol = num(settings.extremeRvolThreshold, 1.75, 1, 10)
      const elevatedCumRvol = num(settings.elevatedCumulativeRvol, 1.15, 1, 5)
      const quietRvol = num(settings.quietRvolThreshold, 0.75, 0.1, 1)

      const realizedVolLength = int(settings.realizedVolLength, 30, 5, 300)
      const realizedVolBaselineLength = int(settings.realizedVolBaselineLength, 150, 20, 1000)
      const realizedVolZLength = int(settings.realizedVolZLength, 150, 20, 1000)
      const volatilityExpansionRatio = num(settings.volatilityExpansionRatio, 1.2, 1.01, 5)
      const volatilityContractionRatio = num(settings.volatilityContractionRatio, 0.8, 0.1, 0.99)

      const vwapSourceName = pickSource(settings.vwapSource, 'hlc3')
      const vwapSlopeLookback = int(settings.vwapSlopeLookback, 5, 1, 100)
      const vwapCrossLookback = int(settings.vwapCrossLookback, 20, 5, 200)
      const strongVwapSlopeAtr = num(settings.strongVwapSlopeAtr, 0.12, 0.01, 2)
      const vwapRotationZ = num(settings.vwapRotationZ, 0.55, 0.1, 3)
      const rotationCrossTarget = int(settings.rotationCrossTarget, 3, 1, 20)

      const emaSourceName = pickSource(settings.emaSource, 'close')
      const emaFastLength = int(settings.emaFastLength, 9, 1, 200)
      const emaMidLength = int(settings.emaMidLength, 20, 2, 300)
      const emaSlowLength = int(settings.emaSlowLength, 50, 3, 500)
      const emaSlopeLookback = int(settings.emaSlopeLookback, 5, 1, 100)
      const emaCompressionAtr = num(settings.emaCompressionAtr, 0.18, 0.01, 3)
      const emaExpansionAtr = num(settings.emaExpansionAtr, 0.65, 0.05, 5)

      const atrLength = int(settings.atrLength, 14, 2, 200)
      const diLength = int(settings.diLength, 14, 2, 100)
      const adxSmoothing = int(settings.adxSmoothing, 14, 2, 100)
      const weakAdx = num(settings.weakAdx, 17, 1, 50)
      const strongAdx = num(settings.strongAdx, 28, 5, 80)
      const efficiencyLength = int(settings.efficiencyLength, 20, 2, 300)
      const weakEfficiency = num(settings.weakEfficiency, 0.22, 0.01, 0.9)
      const strongEfficiency = num(settings.strongEfficiency, 0.55, 0.05, 1)

      const directionThreshold = num(settings.directionThreshold, 0.34, 0.05, 0.9)
      const trendThreshold = num(settings.trendThreshold, 0.54, 0.05, 0.95)
      const expansionThreshold = num(settings.expansionThreshold, 0.56, 0.05, 0.95)
      const compressionThreshold = num(settings.compressionThreshold, 0.62, 0.05, 0.95)
      const balanceThreshold = num(settings.balanceThreshold, 0.58, 0.05, 0.95)
      const rangeExpansionRatio = num(settings.rangeExpansionRatio, 1.18, 1.01, 5)
      const rangeCompressionRatio = num(settings.rangeCompressionRatio, 0.78, 0.1, 0.99)

      const plotCap = num(settings.plotCap, 4, 1.5, 20)
      const minTick = Number(ctx && ctx.tickSize) // 0

      if (size === 0) {
        return {
          barRvolPlot: [], cumRvolPlot: [], volRatioPlot: [], rangeRatioPlot: [],
          barRvol: [], cumRvol: [], volRatio: [], rangeRatio: [], realizedVolZ: [],
          directionScore: [], trendQuality: [], expansionScore: [], compressionScore: [],
          balanceScore: [], vwapZ: [], emaSpreadAtr: [], efficiency: [], adx: [],
          regimeCode: [], regimeConfidence: [], inRth: [], slotSamples: [], supported: [],
          emaStateCode: [], vwapStateCode: [], participationCode: [], volatilityCode: [],
          trendStrengthCode: [], rangeStateCode: [], sessionPhaseCode: [],
        }
      }

      /* ---- price series and the studies that do not need the session ---- */

      const high = bars.map((b) => b.high)
      const low = bars.map((b) => b.low)
      const close = bars.map((b) => b.close)
      const open = bars.map((b) => b.open)
      const times = bars.map((b) => b.time)
      // nz(volume, 0.0). Index series carry no volume at all.
      const volume = bars.map((b) => (Number.isFinite(b.volume) ? b.volume : 0))

      const vwapSrc = sourceValues(bars, vwapSourceName)
      const emaSrc = sourceValues(bars, emaSourceName)

      const atrSeries = atr(high, low, close, atrLength)
      const emaFast = smaSeededEma(emaSrc, emaFastLength)
      const emaMid = smaSeededEma(emaSrc, emaMidLength)
      const emaSlow = smaSeededEma(emaSrc, emaSlowLength)

      const emaSpreadAtr = column()
      const emaFastSlopeAtr = column()
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const a = atrSeries[i]
        if (!Number.isFinite(a) // a <= 0) continue
        if (Number.isFinite(emaFast[i]) && Number.isFinite(emaMid[i]) && Number.isFinite(emaSlow[i])) {
          const maximum = Math.max(emaFast[i], Math.max(emaMid[i], emaSlow[i]))
          const minimum = Math.min(emaFast[i], Math.min(emaMid[i], emaSlow[i]))
          emaSpreadAtr[i] = (maximum - minimum) / a
        }
        const back = i - emaSlopeLookback
        if (back >= 0 && Number.isFinite(emaFast[i]) && Number.isFinite(emaFast[back])) {
          emaFastSlopeAtr[i] = (emaFast[i] - emaFast[back]) / a
        }
      }

      const trend = dmi(high, low, close, diLength, adxSmoothing)
      const plusDI = trend.plusDI
      const minusDI = trend.minusDI
      const adx = trend.adx

      // ta.sma(math.abs(ta.change(close)), len) * len. ta.change is na on bar 0,
      // so the first finite value lands one bar after the window fills.
      const absChange = column()
      for (let i = 1; i < size; i++) absChange[i] = Math.abs(close[i] - close[i - 1])
      const pathMean = sma(absChange, efficiencyLength)
      const efficiency = column()
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const totalPath = Number.isFinite(pathMean[i]) ? pathMean[i] * efficiencyLength : NaN
        const back = i - efficiencyLength
        if (!Number.isFinite(totalPath) // totalPath <= 0 // back < 0) continue
        efficiency[i] = Math.abs(close[i] - close[back]) / totalPath
      }

      const logReturnSquared = new Array(size).fill(0)
      for (let i = 1; i < size; i++) {
        if (close[i] > 0 && close[i - 1] > 0) {
          const r = Math.log(close[i] / close[i - 1])
          logReturnSquared[i] = r * r
        }
      }
      const varianceMean = sma(logReturnSquared, realizedVolLength)
      const realizedVolatility = new Array(size).fill(0)
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const variance = Number.isFinite(varianceMean[i]) ? varianceMean[i] * realizedVolLength : 0
        realizedVolatility[i] = Math.sqrt(Math.max(variance, 0))
      }
      const realizedVolBaseline = smaSeededEma(realizedVolatility, realizedVolBaselineLength)
      const volRatio = column()
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) volRatio[i] = safeRatio(realizedVolatility[i], realizedVolBaseline[i])
      const realizedVolZ = zscore(realizedVolatility, realizedVolZLength)

      /* ---- the session pass: RTH state, same-time baselines, session VWAP ---- */

      const tfSeconds = timeframeSeconds(bars, ctx)
      const isIntraday = tfSeconds > 0 && tfSeconds < 86400
      const tfMinutes = isIntraday ? Math.round(tfSeconds / 60) : 0
      const supported = isIntraday && tfSeconds >= 60 && tfMinutes <= maximumSupportedMinutes

      const inSession = sessionFlags(times, sessionSpec, zone)

      const slotVolumeHistory = new Array(MAX_RTH_SLOTS * baselineSessions).fill(NaN)
      const slotRangeHistory = new Array(MAX_RTH_SLOTS * baselineSessions).fill(NaN)
      const slotVolumeSums = new Array(MAX_RTH_SLOTS).fill(0)
      const slotRangeSums = new Array(MAX_RTH_SLOTS).fill(0)
      const slotSampleCounts = new Array(MAX_RTH_SLOTS).fill(0)
      const slotWriteIndices = new Array(MAX_RTH_SLOTS).fill(0)

      let rthOpenPrice = NaN
      let rthHigh = NaN
      let rthLow = NaN
      let sessionCumulativeVolume = 0
      let expectedCumulativeVolume = 0
      let vwapCumulativeVolume = 0
      let vwapCumulativePV = 0
      let vwapCumulativeP2V = 0

      const barRvol = column()
      const cumRvol = column()
      const rangeRatio = column()
      const vwapSeries = column()
      const vwapZ = column()
      const slotSamplesCol = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const slotIndex = new Array(size).fill(-1)
      const baselineReadyCol = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const rthOpenCol = column()
      const inRthCol = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const phaseMinutes = new Array(size).fill(0)

      let previousInRth = false
      let previousDateKey = NaN

      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(times[i], zone)
        const dateKey = parts.year * 10000 + parts.month * 100 + parts.day
        phaseMinutes[i] = parts.hour * 60 + parts.minute
        const cur = inSession[i] === true
        inRthCol[i] = cur ? 1 : 0
        const newRth = cur && (!previousInRth // dateKey !== previousDateKey)

        let slot = -1
        if (cur && supported && tfSeconds > 0) {
          const rthStart = zonedWallClockToUtcSeconds(
            parts.year, parts.month, parts.day, rthOpenHour, rthOpenMinute, 0, zone
          )
          slot = Math.floor((times[i] - rthStart) / tfSeconds)
        }
        const validSlot = slot >= 0 && slot < MAX_RTH_SLOTS
        slotIndex[i] = validSlot ? slot : -1

        const samples = validSlot ? slotSampleCounts[slot] : 0
        const slotVolumeAverage = validSlot && samples > 0 ? slotVolumeSums[slot] / samples : NaN
        const slotRangeAverage = validSlot && samples > 0 ? slotRangeSums[slot] / samples : NaN
        const baselineReady = validSlot && samples >= minimumBaselineSamples
        slotSamplesCol[i] = samples
        baselineReadyCol[i] = baselineReady ? 1 : 0

        if (newRth) {
          rthOpenPrice = open[i]
          rthHigh = high[i]
          rthLow = low[i]
          sessionCumulativeVolume = volume[i]
          expectedCumulativeVolume = nz(slotVolumeAverage)
        } else if (cur) {
          rthHigh = !Number.isFinite(rthHigh) ? high[i] : Math.max(rthHigh, high[i])
          rthLow = !Number.isFinite(rthLow) ? low[i] : Math.min(rthLow, low[i])
          sessionCumulativeVolume += volume[i]
          expectedCumulativeVolume += nz(slotVolumeAverage)
        }
        rthOpenCol[i] = rthOpenPrice

        const developingRange =
          cur && Number.isFinite(rthHigh) && Number.isFinite(rthLow) ? rthHigh - rthLow : NaN
        if (cur && baselineReady) {
          barRvol[i] = safeRatio(volume[i], slotVolumeAverage)
          rangeRatio[i] = safeRatio(developingRange, slotRangeAverage)
          if (expectedCumulativeVolume > 0) {
            cumRvol[i] = sessionCumulativeVolume / expectedCumulativeVolume
          }
        }

        // Pine writes the slot ring on barstate.isconfirmed, after the values
        // above have been read, so a bar never counts towards its own baseline.
        // Over a historical recompute every bar is confirmed.
        if (cur && validSlot) {
          const writeIndex = slotWriteIndices[slot]
          const historyIndex = slot * baselineSessions + writeIndex
          const existingCount = slotSampleCounts[slot]
          const oldVolume = slotVolumeHistory[historyIndex]
          const oldRange = slotRangeHistory[historyIndex]
          const currentVolume = volume[i]
          const currentRange = nz(developingRange)

          slotVolumeHistory[historyIndex] = currentVolume
          slotRangeHistory[historyIndex] = currentRange
          if (existingCount < baselineSessions) {
            slotVolumeSums[slot] += currentVolume
            slotRangeSums[slot] += currentRange
            slotSampleCounts[slot] = existingCount + 1
          } else {
            slotVolumeSums[slot] += currentVolume - nz(oldVolume)
            slotRangeSums[slot] += currentRange - nz(oldRange)
          }
          slotWriteIndices[slot] = (writeIndex + 1) % baselineSessions
        }

        if (newRth) {
          vwapCumulativeVolume = 0
          vwapCumulativePV = 0
          vwapCumulativeP2V = 0
        }
        if (cur) {
          const barVolume = volume[i]
          const price = Number.isFinite(vwapSrc[i]) ? vwapSrc[i] : 0
          vwapCumulativeVolume += barVolume
          vwapCumulativePV += price * barVolume
          vwapCumulativeP2V += price * price * barVolume
        }
        const vwap = vwapCumulativeVolume > 0 ? vwapCumulativePV / vwapCumulativeVolume : NaN
        vwapSeries[i] = vwap
        if (Number.isFinite(vwap)) {
          const variance = Math.max(vwapCumulativeP2V / vwapCumulativeVolume - vwap * vwap, 0)
          const deviation = Math.sqrt(variance)
          if (cur && Number.isFinite(deviation) && deviation > minTick) {
            vwapZ[i] = (close[i] - vwap) / deviation
          }
        }

        previousInRth = cur
        previousDateKey = dateKey
      }

      /* ---- VWAP slope, crossings and the regime engine ---- */

      const vwapSlopeAtr = column()
      const crossSeries = new Array(size).fill(0)
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const a = atrSeries[i]
        const back = i - vwapSlopeLookback
        if (
          inRthCol[i] === 1 && slotIndex[i] >= vwapSlopeLookback && back >= 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(a) && a > 0 &&
          Number.isFinite(vwapSeries[i]) && Number.isFinite(vwapSeries[back])
        ) {
          vwapSlopeAtr[i] = (vwapSeries[i] - vwapSeries[back]) / a
        }
        if (i > 0 && inRthCol[i] === 1) {
          const a1 = close[i - 1]
          const b1 = vwapSeries[i - 1]
          const a2 = close[i]
          const b2 = vwapSeries[i]
          if (Number.isFinite(a1) && Number.isFinite(b1) && Number.isFinite(a2) && Number.isFinite(b2)) {
            if ((a1 <= b1 && a2 > b2) // (a1 >= b1 && a2 < b2)) crossSeries[i] = 1
          }
        }
      }
      const crossMean = sma(crossSeries, vwapCrossLookback)

      const directionScore = column()
      const trendQuality = column()
      const expansionScore = column()
      const compressionScore = column()
      const balanceScore = column()
      const regimeCode = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const regimeConfidence = column()
      const emaStateCode = new Array(size).fill(7)
      const vwapStateCode = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const participationCode = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const volatilityCode = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const trendStrengthCode = new Array(size).fill(2)
      const rangeStateCode = new Array(size).fill(0)
      const sessionPhaseCode = new Array(size).fill(0)

      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        const cur = inRthCol[i] === 1
        const ready = baselineReadyCol[i] === 1
        const spread = emaSpreadAtr[i]
        const slope = vwapSlopeAtr[i]
        const eff = efficiency[i]
        const adxValue = adx[i]
        const vwap = vwapSeries[i]
        const crossCount = Number.isFinite(crossMean[i]) ? crossMean[i] * vwapCrossLookback : NaN

        const bullStack = emaFast[i] > emaMid[i] && emaMid[i] > emaSlow[i]
        const bearStack = emaFast[i] < emaMid[i] && emaMid[i] < emaSlow[i]
        const compressed = Number.isFinite(spread) && spread <= emaCompressionAtr
        const expanded = Number.isFinite(spread) && spread >= emaExpansionAtr

        emaStateCode[i] = compressed ? 0
          : bullStack && expanded && emaFastSlopeAtr[i] > 0 ? 1
          : bearStack && expanded && emaFastSlopeAtr[i] < 0 ? 2
          : bullStack && close[i] < emaFast[i] && close[i] >= emaMid[i] ? 3
          : bearStack && close[i] > emaFast[i] && close[i] <= emaMid[i] ? 4
          : bullStack ? 5
          : bearStack ? 6
          : 7

        const rotating =
          cur && Number.isFinite(vwapZ[i]) && Math.abs(vwapZ[i]) <= vwapRotationZ &&
          crossCount >= rotationCrossTarget
        vwapStateCode[i] = !cur // !Number.isFinite(vwap) ? 0
          : rotating ? 1
          : close[i] > vwap && nz(slope) > 0 ? 2
          : close[i] < vwap && nz(slope) < 0 ? 3
          : close[i] > vwap ? 4
          : 5

        const emaDirection = bullStack ? 1 : bearStack ? -1 : close[i] >= emaMid[i] ? 0.25 : -0.25
        const vwapDirection = cur && Number.isFinite(vwap)
          ? (close[i] >= vwap ? 0.6 : -0.6) +
            (nz(slope) > 0.02 ? 0.4 : nz(slope) < -0.02 ? -0.4 : 0)
          : 0
        const diDirection = plusDI[i] > minusDI[i] ? 0.7 : plusDI[i] < minusDI[i] ? -0.7 : 0
        const effBack = i - efficiencyLength
        const efficiencyDirection = Number.isFinite(eff)
          ? eff * (effBack >= 0 && close[i] >= close[effBack] ? 0.7 : -0.7)
          : 0
        // Relative strength needs a second instrument, which a chart study
        // cannot request here, so its contribution is the Pine value for
        // "not ready", which is zero.
        const relativeDirection = 0
        const openDirection = cur && Number.isFinite(rthOpenCol[i])
          ? (close[i] >= rthOpenCol[i] ? 0.35 : -0.35)
          : 0
        const directionRaw =
          emaDirection + vwapDirection + diDirection + efficiencyDirection +
          relativeDirection + openDirection
        const direction = fClamp(directionRaw / DIRECTION_MAXIMUM, -1, 1)
        directionScore[i] = direction

        const adxScore = fClamp((adxValue - weakAdx) / Math.max(strongAdx - weakAdx, 0.1), 0, 1)
        const efficiencyScore = fClamp(
          (nz(eff) - weakEfficiency) / Math.max(strongEfficiency - weakEfficiency, 0.01), 0, 1
        )
        const emaSeparationScore = fClamp(nz(spread) / Math.max(emaExpansionAtr, 0.01), 0, 1)
        const vwapSlopeScore = fClamp(Math.abs(nz(slope)) / Math.max(strongVwapSlopeAtr, 0.01), 0, 1)
        const quality =
          adxScore * 0.35 + efficiencyScore * 0.3 + emaSeparationScore * 0.2 + vwapSlopeScore * 0.15
        trendQuality[i] = quality

        const volatilityExpansionScore = fClamp(
          (nz(volRatio[i]) - 1) / Math.max(volatilityExpansionRatio - 1, 0.01), 0, 1
        )
        const rangeExpansionScore = fClamp(
          (nz(rangeRatio[i]) - 1) / Math.max(rangeExpansionRatio - 1, 0.01), 0, 1
        )
        const cumulativeParticipationScore = fClamp(
          (nz(cumRvol[i]) - 1) / Math.max(elevatedCumRvol - 1, 0.01), 0, 1
        )
        const barParticipationScore = fClamp(
          (nz(barRvol[i]) - 1) / Math.max(elevatedRvol - 1, 0.01), 0, 1
        )
        let expansionNumerator = volatilityExpansionScore * 0.35
        let expansionDenominator = 0.35
        if (Number.isFinite(rangeRatio[i])) {
          expansionNumerator += rangeExpansionScore * 0.3
          expansionDenominator += 0.3
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(cumRvol[i])) {
          expansionNumerator += cumulativeParticipationScore * 0.2
          expansionDenominator += 0.2
        }
        if (Number.isFinite(barRvol[i])) {
          expansionNumerator += barParticipationScore * 0.15
          expansionDenominator += 0.15
        }
        const expansion = expansionDenominator > 0 ? expansionNumerator / expansionDenominator : 0
        expansionScore[i] = expansion

        const emaCompressionScore = 1 - fClamp(nz(spread) / Math.max(emaCompressionAtr, 0.01), 0, 1)
        const adxCompressionScore = 1 - fClamp(adxValue / Math.max(weakAdx, 0.1), 0, 1)
        const volatilityCompressionScore =
          1 - fClamp((nz(volRatio[i]) - 0.55) / Math.max(1 - 0.55, 0.01), 0, 1)
        const rangeCompressionScore = Number.isFinite(rangeRatio[i])
          ? 1 - fClamp((rangeRatio[i] - 0.45) / Math.max(rangeCompressionRatio - 0.45, 0.01), 0, 1)
          : 0
        const efficiencyCompressionScore = 1 - fClamp(nz(eff) / Math.max(weakEfficiency, 0.01), 0, 1)
        const compression =
          emaCompressionScore * 0.3 + adxCompressionScore * 0.2 + volatilityCompressionScore * 0.2 +
          rangeCompressionScore * 0.15 + efficiencyCompressionScore * 0.15
        compressionScore[i] = compression

        const crossRotationScore = fClamp(crossCount / Math.max(rotationCrossTarget, 1), 0, 1)
        const vwapNearScore = 1 - fClamp(Math.abs(nz(vwapZ[i])) / 1.5, 0, 1)
        const lowEfficiencyScore = 1 - fClamp(nz(eff) / Math.max(strongEfficiency, 0.01), 0, 1)
        const lowDirectionScore = 1 - Math.abs(direction)
        const balance =
          crossRotationScore * 0.3 + vwapNearScore * 0.25 + lowEfficiencyScore * 0.25 +
          lowDirectionScore * 0.2
        balanceScore[i] = balance

        const directional = Math.abs(direction) >= directionThreshold
        const trending = quality >= trendThreshold && directional
        const expanding = expansion >= expansionThreshold
        const compressing = compression >= compressionThreshold
        const balanced = balance >= balanceThreshold

        let code = 0
        if (!cur && !classifyOutside) code = 9
        else if (compressing && !expanding) code = 4
        else if (expanding && directional) code = direction > 0 ? 2 : -2
        else if (trending) code = direction > 0 ? 1 : -1
        else if (balanced) code = 3
        else if (expanding) code = 5
        regimeCode[i] = code

        const maximumCompeting =
          Math.max(quality, Math.max(expansion, Math.max(compression, balance)))
        let agreement
        if (code === 2 // code === -2) agreement = (expansion + quality + Math.abs(direction)) / 3
        else if (code === 1 // code === -1) agreement = (quality + Math.abs(direction) + (1 - balance)) / 3
        else if (code === 3) agreement = balance
        else if (code === 4) agreement = compression
        else if (code === 5) agreement = expansion
        else if (code === 9) agreement = 1
        else agreement = fClamp(1.2 - maximumCompeting, 0.35, 0.72)
        regimeConfidence[i] = Math.round(fClamp(agreement, 0, 1) * 100)

        participationCode[i] = !cur ? 0
          : !ready ? 1
          : nz(barRvol[i]) >= extremeRvol ? 2
          : nz(barRvol[i]) >= elevatedRvol // nz(cumRvol[i]) >= elevatedCumRvol ? 3
          : nz(barRvol[i]) <= quietRvol && nz(cumRvol[i]) <= quietRvol ? 4
          : 5
        volatilityCode[i] = !Number.isFinite(volRatio[i]) ? 0
          : volRatio[i] >= volatilityExpansionRatio ? 1
          : volRatio[i] <= volatilityContractionRatio ? 2
          : 3
        trendStrengthCode[i] = adxValue >= strongAdx ? 0 : adxValue <= weakAdx ? 1 : 2
        rangeStateCode[i] = !cur ? 0
          : !ready ? 1
          : nz(rangeRatio[i]) >= rangeExpansionRatio ? 2
          : nz(rangeRatio[i]) <= rangeCompressionRatio ? 3
          : 4
        const minutes = phaseMinutes[i]
        sessionPhaseCode[i] = !cur ? 0
          : minutes < 600 ? 1
          : minutes < 660 ? 2
          : minutes < 840 ? 3
          : minutes < 900 ? 4
          : 5
      }

      /* ---- plot columns ---- */

      const cap = (value, show) =>
        (enabled && show && Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.min(value, plotCap) : NaN)
      const barRvolPlot = column()
      const cumRvolPlot = column()
      const volRatioPlot = column()
      const rangeRatioPlot = column()
      for (let i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        barRvolPlot[i] = cap(barRvol[i], showBarRvol)
        cumRvolPlot[i] = cap(cumRvol[i], showCumRvol)
        volRatioPlot[i] = cap(volRatio[i], showVolRatio)
        rangeRatioPlot[i] = cap(rangeRatio[i], showRangeRatio)
      }

      return {
        barRvolPlot: nulls(barRvolPlot),
        cumRvolPlot: nulls(cumRvolPlot),
        volRatioPlot: nulls(volRatioPlot),
        rangeRatioPlot: nulls(rangeRatioPlot),
        barRvol,
        cumRvol,
        volRatio,
        rangeRatio,
        realizedVolZ,
        directionScore,
        trendQuality,
        expansionScore,
        compressionScore,
        balanceScore,
        vwapZ,
        emaSpreadAtr,
        efficiency,
        adx,
        regimeCode,
        regimeConfidence,
        inRth: inRthCol,
        slotSamples: slotSamplesCol,
        supported: new Array(size).fill(supported ? 1 : 0),
        emaStateCode,
        vwapStateCode,
        participationCode,
        volatilityCode,
        trendStrengthCode,
        rangeStateCode,
        sessionPhaseCode,
      }
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return null
      if (settings.indicatorEnabled === false // settings.showDashboard === false) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const at = (key) => {
        const col = values[key]
        return col ? col[i] : NaN
      }
      const baselineSessions = int(settings.baselineSessions, 40, 5, 60)
      const regime = REGIME_TEXT[String(at('regimeCode'))] // 'Transition'
      const confidence = at('regimeConfidence')
      const samples = at('slotSamples')
      const supported = at('supported') === 1

      return {
        rows: [
          ['Regime', regime + ' (' + (Number.isFinite(confidence) ? confidence + '%' : 'n/a') + ')'],
          ['Bias', signedText(at('directionScore') * 100, 1)],
          ['Participation', PARTICIPATION_TEXT[at('participationCode')] // 'n/a'],
          ['RVOL bar / cum', ratioText(at('barRvol')) + '   ' + ratioText(at('cumRvol'))],
          ['Trend structure',
            (EMA_TEXT[at('emaStateCode')] // 'n/a') + '   ' + (TREND_TEXT[at('trendStrengthCode')] // 'n/a')],
          ['ADX / efficiency', numberText(at('adx'), 1) + '   ' + numberText(at('efficiency'), 2)],
          ['Volatility', VOLATILITY_TEXT[at('volatilityCode')] // 'n/a'],
          ['RV ratio / z', ratioText(at('volRatio')) + '   ' + signedText(at('realizedVolZ'), 2)],
          ['Location / range',
            (VWAP_TEXT[at('vwapStateCode')] // 'n/a') + '   ' + (RANGE_TEXT[at('rangeStateCode')] // 'n/a')],
          ['VWAP z / range', signedText(at('vwapZ'), 2) + '   ' + ratioText(at('rangeRatio'))],
          ['EMA spread / ATR', numberText(at('emaSpreadAtr'), 2)],
          ['Scores T/E/C/B',
            numberText(at('trendQuality'), 2) + '  ' + numberText(at('expansionScore'), 2) + '  ' +
            numberText(at('compressionScore'), 2) + '  ' + numberText(at('balanceScore'), 2)],
          ['Relative strength', 'Not available on a single-symbol study'],
          [
            'Session',
            supported
              ? (PHASE_TEXT[at('sessionPhaseCode')] // 'n/a') + '   samples ' +
                (Number.isFinite(samples) ? samples : 0) + '/' + baselineSessions
              : 'Unsupported timeframe for same-time RVOL. Use 1m, 5m or 15m.',
          ],
        ],
      }
    },

    alerts: [

        message: 'Meridian Futures Context: the confirmed RTH regime changed.',
        when({ values, index }) {
          if (index < 1) return false
          const code = values.regimeCode
          const rth = values.inRth
          if (!code // !rth) return false
          return rth[index] === 1 && Number.isFinite(code[index]) &&
            Number.isFinite(code[index - 1]) && code[index] !== code[index - 1]
        },
      },

          const col = values.barRvol
          const rth = values.inRth
          if (!col // !rth) return false
          const threshold = num(settings.alertRvolThreshold, 2, 1, 20)
          const current = col[index]
          const previous = index > 0 ? col[index - 1] : NaN
          return rth[index] === 1 && Number.isFinite(current) && current >= threshold &&
            nz(previous) < threshold
        },
      },
