      {
        id: 'level-rejected-up',
        title: 'Meridian - Bullish level rejection',
        message: 'Meridian Futures Levels: bullish rejection from a tracked level.',
        when: ({ values, index }) => values.eventCode?.[index] === 2,
      },
      {
        id: 'level-rejected-down',
        title: 'Meridian - Bearish level rejection',
        message: 'Meridian Futures Levels: bearish rejection from a tracked level.',
        when: ({ values, index }) => values.eventCode?.[index] === -2,
      },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length

      /* ---- inputs, coerced. A cleared field arrives as '', and Number('') is 0,
       * so every numeric read is clamped to the declared minimum. */
      const enabled = settings.enabled !== false
      const zoneRaw = typeof settings.timezone === 'string' ? settings.timezone.trim() : ''
      const zone = zoneRaw !== '' && isValidTimezone(zoneRaw) ? zoneRaw : DEFAULT_ZONE

      const futSpec = parseSessionSpec(String(settings.futuresSession ?? '')) ?? parseSessionSpec(DEFAULT_FUTURES)
      const onSpec = parseSessionSpec(String(settings.overnightSession ?? '')) ?? parseSessionSpec(DEFAULT_OVERNIGHT)
      const rthSpec = parseSessionSpec(String(settings.rthSession ?? '')) ?? parseSessionSpec(DEFAULT_RTH)

      const rthOpenHour = int(settings.rthOpenHour, 9, 0, 23)
      const rthOpenMinute = int(settings.rthOpenMinute, 30, 0, 59)
      const showSessionOpens = settings.showSessionOpens !== false
      const showOvernight = settings.showOvernight !== false
      const showOvernightMid = settings.showOvernightMid === true

      const showOR = settings.showOR !== false
      const orDuration = pick(settings.openingRangeDuration, ['1 Minute', '5 Minutes', '15 Minutes', '30 Minutes'], '15 Minutes')
      const orMinutes = orDuration === '1 Minute' ? 1 : orDuration === '5 Minutes' ? 5 : orDuration === '30 Minutes' ? 30 : 15
      const showORDeveloping = settings.showORDeveloping !== false
      const showORMid = settings.showORMid !== false

      const showIB = settings.showIB !== false
      const ibMinutes = int(settings.initialBalanceMinutes, 60, 1, 240)
      const showIBDeveloping = settings.showIBDeveloping === true
      const showIBMid = settings.showIBMid !== false

      const showTimeMarkers = settings.showTimeMarkers !== false

      const showVWAP = settings.showVWAP !== false
      const vwapAnchor = pick(settings.vwapAnchor, ['RTH', 'Full Futures Session', 'Week'], 'RTH')
      const vwapSourceName = SOURCES.has(settings.vwapSource) ? settings.vwapSource : 'hlc3'
      const deviationMethod = pick(settings.deviationMethod, ['Volume-weighted', 'Unweighted'], 'Volume-weighted')
      const carryVWAP = settings.carryVWAP === true
      const showBand1 = settings.showBand1 !== false
      const showBand2 = settings.showBand2 !== false
      const showBand3 = settings.showBand3 === true
      const bandMult1 = num(settings.bandMult1, 1, 0.1, 20)
      const bandMult2 = num(settings.bandMult2, 2, 0.1, 20)
      const bandMult3 = num(settings.bandMult3, 3, 0.1, 20)

      const showPreviousDay = settings.showPreviousDay !== false
      const previousDayBasis = pick(settings.previousDayBasis, ['Exchange daily bar', 'Custom RTH session'], 'Exchange daily bar')
      const showPreviousWeek = settings.showPreviousWeek !== false

      const showFib = settings.showFib === true
      const fibAnchor = pick(settings.fibAnchor, ['Opening Range', 'Initial Balance', 'Overnight', 'Previous Day', 'Previous Week'], 'Initial Balance')
      const showFibRetracements = settings.showFibRetracements !== false
      const showFibExtensions = settings.showFibExtensions !== false
      const fibRetrace1 = num(settings.fibRetrace1, 0.382, 0, 1)
      const fibRetrace2 = num(settings.fibRetrace2, 0.5, 0, 1)
      const fibRetrace3 = num(settings.fibRetrace3, 0.618, 0, 1)
      const fibProjection1 = num(settings.fibProjection1, 0.272, 0, 5)
      const fibProjection2 = num(settings.fibProjection2, 0.618, 0, 5)
      const fibProjection3 = num(settings.fibProjection3, 1, 0, 5)

      const clusterAtrLength = int(settings.clusterAtrLength, 14, 2, 200)
      const showStates = settings.showStates !== false
      const stateToleranceMode = pick(settings.stateToleranceMode, ['Ticks', 'ATR'], 'Ticks')
      const stateTouchTicks = num(settings.stateTouchTicks, 4, 0.25, 500)
      const stateAtrLength = int(settings.stateAtrLength, 14, 2, 200)
      const stateTouchAtr = num(settings.stateTouchAtr, 0.04, 0.001, 1)
      const stateAcceptTicks = num(settings.stateAcceptTicks, 2, 0, 500)
      const stateAcceptCloses = int(settings.stateAcceptCloses, 2, 1, 10)
      const stateMinimumWick = num(settings.stateMinimumWick, 0.08, 0, 2)
      const stateCooldownBars = int(settings.stateCooldownBars, 3, 0, 100)

      /* ---- columns. Every one is exactly bars.length long. */
      const gaps = () => new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      const zeros = () => new Array(n).fill(0)
      const out = {
        orHigh: gaps(), orLow: gaps(), orMid: gaps(),
        ibHigh: gaps(), ibLow: gaps(), ibMid: gaps(),
        onHigh: gaps(), onLow: gaps(), onMid: gaps(),
        futOpen: gaps(), rthOpen: gaps(),
        vwap: gaps(), vu1: gaps(), vl1: gaps(), vu2: gaps(), vl2: gaps(), vu3: gaps(), vl3: gaps(),
        pdh: gaps(), pdl: gaps(), pwh: gaps(), pwl: gaps(),
        fibR1: gaps(), fibR2: gaps(), fibR3: gaps(),
        fibU1: gaps(), fibU2: gaps(), fibU3: gaps(),
        fibD1: gaps(), fibD2: gaps(), fibD3: gaps(),
      }
      /* Columns no plot declares. markers, draws, background, table and alerts
       * are handed `values` and never `store`, so everything they read has to
       * come back from calc. */
      const extra = {
        sessMask: zeros(),
        eventCode: zeros(), eventPrice: gaps(), eventName: zeros(),
        stPdh: zeros(), stPdl: zeros(), stPwh: zeros(), stPwl: zeros(),
        stOrh: zeros(), stOrl: zeros(), stIbh: zeros(), stIbl: zeros(),
        stOnh: zeros(), stOnl: zeros(), stVwap: zeros(),
        rawOrHigh: gaps(), rawOrLow: gaps(), rawOrMid: gaps(),
        rawIbHigh: gaps(), rawIbLow: gaps(), rawIbMid: gaps(),
        /* The carried values behind the session plots. The plots themselves go
         * blank outside the session that owns them, but the clustering engine
         * reads the level itself, which survives the session that set it. */
        rawOnHigh: gaps(), rawOnLow: gaps(), rawRthOpen: gaps(), rawFutOpen: gaps(),
        flagOrDisp: zeros(), flagIbDisp: zeros(), flagOrState: zeros(), flagIbState: zeros(),
        flagVwapVis: zeros(), flagFibReady: zeros(),
        clusterAtr: gaps(), stateAtr: gaps(), markerAtr: gaps(), dayHigh: gaps(),
        markerHit: zeros(), markerTs: gaps(),
        orStartT: gaps(), ibStartT: gaps(), rthEndT: gaps(),
        tick: zeros(), tfWarn: zeros(),
      }
      if (n === 0 // !enabled) {
        const off = {}
        for (const k of Object.keys(out)) off[k] = new Array(n).fill(null)
        for (const k of Object.keys(extra)) off[k] = extra[k]
        return off
      }

      /* ---- zoned time, cheaply.
       * A zone offset only changes on an hour boundary, so one lookup per hour
       * bucket is exact and turns a per-bar Intl format into plain UTC maths. */
      const offsetCache = new Map()
      const offsetFor = (t) => {
        const h = Math.floor(t / 3600)
        let o = offsetCache.get(h)
        if (o === undefined) {
          o = zoneOffsetSeconds(t, zone)
          offsetCache.set(h, o)
        }
        return o
      }
      const partsFor = (t) => {
        const d = new Date((t + offsetFor(t)) * 1000)
        return {
          year: d.getUTCFullYear(), month: d.getUTCMonth() + 1, day: d.getUTCDate(),
          hour: d.getUTCHours(), minute: d.getUTCMinutes(), weekday: d.getUTCDay(),
        }
      }
      const dayIndexCache = new Map()
      const dayIndexFor = (t) => {
        const h = Math.floor(t / 3600)
        let v = dayIndexCache.get(h)
        if (v === undefined) {
          v = zonedDayIndex(t, zone)
          dayIndexCache.set(h, v)
        }
        return v
      }
      /* The trading day, which is what a futures daily candle covers and what
       * Pine's request.security(..., "D") returns. It is NOT the calendar day: a
       * session that wraps past midnight, such as 1800-1700, puts everything
       * from the 18:00 open onwards on the next day's bar.
       *
       * This has to come off the wall clock rather than off a gap between two
       * bars, because a futures feed carries no bars at all during the daily
       * maintenance halt, so the session it belongs to never visibly changes. */
      const futWraps = !!futSpec && futSpec.end <= futSpec.start
      const futStartMinute = futSpec ? futSpec.start : 1080
      const tradingDayFor = (t, parts) =>
        dayIndexFor(t) + (futWraps && parts.hour * 60 + parts.minute >= futStartMinute ? 1 : 0)
      /* Day index 0 is a Thursday, so +3 lands a Monday-start week bucket. */
      const tradingWeekOf = (day) => Math.floor((day + 3) / 7)
      /* Session membership depends only on the zoned weekday, hour and minute,
       * so one library call per distinct wall-clock slot answers every bar. */
      const memberCache = new Map()
      const inSpec = (t, parts, spec, specId) => {
        if (spec === null // spec === undefined) return false
        const key = specId * 10080 + parts.weekday * 1440 + parts.hour * 60 + parts.minute
        let v = memberCache.get(key)
        if (v === undefined) {
          v = inSessionAt(t, spec, zone)
          memberCache.set(key, v)
        }
        return v
      }
      const wallCache = new Map()
      const wallClock = (parts, hour, minute) => {
        const key = ((parts.year * 12 + parts.month) * 32 + parts.day) * 1440 + hour * 60 + minute
        let v = wallCache.get(key)
        if (v === undefined) {
          v = zonedWallClockToUtcSeconds(parts.year, parts.month, parts.day, hour, minute, 0, zone)
          wallCache.set(key, v)
        }
        return v
      }

      /* ---- bar spacing, which stands in for Pine's time_close. */
      let spacing = Infinity
      for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        const d = bars[i].time - bars[i - 1].time
        if (d > 0 && d < spacing) spacing = d
      }
      if (!Number.isFinite(spacing) // spacing <= 0) spacing = 300
      const declaredIntraday = typeof ctx?.interval === 'string' && ctx.interval !== ''
        ? isIntradayInterval(ctx.interval)
        : null
      const intraday = declaredIntraday === null ? spacing < 86400 : declaredIntraday === true

      /* ---- the instrument tick. The chart publishes it, so there is no input
       * for it. A host that never set minMove genuinely does not know, so fall
       * back to a hundred-thousandth of price, which is the right order of
       * magnitude for an index future. */
      const hostTick = Number(ctx?.tickSize)
      const lastClose = Math.abs(bars[n - 1].close)
      const tick = Number.isFinite(hostTick) && hostTick > 0
        ? hostTick
        : Math.max(Number.isFinite(lastClose) && lastClose > 0 ? lastClose * 1e-5 : 0, 1e-8)

      /* ---- series the engine needs. */
      const high = new Array(n)
      const low = new Array(n)
      const close = new Array(n)
      const open = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        high[i] = bars[i].high
        low[i] = bars[i].low
        close[i] = bars[i].close
        open[i] = bars[i].open
      }
      const src = sourceValues(bars, vwapSourceName)
      const clusterAtrSeries = atr(high, low, close, clusterAtrLength)
      const stateAtrSeries = atr(high, low, close, stateAtrLength)
      const markerAtrSeries = atr(high, low, close, 14)

      const fixedTouchTolerance = stateToleranceMode === 'ATR' ? null : stateTouchTicks * tick
      const stateAcceptBuffer = stateAcceptTicks * tick

      /* ---- carried state: the Pine `var` series. */
      let futuresOpen = NaN
      let rthOpenVal = NaN
      let rthHigh = NaN
      let rthLow = NaN
      let previousRthHigh = NaN
      let previousRthLow = NaN
      let overnightHigh = NaN
      let overnightLow = NaN
      let orHigh = NaN
      let orLow = NaN
      let ibHigh = NaN
      let ibLow = NaN
      let orStartTime = NaN
      let ibStartTime = NaN
      let rthEndTime = NaN
      /* The exchange daily bar, folded from the chart's own bars over the full
       * futures session: that session is exactly what a futures daily candle
       * covers, and folding it here avoids the lookahead a higher-timeframe
       * request against an unclosed bar would carry. */
      let futSessHigh = NaN
      let futSessLow = NaN
      let prevFutHigh = NaN
      let prevFutLow = NaN
      let weekHigh = NaN
      let weekLow = NaN
      let prevWeekHigh = NaN
      let prevWeekLow = NaN
      let weekBucket = null
      let tradingDayBucket = null
      let cumulativeVolume = 0
      let cumulativePV = 0
      let cumulativeP2V = 0
      let cumulativePrice = 0
      let cumulativePrice2 = 0
      let cumulativeBars = 0
      let dayKey = null
      let dayHi = NaN
      let prevInFutures = false
      let prevInOvernight = false
      let prevInRTH = false
      let prevInOR = false
      let prevInIB = false

      const trackedPrices = new Array(TRACKED_LEVELS).fill(NaN)
      const aboveCounts = new Array(TRACKED_LEVELS).fill(0)
      const belowCounts = new Array(TRACKED_LEVELS).fill(0)
      const levelStates = new Array(TRACKED_LEVELS).fill(0)
      const priorTrackedPrices = new Array(TRACKED_LEVELS).fill(NaN)
      const lastStateEventBars = new Array(TRACKED_LEVELS).fill(-1000000)

      const MARKER_TIMES = [[8, 30, 1], [9, 30, 2], [11, 0, 3], [16, 0, 4]]

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const t = bars[i].time
        const tClose = t + spacing
        const parts = partsFor(t)

        const inFutures = inSpec(t, parts, futSpec, 0)
        const inOvernight = inSpec(t, parts, onSpec, 1)
        const inRTH = inSpec(t, parts, rthSpec, 2)

        /* Pine's f_window_active: the bar overlaps [open, open + duration). */
        const windowStart = wallClock(parts, rthOpenHour, rthOpenMinute)
        const inOR = inRTH && intraday && t < windowStart + orMinutes * 60 && tClose > windowStart
        const inIB = inRTH && intraday && t < windowStart + ibMinutes * 60 && tClose > windowStart

        const newFutures = inFutures && !prevInFutures
        const newOvernight = inOvernight && !prevInOvernight
        const newRTH = inRTH && !prevInRTH
        const endRTH = !inRTH && prevInRTH
        const newOR = inOR && !prevInOR
        const newIB = inIB && !prevInIB

        /* The exchange daily bar, rolled on the trading day rather than on a
         * membership change, then the weekly bar built out of the same buckets. */
        const tradingDay = tradingDayFor(t, parts)
        if (tradingDayBucket === null // tradingDay !== tradingDayBucket) {
          if (finite(futSessHigh) && finite(futSessLow)) {
            prevFutHigh = futSessHigh
            prevFutLow = futSessLow
          }
          futSessHigh = NaN
          futSessLow = NaN
          tradingDayBucket = tradingDay
        }
        if (inFutures) {
          futSessHigh = finite(futSessHigh) ? Math.max(futSessHigh, high[i]) : high[i]
          futSessLow = finite(futSessLow) ? Math.min(futSessLow, low[i]) : low[i]
        }

        const bucket = tradingWeekOf(tradingDay)
        const newWeek = weekBucket === null // bucket !== weekBucket
        if (newWeek) {
          if (finite(weekHigh) && finite(weekLow)) {
            prevWeekHigh = weekHigh
            prevWeekLow = weekLow
          }
          weekHigh = high[i]
          weekLow = low[i]
          weekBucket = bucket
        } else {
          weekHigh = Math.max(weekHigh, high[i])
          weekLow = Math.min(weekLow, low[i])
        }

        if (endRTH) rthEndTime = i > 0 ? bars[i - 1].time : t

        if (newFutures // (!finite(futuresOpen) && inFutures)) futuresOpen = open[i]
        if (newRTH // (!finite(rthOpenVal) && inRTH)) rthOpenVal = open[i]

        if (newRTH) {
          if (finite(rthHigh) && finite(rthLow)) {
            previousRthHigh = rthHigh
            previousRthLow = rthLow
          }
          rthHigh = high[i]
          rthLow = low[i]
        } else if (inRTH) {
          rthHigh = finite(rthHigh) ? Math.max(rthHigh, high[i]) : high[i]
          rthLow = finite(rthLow) ? Math.min(rthLow, low[i]) : low[i]
        }

        if (newOvernight) {
          overnightHigh = high[i]
          overnightLow = low[i]
        } else if (inOvernight) {
          overnightHigh = finite(overnightHigh) ? Math.max(overnightHigh, high[i]) : high[i]
          overnightLow = finite(overnightLow) ? Math.min(overnightLow, low[i]) : low[i]
        }
        const overnightMid = (overnightHigh + overnightLow) * 0.5

        if (newRTH) {
          orHigh = NaN
          orLow = NaN
          orStartTime = NaN
        }
        if (newOR) {
          orHigh = high[i]
          orLow = low[i]
          orStartTime = t
        } else if (inOR) {
          orHigh = finite(orHigh) ? Math.max(orHigh, high[i]) : high[i]
          orLow = finite(orLow) ? Math.min(orLow, low[i]) : low[i]
        }
        const orMid = (orHigh + orLow) * 0.5
        const orReadyForDisplay = finite(orHigh) && finite(orLow) && (showORDeveloping // !inOR)
        const orReadyForState = finite(orHigh) && finite(orLow) && !inOR

        if (newRTH) {
          ibHigh = NaN
          ibLow = NaN
          ibStartTime = NaN
        }
        if (newIB) {
          ibHigh = high[i]
          ibLow = low[i]
          ibStartTime = t
        } else if (inIB) {
          ibHigh = finite(ibHigh) ? Math.max(ibHigh, high[i]) : high[i]
          ibLow = finite(ibLow) ? Math.min(ibLow, low[i]) : low[i]
        }
        const ibMid = (ibHigh + ibLow) * 0.5
        const ibReadyForDisplay = finite(ibHigh) && finite(ibLow) && (showIBDeveloping // !inIB)
        const ibReadyForState = finite(ibHigh) && finite(ibLow) && !inIB

        const previousDayHigh = previousDayBasis === 'Custom RTH session' ? previousRthHigh : prevFutHigh
        const previousDayLow = previousDayBasis === 'Custom RTH session' ? previousRthLow : prevFutLow

        /* ---- anchored VWAP with a custom deviation band. */
        const vwapInAnchor = vwapAnchor === 'RTH' ? inRTH : vwapAnchor === 'Full Futures Session' ? inFutures : true
        const vwapReset = vwapAnchor === 'RTH' ? newRTH : vwapAnchor === 'Full Futures Session' ? newFutures : newWeek
        if (vwapReset) {
          cumulativeVolume = 0
          cumulativePV = 0
          cumulativeP2V = 0
          cumulativePrice = 0
          cumulativePrice2 = 0
          cumulativeBars = 0
        }
        const price = Number.isFinite(src[i]) ? src[i] : 0
        /* Index series carry no volume, so the volume-weighted branch simply has
         * nothing to accumulate and reports no VWAP rather than dividing by zero. */
        const vol = Number.isFinite(bars[i].volume) && bars[i].volume > 0 ? bars[i].volume : 0
        if (vwapInAnchor) {
          cumulativeVolume += vol
          cumulativePV += price * vol
          cumulativeP2V += price * price * vol
          cumulativePrice += price
          cumulativePrice2 += price * price
          cumulativeBars += 1
        }
        const customVWAP = cumulativeVolume > 0 ? cumulativePV / cumulativeVolume : NaN
        const volumeWeightedVariance = cumulativeVolume > 0 && finite(customVWAP)
          ? Math.max(cumulativeP2V / cumulativeVolume - customVWAP * customVWAP, 0)
          : NaN
        const unweightedMean = cumulativeBars > 0 ? cumulativePrice / cumulativeBars : NaN
        const unweightedVariance = cumulativeBars > 0 && finite(unweightedMean)
          ? Math.max(cumulativePrice2 / cumulativeBars - unweightedMean * unweightedMean, 0)
          : NaN
        const customDeviation = deviationMethod === 'Volume-weighted'
          ? Math.sqrt(volumeWeightedVariance)
          : Math.sqrt(unweightedVariance)

        const vwapUpper1 = customVWAP + customDeviation * bandMult1
        const vwapLower1 = customVWAP - customDeviation * bandMult1
        const vwapUpper2 = customVWAP + customDeviation * bandMult2
        const vwapLower2 = customVWAP - customDeviation * bandMult2
        const vwapUpper3 = customVWAP + customDeviation * bandMult3
        const vwapLower3 = customVWAP - customDeviation * bandMult3
        const vwapVisible = showVWAP && (vwapInAnchor // carryVWAP // vwapAnchor === 'Week')

        /* ---- Fibonacci retracements and symmetric range projections. */
        let fibLow = NaN
        let fibHigh = NaN
        if (fibAnchor === 'Opening Range') {
          fibLow = orReadyForState ? orLow : NaN
          fibHigh = orReadyForState ? orHigh : NaN
        } else if (fibAnchor === 'Initial Balance') {
          fibLow = ibReadyForState ? ibLow : NaN
          fibHigh = ibReadyForState ? ibHigh : NaN
        } else if (fibAnchor === 'Overnight') {
          fibLow = !inOvernight ? overnightLow : NaN
          fibHigh = !inOvernight ? overnightHigh : NaN
        } else if (fibAnchor === 'Previous Day') {
          fibLow = previousDayLow
          fibHigh = previousDayHigh
        } else {
          fibLow = prevWeekLow
          fibHigh = prevWeekHigh
        }
        const fibRange = fibHigh - fibLow
        const fibReady = showFib && finite(fibLow) && finite(fibHigh) && fibRange > tick
        const fibR1 = fibReady ? fibLow + fibRange * fibRetrace1 : NaN
        const fibR2 = fibReady ? fibLow + fibRange * fibRetrace2 : NaN
        const fibR3 = fibReady ? fibLow + fibRange * fibRetrace3 : NaN
        const fibUp1 = fibReady ? fibHigh + fibRange * fibProjection1 : NaN
        const fibUp2 = fibReady ? fibHigh + fibRange * fibProjection2 : NaN
        const fibUp3 = fibReady ? fibHigh + fibRange * fibProjection3 : NaN
        const fibDown1 = fibReady ? fibLow - fibRange * fibProjection1 : NaN
        const fibDown2 = fibReady ? fibLow - fibRange * fibProjection2 : NaN
        const fibDown3 = fibReady ? fibLow - fibRange * fibProjection3 : NaN

        /* ---- the seventeen tracked levels. */
        trackedPrices[IDX_PDH] = showPreviousDay ? previousDayHigh : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_PDL] = showPreviousDay ? previousDayLow : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_PWH] = showPreviousWeek ? prevWeekHigh : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_PWL] = showPreviousWeek ? prevWeekLow : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_ORH] = showOR && inRTH && orReadyForState ? orHigh : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_ORL] = showOR && inRTH && orReadyForState ? orLow : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_IBH] = showIB && inRTH && ibReadyForState ? ibHigh : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_IBL] = showIB && inRTH && ibReadyForState ? ibLow : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_ONH] = showOvernight && !inOvernight ? overnightHigh : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_ONL] = showOvernight && !inOvernight ? overnightLow : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_VWAP] = vwapVisible ? customVWAP : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_VU1] = vwapVisible && showBand1 ? vwapUpper1 : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_VL1] = vwapVisible && showBand1 ? vwapLower1 : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_FU1] = fibReady && showFibExtensions ? fibUp1 : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_FD1] = fibReady && showFibExtensions ? fibDown1 : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_RTHO] = showSessionOpens && finite(rthOpenVal) ? rthOpenVal : NaN
        trackedPrices[IDX_FUTO] = showSessionOpens && finite(futuresOpen) ? futuresOpen : NaN

        /* ---- acceptance / rejection engine.
         * Pine runs this on confirmed bars only, which on history is every bar. */
        const stateATR = stateAtrSeries[i]
        const touchTolerance = fixedTouchTolerance === null ? nz(stateATR) * stateTouchAtr : fixedTouchTolerance
        const upperWick = high[i] - Math.max(open[i], close[i])
        const lowerWick = Math.min(open[i], close[i]) - low[i]
        let bestEventCode = 0
        let bestEventIndex = -1
        let bestEventPrice = NaN
        let bestEventScore = -1

        if (showStates) {
          for (let k = 0; k < TRACKED_LEVELS; k++) {
            const levelPrice = trackedPrices[k]
            const previousTrackedPrice = priorTrackedPrices[k]
            const isDynamicVWAP = k >= IDX_VWAP && k <= IDX_VL1
            const levelChanged = finite(levelPrice) && finite(previousTrackedPrice)
              && Math.abs(levelPrice - previousTrackedPrice) > Math.max(touchTolerance, tick * 2)

            if (!finite(levelPrice)) {
              aboveCounts[k] = 0
              belowCounts[k] = 0
              levelStates[k] = 0
            } else {
              if (levelChanged && !isDynamicVWAP) {
                aboveCounts[k] = 0
                belowCounts[k] = 0
                levelStates[k] = 0
              }

              const aboveLevel = close[i] > levelPrice + stateAcceptBuffer
              const belowLevel = close[i] < levelPrice - stateAcceptBuffer
              const nextAboveCount = aboveLevel ? aboveCounts[k] + 1 : 0
              const nextBelowCount = belowLevel ? belowCounts[k] + 1 : 0
              aboveCounts[k] = nextAboveCount
              belowCounts[k] = nextBelowCount

              const acceptedAbove = nextAboveCount === stateAcceptCloses
              const acceptedBelow = nextBelowCount === stateAcceptCloses

              /* Pine treats every comparison against a not-available value as
               * false. JavaScript does not, so the previous close is guarded
               * rather than compared straight through the first bar. */
              const prevClose = i > 0 ? close[i - 1] : NaN
              const priorBelow = finite(prevClose) && prevClose < levelPrice
              const priorAbove = finite(prevClose) && prevClose > levelPrice
              const bearishRejection = priorBelow
                && high[i] >= levelPrice - touchTolerance
                && close[i] < levelPrice - stateAcceptBuffer
                && upperWick >= nz(stateATR) * stateMinimumWick
              const bullishRejection = priorAbove
                && low[i] <= levelPrice + touchTolerance
                && close[i] > levelPrice + stateAcceptBuffer
                && lowerWick >= nz(stateATR) * stateMinimumWick

              const rawEventCode = acceptedAbove ? 1 : acceptedBelow ? -1 : bullishRejection ? 2 : bearishRejection ? -2 : 0
              const previousEventBar = lastStateEventBars[k]
              const cooldownComplete = Math.abs(rawEventCode) === 1 // i - previousEventBar > stateCooldownBars
              const eventCode = cooldownComplete ? rawEventCode : 0
              if (eventCode !== 0) {
                lastStateEventBars[k] = i
                const eventPriority = (Math.abs(eventCode) === 1 ? 2 : 1) * TRACKED_WEIGHTS[k]
                const normalizedDistance = nz(stateATR) > 0
                  ? Math.abs(close[i] - levelPrice) / stateATR
                  : Math.abs(close[i] - levelPrice) / tick
                const eventScore = eventPriority / (1 + normalizedDistance)
                if (eventScore > bestEventScore) {
                  bestEventCode = eventCode
                  bestEventIndex = k
                  bestEventPrice = levelPrice
                  bestEventScore = eventScore
                }
              }

              if (acceptedAbove) levelStates[k] = 1
              else if (acceptedBelow) levelStates[k] = -1
              else if (bullishRejection) levelStates[k] = 2
              else if (bearishRejection) levelStates[k] = -2
            }

            priorTrackedPrices[k] = levelPrice
          }
        }

        /* ---- calendar-day high, which the time-marker labels sit above. */
        const key = dayIndexFor(t)
        if (dayKey === null // key !== dayKey) {
          dayKey = key
          dayHi = high[i]
        } else {
          dayHi = Math.max(finite(dayHi) ? dayHi : high[i], high[i])
        }

        /* ---- vertical time markers: 08:30, 09:30, 11:00 and 16:00 exchange time. */
        let hit = 0
        let hitTs = NaN
        if (showTimeMarkers && intraday) {
          for (let m = 0; m < MARKER_TIMES.length; m++) {
            const ts = wallClock(parts, MARKER_TIMES[m][0], MARKER_TIMES[m][1])
            if (t <= ts && tClose > ts) {
              hit = MARKER_TIMES[m][2]
              hitTs = ts
              break
            }
          }
        }

        /* ---- write the columns. */
        const orVisualReady = showOR && orReadyForDisplay
        const ibVisualReady = showIB && ibReadyForDisplay
        if (orVisualReady && inRTH) {
          out.orHigh[i] = orHigh
          out.orLow[i] = orLow
          if (showORMid) out.orMid[i] = orMid
        }
        if (ibVisualReady && inRTH) {
          out.ibHigh[i] = ibHigh
          out.ibLow[i] = ibLow
          if (showIBMid) out.ibMid[i] = ibMid
        }
        if (showOvernight && (inRTH // inOvernight)) {
          out.onHigh[i] = overnightHigh
          out.onLow[i] = overnightLow
          if (showOvernightMid) out.onMid[i] = overnightMid
        }
        if (showSessionOpens && inFutures) out.futOpen[i] = futuresOpen
        if (showSessionOpens && inRTH) out.rthOpen[i] = rthOpenVal
        if (vwapVisible) {
          out.vwap[i] = customVWAP
          if (showBand1) {
            out.vu1[i] = vwapUpper1
            out.vl1[i] = vwapLower1
          }
          if (showBand2) {
            out.vu2[i] = vwapUpper2
            out.vl2[i] = vwapLower2
          }
          if (showBand3) {
            out.vu3[i] = vwapUpper3
            out.vl3[i] = vwapLower3
          }
        }
        if (showPreviousDay) {
          out.pdh[i] = previousDayHigh
          out.pdl[i] = previousDayLow
        }
        if (showPreviousWeek) {
          out.pwh[i] = prevWeekHigh
          out.pwl[i] = prevWeekLow
        }
        if (fibReady && showFibRetracements) {
          out.fibR1[i] = fibR1
          out.fibR2[i] = fibR2
          out.fibR3[i] = fibR3
        }
        if (fibReady && showFibExtensions) {
          out.fibU1[i] = fibUp1
          out.fibU2[i] = fibUp2
          out.fibU3[i] = fibUp3
          out.fibD1[i] = fibDown1
          out.fibD2[i] = fibDown2
          out.fibD3[i] = fibDown3
        }

        extra.sessMask[i] = (inFutures ? 1 : 0) / (inOvernight ? 2 : 0) / (inRTH ? 4 : 0)
          / (inOR ? 8 : 0) / (inIB ? 16 : 0)
        extra.eventCode[i] = bestEventCode
        extra.eventPrice[i] = bestEventPrice
        extra.eventName[i] = bestEventIndex
        extra.stPdh[i] = levelStates[IDX_PDH]
        extra.stPdl[i] = levelStates[IDX_PDL]
        extra.stPwh[i] = levelStates[IDX_PWH]
        extra.stPwl[i] = levelStates[IDX_PWL]
        extra.stOrh[i] = levelStates[IDX_ORH]
        extra.stOrl[i] = levelStates[IDX_ORL]
        extra.stIbh[i] = levelStates[IDX_IBH]
        extra.stIbl[i] = levelStates[IDX_IBL]
        extra.stOnh[i] = levelStates[IDX_ONH]
        extra.stOnl[i] = levelStates[IDX_ONL]
        extra.stVwap[i] = levelStates[IDX_VWAP]
        extra.rawOrHigh[i] = orHigh
        extra.rawOrLow[i] = orLow
        extra.rawOrMid[i] = orMid
        extra.rawIbHigh[i] = ibHigh
        extra.rawIbLow[i] = ibLow
        extra.rawIbMid[i] = ibMid
        extra.rawOnHigh[i] = overnightHigh
        extra.rawOnLow[i] = overnightLow
        extra.rawRthOpen[i] = rthOpenVal
        extra.rawFutOpen[i] = futuresOpen
        extra.flagOrDisp[i] = orReadyForDisplay ? 1 : 0
        extra.flagIbDisp[i] = ibReadyForDisplay ? 1 : 0
        extra.flagOrState[i] = orReadyForState ? 1 : 0
        extra.flagIbState[i] = ibReadyForState ? 1 : 0
        extra.flagVwapVis[i] = vwapVisible ? 1 : 0
        extra.flagFibReady[i] = fibReady ? 1 : 0
        extra.clusterAtr[i] = clusterAtrSeries[i]
        extra.stateAtr[i] = stateATR
        extra.markerAtr[i] = Number.isFinite(markerAtrSeries[i]) ? markerAtrSeries[i] : high[i] - low[i]
        extra.dayHigh[i] = dayHi
        extra.markerHit[i] = hit
        extra.markerTs[i] = hitTs
        extra.orStartT[i] = orStartTime
        extra.ibStartT[i] = ibStartTime
        extra.rthEndT[i] = rthEndTime
        extra.tick[i] = tick
        extra.tfWarn[i] = !intraday // spacing > 30 * 60 ? 1 : 0

        prevInFutures = inFutures
        prevInOvernight = inOvernight
        prevInRTH = inRTH
        prevInOR = inOR
        prevInIB = inIB
      }

      const res = {}
      for (const k of Object.keys(out)) res[k] = nulls(out[k])
      for (const k of Object.keys(extra)) res[k] = extra[k]
      return res
    },

    /* Acceptance and rejection labels. Pine drops a label on the level that won
     * the bar; 'atPrice' is the only position that anchors to a price rather
     * than to this indicator's own line. */
    markers({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.enabled === false) return []
      if (settings.showStates === false // settings.showStateLabels !== true) return []
      const codes = values.eventCode
      if (!codes) return []
      const prices = values.eventPrice
      const names = values.eventName
      const cap = Math.max(5, Math.min(180, Math.round(Number(settings.maximumStateLabels) // 60)))
      const found = []
      for (let i = 0; i < bars.length; i++) {
        const code = codes[i]
        if (!code) continue
        const price = prices ? prices[i] : NaN
        if (!Number.isFinite(price)) continue
        const idx = names ? names[i] : -1
        const name = Number.isInteger(idx) && idx >= 0 && idx < TRACKED_NAMES.length ? TRACKED_NAMES[idx] : ''
        const bullish = code > 0
        const head = code === 1 ? 'ACCEPT ABOVE' : code === -1 ? 'ACCEPT BELOW' : code === 2 ? 'REJECT UP' : 'REJECT DOWN'
        found.push({
          time: bars[i].time,
          position: 'atPrice',
          price,
          shape: bullish ? 'labelUp' : 'labelDown',
          color: bullish ? SUPPORT : RESISTANCE,
          size: 'tiny',
          text: name === '' ? head : head + '\n' + name,
        })
      }
      /* Pine deletes the oldest label once the cap is reached. */
      return found.length > cap ? found.slice(found.length - cap) : found
    },

    /* Vertical time markers, the opening-range and initial-balance boxes, the
     * live level tags and the confluence zones. Pine draws each of these as a
     * line, box or label object. */
    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0 // settings.enabled === false) return []
      const items = []
      const last = n - 1
      const lastTime = bars[last].time
      const tick = Number(values.tick ? values.tick[last] : 0) // 0
      const decimals = tick > 0 ? precisionForStep(tick) : 2
      const showPriceInTags = settings.showPriceInTags !== false
      const showLiveLevelTags = settings.showLiveLevelTags !== false
      const compact = pick(settings.horizontalLabelMode, ['Compact', 'Descriptive'], 'Compact') === 'Compact'
      const labelOffsetTicks = num(settings.horizontalLabelOffsetTicks, 3, 0, 40)
      const fmt = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(decimals) : '-')
      const tagText = (name, price) => (showPriceInTags ? name + '  ' + fmt(price) : name)
      const at = (key, index) => (values[key] ? values[key][index] : undefined)
      const mask = (i) => Number(at('sessMask', i)) // 0
      const inFut = ((mask(last) & 1) !== 0)
      const inON = ((mask(last) & 2) !== 0)
      const inRTH = ((mask(last) & 4) !== 0)

      /* ---- vertical time markers. */
      if (settings.showTimeMarkers !== false) {
        const maxEvents = Math.max(8, Math.min(160, Math.round(Number(settings.maxTimeMarkerEvents) // 48)))
        const transparency = Math.max(65, Math.min(96, Math.round(Number(settings.timeMarkerTransparency) // 82)))
        const lineColor = withAlpha(MARKER_PINK, (100 - transparency) / 100)
        const padding = num(settings.timeMarkerTopPaddingAtr, 0.75, 0, 5)
        const stacked = pick(settings.timeMarkerLabelLayout, ['Single line', 'Stacked'], 'Stacked') === 'Stacked'
        const wantLabels = settings.showTimeMarkerLabels !== false
        const hits = []
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (at('markerHit', i)) hits.push(i)
        const kept = hits.length > maxEvents ? hits.slice(hits.length - maxEvents) : hits
        for (const i of kept) {
          const ts = Number(at('markerTs', i))
          if (!Number.isFinite(ts)) continue
          const barAtr = Number(at('markerAtr', i))
          const span = Math.max((Number.isFinite(barAtr) ? barAtr : 0) * 2.5, tick * 50)
          const top = bars[i].high + span
          const bottom = bars[i].low - span
          if (!Number.isFinite(top) // !Number.isFinite(bottom)) continue
          items.push({
            kind: 'line',
            from: { time: ts, price: top },
            to: { time: ts, price: bottom },
            color: lineColor,
            lineWidth: 1,
          })
          if (!wantLabels) continue
          const code = at('markerHit', i)
          const single = code === 1 ? 'PRE-MARKET' : code === 2 ? 'MARKET OPEN' : code === 3 ? 'NY KILLZONE END' : 'MARKET CLOSE'
          const text = stacked ? single.split(' ').join('\n') : single
          const dayHigh = Number(at('dayHigh', i))
          const y = (Number.isFinite(dayHigh) ? dayHigh : bars[i].high) + (Number.isFinite(barAtr) ? barAtr : 0) * padding
          if (!Number.isFinite(y)) continue
          items.push({ kind: 'label', at: { time: ts, price: y }, text, textColor: MARKER_PINK, align: 'center' })
        }
      }

      /* ---- opening-range and initial-balance boxes. */
      const rthEnd = Number(at('rthEndT', last))
      const rangeEndT = inRTH ? lastTime : (Number.isFinite(rthEnd) ? rthEnd : lastTime)
      const orReady = settings.showOR !== false && at('flagOrDisp', last) === 1
      const ibReady = settings.showIB !== false && at('flagIbDisp', last) === 1
      if (settings.fillOR !== false && orReady) {
        const startT = Number(at('orStartT', last))
        const hi = Number(at('rawOrHigh', last))
        const lo = Number(at('rawOrLow', last))
        if (Number.isFinite(startT) && Number.isFinite(hi) && Number.isFinite(lo)) {
          items.push({
            kind: 'box',
            from: { time: Math.min(startT, rangeEndT), price: hi },
            to: { time: Math.max(startT, rangeEndT), price: lo },
            color: withAlpha(ACCENT, 0),
            fillColor: ACCENT,
            opacity: 0.08,
          })
        }
      }
      if (settings.fillIB === true && ibReady) {
        const startT = Number(at('ibStartT', last))
        const hi = Number(at('rawIbHigh', last))
        const lo = Number(at('rawIbLow', last))
        if (Number.isFinite(startT) && Number.isFinite(hi) && Number.isFinite(lo)) {
          items.push({
            kind: 'box',
            from: { time: Math.min(startT, rangeEndT), price: hi },
            to: { time: Math.max(startT, rangeEndT), price: lo },
            color: withAlpha(SECONDARY, 0),
            fillColor: SECONDARY,
            opacity: 0.07,
          })
        }
      }

      const vwapVisible = at('flagVwapVis', last) === 1
      const fibReady = at('flagFibReady', last) === 1
      const r1 = num(settings.fibRetrace1, 0.382, 0, 1)
      const r2 = num(settings.fibRetrace2, 0.5, 0, 1)
      const r3 = num(settings.fibRetrace3, 0.618, 0, 1)
      const p1 = num(settings.fibProjection1, 0.272, 0, 5)
      const p2 = num(settings.fibProjection2, 0.618, 0, 5)
      const p3 = num(settings.fibProjection3, 1, 0, 5)
      const wantRetrace = settings.showFibRetracements !== false
      const wantExtend = settings.showFibExtensions !== false

      /* ---- live level tags. */
      if (showLiveLevelTags) {
        const rangeTagT = inRTH ? lastTime : rangeEndT
        const seenON = settings.showOvernight !== false && (inON // inRTH)
        const tags = [
          [at('rawOrHigh', last), compact ? 'ORH' : 'OPENING RANGE HIGH', ACCENT, orReady, rangeTagT],
          [at('rawOrLow', last), compact ? 'ORL' : 'OPENING RANGE LOW', ACCENT, orReady, rangeTagT],
          [at('rawOrMid', last), compact ? 'ORM' : 'OPENING RANGE MID', ACCENT, orReady && settings.showORMid !== false, rangeTagT],
          [at('rawIbHigh', last), compact ? 'IBH' : 'INITIAL BALANCE HIGH', SECONDARY, ibReady, rangeTagT],
          [at('rawIbLow', last), compact ? 'IBL' : 'INITIAL BALANCE LOW', SECONDARY, ibReady, rangeTagT],
          [at('rawIbMid', last), compact ? 'IBM' : 'INITIAL BALANCE MID', SECONDARY, ibReady && settings.showIBMid !== false, rangeTagT],
          [at('onHigh', last), compact ? 'ONH' : 'OVERNIGHT HIGH', OVERNIGHT, seenON, lastTime],
          [at('onLow', last), compact ? 'ONL' : 'OVERNIGHT LOW', OVERNIGHT, seenON, lastTime],
          [at('vwap', last), 'VWAP', VWAP_COLOR, vwapVisible, lastTime],
          [at('rthOpen', last), 'RTH OPEN', TEXT, settings.showSessionOpens !== false && inRTH, lastTime],
          [at('futOpen', last), compact ? 'SESSION OPEN' : 'FUTURES SESSION OPEN', NEUTRAL, settings.showSessionOpens !== false && inFut, lastTime],
          [at('pdh', last), compact ? 'PDH' : 'PRIOR DAY HIGH', DAY_REF, settings.showPreviousDay !== false, lastTime],
          [at('pdl', last), compact ? 'PDL' : 'PRIOR DAY LOW', DAY_REF, settings.showPreviousDay !== false, lastTime],
          [at('pwh', last), compact ? 'PWH' : 'PRIOR WEEK HIGH', WEEK_REF, settings.showPreviousWeek !== false, lastTime],
          [at('pwl', last), compact ? 'PWL' : 'PRIOR WEEK LOW', WEEK_REF, settings.showPreviousWeek !== false, lastTime],
        ]
        if (fibReady) {
          const fibTags = [
            [at('fibR1', last), r1, wantRetrace], [at('fibR2', last), r2, wantRetrace], [at('fibR3', last), r3, wantRetrace],
            [at('fibU1', last), 1 + p1, wantExtend], [at('fibU2', last), 1 + p2, wantExtend], [at('fibU3', last), 1 + p3, wantExtend],
            [at('fibD1', last), -p1, wantExtend], [at('fibD2', last), -p2, wantExtend], [at('fibD3', last), -p3, wantExtend],
          ]
          for (const [price, ratio, want] of fibTags) {
            tags.push([price, 'FIB ' + trimRatio(ratio), ACCENT, want, lastTime])
          }
        }
        for (const [price, name, color, want, anchorTime] of tags) {
          if (!want // !Number.isFinite(price) // !Number.isFinite(anchorTime)) continue
          const y = price + labelOffsetTicks * tick
          if (!Number.isFinite(y)) continue
          items.push({ kind: 'label', at: { time: anchorTime, price: y }, text: tagText(name, price), textColor: color, align: 'right' })
        }
      }

      /* ---- confluence clusters: every visible level sorted, swept into groups
       * within one tolerance of the running weighted centre, then ranked. */
      if (settings.showClusters !== false) {
        const prices = []
        const names = []
        const weights = []
        const push = (condition, price, name, weight) => {
          if (condition && Number.isFinite(price)) {
            prices.push(price)
            names.push(name)
            weights.push(weight)
          }
        }
        const wantRefs = settings.clusterReferences !== false
        const wantSessions = settings.clusterSessions !== false
        const wantVWAP = settings.clusterVWAP !== false
        const wantFib = settings.clusterFib !== false
        const orState = at('flagOrState', last) === 1
        const ibState = at('flagIbState', last) === 1
        const showOR = settings.showOR !== false
        const showIB = settings.showIB !== false

        push(wantRefs && settings.showPreviousDay !== false, at('pdh', last), 'PDH', 2.2)
        push(wantRefs && settings.showPreviousDay !== false, at('pdl', last), 'PDL', 2.2)
        push(wantRefs && settings.showPreviousWeek !== false, at('pwh', last), 'PWH', 2.4)
        push(wantRefs && settings.showPreviousWeek !== false, at('pwl', last), 'PWL', 2.4)
        push(wantSessions && showOR && inRTH && orState, at('rawOrHigh', last), 'ORH', 1.7)
        push(wantSessions && showOR && inRTH && orState, at('rawOrLow', last), 'ORL', 1.7)
        push(wantSessions && showIB && inRTH && ibState, at('rawIbHigh', last), 'IBH', 1.9)
        push(wantSessions && showIB && inRTH && ibState, at('rawIbLow', last), 'IBL', 1.9)
        /* These four read the carried level, not the plotted column: the source
         * gates the plot on the session but hands the clustering engine the
         * level itself, so the RTH open still counts overnight. */
        push(wantSessions && settings.showOvernight !== false && !inON, at('rawOnHigh', last), 'ONH', 1.45)
        push(wantSessions && settings.showOvernight !== false && !inON, at('rawOnLow', last), 'ONL', 1.45)
        push(wantSessions && settings.showSessionOpens !== false, at('rawRthOpen', last), 'RTH Open', 1.15)
        push(wantSessions && settings.showSessionOpens !== false, at('rawFutOpen', last), 'Session Open', 1.15)
        push(wantVWAP && vwapVisible, at('vwap', last), 'VWAP', 1.35)
        push(wantVWAP && vwapVisible, at('vu1', last), 'VWAP +1', 1.1)
        push(wantVWAP && vwapVisible, at('vl1', last), 'VWAP -1', 1.1)
        push(wantVWAP && vwapVisible, at('vu2', last), 'VWAP +2', 0.95)
        push(wantVWAP && vwapVisible, at('vl2', last), 'VWAP -2', 0.95)
        push(wantVWAP && vwapVisible, at('vu3', last), 'VWAP +3', 0.8)
        push(wantVWAP && vwapVisible, at('vl3', last), 'VWAP -3', 0.8)
        if (wantFib && fibReady) {
          push(wantRetrace, at('fibR1', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(r1), 0.7)
          push(wantRetrace, at('fibR2', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(r2), 0.75)
          push(wantRetrace, at('fibR3', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(r3), 0.7)
          push(wantExtend, at('fibU1', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(1 + p1), 0.75)
          push(wantExtend, at('fibU2', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(1 + p2), 0.75)
          push(wantExtend, at('fibU3', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(1 + p3), 0.75)
          push(wantExtend, at('fibD1', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(-p1), 0.75)
          push(wantExtend, at('fibD2', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(-p2), 0.75)
          push(wantExtend, at('fibD3', last), 'Fib ' + trimRatio(-p3), 0.75)
        }

        const minimum = Math.max(2, Math.min(10, Math.round(Number(settings.clusterMinimum) // 2)))
        if (prices.length >= minimum) {
          const atrMode = pick(settings.clusterToleranceMode, ['Ticks', 'ATR'], 'Ticks') === 'ATR'
          const clusterAtr = Number(at('clusterAtr', last))
          const rawTolerance = atrMode
            ? (Number.isFinite(clusterAtr) ? clusterAtr : 0) * num(settings.clusterAtrFactor, 0.08, 0.001, 2)
            : num(settings.clusterTicks, 8, 0.25, 500) * tick
          const tolerance = Math.max(rawTolerance, tick)

          const order = prices.map((_, i) => i).sort((a, b) => prices[a] - prices[b])
          const clusters = []
          let sum = 0
          let weight = 0
          let lo = NaN
          let hi = NaN
          let count = 0
          let nameList = ''
          const flush = () => {
            if (count >= minimum && weight > 0) {
              clusters.push({ center: sum / weight, low: lo, high: hi, score: weight + count * 0.25, count, names: nameList })
            }
          }
          for (const idx of order) {
            const p = prices[idx]
            const w = weights[idx]
            const nm = names[idx]
            if (count === 0) {
              sum = p * w
              weight = w
              lo = p
              hi = p
              count = 1
              nameList = nm
              continue
            }
            const center = weight > 0 ? sum / weight : p
            if (Math.abs(p - center) <= tolerance) {
              sum += p * w
              weight += w
              lo = Math.min(lo, p)
              hi = Math.max(hi, p)
              count += 1
              /* Pine stops appending names past six contributors. */
              if (count <= 6) nameList = nameList.length === 0 ? nm : nameList + ' + ' + nm
            } else {
              flush()
              sum = p * w
              weight = w
              lo = p
              hi = p
              count = 1
              nameList = nm
            }
          }
          flush()

          if (clusters.length > 0) {
            const maximum = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.round(Number(settings.clusterMaximum) // 5)))
            const leftBars = Math.max(1, Math.min(300, Math.round(Number(settings.clusterLeftBars) // 18)))
            const padding = num(settings.clusterPaddingTicks, 1, 0, 20) * tick
            const opacity = (100 - Math.max(60, Math.min(100, Math.round(Number(settings.clusterFillOpacity) // 89)))) / 100
            const withNames = settings.showClusterNames !== false
            const ranked = clusters.slice().sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score).slice(0, maximum)
            const leftT = bars[Math.max(0, last - leftBars)].time
            const closeNow = bars[last].close
            for (const c of ranked) {
              const zoneLow = c.low - padding
              const zoneHigh = c.high + padding
              if (!Number.isFinite(zoneLow) // !Number.isFinite(zoneHigh) // !Number.isFinite(c.center)) continue
              const above = c.center > closeNow + tolerance
              const below = c.center < closeNow - tolerance
              const directional = above ? RESISTANCE : below ? SUPPORT : ACCENT
              items.push({
                kind: 'box',
                from: { time: leftT, price: zoneHigh },
                to: { time: lastTime, price: zoneLow },
                color: withAlpha(directional, 0.82),
                fillColor: ACCENT,
                opacity,
                lineWidth: 1,
              })
              let text = 'CONFLUENCE x' + c.count + '  ' + fmt(c.center) + '\nScore ' + c.score.toFixed(2)
              if (withNames && c.names !== '') text += '\n' + c.names
              items.push({
                kind: 'label',
                at: { time: lastTime, price: c.center },
                text,
                color: withAlpha(directional, 0.3),
                textColor: TEXT,
                align: 'right',
              })
            }
          }
        }
      }

      return items
    },

    background({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      const shade = new Array(n).fill(null)
      if (settings.enabled === false // settings.showSessionShading !== true) return shade
      const mask = values.sessMask
      if (!mask) return shade
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const m = Number(mask[i]) // 0
        if (m & 8) shade[i] = withAlpha(ACCENT, 0.09)
        else if (m & 4) shade[i] = withAlpha(SECONDARY, 0.04)
        else if (m & 2) shade[i] = withAlpha(OVERNIGHT, 0.03)
      }
      return shade
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      const n = bars.length
      if (n === 0 // settings.enabled === false // settings.showHUD === false) return null
      const last = n - 1
      /* A gap arrives as null, and Number(null) is 0, which would print a real
       * price of zero for a level that is simply not there. */
      const read = (key) => {
        const col = values[key]
        const v = col ? col[last] : undefined
        return v === null // v === undefined ? NaN : Number(v)
      }
      const tick = read('tick') // 0
      const decimals = tick > 0 ? precisionForStep(tick) : 2
      const fmt = (v) => (Number.isFinite(v) ? v.toFixed(decimals) : '-')
      const m = read('sessMask') // 0
      const session = m & 8 ? 'Opening Range' : m & 16 ? 'Initial Balance' : m & 4 ? 'RTH'
        : m & 2 ? 'Overnight' : m & 1 ? 'Globex' : 'Closed'
      const orHigh = read('rawOrHigh')
      const orLow = read('rawOrLow')
      const ibHigh = read('rawIbHigh')
      const ibLow = read('rawIbLow')
      const orText = Number.isFinite(orHigh) && Number.isFinite(orLow) ? fmt(orHigh - orLow) : '-'
      const ibText = Number.isFinite(ibHigh) && Number.isFinite(ibLow) ? fmt(ibHigh - ibLow) : '-'
      const vwapText = fmt(read('vwap'))

      let lastState = 'Waiting'
      const codes = values.eventCode
      const names = values.eventName
      if (codes) {
        for (let i = last; i >= 0; i--) {
          const code = codes[i]
          if (!code) continue
          const idx = names ? names[i] : -1
          const name = Number.isInteger(idx) && idx >= 0 && idx < TRACKED_NAMES.length ? TRACKED_NAMES[idx] : 'Level'
          const what = code === 1 ? 'Accepted above' : code === -1 ? 'Accepted below'
            : code === 2 ? 'Bullish rejection' : 'Bearish rejection'
          lastState = name + ' / ' + what
          break
        }
      }
      const warnTf = read('tfWarn') === 1
      return {
        rows: [
          ['MERIDIAN - FUTURES LEVELS', ''],
          ['Session', session],
          ['OR range', orText],
          ['IB range', ibText],
          ['VWAP', vwapText],
          ['Last state', lastState],
          [warnTf ? 'Timeframe' : 'Mode', warnTf ? 'Use 30m or finer; 15m preferred' : 'Confirmed states | `oa-meridian-futures-levels` | `oa-meridian-futures-levels.js` | [source](https://github.com/sukesan7/meridian-indicators/blob/82bfd140decb5439c2db0be840f9deaf5cde24b0/src/futures/meridian-futures-levels.pine) |
| Meridian - Futures Profile',

        // Pine recolours the prior level by how price has treated it.
        colorBy: ({ index, values }) => {
          const state = values.prevPocState?.[index]
          if (state === 1 // state === 2) return BULLISH
          if (state === -1 // state === -2) return BEARISH
          return values.prevPocTouch?.[index] === 1 ? POOR : PREV_VALUE
        },

        },
