    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const out = {}
      for (const key of PLOT_KEYS) out[key] = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (const key of STATE_KEYS) out[key] = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      out.snap = new Array(n).fill(null)

      const finish = () => {
        const result = { snap: out.snap }
        for (const key of PLOT_KEYS) result[key] = nulls(out[key])
        for (const key of STATE_KEYS) result[key] = out[key]
        return result
      }

      const enabled = settings.indicatorEnabled !== false
      if (n === 0 // !enabled) return finish()

      /* A cleared number field arrives as '', and Number('') is 0, so a blank
       * falls back to the declared default rather than to a zero-width window. */
      const num = (key, fallback, min, max) => {
        const raw = settings[key]
        if (raw === '' // raw === null // raw === undefined) return fallback
        const v = Number(raw)
        if (!isF(v)) return fallback
        return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, v))
      }
      const int = (key, fallback, min, max) => Math.floor(num(key, fallback, min, max))
      const flag = (key, fallback) => (typeof settings[key] === 'boolean' ? settings[key] : fallback)

      const zoneRaw = String(settings.sessionTimezone ?? '').trim()
      const fallbackZone = isValidTimezone('America/New_York') ? 'America/New_York' : DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
      const zone = zoneRaw !== '' && isValidTimezone(zoneRaw) ? zoneRaw : fallbackZone

      const spec = parseSessionSpec(String(settings.rthSession ?? '').trim()) ??
        parseSessionSpec('0930-1600:23456')
      if (!spec) return finish()

      const openHour = int('rthOpenHour', 9, 0, 23)
      const openMinute = int('rthOpenMinute', 30, 0, 59)
      const blockMinutes = BLOCK_MINUTES[settings.blockSizeInput] ?? 30
      const blockSeconds = blockMinutes * 60
      const ibBlocks = int('initialBalanceBlocks', 2, 1, 12)
      const maxChartMinutes = int('maximumChartMinutes', 30, 1, 60)

      const rowMode = settings.rowSizeMode === 'Manual' ? 'Manual' : 'Auto'
      const manualTicks = int('manualTicksPerRow', 8, 1, 1000)
      const targetRows = int('automaticTargetRows', 70, 20, 150)
      const minAutoTicks = int('minimumAutomaticTicks', 1, 1, 100)
      const maxRenderedRows = int('maximumRenderedRows', 100, 30, 140)
      const maxRowsPerBlock = int('maximumRowsPerBlock', 250, 50, 1000)
      const vaPercent = num('valueAreaPercent', 70, 50, 95)

      const showCurrentProfile = flag('showCurrentProfile', true)
      const showPreviousProfile = flag('showPreviousProfile', true)
      const maxProfileWidthBars = int('maximumProfileWidthBars', 20, 6, 50)
      const showRowCounts = flag('showRowCounts', false)
      const showProfileNames = flag('showProfileNames', true)
      const showValueAreaShading = flag('showValueAreaShading', true)
      const showProfileMidpoint = flag('showProfileMidpoint', true)
      const profileTransparency = int('profileTransparency', 28, 0, 90)
      const previousProfileTransparency = int('previousProfileTransparency', 48, 0, 95)

      const showCurrentLevels = flag('showCurrentLevels', true)
      const extendPreviousLevels = flag('extendPreviousLevels', true)
      const showInitialBalance = flag('showInitialBalance', true)
      const showIbExtensions = flag('showIbExtensions', true)
      const firstIbExtension = num('firstIbExtension', 0.5, 0.1, 5)
      const secondIbExtension = num('secondIbExtension', 1, 0.1, 10)
      const showSessionOpenClose = flag('showSessionOpenClose', false)
      const acceptanceCloses = int('acceptanceCloses', 2, 1, 5)
      const showSinglePrintZones = flag('showSinglePrintZones', true)
      const showPoorHighLow = flag('showPoorHighLow', true)
      const maxSinglePrintZones = int('maximumSinglePrintZones', 12, 1, 30)

      const showEstimatedVolume = flag('showEstimatedVolume', false)
      const estimatedVolumeWidthBars = int('estimatedVolumeWidthBars', 12, 4, 30)
      const showEstimatedVolumeLevels = flag('showEstimatedVolumeLevels', true)
      const volumeVaPercent = num('estimatedVolumeValueArea', 70, 50, 95)

      const shapeCfg = {
        peakRatio: num('doublePeakMinimumRatio', 0.62, 0.30, 1),
        valleyRatio: num('doublePeakValleyRatio', 0.55, 0.10, 0.90),
        minSeparation: int('doublePeakMinimumSeparation', 5, 2, 30),
        skewThreshold: num('shapeSkewThreshold', 0.45, 0.10, 2),
        trendExtension: num('trendRangeExtension', 1.75, 1.1, 5),
      }
      const strongPocRows = num('strongPocMigrationRows', 2, 0.5, 10)

      /* syminfo.mintick. The host supplies it once the pane has a minMove; with
       * no minMove the scale infers precision from the range, so approximate a
       * tick at one basis point of price rather than asking the user for one. */
      let tick = Number(ctx?.tickSize)
      if (!isF(tick) // tick <= 0) {
        let reference = NaN
        for (let i = bars.length - 1; i >= 0 && !isF(reference); i--) {
          if (isF(bars[i].close) && Math.abs(bars[i].close) > 0) reference = Math.abs(bars[i].close)
        }
        tick = isF(reference) && reference > 0
          ? Math.max(1e-8, Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(reference)) - 4))
          : 0.01
      }

      /* syminfo.root: only the two Nasdaq futures roots change the fallback row
       * size, and the host only knows a symbol when it has set a data context. */
      const root = String(ctx?.symbol ?? '').toUpperCase()
      const defaultRowTicks = root.startsWith('MNQ') // root.startsWith('NQ') ? 8 : 4

      const chooseTicks = (previousRange) => {
        const fallbackTicks = Math.max(defaultRowTicks, minAutoTicks)
        const autoTicks = isF(previousRange) && previousRange > tick
          ? Math.ceil(previousRange / tick / targetRows)
          : fallbackTicks
        return rowMode === 'Manual' ? manualTicks : Math.max(autoTicks, minAutoTicks)
      }

      /* timeframe.isintraday / timeframe.in_seconds(). */
      const barSeconds = medianBarSeconds(bars)
      let chartMinutes = 0
      let intraday = false
      const code = ctx?.interval
      if (code) {
        try {
          intraday = isIntradayInterval(code)
          const secs = intervalToSeconds(code)
          if (intraday && isF(secs) && secs > 0) chartMinutes = Math.round(secs / 60)
        } catch (e) {
          intraday = false
        }
      } else if (isF(barSeconds) && barSeconds > 0 && barSeconds < 86400) {
        intraday = true
        chartMinutes = Math.round(barSeconds / 60)
      }
      const supportedTimeframe = intraday && chartMinutes >= 1 &&
        chartMinutes <= maxChartMinutes && chartMinutes <= blockMinutes
      const chartWarning = !supportedTimeframe

      /* Session state, carried bar to bar exactly as the Pine `var`s are. */
      let curTpo = new Map()
      let prevTpo = new Map()
      let curVol = new Map()
      let prevVol = new Map()
      let curRowSize = NaN
      let prevRowSize = NaN
      let curMinRow = null
      let curMaxRow = null
      let prevMinRow = null
      let prevMaxRow = null
      let curHasData = false
      let prevHasData = false
      let curOverflow = false
      let prevOverflow = false
      let curStartIdx = null
      let curEndIdx = null
      let prevStartIdx = null
      let prevEndIdx = null
      let curOpen = NaN
      let curClose = NaN
      let curHigh = NaN
      let curLow = NaN
      let prevHigh = NaN
      let prevLow = NaN
      let curIbHigh = NaN
      let curIbLow = NaN
      let curRotation = 0
      let activeBlockId = -1
      let activeHigh = NaN
      let activeLow = NaN
      let lastBlockHigh = NaN
      let lastBlockLow = NaN
      let curBlocks = 0
      let pocState = 0
      let vahState = 0
      let valState = 0
      let prevStats = null
      let prevZones = []
      let prevStatsStale = true
      let curCache = null
      let volCache = null
      let shapeCache = null
      let inPrevBar = false
      let prevDateKey = null
      let snapshot = null

      /* math.sum(..., acceptanceCloses): a rolling window of 0/1 terms. */
      const windows = { poc: [], pocBelow: [], vah: [], val: [] }
      const push = (name, value) => {
        const w = windows[name]
        w.push(value)
        if (w.length > acceptanceCloses) w.shift()
        let total = 0
        for (const x of w) total += x
        return total
      }

      const commitBlock = () => {
        const lowRow = Math.floor(activeLow / curRowSize)
        const highRow = Math.floor(activeHigh / curRowSize)
        const added = addTpoBlock(curTpo, lowRow, highRow, curMinRow, curMaxRow, maxRowsPerBlock)
        curMinRow = added.min
        curMaxRow = added.max
        curOverflow = curOverflow // added.overflow
        if (isF(lastBlockHigh)) {
          curRotation += activeHigh > lastBlockHigh ? 1 : activeHigh < lastBlockHigh ? -1 : 0
          curRotation += activeLow > lastBlockLow ? 1 : activeLow < lastBlockLow ? -1 : 0
        }
        curBlocks += 1
        lastBlockHigh = activeHigh
        lastBlockLow = activeLow
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const bar = bars[i]
        const inRTH = inSessionAt(bar.time, spec, zone)
        const parts = utcSecondsToZonedParts(bar.time, zone)
        const dateKey = parts.year * 10000 + parts.month * 100 + parts.day
        const newRTH = inRTH && (i === 0 // !inPrevBar // dateKey !== prevDateKey)
        const endRTH = !inRTH && inPrevBar
        const rthStart = zonedWallClockToUtcSeconds(parts.year, parts.month, parts.day, openHour, openMinute, 0, zone)
        const blockId = inRTH ? Math.floor((bar.time - rthStart) / blockSeconds) : -1

        if (newRTH) {
          if (curHasData) {
            if (activeBlockId >= 0 && isF(activeHigh) && isF(activeLow) && isF(curRowSize)) commitBlock()
            curClose = i > 0 ? bars[i - 1].close : bar.close
            curEndIdx = i > 0 ? i - 1 : i

            prevTpo = new Map(curTpo)
            prevVol = new Map(curVol)
            prevRowSize = curRowSize
            prevMinRow = curMinRow
            prevMaxRow = curMaxRow
            prevStartIdx = curStartIdx
            prevEndIdx = curEndIdx
            prevHigh = curHigh
            prevLow = curLow
            prevOverflow = curOverflow
            prevHasData = curTpo.size > 0
            prevStatsStale = true
          }

          const previousRangeForSizing = prevHasData && isF(prevHigh) && isF(prevLow)
            ? prevHigh - prevLow
            : NaN
          curRowSize = chooseTicks(previousRangeForSizing) * tick
          curTpo = new Map()
          curVol = new Map()
          curMinRow = null
          curMaxRow = null
          curHasData = true
          curOverflow = false
          curStartIdx = i
          curEndIdx = null
          curOpen = bar.open
          curClose = NaN
          curHigh = bar.high
          curLow = bar.low
          curIbHigh = NaN
          curIbLow = NaN
          curRotation = 0
          curBlocks = 0
          activeBlockId = -1
          activeHigh = NaN
          activeLow = NaN
          lastBlockHigh = NaN
          lastBlockLow = NaN
          /* Pine clears the prior-level acceptance states on a new session. */
          pocState = 0
          vahState = 0
          valState = 0
        }

        if (inRTH && curHasData && isF(curRowSize) && curRowSize > 0) {
          curHigh = !isF(curHigh) ? bar.high : Math.max(curHigh, bar.high)
          curLow = !isF(curLow) ? bar.low : Math.min(curLow, bar.low)

          if (blockId >= 0 && blockId < ibBlocks) {
            curIbHigh = !isF(curIbHigh) ? bar.high : Math.max(curIbHigh, bar.high)
            curIbLow = !isF(curIbLow) ? bar.low : Math.min(curIbLow, bar.low)
          }

          if (activeBlockId < 0) {
            activeBlockId = blockId
            activeHigh = bar.high
            activeLow = bar.low
          } else if (blockId !== activeBlockId) {
            commitBlock()
            activeBlockId = blockId
            activeHigh = bar.high
            activeLow = bar.low
          } else {
            activeHigh = Math.max(activeHigh, bar.high)
            activeLow = Math.min(activeLow, bar.low)
          }

          /* Pine guards this with barstate.isconfirmed; every loaded bar is a
           * closed bar, so the historical branch is the one that applies. */
          if (showEstimatedVolume) {
            const barLowRow = Math.floor(bar.low / curRowSize)
            const barHighRow = Math.floor(bar.high / curRowSize)
            const overflow = addEstimatedVolume(curVol, barLowRow, barHighRow, bar.volume, maxRowsPerBlock)
            curOverflow = curOverflow // overflow
          }
        }

        if (endRTH && curHasData && activeBlockId >= 0 && isF(curRowSize) && curRowSize > 0) {
          commitBlock()
          curClose = i > 0 ? bars[i - 1].close : bar.close
          curEndIdx = i > 0 ? i - 1 : i
          activeBlockId = -1
          activeHigh = NaN
          activeLow = NaN
        }

        const aLow = inRTH && activeBlockId >= 0 && isF(activeLow) && isF(curRowSize) && curRowSize > 0
          ? Math.floor(activeLow / curRowSize)
          : null
        const aHigh = inRTH && activeBlockId >= 0 && isF(activeHigh) && isF(curRowSize) && curRowSize > 0
          ? Math.floor(activeHigh / curRowSize)
          : null
        const includeActive = inRTH && activeBlockId >= 0 && aLow !== null && aHigh !== null
        const dispMin = includeActive ? (curMinRow === null ? aLow : Math.min(curMinRow, aLow)) : curMinRow
        const dispMax = includeActive ? (curMaxRow === null ? aHigh : Math.max(curMaxRow, aHigh)) : curMaxRow

        /* Outside the session nothing about the current profile can move, so
         * the previous bar's statistics still stand. */
        const mutated = newRTH // endRTH // (inRTH && curHasData)
        if (mutated // curCache === null) {
          curCache = tpoStats(curTpo, dispMin, dispMax, curRowSize, includeActive, aLow, aHigh, vaPercent)
          volCache = null
          shapeCache = null
        }
        const cur = curCache
        if (prevStatsStale) {
          prevStats = tpoStats(prevTpo, prevMinRow, prevMaxRow, prevRowSize, false, null, null, vaPercent)
          prevZones = buildZones(prevTpo, prevMinRow, prevMaxRow, prevStats.valid)
          prevStatsStale = false
        }
        const prev = prevStats
        if (volCache === null) volCache = volumeStats(curVol, dispMin, dispMax, curRowSize, volumeVaPercent)
        const vol = volCache

        const ibRange = isF(curIbHigh) && isF(curIbLow) ? curIbHigh - curIbLow : NaN
        const profileRange = cur.valid ? cur.profileHigh - cur.profileLow : NaN
        if (shapeCache === null) {
          shapeCache = profileShape(curTpo, dispMin, dispMax, includeActive, aLow, aHigh,
            cur.pocRow, cur.skewness, profileRange, ibRange, shapeCfg)
        }
        const shapeOut = shapeCache

        const close = bar.close
        let valueRel = 0
        if (cur.valid && prev.valid) {
          if (cur.val > prev.vah) valueRel = 1
          else if (cur.vah < prev.val) valueRel = 2
          else if (cur.vah > prev.vah && cur.val > prev.val) valueRel = 3
          else if (cur.vah < prev.vah && cur.val < prev.val) valueRel = 4
          else if (cur.vah <= prev.vah && cur.val >= prev.val) valueRel = 5
          else if (cur.vah >= prev.vah && cur.val <= prev.val) valueRel = 6
          else valueRel = 7
        }

        const migrationRows = cur.valid && prev.valid
          ? (cur.poc - prev.poc) / Math.max(curRowSize, tick)
          : NaN
        let pocMig = 0
        if (isF(migrationRows)) {
          if (migrationRows >= strongPocRows) pocMig = 1
          else if (migrationRows > 0.5) pocMig = 2
          else if (migrationRows <= -strongPocRows) pocMig = 3
          else if (migrationRows < -0.5) pocMig = 4
          else pocMig = 5
        }

        let openLoc = 0
        if (prev.valid && isF(curOpen)) {
          if (curOpen > prev.profileHigh) openLoc = 1
          else if (curOpen > prev.vah) openLoc = 2
          else if (curOpen >= prev.val) openLoc = 3
          else if (curOpen >= prev.profileLow) openLoc = 4
          else openLoc = 5
        }

        let curLoc = 0
        if (cur.valid) {
          if (close > cur.profileHigh) curLoc = 1
          else if (close > cur.vah) curLoc = 2
          else if (Math.abs(close - cur.poc) <= curRowSize) curLoc = 3
          else if (close >= cur.val) curLoc = 4
          else if (close >= cur.profileLow) curLoc = 5
          else curLoc = 6
        }

        const upwardValue = valueRel === 1 // valueRel === 3
        const downwardValue = valueRel === 2 // valueRel === 4
        const pocUp = pocMig === 1 // pocMig === 2
        const pocDown = pocMig === 3 // pocMig === 4
        const aboveIb = isF(curIbHigh) && close > curIbHigh
        const belowIb = isF(curIbLow) && close < curIbLow
        const returnedInsidePriorValue = prev.valid && close <= prev.vah && close >= prev.val
        const openedAbovePriorValue = prev.valid && curOpen > prev.vah
        const openedBelowPriorValue = prev.valid && curOpen < prev.val

        let participant = 0
        if (shapeOut.shapeCode === 1 && curLoc === 4) participant = 1
        else if (openedAbovePriorValue && returnedInsidePriorValue) participant = 2
        else if (openedBelowPriorValue && returnedInsidePriorValue) participant = 3
        else if (upwardValue && pocUp && (aboveIb // close > cur.vah)) participant = 4
        else if (downwardValue && pocDown && (belowIb // close < cur.val)) participant = 5

        let auctionCode = 0
        if (shapeOut.doubleDistribution) auctionCode = 4
        else if (openedAbovePriorValue && returnedInsidePriorValue && !pocUp) auctionCode = -3
        else if (openedBelowPriorValue && returnedInsidePriorValue && !pocDown) auctionCode = 3
        else if (shapeOut.shapeCode === 5 && upwardValue && pocUp) auctionCode = 2
        else if (shapeOut.shapeCode === 5 && downwardValue && pocDown) auctionCode = -2
        else if (upwardValue && pocUp && close >= cur.poc) auctionCode = 1
        else if (downwardValue && pocDown && close <= cur.poc) auctionCode = -1
        else if (shapeOut.shapeCode === 1 && curLoc === 4) auctionCode = 5
        else if (cur.valid && close >= cur.val && close <= cur.vah) auctionCode = 6

        const pocTouched = inRTH && prev.valid && bar.high >= prev.poc && bar.low <= prev.poc
        const vahTouched = inRTH && prev.valid && bar.high >= prev.vah && bar.low <= prev.vah
        const valTouched = inRTH && prev.valid && bar.high >= prev.val && bar.low <= prev.val

        const closesAbovePocCount = push('poc', prev.valid && close > prev.poc ? 1 : 0)
        const closesBelowPocCount = push('pocBelow', prev.valid && close < prev.poc ? 1 : 0)
        const closesAboveVahCount = push('vah', prev.valid && close > prev.vah ? 1 : 0)
        const closesBelowValCount = push('val', prev.valid && close < prev.val ? 1 : 0)
        const closesAbovePoc = prev.valid && closesAbovePocCount >= acceptanceCloses
        const closesBelowPoc = prev.valid && closesBelowPocCount >= acceptanceCloses
        const closesAboveVah = prev.valid && closesAboveVahCount >= acceptanceCloses
        const closesBelowVal = prev.valid && closesBelowValCount >= acceptanceCloses

        if (inRTH && prev.valid) {
          if (closesAbovePoc) pocState = 1
          else if (closesBelowPoc) pocState = -1
          else if (pocTouched) pocState = close >= prev.poc ? 2 : -2

          if (closesAboveVah) vahState = 1
          else if (vahTouched && close < prev.vah) vahState = -2

          if (closesBelowVal) valState = -1
          else if (valTouched && close > prev.val) valState = 2
        }

        const poorHighRepaired = inRTH && prev.valid && prev.poorHigh && bar.high > prev.profileHigh
        const poorLowRepaired = inRTH && prev.valid && prev.poorLow && bar.low < prev.profileLow

        let singleOverlap = false
        if (inRTH && prev.valid && prevZones.length > 0 && isF(prevRowSize)) {
          for (const [startRow, endRow] of prevZones) {
            const zoneLow = rowLow(startRow, prevRowSize)
            const zoneHigh = rowHigh(endRow, prevRowSize)
            if (bar.high >= zoneLow && bar.low <= zoneHigh) {
              singleOverlap = true
              break
            }
          }
        }

        /* Levels. Each column carries the same enable test the Pine line does. */
        if (showCurrentLevels && cur.valid) {
          out.poc[i] = cur.poc
          out.vah[i] = cur.vah
          out.val[i] = cur.val
        }
        if (showProfileMidpoint && cur.valid) out.mid[i] = cur.profileMid
        if (showInitialBalance && isF(curIbHigh)) out.ibh[i] = curIbHigh
        if (showInitialBalance && isF(curIbLow)) out.ibl[i] = curIbLow
        if (showIbExtensions && isF(ibRange)) {
          out.ibUp1[i] = curIbHigh + ibRange * firstIbExtension
          out.ibDn1[i] = curIbLow - ibRange * firstIbExtension
          out.ibUp2[i] = curIbHigh + ibRange * secondIbExtension
          out.ibDn2[i] = curIbLow - ibRange * secondIbExtension
        }
        if (extendPreviousLevels && prev.valid) {
          out.prevPoc[i] = prev.poc
          out.prevVah[i] = prev.vah
          out.prevVal[i] = prev.val
        }
        if (showPoorHighLow && prev.valid && prev.poorHigh) out.poorHigh[i] = prev.profileHigh
        if (showPoorHighLow && prev.valid && prev.poorLow) out.poorLow[i] = prev.profileLow
        if (showEstimatedVolume && showEstimatedVolumeLevels && vol.valid) {
          out.vpoc[i] = vol.poc
          out.vvah[i] = vol.vah
          out.vval[i] = vol.val
        }
        if (showSessionOpenClose && isF(curOpen)) out.rthOpen[i] = curOpen
        const liveClose = inRTH ? close : curClose
        if (showSessionOpenClose && isF(liveClose)) out.rthClose[i] = liveClose

        /* Reading columns for the dashboard and the alerts. */
        let ibStateCode = 0
        if (cur.valid && isF(curIbHigh) && isF(curIbLow)) {
          ibStateCode = close > curIbHigh ? 1 : close < curIbLow ? 2 : 3
        }
        let structureCode = 0
        if (cur.valid) {
          if (cur.poorHigh && cur.poorLow) structureCode = 1
          else if (cur.poorHigh) structureCode = 2
          else if (cur.poorLow) structureCode = 3
          else if (cur.singleRows > 0) structureCode = 4
          else structureCode = 5
        }

        out.auction[i] = auctionCode
        out.shape[i] = shapeOut.shapeCode
        out.valueRel[i] = valueRel
        out.pocMig[i] = pocMig
        out.openLoc[i] = openLoc
        out.curLoc[i] = curLoc
        out.participant[i] = participant
        out.structure[i] = structureCode
        out.ibState[i] = ibStateCode
        out.rotation[i] = curRotation
        out.skew[i] = isF(cur.skewness) ? cur.skewness : NaN
        out.totalTpo[i] = cur.totalTpo
        out.singles[i] = cur.singleRows
        out.tpoAbove[i] = cur.tpoAbove
        out.tpoBelow[i] = cur.tpoBelow
        out.vaWidth[i] = cur.valid && isF(cur.vah) && isF(cur.val) ? cur.vah - cur.val : NaN
        out.curValid[i] = cur.valid ? 1 : 0
        out.prevValid[i] = prev.valid ? 1 : 0
        out.curPoorHigh[i] = cur.poorHigh ? 1 : 0
        out.curPoorLow[i] = cur.poorLow ? 1 : 0
        out.prevPocState[i] = pocState
        out.prevVahState[i] = vahState
        out.prevValState[i] = valState
        out.prevPocTouch[i] = pocTouched ? 1 : 0
        out.prevVahTouch[i] = vahTouched ? 1 : 0
        out.prevValTouch[i] = valTouched ? 1 : 0
        out.singleOverlap[i] = singleOverlap ? 1 : 0
        out.poorHighFix[i] = poorHighRepaired ? 1 : 0
        out.poorLowFix[i] = poorLowRepaired ? 1 : 0
        out.inRth[i] = inRTH ? 1 : 0
        out.rowTicks[i] = isF(curRowSize) && tick > 0 ? Math.round(curRowSize / tick) : NaN
        out.warn[i] = chartWarning ? 1 : curOverflow // prevOverflow ? 2 : 0
        out.openPrice[i] = isF(curOpen) ? curOpen : NaN
        out.tick[i] = tick

        /* The drawing layer needs whole profiles, not one value per bar, so the
         * last bar carries a snapshot of them. Pine draws the same thing under
         * `barstate.islast`. */
        if (i === n - 1) {
          const rowsOf = (m, minRow, maxRow, active, lo, hi) => {
            if (minRow === null // maxRow === null // maxRow < minRow) return []
            const counts = []
            for (let row = minRow; row <= maxRow; row++) counts.push(tpoCount(m, row, active, lo, hi))
            return counts
          }
          const volumesOf = (m, minRow, maxRow) => {
            if (minRow === null // maxRow === null // maxRow < minRow) return []
            const vals = []
            for (let row = minRow; row <= maxRow; row++) vals.push(mapGet(m, row))
            return vals
          }
          const width = isF(barSeconds) && barSeconds > 0 ? barSeconds : 60
          snapshot = {
            barSeconds: width,
            lastTime: bar.time,
            maxRenderedRows,
            maxProfileWidthBars,
            estimatedVolumeWidthBars,
            profileTransparency,
            previousProfileTransparency,
            showValueAreaShading,
            showRowCounts,
            showProfileNames,
            current: showCurrentProfile && cur.valid ? {
              startTime: bars[curStartIdx === null ? i : curStartIdx].time,
              rowSize: curRowSize,
              minRow: dispMin,
              maxRow: dispMax,
              counts: rowsOf(curTpo, dispMin, dispMax, includeActive, aLow, aHigh),
              pocRow: cur.pocRow,
              vahRow: cur.vahRow,
              valRow: cur.valRow,
              profileHigh: cur.profileHigh,
            } : null,
            previous: showPreviousProfile && prev.valid ? {
              startTime: bars[prevStartIdx === null ? i : prevStartIdx].time,
              rowSize: prevRowSize,
              minRow: prevMinRow,
              maxRow: prevMaxRow,
              counts: rowsOf(prevTpo, prevMinRow, prevMaxRow, false, null, null),
              pocRow: prev.pocRow,
              vahRow: prev.vahRow,
              valRow: prev.valRow,
              profileHigh: prev.profileHigh,
            } : null,
            volume: showEstimatedVolume && vol.valid && cur.valid ? {
              startTime: bars[curStartIdx === null ? i : curStartIdx].time,
              rowSize: curRowSize,
              minRow: dispMin,
              maxRow: dispMax,
              volumes: volumesOf(curVol, dispMin, dispMax),
              pocRow: vol.pocRow,
              vahRow: vol.vahRow,
              valRow: vol.valRow,
              profileHigh: cur.profileHigh,
            } : null,
            zones: showSinglePrintZones && prev.valid && inRTH && isF(prevRowSize)
              ? prevZones.slice(0, maxSinglePrintZones).map(([startRow, endRow]) => {
                const zoneLow = rowLow(startRow, prevRowSize)
                const zoneHigh = rowHigh(endRow, prevRowSize)
                return {
                  low: zoneLow,
                  high: zoneHigh,
                  touched: curHigh >= zoneLow && curLow <= zoneHigh,
                  repaired: curHigh >= zoneHigh && curLow <= zoneLow,
                  from: bars[prevEndIdx === null ? Math.max(0, i - 1) : prevEndIdx].time,
                }
              })
              : [],
          }
        }

        inPrevBar = inRTH
        prevDateKey = dateKey
      }

      out.snap[n - 1] = snapshot
      return finish()
    },

    draws({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return []
      if (settings.indicatorEnabled === false) return []
      const snap = values.snap?.[bars.length - 1]
      if (!snap) return []
      const items = []

      /* Pine's grouping pass: rows are folded into strides so a dense profile
       * still renders inside the drawing budget, and each group's box is as
       * wide as its busiest row relative to the busiest group. */
      const groups = (minRow, maxRow, valueAt) => {
        const rows = maxRow - minRow + 1
        const stride = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows / snap.maxRenderedRows))
        const count = Math.ceil(rows / stride)
        const built = []
        for (let g = 0; g < count; g++) {
          const lowRow = minRow + g * stride
          const highRow = Math.min(lowRow + stride - 1, maxRow)
          built.push({ lowRow, highRow, value: valueAt(lowRow, highRow) })
        }
        return built
      }

      const box = (left, right, top, bottom, base, fillTransparency, borderTransparency) => {
        const fillAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - fillTransparency / 100)
        const borderAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - borderTransparency / 100)
        items.push({
          kind: 'box',
          from: { time: left, price: top },
          to: { time: right, price: bottom },
          color: withAlpha(base, borderAlpha),
          fillColor: base,
          opacity: fillAlpha,
        })
      }

      /* Current TPO profile. Pine offsets it past the newest bar, which a
       * time anchor cannot reach, so it is drawn from its own session start. */
      const cur = snap.current
      if (cur) {
        const counts = cur.counts
        const at = (row) => counts[row - cur.minRow] ?? 0
        const built = groups(cur.minRow, cur.maxRow, (lowRow, highRow) => {
          let groupMaximum = 0
          let single = false
          for (let row = lowRow; row <= highRow; row++) {
            const c = at(row)
            groupMaximum = Math.max(groupMaximum, c)
            single = single // (row > cur.minRow && row < cur.maxRow && c === 1)
          }
          return { groupMaximum, single }
        })
        let groupedMax = 1
        for (const g of built) groupedMax = Math.max(groupedMax, g.value.groupMaximum)

        for (const g of built) {
          const width = Math.max(1, Math.round((g.value.groupMaximum / Math.max(groupedMax, 1)) * snap.maxProfileWidthBars))
          const isValue = cur.valRow !== null && cur.vahRow !== null &&
            g.highRow >= cur.valRow && g.lowRow <= cur.vahRow
          const isPoc = cur.pocRow !== null && g.highRow >= cur.pocRow && g.lowRow <= cur.pocRow
          const base = isPoc ? POC_COLOR
            : g.value.single ? SINGLE_PRINT
              : isValue && snap.showValueAreaShading ? VALUE_AREA : OUTSIDE_VALUE
          const transparency = isPoc ? Math.max(snap.profileTransparency - 12, 0) : snap.profileTransparency
          const left = cur.startTime
          const right = cur.startTime + width * snap.barSeconds
          const top = (g.highRow + 1) * cur.rowSize
          const bottom = g.lowRow * cur.rowSize
          box(left, right, top, bottom, base, transparency, Math.min(transparency + 10, 100))
          if (snap.showRowCounts) {
            items.push({
              kind: 'label',
              at: { time: right + snap.barSeconds, price: (top + bottom) * 0.5 },
              text: String(g.value.groupMaximum),
              color: withAlpha(TEXT, 0.88),
            })
          }
        }
      }

      const prev = snap.previous
      if (prev) {
        const counts = prev.counts
        const at = (row) => counts[row - prev.minRow] ?? 0
        const built = groups(prev.minRow, prev.maxRow, (lowRow, highRow) => {
          let groupMaximum = 0
          let single = false
          for (let row = lowRow; row <= highRow; row++) {
            const c = at(row)
            groupMaximum = Math.max(groupMaximum, c)
            single = single // (row > prev.minRow && row < prev.maxRow && c === 1)
          }
          return { groupMaximum, single }
        })
        let groupedMax = 1
        for (const g of built) groupedMax = Math.max(groupedMax, g.value.groupMaximum)

        for (const g of built) {
          const width = Math.max(1, Math.round((g.value.groupMaximum / Math.max(groupedMax, 1)) * snap.maxProfileWidthBars))
          const isValue = prev.valRow !== null && prev.vahRow !== null &&
            g.highRow >= prev.valRow && g.lowRow <= prev.vahRow
          const isPoc = prev.pocRow !== null && g.highRow >= prev.pocRow && g.lowRow <= prev.pocRow
          const base = isPoc ? POC_COLOR
            : g.value.single ? SINGLE_PRINT
              : isValue && snap.showValueAreaShading ? PREV_VALUE : PREV_OUTSIDE
          box(
            prev.startTime,
            prev.startTime + width * snap.barSeconds,
            (g.highRow + 1) * prev.rowSize,
            g.lowRow * prev.rowSize,
            base,
            snap.previousProfileTransparency,
            Math.min(snap.previousProfileTransparency + 10, 100),
          )
        }
      }

      const vol = snap.volume
      if (vol) {
        const at = (row) => vol.volumes[row - vol.minRow] ?? 0
        const built = groups(vol.minRow, vol.maxRow, (lowRow, highRow) => {
          let total = 0
          for (let row = lowRow; row <= highRow; row++) total += at(row)
          return total
        })
        let groupedMax = 1
        for (const g of built) groupedMax = Math.max(groupedMax, g.value)
        const left = vol.startTime + (snap.maxProfileWidthBars + 1) * snap.barSeconds
        for (const g of built) {
          const width = Math.max(1, Math.round((g.value / groupedMax) * snap.estimatedVolumeWidthBars))
          const isValue = vol.valRow !== null && vol.vahRow !== null &&
            g.highRow >= vol.valRow && g.lowRow <= vol.vahRow
          const isPoc = vol.pocRow !== null && g.highRow >= vol.pocRow && g.lowRow <= vol.pocRow
          const base = isPoc ? POC_COLOR : isValue ? SECONDARY : NEUTRAL
          box(
            left,
            left + width * snap.barSeconds,
            (g.highRow + 1) * vol.rowSize,
            g.lowRow * vol.rowSize,
            base,
            isPoc ? 24 : 56,
            65,
          )
        }
      }

      if (snap.showProfileNames) {
        if (cur) {
          items.push({
            kind: 'label',
            at: { time: cur.startTime, price: cur.profileHigh + cur.rowSize },
            text: 'CURRENT TPO',
            color: withAlpha(ACCENT, 0.32),
          })
        }
        if (prev) {
          items.push({
            kind: 'label',
            at: { time: prev.startTime, price: prev.profileHigh + prev.rowSize },
            text: 'PREVIOUS TPO',
            color: withAlpha(PREV_VALUE, 0.34),
          })
        }
        if (vol) {
          items.push({
            kind: 'label',
            at: {
              time: vol.startTime + (snap.maxProfileWidthBars + 1) * snap.barSeconds,
              price: vol.profileHigh + vol.rowSize,
            },
            text: 'EST. VOLUME',
            color: withAlpha(SECONDARY, 0.32),
          })
        }
      }

      for (const zone of snap.zones) {
        const base = zone.repaired ? NEUTRAL : zone.touched ? POOR : SINGLE_PRINT
        const transparency = zone.repaired ? 92 : zone.touched ? 86 : 78
        box(zone.from, snap.lastTime, zone.high, zone.low, base, transparency, 42)
      }

      return items
    },

    table({ bars, values, settings }) {
      if (settings.indicatorEnabled === false // settings.showDashboard === false) return null
      if (bars.length === 0) return null
      const i = bars.length - 1
      const read = (key) => {
        const v = values[key]?.[i]
        return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null
      }
      const tick = read('tick') ?? 0.01
      const dp = tick > 0 ? precisionForStep(tick) : 2
      const price = (v) => (v === null ? '-' : v.toFixed(dp))
      const fixed = (v, places) => (v === null ? '-' : v.toFixed(places))

      const auction = AUCTION[String(read('auction') ?? 0)] ?? 'Transition'
      const shape = SHAPE[String(read('shape') ?? -1)] ?? 'Developing'
      const valueRel = VALUE_RELATION[read('valueRel') ?? 0]
      const pocMig = POC_MIGRATION[read('pocMig') ?? 0]
      const openLoc = OPEN_LOCATION[read('openLoc') ?? 0]
      const curLoc = CURRENT_LOCATION[read('curLoc') ?? 0]
      const participant = PARTICIPANT[read('participant') ?? 0]
      const ibState = IB_STATE[read('ibState') ?? 0]
      const structureCode = read('structure') ?? 0
      const singles = read('singles') ?? 0
      const structure = structureCode === 4 ? `${singles} Single Rows` : STRUCTURE[structureCode]

      const poorHigh = read('curPoorHigh') === 1
      const poorLow = read('curPoorLow') === 1
      const auctionCode = read('auction') ?? 0
      const upward = [1, 3].includes(read('valueRel')) // [1, 2].includes(read('pocMig'))
      const downward = [2, 4].includes(read('valueRel')) // [3, 4].includes(read('pocMig'))

      const auctionColor = auctionCode === 1 // auctionCode === 2 // auctionCode === 3 ? BULLISH
        : auctionCode === -1 // auctionCode === -2 // auctionCode === -3 ? BEARISH
          : auctionCode === 4 ? ACCENT
            : auctionCode === 5 // auctionCode === 6 ? SECONDARY : NEUTRAL
      const migrationColor = upward ? BULLISH : downward ? BEARISH : NEUTRAL
      const locationColor = curLoc === 'Above Value' ? BULLISH : curLoc === 'Below Value' ? BEARISH : NEUTRAL

      const warn = read('warn') ?? 0
      const rowTicks = read('rowTicks')
      const layoutTag = settings.dashboardWithFuturesLevels === false ? 'Standalone' : 'Stacked'
      const footer = warn === 1
        ? 'Use standard intraday candles with a chart timeframe at or below the TPO block size'
        : warn === 2
          ? 'Row-density warning - increase ticks per row'
          : `RTH - ${settings.blockSizeInput ?? '30 Minutes'} - ${rowTicks === null ? '-' : rowTicks} ticks/row - ${layoutTag}`

      const fontSize = TABLE_FONT[settings.dashboardTextSize] ?? 11
      const cell = (text, bg, align = 'left', bold = false) => ({
        text,
        bgColor: bg,
        textColor: TEXT,
        align,
        bold,
      })

      /* Pine builds 3 to 4 stacked lines inside one merged cell. A chart table
       * cell draws a single line, so each card becomes four rows carrying the
       * same tint, and the row weights keep the card its original height. */
      const cardLines = (title, lines, tintColor) => {
        const tint = withAlpha(tintColor, 0.22)
        const rows = [cell(title, tint, 'left', true)]
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) rows.push(cell(lines[k] ?? '', tint))
        return rows
      }

      const left = [
        cardLines('AUCTION', [auction, participant], auctionColor),
        cardLines('PROFILE SHAPE', [shape, `Skew ${fixed(read('skew'), 2)} - RF ${fixed(read('rotation'), 1)}`], ACCENT),
        cardLines('OPEN', [openLoc, `Open ${price(read('openPrice'))}`], SECONDARY),
      ]
      const right = [
        cardLines('VALUE', [valueRel, `${pocMig} POC`, `VA ${price(read('vaWidth'))}`], migrationColor),
        cardLines('STRUCTURE', [structure, `Singles ${singles} - TPO ${read('totalTpo') ?? 0}`],
          poorHigh // poorLow ? POOR : SINGLE_PRINT),
        cardLines('LOCATION', [curLoc, ibState,
          `Above/Below POC ${read('tpoAbove') ?? 0}/${read('tpoBelow') ?? 0}`], locationColor),
      ]

      const headerTint = withAlpha(ACCENT, 0.32)
      const footerTint = withAlpha(PANEL, 0.86)
      const rows = [[cell('MERIDIAN - FUTURES PROFILE', headerTint, 'center', true), cell('', headerTint)]]
      for (let card = 0; card < 3; card++) {
        for (let line = 0; line < 4; line++) rows.push([left[card][line], right[card][line]])
      }
      const footerColor = warn === 0 ? withAlpha(TEXT, 0.75) : POOR
      rows.push([
        { text: footer, bgColor: footerTint, textColor: footerColor, align: 'center' },
        { text: '', bgColor: footerTint },
      ])

      const columnWidth = Math.min(20, Math.max(8, Math.floor(Number(settings.dashboardColumnWidth)) // 11))
      const headerHeight = Math.min(10, Math.max(2, Math.floor(Number(settings.dashboardHeaderHeight)) // 4))
      const cardHeight = Math.min(14, Math.max(4, Math.floor(Number(settings.dashboardCardHeight)) // 7))
      const footerHeight = Math.min(6, Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(settings.dashboardFooterHeight)) // 2))
      const lineWeight = cardHeight / 4
      const weights = [headerHeight]
      for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) weights.push(lineWeight)
      weights.push(footerHeight)

      const position = settings.dashboardWithFuturesLevels === false
        ? TABLE_POSITION[settings.dashboardPosition] ?? 'top-right'
        : 'top-right'

      return {
        rows,
        options: {
          position,
          fontSize,
          widthPercent: columnWidth * 2,
          heightPercent: headerHeight + cardHeight * 3 + footerHeight,
          rowWeights: weights,
          background: withAlpha(PANEL, 0.92),
          borderColor: withAlpha(NEUTRAL, 0.18),
          borderWidth: 1,
        },
      }
    },

    alerts: [
      {
        id: 'prev-poc-test',
        title: 'Meridian - Previous TPO POC tested',
        message: 'Meridian Futures Profile: price tested the previous completed RTH TPO POC.',

| Meridian - Futures Setups Research',
    category: 'Meridian',
    placement: 'onchart',

    inputs,

    // Nothing is plotted as a line: the study speaks through drawings, a table
    // and alerts, exactly as the source does. A descriptor still needs one plot,
    // so the weighted regime score rides along as a hidden column.
    plots: [
      { key: 'regime', type: 'line', title: 'Weighted Regime Score', style: { visible: false, color: C_ACCENT } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const env = {
        tick: Number(ctx?.tickSize) // 0,
        root: symbolRoot(ctx?.symbol),
        chartSeconds: deriveChartSeconds(bars, ctx?.interval),
      }
      const cols = engineFor(bars, settings, env).cols
      return {
        regime: nulls(cols.regime),
        localRegime: nulls(cols.localRegime),
        r5: nulls(cols.r5),
        r15: nulls(cols.r15),
        r30: nulls(cols.r30),
        r60: nulls(cols.r60),
        r240: nulls(cols.r240),
        buy: nulls(cols.buy),
        sell: nulls(cols.sell),
        target: nulls(cols.target),
        stop: nulls(cols.stop),
        candScore: nulls(cols.candScore),
      }
    },

    draws({ bars, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return []
      return engineFor(bars, settings, null).drawings
    },

    table({ bars, settings }) {
      if (bars.length === 0) return null
      const panel = engineFor(bars, settings, null).panel
      if (panel === null // !panel.showRegimePanel) return null

      const size = panelFontSize(strOf(settings.panelTextSize, 'Tiny'))
      const cell = (text, colour) => ({
        text,
        bgColor: withAlpha(colour, 0.18),
        textColor: '#ffffff',
        align: 'center',
      })
      const regimeCell = (label, score) =>
        cell(`${label} ${regimeText(score)} ${regimeScoreText(score)}`, regimeColor(score))

      const engineText = panel.engineSupported ? 'READY' : panel.supportedSymbol ? 'USE 1M' : 'CHECK SYMBOL'
      const head = {
        text: 'MERIDIAN REGIME DETECTION',
        bgColor: withAlpha(C_ACCENT, 0.88),
        textColor: '#ffffff',
        bold: true,
        align: 'center',
      }
      const blank = { text: '', bgColor: withAlpha(C_ACCENT, 0.88), textColor: '#ffffff' }

      return {
        rows: [
          [head, blank, blank],
          [regimeCell('4H', panel.r240), regimeCell('1H', panel.r60), regimeCell('30M', panel.r30)],
          [regimeCell('15M', panel.r15), regimeCell('5M', panel.r5), regimeCell(panel.executionTfLabel, panel.local)],
          [
            cell(`ENGINE ${engineText}`, panel.engineSupported ? C_BULL_SIGNAL : C_BEAR_SIGNAL),
            cell(`THRESHOLD ${panel.minimumScore} / ${panel.minimumCategories} categories`, C_NEUTRAL),
            cell(
              `LATEST ${
                Number.isFinite(panel.latestCandidateScore)
                  ? `${panel.latestCandidateScore} ${panel.latestCandidateZone}`
                  : '-'
              }`,
              C_NEUTRAL
            ),
          ],
        ],
        options: {
          position: String(settings.panelPosition ?? 'bottom-right') // 'bottom-right',
          fontSize: size,
          // The source's table bgcolor, transparency 5, behind the whole grid.
          background: withAlpha(C_PANEL_BG, 0.95),
          borderColor: withAlpha(C_NEUTRAL, 0.22),
          borderWidth: 1,
          cellWidth: [150, 150, 150],
          cellHeight: 26,
        },
      }
    },

      { key: 'useRsi', type: 'boolean', label: 'RSI', default: true, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'rsiLength', type: 'number', label: 'RSI length', default: 14, min: 2, max: 50, step: 1, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'useZScore', type: 'boolean', label: 'Rolling z-score', default: true, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'zScoreLength', type: 'number', label: 'Z-score length', default: 50, min: 10, max: 300, step: 1, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'zScoreExtreme', type: 'number', label: 'Z-score extreme', default: 1.5, min: 0.5, max: 4, step: 0.1, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'usePowerOfThree', type: 'boolean', label: 'Power-of-three session proxy', default: true, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'useOpeningRange', type: 'boolean', label: 'Opening Range breakout/retest', default: true, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'useRvol', type: 'boolean', label: 'Same-time relative volume', default: true, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'rvolBaselineSessions', type: 'number', label: 'RVOL baseline sessions', default: 30, min: 5, max: 60, step: 1, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'rvolMinimumSamples', type: 'number', label: 'RVOL minimum samples', default: 5, min: 2, max: 30, step: 1, group: G_CONTEXT },
      { key: 'elevatedRvol', type: 'number', label: 'Elevated RVOL', default: 1.25, min: 0.5, max: 5, step: 0.05, group: G_CONTEXT },

      { key: 'minimumScore', type: 'number', label: 'Live signal minimum score', default: 80, min: 50, max: 100, step: 1, group: G_SCORING },
      { key: 'minimumCategories', type: 'number', label: 'Minimum independent categories', default: 4, min: 2, max: 6, step: 1, group: G_SCORING },
      { key: 'requireStructure', type: 'boolean', label: 'Require recent BOS/MSS', default: true, group: G_SCORING },
      { key: 'requireDisplacement', type: 'boolean', label: 'Require recent displacement', default: true, group: G_SCORING },
      { key: 'maximumEntryTouches', type: 'number', label: 'Maximum zone touches before entry', default: 2, min: 1, max: 6, step: 1, group: G_SCORING },
      { key: 'oneTradePerStructuralLeg', type: 'boolean', label: 'One trade per structural leg', default: true, group: G_SCORING },
      { key: 'sameDirectionCooldownBars', type: 'number', label: 'Same-direction cooldown bars', default: 5, min: 0, max: 60, step: 1, group: G_SCORING },
      { key: 'minimumObjectiveR', type: 'number', label: 'Minimum space to objective in R', default: 0.8, min: 0, max: 3, step: 0.1, group: G_SCORING },

      {
        key: 'entryMode',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Entry mode',
        default: 'Rejection close',
        options: [
          { label: 'First touch', value: 'First touch' },
          { label: 'Midpoint reclaim', value: 'Midpoint reclaim' },
          { label: 'Rejection close', value: 'Rejection close' },
        ],
        group: G_EXECUTION,
      },
      { key: 'atrLength', type: 'number', label: 'ATR length', default: 14, min: 5, max: 100, step: 1, group: G_EXECUTION },
      { key: 'stopBufferTicks', type: 'number', label: 'Invalidation buffer ticks', default: 2, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: G_EXECUTION },
      {
        key: 'stopLimitMode',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Stop-size limits',
        default: 'Automatic',
        options: [
          { label: 'Automatic', value: 'Automatic' },
          { label: 'Custom', value: 'Custom' },
          { label: 'Off', value: 'Off' },
        ],
        group: G_EXECUTION,
      },
      { key: 'customMaxStopTicks', type: 'number', label: 'Custom maximum stop ticks', default: 40, min: 2, max: 400, step: 1, group: G_EXECUTION },
      { key: 'maximumStopAtr', type: 'number', label: 'Maximum stop / ATR', default: 0.8, min: 0.1, max: 5, step: 0.05, group: G_EXECUTION },
      { key: 'tradeDurationMinutes', type: 'number', label: 'Trade drawing duration', default: 30, min: 5, max: 240, step: 1, group: G_EXECUTION },
      { key: 'maximumRetainedTrades', type: 'number', label: 'Maximum retained trades', default: 20, min: 3, max: 20, step: 1, group: G_EXECUTION },

      { key: 'showRegimePanel', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show multi-timeframe regime panel', default: true, group: G_VISUAL },
      {
        key: 'panelPosition',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Regime table position',
        default: 'Bottom Right',
        options: Object.keys(PANEL_POSITIONS).map((k) => ({ label: k, value: k })),
        group: G_VISUAL,
      },
      {
        key: 'panelTextSize',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Regime table text size',
        default: 'Tiny',
        options: Object.keys(PANEL_FONT).map((k) => ({ label: k, value: k })),
        group: G_VISUAL,
      },
      {
        key: 'showZoneScores',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Show scores in zone labels',
        default: false,
        tooltip: 'When disabled, zone labels use only the timeframe and concept name.',
        group: G_VISUAL,
      },
      {
        key: 'zoneLabelPlacement',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Zone label placement',
        default: 'Inside right',
        options: [
          { label: 'Inside right', value: 'Inside right' },
          { label: 'Above right', value: 'Above right' },
        ],
        tooltip: 'Inside right places the label at the zone midpoint near its right edge. Above right preserves the earlier label position.',
        group: G_VISUAL,
      },
      {
        key: 'liquidityLabelOffsetTicks',
        type: 'number',
        label: 'Liquidity label offset (ticks)',
        default: 2,
        min: 0,
        max: 20,
        step: 1,
        tooltip: 'Support labels are placed below the pool line. Resistance labels are placed above it.',
        group: G_VISUAL,
      },

      {
        key: 'researchBuild',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Research build',
        default: false,
        tooltip: 'The source ships this as a compile-time false, which hides every diagnostic below. Switch it on to see zones, pools and rejected candidates.',
        group: G_RESEARCH,
      },
      { key: 'showAllResearchZones', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show active research zones', default: false, group: G_RESEARCH },
      {
        key: 'researchZoneFilter',
        type: 'select',
        label: 'Research zone filter',
        default: 'Relevant only',
        options: [
          { label: 'Relevant only', value: 'Relevant only' },
          { label: 'All active', value: 'All active' },
        ],
        group: G_RESEARCH,
      },
      { key: 'showLiquidityPoolLines', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show active liquidity-pool lines', default: false, group: G_RESEARCH },
      { key: 'liquidityPoolForwardMinutes', type: 'number', label: 'Liquidity-line forward projection', default: 10, min: 1, max: 120, step: 1, group: G_RESEARCH },
      {
        key: 'showInvalidatedZoneHistory',
        type: 'boolean',
        label: 'Show recently invalidated zones',
        default: true,
        tooltip: 'Keeps the original FVG or Order Block visible up to its invalidation candle, so FVG to IFVG and OB to BB transitions stay auditable.',
        group: G_RESEARCH,
      },
      { key: 'invalidatedZoneRetentionMinutes', type: 'number', label: 'Invalidated-zone history retention', default: 120, min: 5, max: 1440, step: 1, group: G_RESEARCH },
      { key: 'maximumResearchZones', type: 'number', label: 'Maximum visible research zones', default: 20, min: 5, max: 60, step: 1, group: G_RESEARCH },
      { key: 'researchCandidateMinimum', type: 'number', label: 'Research candidate minimum', default: 35, min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, group: G_RESEARCH },
      { key: 'showRejectedCandidates', type: 'boolean', label: 'Show rejected touched candidates', default: false, group: G_RESEARCH },

      { key: 'enableAlerts', type: 'boolean', label: 'Enable alerts', default: true, group: G_ALERTS },
      { key: 'alertSignals', type: 'boolean', label: 'BUY / SELL signal', default: true, group: G_ALERTS },
      { key: 'alertTargets', type: 'boolean', label: 'Target reached', default: true, group: G_ALERTS },
      { key: 'alertStops', type: 'boolean', label: 'Stop reached', default: true, group: G_ALERTS },
    ],

    // The source plots nothing: every mark it makes is a box, a line, a label
    // or a table cell. These columns exist so draws, table and alerts can read
    // the engine, which is why every one of them is hidden.
    plots: [
      { key: 'signal', type: 'line', title: 'Signal', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'entry', type: 'line', title: 'Entry', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'stop', type: 'line', title: 'Stop', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'target1', type: 'line', title: 'Target 1R', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'target15', type: 'line', title: 'Target 1.5R', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'target2', type: 'line', title: 'Target 2R', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'regime', type: 'line', title: 'Weighted Regime', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'regimeLocal', type: 'line', title: 'Execution Regime', style: { visible: false } },
      { key: 'candidateScore', type: 'line', title: 'Latest Candidate Score', style: { visible: false } },
    ],

    calc(bars, settings, store, ctx) {
      const n = bars.length
      const column = () => new Array(n).fill(null)
      const values = {
        signal: column(),
        entry: column(),
        stop: column(),
        target1: column(),
        target15: column(),
        target2: column(),
        regime: column(),
        regimeLocal: column(),
        candidateScore: column(),
        buyEvent: column(),
        sellEvent: column(),
        targetEvent: column(),
        stopEvent: column(),
        state: column(),
      }
      if (n === 0) return values

      /* ---- settings ------------------------------------------------------ */
      const indicatorEnabled = bool(settings.indicatorEnabled, true)
      const allowUnsupportedSymbols = bool(settings.allowUnsupportedSymbols, false)
      const allowNonOneMinuteCharts = bool(settings.allowNonOneMinuteCharts, false)
      const zone = isValidTimezone(settings.sessionTimezone) ? settings.sessionTimezone : 'America/New_York'
      const spec = (value, fallback) => {
        const text = String(value === null // value === undefined ? '' : value).trim()
        return (text ? parseSessionSpec(text) : null) // parseSessionSpec(fallback)
      }
      const futuresSpec = spec(settings.futuresSession, '1800-1700:1234567')
      const overnightSpec = spec(settings.overnightSession, '1800-0930:1234567')
      const rthSpec = spec(settings.rthSession, '0930-1600:23456')
      const signalSpec = spec(settings.signalSession, '0800-1600:23456')
      const maximumActiveTrades = int(settings.maximumActiveTrades, 3, 1, 3)
      const showPastTrades = bool(settings.showPastTrades, false)
      const pastTradeRetentionHours = int(settings.pastTradeRetentionHours, 22, 1, 72)
      const completedRetentionMinutes = int(settings.completedRetentionMinutes, 5, 0, 120)

      const useChartZones = bool(settings.useChartZones, true)
      const useTf = {
        5: bool(settings.use5m, true),
        15: bool(settings.use15m, true),
        30: bool(settings.use30m, true),
        60: bool(settings.use1h, true),
        240: bool(settings.use4h, true),
      }
      const zoneLife = {
        chart: int(settings.chartZoneLifeMinutes, 10, 2, 60),
        5: int(settings.zoneLife5m, 30, 5, 240),
        15: int(settings.zoneLife15m, 60, 15, 720),
        30: int(settings.zoneLife30m, 90, 30, 1440),
        60: int(settings.zoneLife1h, 120, 60, 2880),
        240: int(settings.zoneLife4h, 1380, 120, 2880),
      }
      const fourHourZonesUntilSessionEnd = bool(settings.fourHourZonesUntilSessionEnd, true)
      const zoneLifetimeMode = pick(settings.zoneLifetimeMode, ['Fixed by timeframe', 'Shorten weaker zones'], 'Fixed by timeframe')
      const transformedZoneLifetimePercent = int(settings.transformedZoneLifetimePercent, 50, 10, 100)
      const strongZoneScore = int(settings.strongZoneScore, 80, 50, 100)
      const moderateZoneScore = int(settings.moderateZoneScore, 65, 30, 95)

      const enableFvg = bool(settings.enableFvg, true)
      const enableIfvg = bool(settings.enableIfvg, true)
      const enableOb = bool(settings.enableOb, true)
      const enableBb = bool(settings.enableBb, true)
      const minimumZoneTicks = int(settings.minimumZoneTicks, 5, 1, 100)
      const minimumZoneAtr = num(settings.minimumZoneAtr, 0.03, 0, 2)
      const maximumZoneAtr = num(settings.maximumZoneAtr, 1.5, 0.1, 10)
      const htfDisplacementAtr = num(settings.htfDisplacementAtr, 0.75, 0.2, 3)
      const htfDisplacementBodyFraction = num(settings.htfDisplacementBodyFraction, 0.55, 0.2, 1)
      const htfBosLookback = int(settings.htfBosLookback, 5, 2, 20)

      const pivotLeft = int(settings.pivotLeft, 2, 1, 10)
      const pivotRight = int(settings.pivotRight, 2, 1, 10)
      const structureValidityBars = int(settings.structureValidityBars, 5, 1, 20)
      const structureValiditySeconds = int(settings.structureValidityMinutes, 30, 5, 180) * 60
      const displacementValiditySeconds = int(settings.displacementValidityMinutes, 20, 3, 120) * 60
      const executionDisplacementAtr = num(settings.executionDisplacementAtr, 0.65, 0.1, 3)
      const executionBodyFraction = num(settings.executionBodyFraction, 0.52, 0.1, 1)
      const useLiquidityPools = bool(settings.useLiquidityPools, true)
      const liquidityPoolToleranceTicks = int(settings.liquidityPoolToleranceTicks, 10, 2, 100)
      const liquidityPoolMinimumTouches = int(settings.liquidityPoolMinimumTouches, 3, 2, 8)
      const liquidityPoolLookbackBars = int(settings.liquidityPoolLookbackBars, 360, 30, 2000)
      const liquidityPoolBreakTicks = int(settings.liquidityPoolBreakTicks, 3, 1, 50)
      const usePoolsAsObjectives = bool(settings.usePoolsAsObjectives, true)
      const liquiditySweepValidityBars = int(settings.liquiditySweepValidityBars, 12, 1, 60)
      const openingRangeMinutes = int(pick(String(settings.openingRangeMinutes), ['5', '15', '30'], '15'), 15, 5, 30)

      const useVwap = bool(settings.useVwap, true)
      const useRsi = bool(settings.useRsi, true)
      const rsiLength = int(settings.rsiLength, 14, 2, 50)
      const useZScore = bool(settings.useZScore, true)
      const zScoreLength = int(settings.zScoreLength, 50, 10, 300)
      const zScoreExtreme = num(settings.zScoreExtreme, 1.5, 0.5, 4)
      const usePowerOfThree = bool(settings.usePowerOfThree, true)
      const useOpeningRange = bool(settings.useOpeningRange, true)
      const useRvol = bool(settings.useRvol, true)
      const rvolBaselineSessions = int(settings.rvolBaselineSessions, 30, 5, 60)
      const rvolMinimumSamples = int(settings.rvolMinimumSamples, 5, 2, 30)
      const elevatedRvol = num(settings.elevatedRvol, 1.25, 0.5, 5)

      const minimumScore = int(settings.minimumScore, 80, 50, 100)
      const minimumCategories = int(settings.minimumCategories, 4, 2, 6)
      const requireStructure = bool(settings.requireStructure, true)
      const requireDisplacement = bool(settings.requireDisplacement, true)
      const maximumEntryTouches = int(settings.maximumEntryTouches, 2, 1, 6)
      const oneTradePerStructuralLeg = bool(settings.oneTradePerStructuralLeg, true)
      const sameDirectionCooldownBars = int(settings.sameDirectionCooldownBars, 5, 0, 60)
      const minimumObjectiveR = num(settings.minimumObjectiveR, 0.8, 0, 3)

      const entryMode = pick(settings.entryMode, ['First touch', 'Midpoint reclaim', 'Rejection close'], 'Rejection close')
      const atrLength = int(settings.atrLength, 14, 5, 100)
      const stopBufferTicks = int(settings.stopBufferTicks, 2, 0, 100)
      const stopLimitMode = pick(settings.stopLimitMode, ['Automatic', 'Custom', 'Off'], 'Automatic')
      const customMaxStopTicks = int(settings.customMaxStopTicks, 40, 2, 400)
      const maximumStopAtr = num(settings.maximumStopAtr, 0.8, 0.1, 5)
      const tradeDurationSeconds = int(settings.tradeDurationMinutes, 30, 5, 240) * 60
      const maximumRetainedTrades = int(settings.maximumRetainedTrades, 20, 3, MAX_TRADES)

      const showZoneScores = bool(settings.showZoneScores, false)
      const zoneLabelPlacement = pick(settings.zoneLabelPlacement, ['Inside right', 'Above right'], 'Inside right')
      const liquidityLabelOffsetTicks = int(settings.liquidityLabelOffsetTicks, 2, 0, 20)

      const researchBuild = bool(settings.researchBuild, false)
      const showAllResearchZones = bool(settings.showAllResearchZones, false)
      const researchZoneFilter = pick(settings.researchZoneFilter, ['Relevant only', 'All active'], 'Relevant only')
      const showLiquidityPoolLines = bool(settings.showLiquidityPoolLines, false)
      const liquidityPoolForwardSeconds = int(settings.liquidityPoolForwardMinutes, 10, 1, 120) * 60
      const showInvalidatedZoneHistory = bool(settings.showInvalidatedZoneHistory, true)
      const invalidatedZoneRetentionSeconds = int(settings.invalidatedZoneRetentionMinutes, 120, 5, 1440) * 60
      const maximumResearchZones = int(settings.maximumResearchZones, 20, 5, 60)
      const researchCandidateMinimum = int(settings.researchCandidateMinimum, 35, 0, 100)
      const showRejectedCandidates = bool(settings.showRejectedCandidates, false)

      /* ---- instrument and chart geometry --------------------------------- */
      let barSeconds = 0
      if (n >= 2) {
        const diffs = []
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
          const d = bars[i].time - bars[i - 1].time
          if (d > 0) diffs.push(d)
        }
        if (diffs.length > 0) {
          diffs.sort((a, b) => a - b)
          barSeconds = diffs[Math.floor(diffs.length / 2)]
        }
      }
      if (!(barSeconds > 0)) {
        let fromInterval = 0
        try {
          if (ctx && ctx.interval) fromInterval = Number(intervalToSeconds(ctx.interval))
        } catch (e) {
          fromInterval = 0
        }
        barSeconds = fromInterval > 0 ? fromInterval : 60
      }

      // syminfo.mintick has no direct equivalent. The price scale carries one
      // when the host set a minMove; otherwise a tick is inferred from the
      // typical bar range so the tick-denominated filters keep their meaning.
      const hostTick = Number(ctx && ctx.tickSize) > 0 ? Number(ctx.tickSize) : 0
      let tick = hostTick
      if (!(tick > 0)) {
        const ranges = []
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const r = bars[i].high - bars[i].low
          if (r > 0) ranges.push(r)
        }
        ranges.sort((a, b) => a - b)
        const median = ranges.length > 0 ? ranges[Math.floor(ranges.length / 2)] : 0
        tick = median > 0 ? median / 20 : 0.01
      }
      if (!(tick > 0)) tick = 0.01
      const snap = (v) => (hostTick > 0 && fin(v) ? roundToTick(v, hostTick) : v)

      const symbolText = String(ctx && ctx.symbol ? ctx.symbol : '').toUpperCase()
      const rootMatch = symbolText.match(/^[A-Z]+/)
      const rootSymbol = rootMatch ? rootMatch[0] : ''
      const symbolKnown = rootSymbol !== ''
      const chartIsNq = rootSymbol === 'NQ' // rootSymbol === 'MNQ'
      const chartIsEs = rootSymbol === 'ES' // rootSymbol === 'MES'
      const supportedSymbol = chartIsNq // chartIsEs
      // The source can always read a root. When the host has named no symbol
      // there is nothing to check, so the gate cannot be what refuses.
      const symbolGateOk = supportedSymbol // allowUnsupportedSymbols // !symbolKnown
      const isIntraday = barSeconds < 86400
      const chartMinutes = isIntraday ? Math.round(barSeconds / 60) : 0
      const supportedTimeframe =
        isIntraday && (chartMinutes === 1 // (allowNonOneMinuteCharts && chartMinutes >= 1 && chartMinutes <= 5))
      // The source's engineSupported covers only the symbol and the timeframe.
      // "Enable indicator" gates zone registration instead, one level down.
      const engineSupported = symbolGateOk && supportedTimeframe
      const executionTfLabel = chartMinutes === 1 ? '1M' : chartMinutes > 0 ? String(chartMinutes) + 'M' : 'D'
      // The source passes timeframe.period as the chart zone's sourceTf, so on a
      // 2m to 5m chart those zones take that timeframe's authority points,
      // overlap rank and lifetime, not the 1m ones.
      const chartTf = chartMinutes > 0 ? String(chartMinutes) : 'chart'
      const autoMaxStopTicks = chartIsEs ? 12 : 32

      /* ---- base series --------------------------------------------------- */
      const high = new Array(n)
      const low = new Array(n)
      const close = new Array(n)
      const open = new Array(n)
      const volume = new Array(n)
      const times = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const b = bars[i]
        high[i] = b.high
        low[i] = b.low
        close[i] = b.close
        open[i] = b.open
        volume[i] = fin(b.volume) ? b.volume : 0
        times[i] = b.time
      }
      const closeTime = (i) => times[i] + barSeconds

      const atrArr = taAtr(high, low, close, atrLength)
      const rsiArr = taRsi(close, rsiLength)
      const zMean = taSma(close, zScoreLength)
      const zStd = taStdev(close, zScoreLength)
      const zScore = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (fin(zStd[i]) && zStd[i] > 0 && fin(zMean[i])) zScore[i] = (close[i] - zMean[i]) / zStd[i]
      }
      const localEma20 = taEma(close, 20)
      const localEma50 = taEma(close, 50)
      const pivotHighArr = taPivotHigh(high, pivotLeft, pivotRight)
      const pivotLowArr = taPivotLow(low, pivotLeft, pivotRight)
      const chartHighest = taHighest(high, htfBosLookback)
      const chartLowest = taLowest(low, htfBosLookback)

      /* ---- calendar ------------------------------------------------------ */
      const offset = new Array(n)
      const localSec = new Array(n)
      const tradingDay = new Array(n)
      const dateKey = new Array(n)
      const minuteOfDay = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        offset[i] = zoneOffsetSeconds(times[i], zone)
        localSec[i] = times[i] + offset[i]
        tradingDay[i] = Math.floor((localSec[i] - 64800) / 86400)
        const p = utcSecondsToZonedParts(times[i], zone)
        dateKey[i] = p.year * 10000 + p.month * 100 + p.day
        minuteOfDay[i] = p.hour * 60 + p.minute
      }
      // The CME week opens with the Sunday-evening trading day. Day 0 of the
      // 18:00-anchored day index is a Thursday, so +4 puts Sunday first.
      const weekIndex = tradingDay.map((d) => Math.floor((d + 4) / 7))

      // timestamp(tz, y, m, d, hh, mm) for the calendar day a bar falls on.
      const wallClock = (i, hour, minute, dayOffset) => {
        const dayStart = Math.floor(localSec[i] / 86400) * 86400
        const target = dayStart + dayOffset * 86400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60
        let utc = target - offset[i]
        const refined = zoneOffsetSeconds(utc, zone)
        if (refined !== offset[i]) utc = target - refined
        return utc
      }

      const inSpec = (specValue, i) => {
        if (!specValue) return false
        try {
          return inSessionAt(times[i], specValue, zone) === true
        } catch (e) {
          return false
        }
      }
      const inFutures = new Array(n)
      const inOvernight = new Array(n)
      const inRth = new Array(n)
      const inSignalWindow = new Array(n)
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        inFutures[i] = inSpec(futuresSpec, i)
        inOvernight[i] = inSpec(overnightSpec, i)
        inRth[i] = inSpec(rthSpec, i)
        inSignalWindow[i] = inSpec(signalSpec, i)
      }

      // request.security(tickerid, "1D" / "1W", [high[1], low[1]], lookahead_on)
      // folded: the previous bucket's extremes, available from its first bar.
      const previousExtremes = (bucketOf) => {
        const hi = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
        const lo = new Array(n).fill(NaN)
        let key = null
        let curHigh = -Infinity
        let curLow = Infinity
        let prevHigh = NaN
        let prevLow = NaN
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          if (bucketOf[i] !== key) {
            if (key !== null) {
              prevHigh = curHigh
              prevLow = curLow
            }
            key = bucketOf[i]
            curHigh = -Infinity
            curLow = Infinity
          }
          hi[i] = prevHigh
          lo[i] = prevLow
          if (high[i] > curHigh) curHigh = high[i]
          if (low[i] < curLow) curLow = low[i]
        }
        return [hi, lo]
      }
      const dailyExtremes = previousExtremes(tradingDay)
      const weeklyExtremes = previousExtremes(weekIndex)
      const pdhArr = dailyExtremes[0]
      const pdlArr = dailyExtremes[1]
      const pwhArr = weeklyExtremes[0]
      const pwlArr = weeklyExtremes[1]

      /* ---- higher timeframes, folded from the chart's own bars ------------ */
      const at = (arr, k) => (k >= 0 && k < arr.length && fin(arr[k]) ? arr[k] : NaN)

      const buildHtf = (minutes) => {
        const size = minutes * 60
        const bucket = new Array(n)
        const H = { time: [], open: [], high: [], low: [], close: [], volume: [], day: [] }
        let current = null
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const b = Math.floor((localSec[i] - 64800) / size)
          if (b !== current) {
            current = b
            H.time.push(times[i])
            H.open.push(open[i])
            H.high.push(high[i])
            H.low.push(low[i])
            H.close.push(close[i])
            H.volume.push(volume[i])
            H.day.push(tradingDay[i])
          } else {
            const k = H.time.length - 1
            if (high[i] > H.high[k]) H.high[k] = high[i]
            if (low[i] < H.low[k]) H.low[k] = low[i]
            H.close[k] = close[i]
            H.volume[k] += volume[i]
          }
          bucket[i] = H.time.length - 1
        }
        const m = H.close.length
        const D = {
          atr: taAtr(H.high, H.low, H.close, atrLength),
          ema20: taEma(H.close, 20),
          ema50: taEma(H.close, 50),
          rsi: taRsi(H.close, rsiLength),
          volAvg: taSma(H.volume, 20),
          highest: taHighest(H.high, htfBosLookback),
          lowest: taLowest(H.low, htfBosLookback),
          vwap: new Array(m).fill(NaN),
        }
        // ta.vwap re-anchors on the session, which for CME futures is 18:00.
        let pv = 0
        let vv = 0
        let day = null
        for (let k = 0; k < m; k++) {
          if (H.day[k] !== day) {
            day = H.day[k]
            pv = 0
            vv = 0
          }
          pv += ((H.high[k] + H.low[k] + H.close[k]) / 3) * H.volume[k]
          vv += H.volume[k]
          D.vwap[k] = vv > 0 ? pv / vv : NaN
        }
        return { bucket, H, D, payload: new Array(m).fill(null) }
      }

      const htfPayload = (tf, N) => {
        if (N < 1) return null
        if (tf.payload[N]) return tf.payload[N]
        const H = tf.H
        const D = tf.D
        const i1 = N - 1
        const i2 = N - 2
        const i3 = N - 3
        const i4 = N - 4
        const c1 = at(H.close, i1)
        const o1 = at(H.open, i1)
        const h1 = at(H.high, i1)
        const l1 = at(H.low, i1)
        const atr1 = at(D.atr, i1)
        const range1 = h1 - l1
        const body1 = Math.abs(c1 - o1)
        const bodyFraction = range1 > 0 ? body1 / range1 : 0
        const bullDisplacement = c1 > o1 && body1 >= atr1 * htfDisplacementAtr && bodyFraction >= htfDisplacementBodyFraction
        const bearDisplacement = c1 < o1 && body1 >= atr1 * htfDisplacementAtr && bodyFraction >= htfDisplacementBodyFraction
        const priorHigh = at(D.highest, i2)
        const priorLow = at(D.lowest, i2)
        const c2 = at(H.close, i2)
        const o2 = at(H.open, i2)

        let regime = 0
        const e201 = at(D.ema20, i1)
        const e501 = at(D.ema50, i1)
        const e204 = at(D.ema20, i4)
        const vwap1 = at(D.vwap, i1)
        const rsi1 = at(D.rsi, i1)
        const c4 = at(H.close, i4)
        const volAvg1 = at(D.volAvg, i1)
        const vol1 = at(H.volume, i1)
        if (c1 > e201 && e201 > e501) regime += 28
        else if (c1 < e201 && e201 < e501) regime -= 28
        if (e201 > e204) regime += 14
        else if (e201 < e204) regime -= 14
        if (c1 > vwap1) regime += 16
        else if (c1 < vwap1) regime -= 16
        if (rsi1 >= 60) regime += 16
        else if (rsi1 >= 53) regime += 8
        else if (rsi1 <= 40) regime -= 16
        else if (rsi1 <= 47) regime -= 8
        const momentum = atr1 > 0 ? (c1 - c4) / atr1 : 0
        if (momentum >= 1) regime += 16
        else if (momentum >= 0.35) regime += 8
        else if (momentum <= -1) regime -= 16
        else if (momentum <= -0.35) regime -= 8
        const volRatio = volAvg1 > 0 ? vol1 / volAvg1 : 1
        if (volRatio >= 1.2) regime += regime > 0 ? 10 : regime < 0 ? -10 : 0
        regime = Math.round(clamp(regime, -100, 100))

        const result = {
          bullFvg: l1 > at(H.high, i3),
          bullFvgTop: l1,
          bullFvgBottom: at(H.high, i3),
          bullFvgTime: at(H.time, i3),
          bearFvg: h1 < at(H.low, i3),
          bearFvgTop: at(H.low, i3),
          bearFvgBottom: h1,
          bearFvgTime: at(H.time, i3),
          bullOb: bullDisplacement && c1 > priorHigh && c2 < o2,
          bearOb: bearDisplacement && c1 < priorLow && c2 > o2,
          obTop: at(H.high, i2),
          obBottom: at(H.low, i2),
          obTime: at(H.time, i2),
          atr: atr1,
          regime,
        }
        tf.payload[N] = result
        return result
      }

      // The source computes every security call whatever the gates say: the
      // regime panel is explicitly the diagnostic that survives them.
      const htf = {}
      for (let t = 0; t < TF_LIST.length; t++) htf[TF_LIST[t]] = buildHtf(TF_LIST[t])

      /* ---- zone helpers -------------------------------------------------- */
      const timeframeRank = (tf) => (tf === '240' ? 6 : tf === '60' ? 5 : tf === '30' ? 4 : tf === '15' ? 3 : tf === '5' ? 2 : 1)
      const timeframeLabel = (tf) =>
        tf === '240' ? '4H' : tf === '60' ? '1H' : tf === '30' ? '30M' : tf === '15' ? '15M' : tf === '5' ? '5M' : executionTfLabel
      const zoneMaxLifeMinutes = (tf) =>
        tf === '240'
          ? zoneLife[240]
          : tf === '60'
            ? zoneLife[60]
            : tf === '30'
              ? zoneLife[30]
              : tf === '15'
                ? zoneLife[15]
                : tf === '5'
                  ? zoneLife[5]
                  : zoneLife.chart
      const zoneLifeMinutes = (tf, score) => {
        const maximumLife = zoneMaxLifeMinutes(tf)
        const multiplier =
          zoneLifetimeMode === 'Fixed by timeframe' ? 1 : score >= strongZoneScore ? 1 : score >= moderateZoneScore ? 0.75 : 0.5
        return Math.max(2, Math.round(maximumLife * multiplier))
      }
      // 17:00 local on the day of the timestamp itself, never on the day of the
      // bar being processed: the source derives y/m/d from the detection time,
      // so re-evaluating an old 4H zone must keep giving the same close. A zone
      // holds one detectedTime for its whole life, so memoising on it is exact.
      const sessionCloseMemo = new Map()
      const wallClockAt = (t, hour, minute, dayOffset) => {
        const off = zoneOffsetSeconds(t, zone)
        const dayStart = Math.floor((t + off) / 86400) * 86400
        const target = dayStart + dayOffset * 86400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60
        let utc = target - off
        const refined = zoneOffsetSeconds(utc, zone)
        if (refined !== off) utc = target - refined
        return utc
      }
      const futuresSessionCloseAfter = (timestamp) => {
        const cached = sessionCloseMemo.get(timestamp)
        if (cached !== undefined) return cached
        const today = wallClockAt(timestamp, 17, 0, 0)
        const result = timestamp < today ? today : wallClockAt(timestamp, 17, 0, 1)
        sessionCloseMemo.set(timestamp, result)
        return result
      }
      const zoneExpiryTime = (detectedTime, tf, score, lifetimeFactor) => {
        const safeFactor = clamp(lifetimeFactor, 0.1, 1)
        if (tf === '240' && fourHourZonesUntilSessionEnd) {
          const sessionClose = futuresSessionCloseAfter(detectedTime)
          const remaining = Math.max(120, sessionClose - detectedTime)
          return detectedTime + Math.round(remaining * safeFactor)
        }
        const baseMinutes = zoneLifeMinutes(tf, score)
        return detectedTime + Math.max(2, Math.round(baseMinutes * safeFactor)) * 60
      }
      const zoneAuthorityRaw = (tf, zoneType, top, bottom, sourceAtr) => {
        const tfPoints = tf === '240' ? 22 : tf === '60' ? 18 : tf === '30' ? 15 : tf === '15' ? 12 : tf === '5' ? 8 : 5
        const typePoints = zoneType === 'BB' ? 4 : zoneType === 'IFVG' ? 3 : zoneType === 'OB' ? 2 : 0
        const sizeAtr = sourceAtr > 0 ? Math.abs(top - bottom) / sourceAtr : 0
        const widthPoints = Math.round(clamp(sizeAtr / 0.6, 0, 1) * 4)
        return Math.min(tfPoints + typePoints + widthPoints, 30)
      }

      /* ---- engine state -------------------------------------------------- */
      const zones = []
      const activeZones = []
      const zoneIds = new Set()
      const liquidityPools = []
      const trades = []
      const pivotMarks = []
      const candidateLabels = []

      const dropActive = (z) => {
        const k = activeZones.indexOf(z)
        if (k >= 0) activeZones.splice(k, 1)
      }
      const activeTradeCount = () => {
        let count = 0
        for (let t = 0; t < trades.length; t++) if (trades[t].state === T_ACTIVE) count += 1
        return count
      }

      const registerZone = (i, zoneType, direction, tf, topValue, bottomValue, sourceTime, sourceAtrValue, lifetimeFactor) => {
        const top = Math.max(topValue, bottomValue)
        const bottom = Math.min(topValue, bottomValue)
        const sourceAtr = !fin(sourceAtrValue) // sourceAtrValue <= 0 ? atrArr[i] : sourceAtrValue
        if (!fin(top) // !fin(bottom) // !fin(sourceTime)) return
        const width = top - bottom
        const sizeAtr = fin(sourceAtr) && sourceAtr > 0 ? width / sourceAtr : NaN
        const sizeTicks = width / tick
        const id = zoneType + '/' + direction + '/' + tf + '/' + sourceTime
        const typeEnabled = zoneType === 'FVG' ? enableFvg : zoneType === 'IFVG' ? enableIfvg : zoneType === 'OB' ? enableOb : enableBb
        if (
          indicatorEnabled &&
          typeEnabled &&
          !zoneIds.has(id) &&
          fin(sizeAtr) &&
          sizeTicks >= minimumZoneTicks &&
          sizeAtr >= minimumZoneAtr &&
          sizeAtr <= maximumZoneAtr
        ) {
          const initialAuthority = zoneAuthorityRaw(tf, zoneType, top, bottom, sourceAtr)
          const detectedTime = closeTime(i)
          const zoneValue = {
            id,
            zoneType,
            sourceTf: tf,
            sourceRank: timeframeRank(tf),
            direction,
            top,
            bottom,
            midpoint: (top + bottom) * 0.5,
            sourceAtr,
